translations: 你感觉到自己被净化了。

messages.msgid: You use your flippin' face to smash the %s.  EXTREME.
translations: 你用你坚硬的脸皮猛击了 %s。太疯狂了。
你用一记强力的肘击猛击了 %s。

messages.msgid: You're visibly shaken up, and are having a hard time focusing on what's going on around you.
translations: 你明显被震晕了，很难集中精神注意到发生在你身边的事情。

messages.msgid: The pollen makes it hard to breathe!
You can't trust everything that you see.
translations: 你不能相信你所看到的一切。

messages.msgid: You sense an otherworldy danger here.
translations: 你感觉到这里有一种异界的危险。

messages.msgid: Will heal injuries all over your body.
translations: 能够治疗你全身的伤口。

messages.msgid: Reveals an area around you on the overmap.
translations: 获得你附近的大地图视野。

messages.msgid: You squat down, build up tension in your legs and release, launching yourself quite a distance.
translations: 你蹲下，双腿紧绷，然后突然松开，让自己弹跳出一段距离。

messages.msgid: A scrap of paper.  Something's written on it, scrawled in bad handwriting.
translations: 一张废纸，上面写了些字，但是太潦草了。

messages.msgid: Tucked between your back and the backpack.
Attached with a carabiner or strap.
Pouch sized for a hydration pack.
translations: 一个大小适合储水背袋的口袋。

messages.msgid: Tasty meat that has been heavily smoked for preservation.  It could be further smoked to dehydrate it completely.
translations: 一份经过烟熏处理以长期保存的美味熏肉。可进一步烟熏，使其完全脱水。

messages.msgid: A rare substance of uncertain origins.  Causes you to mutate.
translations: 一种罕见的未知来源物质，会导致你基因变异。
流亡族四足机器人（损坏）
P90 自动单兵防卫武器

messages.msgid: A late 90s manufactured personal defense weapon (PDW), this automatic firearm fires the high-velocity, proprietary 5.7x28mm cartridge.  Making use of top-mounted 50-round custom magazines which lock into the receiver of the weapon behind the grip, this little submachine gun packs quite the nasty payload.  Its small, high-speed caliber makes it excellent at both defeating armored opponents and firing short bursts manageably.
translations: 作为90年代末生产的个人防卫武器(PDW)，这把全自动枪支发射高速的5.7x28mm特制子弹。利用顶部安装的50发定制弹匣锁定在握把后的机匣中，这把小型冲锋枪火力十足。它的小型高速子弹更使其在对抗着甲目标和进行可控短连射方面表现出色。

messages.msgid: A medieval hammer with a spike on one end, made for battle.  Its odd shape and balance make it an excellent weapon, but an ineffective tool.
translations: 一把中世纪风格的战锤，一端有根尖刺。它古怪的外形和平衡使它成为一把优秀的武器，不过敲起钉子来就没有五金店里的锤子好用了。

messages.msgid: The laptop's batteries need more charge.
You stop lighting up the screen.
You've already activated the %s, try throwing it instead.
translations: 你已经激活了%s，赶紧丢出去。

messages.msgid: You've already pulled the %s's pin, try throwing it instead.
translations: 你拉下了%s的拉环，赶紧丢出去。

messages.msgid: You pull the pin on the grenade.
translations: 你拉开了手雷的保险销。

messages.msgid: A lightweight, handheld cordless circular saw.  It is currently on and the blade is spinning; use this item to turn it off.
translations: 一把轻便的手持无线圆锯。它的刃片正高速旋转。激活它来关闭。

messages.msgid: It's subtle, but your skin has definitely taken on a sickly yellow-green hue.
translations: 虽然很轻微，但你的皮肤毫无疑问正呈现病态的黄绿色。

messages.msgid: You drop down on all fours.
You come out of your quadrupedal posture.

Precise step-by-step instructions and other required data for installation of an Alarm System CBM, stored on a data card of proprietary form-factor, designed to be used extensively by an Autodoc, and allowing bionic installation with minimal failure chance.  An integrated security subroutine renders it unusable after a single installation.
translations: 一套用于安装警报系统CBM的精确到每个步骤的指令和数据，存储于特殊规格的专有数据卡中，能够用于全自动医疗仪来将CBM安装失败率降到最低。其中包含的安全子程序会使其在安装完CBM后立刻失效。

你感觉到这里有东西在动。

messages.msgid: The ancient arts of drunken brawling come naturally to you!  While under the influence of alcohol, your melee skill will rise considerably, especially unarmed combat.
translations: 古老的酒后斗殴术对你来说如同是与生俱来一般！在酒精的作用下，你的近战能力将大幅上升，尤其是徒手格斗。

messages.msgid: Gives you the power to see in the dark.
translations: 给你在黑暗中视物的能力。
创造一盏神奇的魔法阅读灯。

messages.msgid: You project a glowing white crystal of ice and it explodes on impact into a blossom of shattering cold.
translations: 你发射出一颗发光的白色冰晶，在撞击之处绽放酷寒。

messages.msgid: Heals a little bit of damage on the target.
translations: 治疗一点点目标所受的伤害。

messages.msgid: Cause a localized earthquake, knocking down enemies and overturning the earth.
translations: 造成局部地震并会击倒敌人。

messages.msgid: Your flesh and bones start to knit together before your eyes.
translations: 你的肉体和骨骼开始在你的眼前交织在一起。

messages.msgid: No illness is going to get you down now.
translations: 现在，任何疾病都不会让你倒下。

messages.msgid: Anyone who attacks you will regret it.
translations: 任何攻击你的人都会后悔的。

messages.msgid: Long thorns grow through your skin, clothes, and armor.
translations: 长长的荆棘穿过你的皮肤、衣服和盔甲。

messages.msgid: The thorns vanish without a trace, leaving your gear unharmed.
translations: 荆棘消失得无影无踪，你的装备却毫发无损。
你会感觉到一种令人愉悦的温暖。

messages.msgid: You shiver as a cool breeze hits your skin.
translations: 一阵凉风拂过，你不禁打了个寒颤。

messages.msgid: Your body will not be corrupted by these vile substances.
translations: 你的身体不会被这些邪恶的物质腐蚀。

messages.msgid: Your range of motion is greatly increased.
translations: 你的活动范围大大增加了。

messages.msgid: You arms are as bendy as rubber.
translations: 你的胳膊像橡胶一样有弹性。

messages.msgid: Your limbs creak as they lose their flexibility.
translations: 你的四肢因失去灵活性而吱吱作响。

messages.msgid: You can see in the dark.
The night doesn't seem so dark anymore.
translations: 夜晚对你不再是一片黑暗。

messages.msgid: The darkness of the night rushes in again.
You feel a prickle as your wounds ache.
translations: 你的伤口疼痛难忍，感到一阵阵刺痛。

messages.msgid: You can pick out even minute details.
translations: 即使是微小的细节，你也能挑出端倪。

messages.msgid: Distant objects loose their magical clarity.
translations: 远处的物体失去了神奇的清晰度。

messages.msgid: You can eat toxic or spoiled food without penalty.  You still should not eat zombie meat.
translations: 你可以食用有毒或变质的食物而不会受到惩罚。 但还是不能吃丧尸肉。

messages.msgid: Something in your mouth tastes foul.
translations: 你嘴里的东西味道很臭。

messages.msgid: You are being rapidly sobered up.
Your head pounds, but you feel much more alert.
translations: 你的头 "砰砰 "直跳，但却感觉精神了许多。

messages.msgid: You are in contact with iron.  It will cause you pain and discomfort until removed.
translations: 你正接触着铁器，在将其移开前，它会持续给你带来痛苦与不适。

messages.msgid: As the iron touches you, your skin begins to burn.
translations: 铁器触及之处，你的皮肤传来一阵灼痛。

messages.msgid: The burning from the iron finally fades.
translations: 铁器带来的灼痛感终于消退了。

messages.msgid: You are in contact with steel.  It will cause you pain and discomfort until removed.
translations: 你正接触着钢材，在将其移开前，它会持续给你带来痛苦与不适。

messages.msgid: As the steel touches you, your skin begins to itch.
translations: 钢材触及之处，你的皮肤传来一阵瘙痒。

messages.msgid: The itching from the steel finally fades.
translations: 钢材带来的瘙痒感终于消退了。

messages.msgid: Your sight adjusts to the darkness.
translations: 你的视力开始适应黑暗。

messages.msgid: The roots and vines wither up and die.
Your speed is boosted to superhuman levels!
translations: 你的速度被提升到超人的水平！

messages.msgid: You return to your normal speed.
translations: 你速度的回到正常水平。

messages.msgid: Immunity to bleeding and bites, increased stamina regeneration, increased hunger and thirst gain.
translations: 对流血和咬伤免疫，增加耐力重生速度，饥渴增长速度。

messages.msgid: The tension running through your flesh fades.
translations: 你感到血肉中的紧绷感消退了。

messages.msgid: The energy in your body fades away.
translations: 你身体里的能量消失了。

messages.msgid: The fog shields you from sight.
The wind around you dies down.
You are immune to heat and fire.
You add the locations to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了一些地点。

messages.msgid: A magical light source that will light up a small area.
translations: 一盏魔法灯，能照亮一小块区域。

messages.msgid: You have a majestic crown of antlers.
translations: 你生出了一顶雄伟的鹿角王冠。

messages.msgid: You become more graceful, agile, and coordinated.
translations: 你会变得更优雅、更敏捷、更协调。

messages.msgid: The secrets of the living earth are revealed to you.
translations: 生命土地将向你揭示它的秘密。

messages.msgid: Flap your wings and fly upward.
You are able to store more mana in your body than usual.
translations: 你可以在你的身体里储存比正常多的魔力。

messages.msgid: You are able to store a lot more mana in your body than usual.
translations: 你可以在你的身体里储存比正常多很多的魔力。

messages.msgid: You aren't where you seem to be.
translations: 你似乎不在你所在的地方。

messages.msgid: You were born with an allergy to iron and, to a lesser extent, steel.  Wearing or touching anything made of iron or steel will cause you pain and discomfort.
translations: 你天生对铁过敏，对钢的过敏程度会轻一点。穿戴或接触任何由铁或钢制成的东西都会让你感到疼痛和不适。

messages.msgid: You can transform yourself into a deer.
%1$s's body jets fire and heat out from the wound.

translations: 世界恢复到了正常速度。
你的灵行走在此世界之上。

messages.msgid: Your feet touch the ground once again.
translations: 你的双脚再次落回地面。

messages.msgid: You snap out of your trance.
Your steps are normal once again.
translations: 你的步伐回到了正常水平。

messages.msgid: Your body, lying on the ground while your spirit walks free.  Hopefully nothing happens to it while you're gone.
translations: 你的身体，躺在地上，而你的灵魂自由行走。希望你离开的这段时间里没发生什么事。

messages.msgid: A thin silver cord, stretching off into the distance, connecting you to your body.  You could follow it back to return.
translations: 一根银色细绳，延伸到远处，将你与身体连接起来。你可以跟着它回去。

messages.msgid: A brown jumpsuit with OA written in big yellow block letters on the back.
translations: 一件棕色连身衣，背面写着OA两个黄色大写字母。

messages.msgid: A black jumpsuit with white symbol "υ" on the back.
translations: 黑色连身裤，背面有白色符号“υ”。

messages.msgid: A black jumpsuit with white symbol "ϴ" on the back.
translations: 黑色连身裤，背面有白色符号“ϴ”。

messages.msgid: A black jumpsuit with white symbol "ν" on the back.
translations: 背面印有白色符号ν的黑色连体裤。

messages.msgid: A black jumpsuit with white symbol "τ" on the back.
translations: 背面印有白色符号τ的黑色连体裤。

messages.msgid: Follow the silver cord back to your body.
translations: 跟随系魂银带返回你的身体。

messages.msgid: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>cold iron damage</info>.
translations: 这件装备能 <good>完全保护</good> 你 <info>不受寒钢伤害</info>。

messages.msgid: This thing was crafted by a mad inventor.  It is very unstable and will rapidly degrade without an inventor's presence.
translations: 这件物品由疯狂天才制造。它非常不稳定，如果不由疯狂天才使用，它会迅速退化。

messages.msgid: This weapon is primarily or mostly made of wood.
translations: 这件武器主要或大部分由木头制成。

messages.msgid: This character cannot be affected by Arvore pollens.
translations: 该角色不会受到木灵花粉的影响。

messages.msgid: This gear will transform you into animal form, and may have some side effects.
translations: 这件装备会将你转化为野兽形态，并可能带来一些副作用。

messages.msgid: This item has a <good>charm</good> on it.
This weapon does <good>extra damage</good> against creatures of the <info>Nether</info>.
translations: 此武器对<info>幽冥生物</info>有<good>额外杀伤力</good>。

messages.msgid: You are immune to the evil eye.
You are immune to adverse affects on your timeline.
translations: 你免疫对自身时间线的不利影响。
泰兹卡特里波卡之血（烟雾镜）

messages.msgid: An urban fantasy content mod for Agent Mulder in the apocalypse.  Creates a multi decade timeline of dimensional spillage prior to the Cataclysm.  This spillage was characterized by thin places appearing where people could step through into another dimension, but things from those dimensions could wander into our world as well.  XEDRA proliferated into an alphabet soup of agencies dedicated to simultaneously stopping, controlling, and utilizing these thin places with varying degrees of success.  Contains monsters of various types, new professions and locations, new uses for existing skills,the new deduction skill, new magic systems, and content of every type that a multidimensional Cataclysm has to offer.  This is a heavily science-fantasy mod where you are as likely to encounter supernatural monsters as you are UFOs, Sasquatch, and Chupacabra.  Please examine the readme.md file for further details.
translations: 这是一个以都市奇幻为主题的mod，为穆德探员（电视剧《X档案》主角）而设。为大灾变发生前的时间线加入已经持续数十年的维度溢出。这种溢出分隔了一些比较薄弱的地点，人们可以通过这些地点进入另一个维度，但来自这些维度的东西也会闯入我们的世界。XEDRA扩张成了一大坨官僚部门，同时负责阻止、控制、使用这些薄弱地点，有成功也有失败。本模组包含各种类型的怪物、新的职业和地点、现有技能的新用途、新的推理技能、新的魔法系统，以及多维度大灾变所能提供的各种类型的内容。这是一款科学奇幻色彩浓厚的 MOD，在这里你很可能会遇到超自然怪物，也很可能会遇到不明飞行物、大脚野人和卓柏卡布拉。详情请查看readme.md文件。

messages.msgid: Very basic familiarity with various types of alien creatures.
translations: 对各种外星生物非常基本的了解。

messages.msgid: It's particularly difficult to turn daydreams and moonlight into clothing, but you seem to have gotten the hang of it.
translations: 要想将白梦与月光等材料编制成衣服是很困难的，但你似乎确实掌握了这种技术。

messages.msgid: Even the Bright Lords would bid on your clothing if they found it at a Goblin Market.
translations: 即使是光明领主，如果他们在哥布林市场找到你的衣服，也会出价购买。

messages.msgid: The trees always hearken to your voice and wood practically molds itself like clay in your hands.
translations: 林木总是会聆听你的声音，木材在你手中也温顺如泥，任你塑造。

messages.msgid: Not only can you create furniture and other large constructs using treesinging, you can mold treesung wood into weapons and armor as well.
translations: 你不仅能用树咏之术创造家具和其他大型结构，还能将咏成之木塑造成武器和防具。

messages.msgid: Your ability to see the pattern behind a series of data points.  Allows you to ask questions that you otherwise couldn't ask and find things you might have missed otherwise.
translations: 你透过一系列数据点看到其中隐含模式的能力。能让你提出原本无法提出的问题，找到原本可能错过的内容。

messages.msgid: You can't even think yourself out of a paper bag.
translations: 你连怎么从纸袋里钻出来都想不明白。

messages.msgid: You get the gist of playing a round of chess.
translations: 你对象棋的玩法略知一二。

messages.msgid: You realized that one weird tabloid paper you've read a long time ago might have been correct all this time.
translations: 你意识到很久以前读过的一份古怪小报，其内容可能一直都是正确的。

messages.msgid: You probably know how to deduce an electronic lock's password.
translations: 你大概知道如何推断出电子锁的密码。

messages.msgid: You can easily rule out non-magickal causes in a given situation.
translations: 在特定情况下，你总能轻易排除非魔法因素的干扰。

messages.msgid: You're aware of more supernatural happenings than everyone else.
translations: 你知晓的超自然事件远比常人要多。

messages.msgid: You know even what you don't know.
You can't even solve a simple Sudoku puzzle.
translations: 你连简单的数独都解不出来。

messages.msgid: You can deduce the whereabouts of your missing item in your house.
translations: 你能推断出家里丢失物品的下落。

messages.msgid: You solve murder mysteries in the first chapter.
translations: 谋杀悬案小说，你总能在第一章就找出凶手。

messages.msgid: You can figure out the workings of the world mundane and supernatural from some observations.
translations: 仅凭些许观察，你便能洞悉凡俗与超凡世界的运作规律。

messages.msgid: You're basically modern day Sherlock Holmes.
translations: 你基本上就是当代的夏洛克·福尔摩斯。

messages.msgid: No secret is safe from you.
translations: 在你面前，没有秘密可言。

messages.msgid: Even the unknowable unknowns are known to you.
translations: 对你而言，就连那“不可知之未知”也尽在掌握。

messages.msgid: Stolen blood is boosting your speed enormously.
translations: 窃取的血液正极大提升着你的速度。

messages.msgid: You are more buoyant than before.  This will make swimming much easier.
translations: 你比浮力更大了。这将使游泳变得更加容易。

messages.msgid: You are surrounded by an eldritch glow.
translations: 你被一道奇异的光芒笼罩。

messages.msgid: The ache from your wounds finally fades.
translations: 你伤口的疼痛终于消退了。

messages.msgid: Your wound closes up and covers over instantly.
translations: 你的伤口立刻闭合并被盖住了。

messages.msgid: You have contracted an interdimensional disease, specifically Blood Spiders.  Symptoms can be alleviated by medication (antiparasitic).
translations: 你感染了一种异界疾病，具体学名叫血蛛病。通过抗寄生虫药物治疗可以缓解症状。

messages.msgid: The world is beautiful and breathtaking but maybe also terrifying.
translations: 这个世界既美丽的，令人惊叹，但也可能是可怕的。

messages.msgid: The colors brighten and your vision sharpens.
translations: 色彩愈发鲜艳，你的视觉也变得敏锐起来。

messages.msgid: The world becomes a duller place.
translations: 这个世界又变得如之前一般沉闷。

messages.msgid: Your vision suddenly feels as if it shifted down and to the left.
translations: 你的视野突然感觉好像向左下方移动了。

messages.msgid: You are viewing the world as if from an orchestra pit.
translations: 你觉得自己看着世界就像是一个管弦乐队一样。

messages.msgid: You feel your body moves mirrored to the thoughts in your head.
translations: 你觉得自己的身体运动好像和你头脑中的想法正好相反。

messages.msgid: The hum in your bones subsides.
translations: 你骨头里的嗡嗡声消失了。

messages.msgid: Your body accepts your presence once more.
translations: 你的身体重新接受了你的存在。

messages.msgid: A mirror cracks in the distance.
translations: 远处仿佛有面镜子裂开了。

messages.msgid: Your body is dimly covered in ephemeral flames.
translations: 你的身体被短暂的火焰模糊地覆盖着。

messages.msgid: The flames sometimes obstruct your vision, yet you feel no pain from them.
translations: 火焰有时会挡住你的视线，但你却感觉不到任何疼痛。

messages.msgid: You body shines like a lit beacon.
translations: 你的身体像灯塔一样耀眼。
火焰让你无法集中精力。

messages.msgid: You are flatter and less real in ways that makes you less susceptible to damage.
translations: 你变得更加扁平、更加虚幻，这让你不易受到伤害。

messages.msgid: You have an incredibly amazing idea.  You think you should <color_yellow>research</color> it.
translations: 你有了个超棒的点子。你觉得你应该<color_yellow>研究</color>它。

messages.msgid: You've got a few theories you'd like to explore.  Grab a laptop, a cup of coffee, and <color_yellow>research</color> it like a proper scientist.
translations: 你有了几个想研究的理论。找个笔记本电脑，加上一杯咖啡，像个正经科学家一样<color_yellow>研究</color>它。

messages.msgid: Your brain can't hold any more brilliance.  To the <color_yellow>research</color> table!
translations: 你的大脑无法承受更多的智慧，快去<color_yellow>研究</color>！

messages.msgid: A great idea has illuminated your mind, it's probably a good time to pick up your laptop and do some calculations.
translations: 一个好点子点亮了你的头脑，现在也许是拿起笔记本电脑计算一下的好时机。

messages.msgid: You have recently realized a new alchemical recipe and your thoughts are scattered.
translations: 你刚发明了一个炼金配方，如今思绪混乱。

messages.msgid: Your mind feels normal enough that you could focus on new alchemy ideas once again.
translations: 你感觉现在思想足够正常，可以再次专注于新的炼金术研究。

messages.msgid: Sometimes the world nearby twists.  Was it you?
translations: 有时附近的世界扭曲了。是你吗？

messages.msgid: Sometimes you hear an odd noise, like a whisper.
translations: 你偶尔会听到奇怪的声响，仿佛一声低语。

messages.msgid: You feel someone's presences.  They are wondering.
translations: 你感觉到某个存在。它们正在好奇。

messages.msgid: Random voices jump into your head from time to time.  Most of them are friendly.
translations: 时不时会有各种声音闯入你的脑海，其中大部分都很友好。

messages.msgid: You clearly feel the otherworldly presence.  They are ready to help you.
translations: 你清晰地感觉到异界存在。它们准备好帮助你了。

messages.msgid: The darkness loses its shape and your eyes return to their usual hue.
translations: 黑暗失去了它的形状，你所见之处恢复成往常的色彩。

messages.msgid: Is there any point to forward movement?
translations: 还有任何前进的意义吗？

messages.msgid: The air around you chills as existence loses its appeal!
translations: 你周围的空气变冷了，生存对你也失去了吸引力！

messages.msgid: The weight is lifted from your mind and the air warms.
translations: 重负从你的脑海中消失，空气重新变得温暖。

messages.msgid: Heightened levels of organosulfur compounds, mercury, and silver.
translations: 有机硫化合物、汞和银的含量升高。

messages.msgid: Patient has had extensive battlefield blood transfusions.  Serious risk of bloodborne infections.
translations: 患者曾接受过大量战场输血，存在严重的血源性感染风险。

messages.msgid: These magickal trucker pills have kicked in and you feel great!
translations: 这些魔法大力丸起效了，你感觉棒极了！

messages.msgid: You shouldn't have taken this many pills.  Your skin flushes and your nerves feel like they are on fire.
translations: 你真不该吃这么多药丸。你的皮肤开始发烫，神经如同灼烧。

messages.msgid: Your heartbeat doesn't feel normal.  Why on earth did you take more of these pills?
translations: 你的心跳不太对劲。你究竟是为什么还要吃这种药？

messages.msgid: This might just be it, the big one.  With no hospital available you're just going to have to ride it straight through Hell.
translations: 这回恐怕就是它了，那要命的玩意儿。附近又没有医院，你只能硬着头皮闯过这道鬼门关了。

messages.msgid: These magickal trucker pills have worn off and you feel rough.  It might be best to go ahead and sleep through the hangover as best you can.
translations: 这些神奇的大力丸已经失效，你感觉很难受。 最好的办法可能是先睡一觉，尽可能地度过宿醉期。

messages.msgid: Aside from any leftover pain and damage that was done to your body by overdosing your feeling pretty good now.
translations: 除了残留的疼痛和药物过量对身体造成的伤害，你现在感觉很好。

messages.msgid: Your heartbeat slows into a somewhat normal rhythm but your skin is still on fire.
translations: 你的心跳逐渐减慢，节奏稍稍正常，但皮肤仍然火辣辣的。

messages.msgid: The pain in your chest subsides but your heart is still beating in a concerning fashion.
translations: 胸口的疼痛感减弱了，但心脏仍在令人担忧地跳动。

messages.msgid: Patient has dangerous levels of multiple chemicals in their blood.  Sedation and restraint suggested.
translations: 患者血液内多种化学物质含量已达危险水平，建议施以镇静并加以约束。

messages.msgid: Patient has multiple byproducts in blood stream suggesting extended drug binge.
translations: 患者血液中含有多种副产物，表明其曾长期滥用药物。

messages.msgid: Your vision twists a little after drinking that Fae blood.
translations: 喝下那妖精之血后，你的视野有些扭曲。

messages.msgid: Your vision starts distorting a little more as you drink the Fae blood.
translations: 随着你饮下更多妖精之血，你的视野开始进一步扭曲。

messages.msgid: Your vision starts seeing things that aren't there as you drink the Fae blood.
translations: 饮下妖精之血后，你的眼前开始出现种种幻象。

messages.msgid: Drinking that much Fae blood has left your vision almost unable to differentiate between reality and illusion.
translations: 饮下海量妖精之血后，你的双眼已近乎无法分辨现实与幻觉。

messages.msgid: Your vision is almost back to normal.
translations: 你的视觉几乎恢复正常了。

messages.msgid: You stopped seeing things, but your vision still twists and deforms what you see.
translations: 你不再看见幻象，但你眼中的景象依旧扭曲变形。

messages.msgid: Your ability to differentiate what is real and what isn't is a little better now.
translations: 你分辨现实与虚幻的能力略有恢复。

messages.msgid: You have poisoned your own blood!
Your blood turns to acid and melts through your body.
translations: 你的血液转变为酸，流遍身体将你溶解。

messages.msgid: Your complexion is wan and spent.
Your skin is pale and your eyes are thoroughly bloodshot.
translations: 你的皮肤苍白，双眼极度充血。

messages.msgid: Your skin is pale and your eyes have turned dark red.  You feel a constant hunger, like the food you eat is no longer nourishing you.
translations: 你的皮肤变得苍白眼睛转为深红色。你感到持续的饥饿感，就像你所吃的食物不再为你提供营养一样。

messages.msgid: You feel the blood rushing from the wound and then a pressure that reminds you of backwash.
translations: 你感到血从伤口中涌出，然后有一种像回流的压力。

messages.msgid: Your iris slowly turns red from the outside in.
translations: 你的虹膜从内而外地缓慢变红。

messages.msgid: There is an emptiness in your stomach and soul that can no longer be filled with mortal joys.
translations: 你的五脏六腑与灵魂深处都充斥着空虚，那是凡间的欢愉再也无法填满的。

messages.msgid: You succumb to your deadly necrotic condition.
translations: 你死于致命的坏死症状。

messages.msgid: Unknown RNA virus is rewriting sampled blood cells.
translations: 未知的RNA病毒正在重写采样血细胞。

messages.msgid: Your skin is deathly white and will redden and burn when exposed to the sun.
translations: 你的皮肤如尸体般苍白，当暴露在太阳下时会发红并烧伤。

messages.msgid: You've chosen to embrace this illness and enhance your curse.
translations: 你选择拥抱这疾病，增强你的诅咒。

messages.msgid: Blood sample contains numerous unidentified mutations and numerous blood sources.  Original host blood unidentifiable in the mix.
translations: 血样中含有大量不明突变与多种血液来源，混合物中已无法辨别出原始宿主的血液。

messages.msgid: Your skin is deathly white, your eyes are solid red except for a huge pupil, the only food you can consume is human blood, and if sunlight hits you that part of your body instantly burns.
translations: 你的皮肤同死人般泛白，眼中除了巨大的眼瞳外尽溢血红，你今后仅以人血为生，若是行于阳光之下，被太阳照射的部位便会化为灰烬。

messages.msgid: Becoming a monster is a matter of degrees until one day it isn't and you can no longer remember why morality seemed important.
translations: 成为怪物是个循序渐进的过程，直到有一天，当你记不起道德为何物时，也就完全沦为了怪物。

messages.msgid: The absence of raw blood from your diet has left you wan, pale and uncomfortable.
translations: 你的饮食中缺乏生肉，让你变得苍白、无精打采、不舒服。

messages.msgid: Your body is weakened and your need to feed is a constant pain in your chest.
translations: 你的身体虚弱，需要进食的欲望在你的胸口带来持续的痛苦。

messages.msgid: Severe blood deficiency has left you looking emaciated no matter what your weight is.
translations: 严重的血液不足让你看起来瘦弱不堪，无论你的体重是多少。

messages.msgid: One day blood may spill on your lips and wake you from your slumber, but until then you are a corpse.
translations: 有一天，鲜血可能会溅到你的嘴唇上，将你从沉睡中唤醒，但在那之前，你只是一具尸体。

messages.msgid: Most of your thoughts now revolve around blood, how good it tastes and where you might find it.
translations: 现在你大部分的思绪都围绕着血液，它的美味以及你可能会在哪里找到它
你的嗜血欲望已经得到满足。

messages.msgid: You've almost consumed enough blood to feel normal again.
translations: 你已经几乎喝够血液以恢复正常了。

messages.msgid: More blood and you'll start to feel even better.
translations: 多点血液，你会感觉更好。
严重进行性贫血性自噬

messages.msgid: You are having your blood drunk by a vampire and are still in a swoon.
translations: 你正被一个吸血鬼吸食血液，仍处于昏迷状态。

messages.msgid: Your blood hums with power, allowing you to access more of your vampiric abilities.
translations: 你的血液中力量奔涌，让你能施展更多吸血鬼异能。

messages.msgid: You have used up much of the power in your blood, and are slightly listless as a result.  In addition, some of your vampiric powers will not function as well, or at all, until the power returns to your blood.
translations: 你耗尽了血液中的诸多力量，因而精神萎靡。在你血中之力恢复前，你的一些吸血鬼异能会效果大减，甚至完全失效。

messages.msgid: Your thoughts keep going back to the taste of warm, fresh blood.
translations: 温热鲜血的滋味总是在你脑海中挥之不去。

messages.msgid: You have the strength of the damned.
You have the fortitude of the grave.
translations: 你拥有如坟墓般的冷漠坚毅。

messages.msgid: You can still taste the warm blood on your lips.  You feel amazing.
translations: 你唇间似乎还残留着温热的血味，这感觉妙不可言。

messages.msgid: You can move so quickly you might even be able to dodge bullets.
translations: 你的动作迅捷无伦，甚至可能快过子弹。

messages.msgid: You are clouding nearby minds and are harder to spot in dim light or darkness.
translations: 你正在蒙蔽周遭的心智，在昏暗或黑暗中更难被察觉。

messages.msgid: You end your imitation of death.
You've been caught, and they know you aren't dead
translations: 你被识破了，他们知道你没有死。

messages.msgid: You just can't seem to move or think.
translations: 你仿佛动弹不得，也无法思考。

messages.msgid: You snap out of your fugue.
You recently discovered a gift of the blood.  Until you've experimented with it and tested your new powers, further research will be fruitless.
translations: 你最近发现了一项血之恩赐。在完全掌握并测试此项新能力之前，进一步的探索将是徒劳的。

messages.msgid: You're sure you could try to learn a new blood gift now.
translations: 你确信现在可以尝试领悟一项新的血礼了。

messages.msgid: You ate a whole dreamdross ingot.  It is too much for your body, but for a while you are much <color_green>stronger</color>, and <color_green>recover from traumas</color> faster.
translations: 你吃下了一整块浮梦锭。超过了你能吸收的量，但在接下来的一段时间内，你<color_green>更强壮</color>，<color_green>伤口愈合</color>更快。

messages.msgid: A huge warm wave moves from your stomach through your body.
translations: 一股巨大的暖流从腹部涌向全身。

messages.msgid: You feel a deep energy in your muscles, exuberant and coiled.
translations: 你感受到肌肉中的深层能量，充满活力且紧绷。

messages.msgid: Your reaction speed turns back to normal.
translations: 你的反应速度回落至常态。

messages.msgid: Take the blows.  <color_red>Don't let the world kill you</color>.  Your skin can stop a few attacks.
translations: 承受打击。<color_red>别让世界杀死你</color>。你的皮肤可以阻止一些攻击。

messages.msgid: Your sense of touch is blunted for a bit, but your skin feels more dense.
translations: 你的触觉迟钝少许，但你感觉皮肤更加紧实。

messages.msgid: Your body is a tool of destruction.  <color_red>Use it effectively</color>.  Your attacks are faster and deadlier, and your dodging ability is better.
translations: 你的身体是毁灭的工具。<color_red>有效地使用它</color>。你的攻击更快更致命，你的躲避能力也更好。

messages.msgid: You can feel a bubbling energy in your muscles.
translations: 你可以感受到肌肉中涌动的能量。

messages.msgid: The feelings in your muscles subside.
translations: 你肌肉中的感觉消退了。

messages.msgid: You feel your legs are much longer now.
translations: 现在你感觉你的腿更长了。

messages.msgid: Your body shrinks back into its normal space.
translations: 你的身体回缩到了正常占比。

messages.msgid: You are the only who can control your body now.
translations: 现在你是唯一能控制自己身体的人。

messages.msgid: External forces apply to your body again.
translations: 外力再次作用于你的身体。
你喝了土妖精命运药水。

messages.msgid: You consumed a large amount of Ierde destiny draught.
translations: 你消耗了大量的土妖精命运药水。

messages.msgid: You consumed a life-changing amount of Ierde destiny draught.
translations: 你饮用了足以改变一生的土妖精命运药水

messages.msgid: Anomalous silicon content in blood sample
translations: 血液样本中硅含量异常

messages.msgid: <color_green>Nothing can slow you down</color>, and your <color_red>pain</color> sensations are dull.
translations: <color_green>没有什么可以让你慢下来</color>， 你的<color_red>疼痛感</color>也会变得迟钝。
肯定有什么地方不对劲。

messages.msgid: You were not born to crawl beneath the dirt like a mole.  You need to get out to the open sky.
translations: 你生来就不是像鼹鼠一样在地下泥土中匍匐，你需要重归广阔的天空。

messages.msgid: You've broken one of the ancient laws that bind the fae and are suffering thereby.
translations: 你违反了一条束缚精灵的古老法则并因此而受苦。

messages.msgid: You are in contact with iron, the ancient bane of the fae.  It will cause you pain and discomfort until removed.
translations: 你接触了铁，妖精的古老禁忌。这会导致你疼痛且不适直到你将它取下。

messages.msgid: You are in contact with steel, the closest material to iron, the ancient bane of the fae.  It will cause you pain and discomfort until removed.
translations: 你正接触着钢，最接近铁的物质，妖精自古以来的克星。在移除它之前，这会给你带来疼痛与不适。

messages.msgid: As the steel touches you, your skin begins to burn.
translations: 当钢触碰到你时，你的皮肤开始被灼烧。

messages.msgid: The burning from the steel finally fades.
translations: 钢造成的灼痛感终于消退了。

messages.msgid: As the iron touches you, your skin begins to itch fiercely.
translations: 当铁触碰到你时，你的皮肤开始剧烈地发痒。

messages.msgid: The itch from the iron finally fades.
translations: 铁造成的瘙痒感终于消退了。

messages.msgid: You are in tune with the natural world, drawing strength from it and calming natural animals.
translations: 你与自然世界融为一体，从中汲取力量并安抚自然动物。

messages.msgid: You can feel the lifeblood of nature all around, welcoming you as kin.
translations: 你可以感受到周围大自然的生命，像亲人一样欢迎你。
你与自然的交流逐渐消失。

messages.msgid: Roots and vines clutch at you.
translations: 树根和藤蔓紧紧抓住你。

messages.msgid: You are filled with the vitality of nature.
translations: 你充满了大自然的活力。

messages.msgid: You can feel the power of nature flowing through you.
translations: 你可以感受到自然的力量在你身上流动。

messages.msgid: The power of nature fades from you.
translations: 自然的力量从你身上消失。

messages.msgid: You can bring forth a fine bunch of seeds, ready for planting.
translations: 你可以催生出一大捧优质的种子，随时可以播种。

messages.msgid: You were reborn and your soul and new body are still finding their balance.
translations: 你重生了，你的灵魂和新身体仍在寻找平衡。

messages.msgid: You are emitting a pollen that will weaken and disorient your enemies.
translations: 你播撒着花粉，它会削弱并迷惑你的敌人。

messages.msgid: You broke the pact of the green and have no more protection from the triffids' wrath.
translations: 你违背了绿之约，从此再无庇护，要直面三尖树的愤怒了。

messages.msgid: It's very hard for you to move.
It's easier for you to move again.
translations: 现在你再动起来就容易多了。

messages.msgid: Drawing on the immobility of the mountain, you are resilient but rooted in place.
translations: 你汲取山岳的沉稳之力，身躯坚不可摧，但也因此在原地生根。

messages.msgid: Your skin is much harder than it appears.
translations: 你的皮肤比看起来坚硬得多。

messages.msgid: The magicks reinforcing your skin vanish.
translations: 重塑你皮肤的魔力消失了。

messages.msgid: You are protected by the living earth.
translations: 你正受到活化大地的庇护。
你的土盾最终崩解消散。

messages.msgid: You are sensing the movements of nearby creatures upon the living earth.
translations: 你正在感知附近生物在地面上的活动。

messages.msgid: Nearby creatures' movements are revealed to you.
translations: 你察觉到附近生物的动向。

messages.msgid: You're just this guy, you know?
translations: 你知道的吧？你就是那个人。

messages.msgid: Nearby enemies twitch and start turning towards you.
translations: 你身边的敌人吃了一惊，转向了你。

messages.msgid: It's time for a study session
You were just on the cusp of something as your enhanced focus fades.
translations: 你正刚登上思考的顶峰，你超人的专注力便恢复如初。

messages.msgid: You have transferred your essence into a human, saving yourself at the expense of their being.  It will take some time until you can do this again.
translations: 你已将自己的精魂转移到一个人类身上，夺取其躯体为自己保命。你需要一段时间来恢复，才能再次施展。

messages.msgid: You are walking through the air.
Your burning internal organs are making it more difficult to aim.
translations: 你燃烧的内脏使得它变得更加难以被瞄准。

messages.msgid: Your impurities are being seared away!
translations: 你体内不纯之物正被灼烧！

messages.msgid: You are filled with transcendent flame.
All of your weakness boils away in the heat of the flames!
translations: 你所有的虚弱随着火焰的热量升腾而去！

messages.msgid: As the heat leaves you, pain rushes in to take its place.
translations: 随着热量消散，疼痛再一次袭来。
你的速度神奇的增加了。

messages.msgid: You are filled with burning vigor.
You are throwing off a large amount of heat.
The air around you heats up.
translations: 你身边的空气被烧热了。

messages.msgid: The air around you cools down.
translations: 你身边的空气不再那么灼热。

messages.msgid: Like the phoenix, you have been reborn.
translations: 就像不死鸟那样，你浴火重生。

messages.msgid: Like the phoenix, the flames are renewing your flesh.
translations: 火焰重塑你的肉身，你如一只不死鸟。

messages.msgid: The aftereffects of the phoenix fire finally fade.
translations: 不死鸟咒的副作用终于消散了。

messages.msgid: While you may just be dreaming, you are still capable of affecting the world.
translations: 你可能身在梦中，但仍可影响现实。

messages.msgid: You have transformed yourself into a cloud of smoke.
translations: 你变换身姿，化为一团烟雾。

messages.msgid: Your body falls apart into billowing smoke!
translations: 你的身体四散，化为滚滚浓烟！

messages.msgid: You reconstruct yourself from the smoke.
translations: 你由烟雾转回正常形态。

messages.msgid: You are walking on the winds.
Your strikes cut the air and carry on to your foes.
translations: 你的攻击能切开空气，余势不止，直击敌身。

messages.msgid: Your blows no longer split the air itself.
translations: 你的攻击不再能劈开空气了。

messages.msgid: The winds are swirling around you and slowing you down!
translations: 风在你的四周盘旋，使你减速！

messages.msgid: A wind swirls up around you, slowing you.
translations: 风在你的四周盘旋，使你减速。

messages.msgid: You steps are buoyed up by the winds.
The winds around you die down.
You are mist and cloud and wind.

translations: 你的身体又一次回归固态。
你的动作超乎人类，犹如流体。

messages.msgid: You are surrounded by a thin shell of acidic mist.
translations: 一层稀薄的酸雾包围着你。

messages.msgid: The acidic mist around you dissipates.
Currents of aetherial water are hindering your movements.
translations: 以太水流正阻碍着你的行动。

messages.msgid: You feel like you're wading through a rushing river!
translations: 你感觉就像在湍急的河流中跋涉！

messages.msgid: The drag on your movements is gone.
translations: 你行动时的滞涩感消失了。

messages.msgid: Like the whistling wind or the supple willow, you can easily move when danger beckons.  The spell has greatly reduced effect if not outside (if Sylph) or not on natural terrain (if Arvore).
translations: 你如同呼啸的风、柔韧的柳条，在危难降临时可以轻松自如地移动。若你（风妖精）不身处室外，或你（木灵）不立于自然之地，此法术效果将大打折扣。

messages.msgid: Your enhanced dodging ability fades away.
translations: 你的强化躲避效果褪去。

messages.msgid: You can sense nearby creatures that come from under the hill.
translations: 你能感知到附近来自山丘之下的存在。
你能感知到附近的吸血鬼。
你侦测到此处有一名吸血鬼。

messages.msgid: You rubbed the paste of blood and herbs and ashes on your eyes.  It stings.  A lot.
translations: 你将那混有血液、草药与灰烬的膏体涂抹在双眼上，一阵剧烈的刺痛传来。

messages.msgid: Your foot seems to keep finding just the right place to step.
translations: 你的双脚仿佛总能找到最合适的落点。

messages.msgid: Your wounds are healing more quickly, as long as you don't do too much to upset the charm.
translations: 只要你不做出什么会干扰到咒法效果的举动，你的伤口就会愈合得更快。

messages.msgid: Blood easily stops flowing under your touch.
translations: 你的触摸能轻易止住血流。

messages.msgid: The waters are bearing you up.
Your mind is set in order, walled and guarded.
translations: 你的心智井然有序，如同高墙守卫，固若金汤。

messages.msgid: You're starting to get used to being an animal.  Even enjoy it.
translations: 你开始习惯于化身为兽，甚至乐在其中。

你的隐形咒法已然失效。

messages.msgid: Your invisibility charm is about to fade.
translations: 你的隐形咒法即将失效。

messages.msgid: You consumed a large amount of Arvore destiny draught.
translations: 你消耗了大量的木灵命运药水。

messages.msgid: You consumed a life-changing amount of Arvore destiny draught.
translations: 你饮用了改变生活的木灵命运药水。

messages.msgid: Anomalous chlorophyll content in blood sample
translations: 血液样本中叶绿素含量异常
你服用了一份木灵炼金药剂。

messages.msgid: You consumed a large amount of Arvore alchemical draught.
translations: 你服用了大量的木灵炼金药剂。

messages.msgid: You consumed a life-changing amount of Arvore alchemical draught.
translations: 你服用了足以改变一生的木灵炼金药剂。
你喝了水妖精命运药水。

messages.msgid: You consumed a large amount of Undine destiny draught.
translations: 你消耗了大量的水妖精命运药水。

messages.msgid: You consumed a life-changing amount of Undine destiny draught.
translations: 你饮用了足以改变一生的水妖精命运药水

messages.msgid: Excessive water content in blood sample
translations: 血液样本中水分含量过高
你喝了火妖精命运药水。

messages.msgid: You consumed a large amount of Salamander destiny draught.
translations: 你消耗了大量的火妖精命运药水。

messages.msgid: You consumed a life-changing amount of Salamander destiny draught.
translations: 你饮用了足已改变一生的火妖精命运药水。

messages.msgid: Blood sample displays unnatural heat generation
translations: 血液样本呈现出不正常的产热现象
你喝了仿灵人命运药水。

messages.msgid: You consumed a large amount of Homullus destiny draught.
translations: 你消耗了大量的仿灵人命运药水。

messages.msgid: You consumed a life-changing amount of Homullus destiny draught.
translations: 你饮用了足以改变一生的仿灵人命运药水。

messages.msgid: Inert elements providing some functions of blood
translations: 惰性元素正在承担部分血液功能
你喝了风妖精命运药水。

messages.msgid: You consumed a large amount of Sylph destiny draught.
translations: 你消耗了大量的风妖精命运药水。

messages.msgid: You consumed a life-changing amount of Sylph destiny draught.
translations: 你饮用了改变生活的风妖精命运药水。

messages.msgid: Dangerous levels of oxygen and nitrogen in blood sample
translations: 血液样本中的氧和氮含量已达危险水平

messages.msgid: They could have sworn you were there a moment ago.
translations: 他们敢发誓你刚才还在那儿。

messages.msgid: Your weapon is burning with white-gold fire.
translations: 你的武器正燃起白金色的火焰

messages.msgid: The flames on your weapon go out.
You would have definitely won the contests.
translations: 你本该在比赛中稳操胜券。
你的矫健体魄正在衰退。

messages.msgid: You are no longer protected by the contracts of eld.
translations: 你不再受远古契约的庇护。

messages.msgid: People can definitely see you now.
translations: 现在，人们肯定能看见你了。

messages.msgid: You recently called some daffodils.  You need to wait a day before you can call more.
translations: 你最近召唤了一些水仙花战士，需要等待一天才能再次召唤。

messages.msgid: Recovering from the last breath's mist
Triggering your abilities that way has taken their toll on you.  You cannot save yourself from death that way another time yet.
translations: 以这种方式触发能力对你造成了巨大的损耗，你暂时无法再用此法将自己从死亡边缘拉回来了。

messages.msgid: A lilit has drained away some of your life-force.
translations: 你被一个莉莉丝榨走了一些生命力。

messages.msgid: You are out of ruach and gradually weakening.
translations: 你的灵息已经耗尽，身体正逐渐衰弱。

messages.msgid: You are enhancing your physical abilities.
translations: 你的灵息已经耗尽，身体正逐渐衰弱。
你正在强化自己的身体能力。

messages.msgid: Your movements make as little noise as the shadows of the night.
translations: 你的移动速度快得不可思议。

messages.msgid: You will endure all obstacles without faltering.
translations: 你的行动悄无声息，宛如夜幕中的阴影。

messages.msgid: Now they will know why they fear the night.
translations: 现在，他们将明白自己为何畏惧黑夜。

messages.msgid: Having spent a long time in the shadows, you are now quicker than usual.
translations: 久沐暗影，你的身手已比往日更加迅捷。

messages.msgid: This follower allowed you to take some of their ruach, and they won't respond kindly to being drained more this soon.
translations: 这位追随者允许你吸取他的一部分灵息，若是在短时间内再度索取，他可不会有什么好脸色。

messages.msgid: I wish you a good night.
You could swear that this man wished you a good night.
translations: 你敢发誓，那个人刚才祝了你晚安。

messages.msgid: Sleep well.  Nothing but you can disrupt your sleep.
translations: 安心睡吧，除了你自己，没有什么能打扰你的睡眠。

messages.msgid: As you fall asleep, you feel safer than you ever were.
translations: 入睡之际，你感到前所未有的安心。

messages.msgid: As you wake up, the feeling of safety quickly fades away.
translations: 醒来之时，那份安全感也随之迅速消散。

messages.msgid: A loud noise fueled by a curse has sent you reeling.
translations: 一声蕴含诅咒的巨响让你头晕目眩，站立不稳。

messages.msgid: You are infected by a supernatural disease.
translations: 你感染了一种超自然疾病。

messages.msgid: You have engaged some of your temporal abilities and any kills you make while this is active will grant you insight.
translations: 你已激活部分时间系能力，力场持续期间，你所造成的任何杀戮都将为你带来新的洞悉。

messages.msgid: You gain an increased awareness of the 4th dimension and how it interacts with the universe.
translations: 你获得了对第四维度以及它如何与宇宙相互作用更多的认知。

messages.msgid: Your awareness of the 4th dimension fades.
translations: 你对第四维度的感知消失了。

messages.msgid: You are completely frozen in time.
You are anchored in normal reality.
translations: 你被锚定在正常的现实中。

messages.msgid: You continuously generate fields of short-lived accelerated time.
translations: 你不断产生出短时间内加速时间的地域。

messages.msgid: Your local time is far accelerated to the baseline, allowing you to act much quicker.
translations: 你自身的时间相比外界被极大程度的加速，使你能够更快的行动。

messages.msgid: You maintain a field of unstable time around you.  When you attack targets in melee they will degrade over time.
translations: 你在你的身体周围保持一个不稳定的时间场。你可以通过近战攻击来使目标随时间逐渐退化。

messages.msgid: Your field of unstable time fades.
translations: 你的不稳定时间场消失了。

messages.msgid: You are accelerating your relative progression of time compared to the universal baseline.
translations: 你正在加速你的相对于这个宇宙的时间进程。

messages.msgid: The world slows down around you.
translations: 你眼中的世界变得缓慢。

messages.msgid: You maintain a field of destabilized time around you.  Your attacks cause your targets to erode over time.
translations: 你在你的身体周围保持一个失序时间场。你可以通过攻击来逐渐侵蚀目标。

messages.msgid: Your hands turn gray as the air around them starts to flicker.
translations: 你的双手变灰，周围的空气开始闪烁。

messages.msgid: Your field of destabilized time fades.
translations: 你的失序时间场消失了。

messages.msgid: You are protected from adverse changes in your personal timestream.
translations: 你受到保护，免受你个人时间流动变化带来的负面影响。

messages.msgid: You may not look any different, but you can tell that you're completely protected from harmful time magic
translations: 也许你看起来没有什么不同，但你知道，你已免受有对你有害的时间魔法的影响。

messages.msgid: You feel more vulnerable to manipulated time.
translations: 你更容易受到时间的操纵。

messages.msgid: Your equipment is slowly losing its damage, repairing itself to its original, ideal form.
translations: 您的物品正在慢慢修复，恢复到最初的理想状态。

messages.msgid: Your equipment obtains a gray tint and appears ever so slightly more whole.
translations: 您的物品呈现出灰色调，并且看起来更加完整。

messages.msgid: Your equipment loses its gray tint.
translations: 您的物品失去了灰色调。

messages.msgid: Your injuries are disappearing in a harmless paradox.
translations: 你的创伤正在因一个无害的悖论而消失。

messages.msgid: The equipments' faults are disappearing in a harmless paradox.
translations: 你的物品的缺陷正在因一个无害的悖论而消失。

messages.msgid: Every few seconds every change to your person reverts.
translations: 每隔几秒钟，你身上的一切变化都被重置。

messages.msgid: You are prepared to revert yourself to a prior point in time.
translations: 您时刻准备将自己恢复到之前的时间点。

messages.msgid: This creature destabilizes time around it, eroding everything it touches.
translations: 这个生物正在使周围的时间失序，侵蚀它接触到的一切。

messages.msgid: You recently reshuffled your vampiric weaknesses.  Until your blood stabilizes, further attempts will be fruitless.
translations: 你最近重塑了自身的吸血鬼弱点，在你的血液稳定下来之前，任何进一步的尝试都将是徒劳的。

messages.msgid: Your blood has stabilized enough to let you try to reshuffle your weaknesses again, should they prove too much to bear.
translations: 你的血液已经足够稳定，如果那些弱点实在难以忍受，你可以再次尝试重塑它们。

messages.msgid: Cold blood is not enough.  You need some warm blood straight from the vein, you need it NOW!
translations: 冰冷的血液已经满足不了你了。你需要一些直接来自的血管的温暖血液，你现在就要，现！在！

messages.msgid: You want to sink your fangs in someone's neck and drink their blood.
translations: 你渴望将尖牙刺入某人的脖颈，畅饮他们的鲜血。

messages.msgid: You have slept away from the earth, leaving you fatigued and weakened for an entire day.
translations: 脱离大地而眠，使你一整日都疲惫不堪，虚弱无力。

messages.msgid: The sanctity of this place is killing you.
translations: 此地的圣洁气息正在扼杀你。

messages.msgid: You feel rejected by this place.
translations: 你感觉此地正在排斥你。

messages.msgid: You are dissolving in the vast waters.
translations: 你正在汪洋中渐渐溶解。

messages.msgid: You are melting from your proximity to water.
translations: 只是靠近水源，你的身体便开始融化。

messages.msgid: The sun is burning you like a dry leaf in a wildfire.
translations: 骄阳似火，你的身体仿佛野火中的枯叶，一触即燃。

messages.msgid: Need blood must have blood blood right now DRINK BLOOD NOW!
translations: 要血……必须有血……血……就是现在……喝血！立刻！

messages.msgid: You are wracked with pain as your craving hits you.  You can only think about getting some of that delicious blood you so desesperately need.

translations: 嗜血的渴望让你心神不宁。

messages.msgid: The Anathema is much quicker now thanks to vampiric abilities.
translations: 得益于其吸血鬼异能，血孽如今迅捷无比。

messages.msgid: All the vampire blood you drank has empowered you.
translations: 你饮下的所有吸血鬼之血，都化为了你自身的力量。

messages.msgid: Your blood is consuming itself in its thirst for the blood of vampires.
translations: 出于对吸血鬼之血的渴求，你体内的血液正在反噬己身。

messages.msgid: You feel a gnawing thirst for the blood of vampires.  Better find some, before your blood devours itself.
translations: 你感到一股噬骨的饥渴，那是对吸血鬼之血的无尽欲念。最好快点找到一些，否则你自身的血液便会反噬其主。

messages.msgid: Your thirst for vampire blood calms down.
translations: 你对吸血鬼之血的渴望平息了下来。

messages.msgid: Until the shadows you gathered fade or the sun shines upon you, you cannot be seen.
translations: 只要你所聚拢的暗影尚未消散，或是在被阳光照亮之前，任何人都无法看见你的身形。

messages.msgid: The shadows you gathered meld with you, hiding you from sight.
translations: 你召来的暗影与你融为一体，将你的身形隐匿无踪。

messages.msgid: The shadows aren't hiding you anymore.
translations: 暗影不再庇护你的身形。

messages.msgid: Your mind reels from all the vampire blood you drank.
translations: 你饮下的吸血鬼之血太多，心神也为之动摇混乱。

messages.msgid: You are about to suffer from the hydrating gout.  This disease causes the spontaneous generation of water inside the body, and becomes more virulent the more hydrated the afflicted is.
translations: 你即将患上水化痛风。此病会使患者体内自发地生成水，且患者体内的水分越是充盈，病情便会愈发凶险。

messages.msgid: You have a bad feeling about drinking more water.
translations: 你隐隐觉得，再喝水恐怕不妙。

messages.msgid: You are suffering from the peculiar illness known as hydrating gout.  This disease causes the spontaneous generation of water inside the body, and becomes more virulent the more hydrated the afflicted is.
translations: 你正遭受着一种名为水化痛风的怪病。此病会使患者体内自发地生成水，且患者体内的水分越是充盈，病情便会愈发凶险。

messages.msgid: You feel you're going to drown in your own body water.
translations: 你感觉自己快要溺毙在自己体内的积水之中了。

messages.msgid: You no longer fear the absence of thirst.
translations: 你不再为感觉不到口渴而担惊受怕了。

messages.msgid: A sweet scent fills the air.
translations: 空气中弥漫着甜美的芳香。

messages.msgid: The scent of flowers fades away.
translations: 花儿的芬芳渐渐消散了。

messages.msgid: You feel like you've just come outside after a long winter.
translations: 你感觉自己仿佛在度过一个漫长的寒冬之后，终于沐浴到了春光。
那股清新的感觉渐渐消失了。

messages.msgid: You are covered in a set of living bark armor.
translations: 一套活体树皮铠甲覆盖了你的身体。

messages.msgid: Bark and leaves quickly grow over your skin.
translations: 树皮与绿叶迅速从你的皮肤上生长出来，交织成甲。

messages.msgid: The bark armor cracks and falls away.
translations: 树皮铠甲寸寸碎裂，从你身上剥落下来。

messages.msgid: You are drawing on the energy of life to increase your healing rate.
translations: 你正汲取着生命能量，以加快自身的痊愈速度。

messages.msgid: Your devotion is stronger than adamant.
translations: 你的虔诚之心，比精金更为坚固。

messages.msgid: A wisp of flickering insubstantial fire hovers near your shoulder.
translations: 一缕摇曳的虚无之火，萦绕在你的肩旁。

messages.msgid: Nearby lights don't seem quite as bright now.
translations: 现在附近的光线似乎不那么刺眼了。

messages.msgid: You blink as nearby lights grow brighter.
translations: 你眨了眨眼，附近的光线又变得明亮起来。

messages.msgid: The essence of summer protects you from excessive heat.
translations: 夏日精萃庇佑着你，使你免受酷热侵袭。

messages.msgid: Your blood loses its glamoured warmth.
translations: 你血液中那由魔法赋予的温暖消散了。

messages.msgid: Ethereal flames flicker around your hands
translations: 虚幻的火焰在你双手周围跃动。

messages.msgid: You need to sit down in the shade.
translations: 你需要在荫凉处坐下休息。

messages.msgid: You are filled with burning energy.
translations: 你浑身充满了灼热的能量。

messages.msgid: The burning energy filling your muscles dissipates.
translations: 那股充盈在你肌肉中的灼热能量消散了。

messages.msgid: The light of the summer sun gives you strength to fight.
translations: 盛夏的阳光赐予你战斗的力量。

messages.msgid: You're fired up and ready for battle.
translations: 你热血沸腾，准备投入战斗。

messages.msgid: The energy of the sun leaves you.
You stand in the ring of flames, facing your foe.  Woe to the vanquished.
translations: 你立于火焰之环中，直面你的宿敌。败者将遭此劫。

messages.msgid: You are the target of Ring of Champions.  Your death will end the glamour.
translations: 你成了斗士之环的目标，你的死亡将终结此项魔法。

messages.msgid: You blaze with the pure light of the summer sun.
translations: 你周身燃烧着盛夏骄阳的纯粹光芒。

messages.msgid: You can sense nearby uses of magick.
translations: 你能够感知到附近正在使用的魔法。

messages.msgid: Your awareness of sorcerers fades away.
translations: 你对施法者的感知力逐渐消失。
你感知到此地有施法者。

messages.msgid: A glamour is prematurely aging you.
translations: 一道魔法正让你加速衰老。
现在，他们将体会到什么是恐惧。

messages.msgid: A chill wind is whirling around you.
translations: 一阵寒风在你周身盘旋。

messages.msgid: The autumn leaves fall to the ground.
Ice coats your lower limbs, freezing you in place.
translations: 寒冰包裹着你的下肢，将你冻在原地。

messages.msgid: The chill around your feet fades away.
Like an animal in winter, you are moving in almost complete silence.
translations: 你如同冬日里的野兽，行动时几乎悄无声息。

messages.msgid: The sound of your footsteps intrudes in your perceptions.
translations: 你的脚步声再次变得清晰可闻。

messages.msgid: Each step you take leaves a tracing of frost on the ground, and liquids freeze at your touch.
translations: 你的每一步都会在地上留下霜痕，触碰到的液体也会冻结成冰。

messages.msgid: You do not move, or breathe, or think, or live.  For now.
translations: 你一动不动，气息全无，思维停滞，毫无生机。暂时如此。

messages.msgid: You can fool them once, but you can't fool them twice.
Your tongue feels like solid ice.
translations: 你的舌头感觉就像一块坚冰。

messages.msgid: The icy feeling on your tongue vanishes.
translations: 你舌头上的冰冷感消退了。
你的所有情感都已冻结。

messages.msgid: You are at home in the dark.
Your fey powers are cut off, like they're trapped behind a wall of glass.
translations: 你的妖精力量被隔绝了，就像它们被一堵玻璃墙隔开一样。

messages.msgid: The glass wall cutting off your fey powers shatters into dust.
translations: 隔离你妖精力量的玻璃墙消散于尘土。
你的伤口正在慢慢愈合。

messages.msgid: Your regeneration slows down as the goblin fruit's magic fades.
translations: 妖精果实的魔法消退后，你的回复速度减慢。

messages.msgid: Your muscles twitch as the goblin fruit's magic fades.
translations: 你的肌肉随着妖精果实魔法的散去而抽搐。

messages.msgid: The magic of that goblin fruit is keeping you warm.
translations: 妖精果实的魔法能让你保持温暖。
你的行动变得悄无声息。
你感觉自己的脚步声轻了许多。

messages.msgid: Your blood is all being contained within your body.
translations: 你的血液都包在你的身体里。

messages.msgid: The magic of that goblin fruit is helping you see better.
translations: 妖精果实的魔力能帮助你看得更清楚。

messages.msgid: You can fall any distance without damage.
translations: 你可以跌落任意高度而不会造成损坏。

messages.msgid: You feel as light as air.
Gravity reclaims its hold on you.
translations: 重力再次压在了对你身上。

messages.msgid: Your head pounds as you suddenly see in all directions simultaneously.
translations: 当你突然同时向四面八方看去时，你的头部一阵剧痛。

messages.msgid: Your senses snap back into your body.
translations: 你的知觉回到了你的身体。

messages.msgid: You feel an urge to take a swim.
translations: 你感到一股游泳的冲动。

messages.msgid: You need to take a breath of air, now!
translations: 你需要呼吸口空气，现在！

messages.msgid: You're beneath notice, unless they get too close of you.
translations: 只要不靠得太近，就没人会注意到你。

messages.msgid: You find it hard to notice your own presence.
translations: 你甚至都很难察觉到自己的存在。
你再次变得容易被察觉了。

messages.msgid: You are mirroring a version of yourself that is more skilled at violence.
translations: 你正在映照出另一个自己——一个更擅长施展暴力的版本。

messages.msgid: Your mind fills with violence and the knowledge to use it.
translations: 暴虐的念头和运用它的技巧充满了你的脑海。

messages.msgid: Your level of violence returns to normal.
translations: 你的暴虐冲动平复了下去。

messages.msgid: You're imitating yourself, if you were better at making things.
translations: 你正在演绎另一个自己——一个手艺远比你现在高超的自己。

messages.msgid: You start imitating a more skilled artisan.
translations: 你开始模仿一位技艺更高超的巧匠。

messages.msgid: You cannot be moved against your will by mundane means.
translations: 任何凡俗之力都无法违背你的意愿强行移动你。
你感觉自己已在原地生根！

messages.msgid: You stumble a little as your immovability ceases.
translations: 不动效果消失时，你脚下一个不稳。

messages.msgid: For an instant, nothing can touch you.
You start dodging everything that could touch you!
translations: 你开始躲避一切可能触碰到你的事物！

messages.msgid: Your dodging abilities return to normal.
translations: 你的闪避能力恢复如初。

messages.msgid: As long as it lasts, you will have an easier time learning new things.
translations: 只要效果还在，你学习新知识就会事半功倍。

messages.msgid: Everything feels a little easier to understand now.
translations: 现在，一切都变得豁然开朗。

messages.msgid: Your mind returns to its regular level of understanding.
You feel your position grow uncertain.
translations: 你感到自己的方位变得飘忽不定。

messages.msgid: You stop teleporting all over the place.
You can climb walls without trouble.
translations: 你可以毫不费力地攀爬墙壁。
你的四肢末端变得黏糊糊的。

messages.msgid: Your extremities stop being this sticky.
translations: 你的四肢末端不再那么黏了。

messages.msgid: Your muscles are filled with pressurized power!
translations: 你的肌肉充满了增压之力！

messages.msgid: The power leaves your muscles in an instant.
translations: 那股力量瞬间从你的肌肉中流失了。

messages.msgid: The pressure inside your muscles grows!
translations: 你肌肉内部的压力增强了！

messages.msgid: You find it easier to carry heavy charges.
translations: 你发现自己更容易搬运重物了。

messages.msgid: You feel lighter, as does everything you're carrying.
translations: 你感觉自己变轻了，你携带的一切物品也是如此。

messages.msgid: The weight of your belongings return to normal.
translations: 你身上物品的重量恢复了正常。

messages.msgid: You move a bit quicker through the wilds.
translations: 你在荒野中的移动速度略有提升。

messages.msgid: Nearby vegetation becomes a little less daunting.
translations: 附近的植被不再那么碍事了。
穿越植被不再那么容易了。

messages.msgid: You are more resistant to damage but move more slowly.
translations: 你对伤害的抵抗力更强了，但移动也更慢了。

messages.msgid: You stiffen, becoming slower but more resistant to anything.
translations: 你的身体变得僵硬，移动更慢，但对各种伤害的抵抗力也更强了。
你身体的僵硬感消失了。

messages.msgid: You are better at convincing others to do what you want.
translations: 你更善于说服他人按你的意愿行事。
你感觉自己更具说服力了。

messages.msgid: The winds are assisting your movements.
You long for the skies as winds start blowing at you.
translations: 风儿开始吹拂着你，你对天空生出向往。

messages.msgid: The skies lose their heightened luster.
translations: 天空失去了那份令人神往的光彩。

messages.msgid: You withstand the cold much better than most.
translations: 你比大多数人更能抵御严寒。

messages.msgid: You make things quicker, unless someone else is looking.
translations: 你制作物品的速度更快了，除非有旁人看着。

messages.msgid: You feel better at making things, but only if nobody is watching you.
translations: 你感觉自己制作物品的技艺精进了，但前提是没人看着你。

messages.msgid: Your increased crafting quickness returns to normal.
translations: 你提升的制作速度恢复了正常。

messages.msgid: You can still faintly taste that cloudy fruit.  Any cloudy fruit you might eat before the aftertaste ends won't have any effect.
translations: 你还能隐约尝到那云果的味道。在余味消散前，食用任何云果都不会产生效果。

messages.msgid: You are wearing equipment that helps handle harsh climates and protects from damaging cold.
translations: 你所穿戴的装备有助于应对恶劣的气候，抵御严寒的侵袭。

messages.msgid: A simple wooden chair with four legs, a seat, and a back.  It's all made of a single, solid piece of wood, with twists and curves like it grew in place rather than being made.  There's even a small branch with a leaf extending from the top.
translations: 一个简易的木椅，有四条椅子腿，一个椅面和椅背。由一整块实心的木头制成，木头的扭曲和曲线看起来就像是天然生长出来的一般。甚至还有一小截带绿叶的枝条生长在顶部。

messages.msgid: A treesung wooden table.  It's all made of a single, solid piece of wood, with twists and curves like it grew in place rather than being made.
translations: 一个树桩衣橱，由一整块实心的木头制成，木头的扭曲和曲线看起来就像是天然生长出来的一般。

messages.msgid: A sturdy wooden bed frame built to hold most standard mattresses.  It's all made of a single, solid piece of wood, with twists and curves like it grew in place rather than being made.
translations: 一个坚固的木制床架，可以承载大多数的床垫。由一整块实心的木头制成，木头的扭曲和曲线看起来就像是天然生长出来的一般。

messages.msgid: An incredibly alcoholic and caffeinated drink.  This probably isn't healthy.
translations: 一种令人难以置信的含酒精和咖啡因的饮料。这可能不健康。

messages.msgid: Sixdust, for when you must scorch the earth.  A sprayable anti-fungal/anti-insecticidal ammo for the chemical thrower.  Best used with some kind of mask or mouth protection.
translations: 六尘，当你必须烧焦大地时。 一种用于化学喷射器的可喷雾抗真菌/抗昆虫药。 最好与某种面罩或口腔防护装置一起使用。

messages.msgid: A small pill made from royal jelly, ash, and poppies.  Blessed with prayers to Brigit over several hours.  Will end any cold or flu instantaneously.
translations: 一颗用蜂王浆、灰烬和罂粟制成的小药丸，经过向布丽吉特祷告数小时获得祝福。能瞬间治愈任何感冒或流感。
你几乎立刻感觉好多了。

messages.msgid: A windowpane worth of Rainbow Skull LSD tabs.  These tabs are said to grant the consumer the ability to see several seconds into the future.
translations: 一扇玻璃窗上的彩虹骷髅LSD标签。据说这些标签可以让消费者看到几秒钟后的未来。
用炼金术改造的小贩药片

messages.msgid: When you began the sinister path into occultism, you never imagined you'd be alchemically altering truckstop viagra into combat drugs.  But here you are, no sleep til Boston.
translations: 当你开始踏上神秘学的邪恶之路时，你从未想过你会用炼金术将路边摊上的伟哥变成战斗药物。但现在看看你，到波士顿之前可别想睡觉。

messages.msgid: You swallow a couple of the large green pills.
translations: 你们吞下了几粒绿色的大药丸。

messages.msgid: A metallic pentagram full of mystic symbols.  Will trap creatures from other dimensions if they wander into it.
translations: 一个充满神秘符号的金属五芒星阵。来自异次元的生物一旦误入其中，便会被其禁锢。

messages.msgid: A key ingredient for Victorian seances led by actual occultists.  This dust summons spirits from beyond to walk the earth again for a short time.  The spirits it summons are mindless and disappear upon being touched.
translations: 这是维多利亚时代由真正的神秘主义者领导的降神会的关键因素。这些尘埃会召唤来自远方的灵魂，让他们短暂地在地球上行走。它召唤的灵魂是无意识的，一被触摸就消失了。

messages.msgid: A tiny effigy of a woman with singed extremities and a waterlogged face.
translations: 一个女人的小雕像，四肢烧焦，满脸是水。

messages.msgid: A shiny, gold necklace adorned with an image of a cat with strange runes on it and diamond eyes.
translations: 一条闪亮的金项链，上面装饰着一只猫的形象，上面有奇怪的符文和钻石眼睛。

messages.msgid: A shiny, gold necklace adorned with an image of a wolf with strange runes on it and diamond eyes.
translations: 一条闪闪发光的金项链，上面装饰着一只狼的形象，上面有奇怪的符文和钻石眼睛。

messages.msgid: A shiny, gold necklace adorned with an image of an octopus with strange runes on it and diamond eyes.
translations: 一条闪闪发光的金项链，上面装饰着章鱼的图案，章鱼的图案上有奇怪的符文和钻石眼睛。

messages.msgid: A shiny, gold necklace adorned with an image of a tree with strange runes on it and diamond eyes.
translations: 一条闪闪发光的金项链，上面装饰着一棵树的形象，上面有奇怪的符文和钻石眼睛。

messages.msgid: A shiny, gold necklace adorned with an image of a scorpion with strange runes on it and diamond eyes.
translations: 一条闪闪发光的金项链，上面装饰着一只蝎子的形象，上面有奇怪的符文和钻石眼睛。

messages.msgid: A shiny, gold necklace adorned with an image of a butterfly with strange runes on it and diamond eyes.
translations: 一条闪闪发光的金项链，上面装饰着一只蝴蝶的形象，上面有奇怪的符文和钻石眼睛。

messages.msgid: A shiny, gold necklace adorned with an image of a spider with strange runes on it and diamond eyes.
translations: 一条闪闪发光的金项链，上面装饰着一只蜘蛛的形象，上面有奇怪的符文和钻石眼睛。
维纳莫宁的康特勒琴，仿品

messages.msgid: A traditional Finnish string instrument.  According to myth the first one was fashioned from a great pike's jawbone.  Does it glimmer in the light?  Do its notes echo and linger more than normal?
translations: 一种传统的芬兰弦乐器。神话中，第一把康特勒琴乃是用巨型狗鱼的颌骨所制。它是否在光下闪烁微光？它的音符是否比寻常的更加萦绕不绝？

messages.msgid: A source of considerable wealth for the few alchemists talented enough to distill them, these potions are capable of adding decades to the lifespan of those who can afford the price of the rare and expensive ingredients they require.  They are however not able to prolong a life indefinitely beyond its natural years, and you will need to find other means to achieve immortality, if that is your goal.
translations: 对于少数有天赋提炼此物的炼金术士而言，这些药水是可观的财富之源。它们能为那些付得起其稀有昂贵原料价格的人增添数十载寿命。然而，它们无法将生命无限延长至超出其自然年限，若你想求得永生，便需另寻他法。

messages.msgid: You imbibed the concoction and you feel your chakras align and your DNA de-age.
translations: 你吸收了混合物，你感觉到你的任督二脉被打通了，你的DNA也修复了一些由于老化带来的损伤。

messages.msgid: This is a potion of wicked quick hands.  It will increase your dexterity for 50 minutes.
translations: 这是一剂神奇的药剂。它会在50分钟内提高你的敏捷。

messages.msgid: This is a potion of terrible strength.  It will increase your strength for 50 minutes.
translations: 这是一种具有强大力量的药剂。它会增加你50分钟的力量。

messages.msgid: This is a potion of hare's leap.  It allows you to jump afar from danger.
translations: 这是兔子跳跃的药剂。它可以让你远离危险。

messages.msgid: This is a transmutation potion that will bring your best attributes to the forefront.
translations: 这是一种转化药剂，它将把你最好的属性带到最前沿。

messages.msgid: You imbibed the concoction and you feel your inner self unleashed.
translations: 你吸收了混合物，你感觉到你内心的自我自由了。

messages.msgid: In a wooden bowl, Faewild and Dreamdross are mixed together along with ground-up leaves.  The mixture has fae and human blood added to it and parts from the plant fae and then all mixed again until it's a uniform blend.  The resulting mixture will eventually dissolve into a deep green liquid.
translations: 在木碗中，妖土和浮梦残渣与磨碎的树叶混合在一起。混合物中加入了妖精和人类的血液，以及从植物妖精身上取下的部分，然后再次混合，直至成为均匀的糊状物。最终的混合物会溶解成深绿色的液体。

messages.msgid: Heat Faewild and Dreamdross over a roaring fire and the mix in the ashes until you have a thick paste.  That paste is mixed with parts taken from the Fair Folk and united with a dollop of fae, and human blood.  The resulting mixture will eventually dissolve into a scarlet liquid that shines with its own light.
translations: 将妖土和浮梦残渣置于烈焰上加热，而后混入灰烬，直至化为浓稠的膏状。再将这膏状物与从仙灵身上取下的部分相融，并合入一小份妖精与人类的血液。最终的混合物将溶解成一种猩红色的液体，熠熠生辉。

messages.msgid: While looking in a mirror, Faewild and Dreamdross are ground to dust.  That dust is mixed with parts taken from the Fair Folk and united with a dollop of fae, and human blood.  The resulting mixture will eventually dissolve into what almost looks like liquid porcelain.
translations: 在看着镜子的时候，狂妖尘和浮梦残渣被研磨成粉末。那些粉末与从精灵族身上取下的部分混合在一起，再加入一团精灵和人类的血液。最终，混合后的物质会逐渐溶解成几乎类似液态瓷器的东西。
潦草的笔记（强力阿司匹林）

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for extra strength aspirin.  The active ingredient is apparently hallucinogenic, which is certainly one way to stop from feeling pain.
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种强效阿司匹林的炼金配方。其活性成分显然具有致幻作用，倒不失为一种止痛的妙法。
潦草的笔记（布里吉特的祝福）

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for a pill to cure minor illnesses.  You're not looking forward to getting that royal jelly now that you've seen what the bees are like lately.
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种能治愈小病的炼金药丸配方。见识过近来蜜蜂的凶猛后，你可一点都不想去搞什么蜂王浆了。

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for some kind of energy drink.  You do a double-take when you see just how much caffeine and alcohol you're supposed to add to the recipe.
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种能量饮品的炼金配方。看到配方里要求添加的咖啡因和酒精含量之高，你都不禁又仔细看了一遍。

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for an insecticide.  "WEAR MASK DURING BREWING!!!!!" is written at the bottom of the recipe
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种杀虫剂的炼金配方。配方底部用粗体大写字体写着：“熬制时务必佩戴面罩！！！！！”
潦草的笔记（先知迷幻剂）

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for an extremely powerful hallucinogen.  The end product will supposedly allow you to "see through time".
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种强力致幻剂的炼金配方。据说，最终的产物能让你“洞悉时间”。
潦草的笔记（炼金大力丸）

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for a "stamina enhancement".  The ingredients make you raise your eyebrows, but the notes in the margins indicate that you won't need to sleep for quite some time after taking them.
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种“耐力增强剂”的炼金配方。其中的成分让你不禁扬了扬眉，但页边的注释表明，服下此物后，你将在很长一段时间内毫无困意。
潦草的笔记（玛扎娜的护符）

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for an enchanted amulet.  The notes indicate wearing it should protect you from cold temperatures.
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种附魔护身符的炼金配方。注释表明，佩戴它应该能让你免受严寒侵袭。

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for a powder to "reveal that which is unseen".  There are repeated references testing its effects at dusk, at crossroads, and on Halloween.
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种能“揭示不可见之物”的粉末的炼金配方。笔记中反复提及，应在黄昏时分、十字路口及万圣夜测试其效。
潦草的笔记（维纳莫宁的康特勒琴，仿制品）

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for…a musical instrument?  You didn't realize that alchemy could be used to get the band back together again.
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种……乐器的炼金配方？你都不知道炼金术还能用来重组乐队。
潦草的笔记（猫之辟邪物）

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for an enchanted amulet.  The notes have several parallel tears in them near the bottom.
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种附魔护身符的炼金配方。笔记底部有几道平行的撕裂痕迹。
潦草的笔记（狼之辟邪物）

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for an enchanted amulet.  The notes have "take off before meals!!" underlined at the bottom.
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种附魔护身符的炼金配方。笔记底部有一行字被划上了下划线：“吃饭前务必摘掉！！”
潦草的笔记（头足辟邪物）

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for an enchanted amulet.  The writing gets increasingly shaky, dissolving into a series of ink blots just under the final steps of the recipe.
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种附魔护身符的炼金配方。字迹愈发潦草，到配方最后几步的下方，已然化为一滩滩墨渍。
潦草的笔记（草木辟邪物）

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for an enchanted amulet.  The notes indicate that it will cause you to grow bark and to "take off your boots first".
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种附魔护身符的炼金配方。注释表明，它会让你长出树皮，并嘱咐要“先脱掉靴子”。
潦草的笔记（蝎尾辟邪物）

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for an enchanted amulet.  There are several stick-figure drawings of a person with a scorpion's tail in the margins.
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种附魔护身符的炼金配方。页边空白处画着几个长了蝎尾的火柴人。
潦草的笔记（蝶之辟邪物）

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for an enchanted amulet.  The notes indicate that you "still can't fly" even with it on.
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种附魔护身符的炼金配方。注释表明，即便戴着它，你也“还是飞不起来”。
潦草的笔记（蛛之辟邪物）

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for an enchanted amulet.  The notes repeatedly mention "Webs aren't really big enough to test, thank God."
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种附魔护身符的炼金配方。笔记里反复提到：“谢天谢地，普通的蛛网还没大到能用来测试的程度。”

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for creating cold iron.  You note with amusement that the recipe doesn't seem to require any actual iron.
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种制造寒铁的炼金配方。你饶有兴致地发现，这个配方似乎并不需要任何真正的铁。

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for the elixir of life.  If only you had found this before the world ended.
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种长生不老药的炼金配方。要是你在世界末日之前就找到它该多好啊。

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for a potion to increase your strength.  Written at the bottom is the note, "Be very careful after drinking!".
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种增强力量的药水配方。底部写着一条注释：“饮用后务必小心！”

messages.msgid: scribbled notes (potion of wicked quick hands)
translations: 潦草的笔记（神速之手药水）
messages.plural: scribbled notes (potion of wicked quick hands)

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for a potion to increase your dexterity.  It looks like the undead will be catching these hands.
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种提升敏捷的药水配方。看来，丧尸们可要尝尝我这双铁拳的厉害了。
潦草的笔记（野兔之跃药水）

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for a potion to allow you to leap a great distance.  Hopefully it also allows you land safely after those great leaps.
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种炼金药水配方，能让你纵身飞跃，跨越很远的距离。希望它也能让你在飞跃之后安然着陆。

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for a mystical trap that will allow you imprison beings from "the Outside."  Based on some scribbled sketches of things it's supposed to contain, you hope it holds if you try to use it.
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种炼金配方，可以制作一个神秘陷阱，用以囚禁来自“外界”的存在。笔记上还画着几幅潦草的草图，描绘了陷阱理应容纳的东西，看着这些图，你只希望这陷阱在派上用场时别掉链子。

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for a method to obtain the power of nature.  The ingredients list tells you that nature is definitely not going to appreciate that.
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种炼金配方，是攫取自然之力的方法。从配方所需的材料来看，大自然对此绝对不会乐见其成。
潦草的笔记（羊皮纸注能）

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for a method to obtain the power of…humanity?  More human than human, you suppose.
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种炼金配方，是攫取……人性之力？的方法。你心想，这大概就是所谓的“比人更人”吧。

messages.msgid: An handwritten set of notes detailing an alchemical recipe for a method to obtain the power of flames.  You hope those lines about "the ashes of the dead" are optional.
translations: 一份手写的笔记，详细记载了一种炼金配方，是攫取火焰之力的方法。你只希望其中提到“死者骨灰”的那几行只是可选步骤。

messages.msgid: A thin and flat knife made for throwing.  Its ineffective cutting edge and odd shape makes it unsuitable for use as a tool.
translations:
一个细薄而扁平的投掷用小刀。它没有刀刃，而且形状也很怪异，这让它无法作为工具使用。
"The world！"

messages.msgid: A pin-shaped piece of moon tears and dreamdross.  It can be used to repair items made of moon tears.
translations: 一根钉状的月之泪和浮梦残渣。可以用来修理月之泪制作的物品。

messages.msgid: Small metal rings, suitable for constructing chainmail, made from moon tears.
translations: 一串小型月之泪锁链，可以用来制造锁环甲。

messages.msgid: The 9×21mm Gyurza (Гюрза, Russian for 'blunt-nosed viper') round is a Russian handgun round designed to defeat body armor that was developed by TsNIITochMash for its SR-1 Vektor semi-automatic pistol and SR-2 Veresk submachine gun.  The 7N29 AP loading fires a 6.7 g (103 gr) bullet at 410 m/s (1,300 ft/s) with 560 J (410 ft⋅lb) of muzzle energy, and will reportedly penetrate two 1.2 mm titanium plates, plus 30 layers of Kevlar, at 50 m (160 ft).  The disadvantage of the rounds is that high impact velocities are needed for them to work effectively, so the bullets are relatively light to maximize their muzzle velocity.  This means they will lose velocity relatively quickly, limiting their effective range.
translations: 9×21mm Gyurza（Гюрза，俄语"斑蝰蛇"）弹是一种俄国手枪子弹，由 TsNIITochMash 公司为其名下的 SR-1 Vektor 半自动手枪和 SR-2 Veresk 冲锋枪所研制的子弹，专门用来击穿防弹衣。7N29 穿甲弹以410米/秒（1300英尺/秒）的速度发射一颗重达6.7克（103格令）的弹丸，枪口动能为 560J（410英尺⋅磅）。据报道，它能在50米（160英尺）处击穿两块1.2mm的钛合金板和30层凯夫拉纤维。这种子弹的缺点是需要较高的撞击速度才能提升功效，因此弹头相对较轻，以最大限度地提高初速。这意味着此类弹药会相对更快地失去速度，从而限制其有效射程。

messages.msgid: Charged ether pulled out of the void between all things.
translations: 从万物之间的虚空中抽取出带电的以太。

messages.msgid: An extremely elastic sinew cut from a corpse, usable as a makeshift slinky.
translations: 从尸体上切下的一根弹性极佳的筋腱，可以当成一个简易的弹簧圈。

messages.msgid: An tightly wound sinew cut from a corpse, usable as thread.
translations: 从尸体上切下的一束紧紧盘绕的筋腱，可用作线绳。

messages.msgid: An short and tightly elastic sinew cut from a corpse, usable as thread.
translations: 从尸体上切下的一根短小而富有弹性的紧实筋腱，可用作缝线。

messages.msgid: Power used to fuel hedge magic.
translations: 为树篱魔法提供动力的能量。

messages.msgid: An original kantele made by Väinämöinen himself.  Fashioned from a great pike's jawbone, the material is unlike anything you saw before the end of the world.  Every note from this instrument thrums with power.
translations: 维纳莫宁亲手制作的康特勒琴真品。它由一条巨型狗鱼的颚骨打造而成，其材质与你在末日降临前所见的任何事物都截然不同。这把乐器奏出的每个音符都律动着澎湃的力量。

messages.msgid: A nice silver necklace.  Wearing it, you feel your aptitude in dream magic increase.
translations: 一条精美的银项链。戴上它，你会感到自己驾驭梦境魔法的才能有所增长。

messages.msgid: A small brown sphere, humming with power.  Activate it to recharge your mana.
translations: 一个棕色的小球，其中蕴含的能量正嗡嗡作响。启动它，便可为你的魔力充能。

messages.msgid: A small silver disk featuring a cow standing next to a river on one of its sides.
translations: 一枚银质小圆盘，其中一面刻画着一头站在河边的母牛。

messages.msgid: A back mounted flag identifying the loyalties of troops.  The heraldry on this banner is of white cow standing next to a river.
translations: 一面背负式旗帜，用以标明部队的归属。旗上的纹章是一头伫立于河畔的白牛。

messages.msgid: A fresh pile of bat guano; this could probably be used to make some great fertilizer.
translations: 一滩新鲜的蝙蝠粪，可以用来制造不错的肥料。

messages.msgid: strategic points of interest tourist map
messages.plural: strategic points of interest tourist maps

messages.msgid: A tourist brochure that has markings on it in places that clearly aren't the advertised tourist 'zebras?'.
translations: 一本旅游手册，上面画着一个标记位置明显不在广告中的旅游地点，“斑马？”。

messages.msgid: A scrap of paper.  Something's written on it, scrawled in bad handwriting.  You can barely make out the words 'Blood treatment' followed by a list of ingredients.
translations: 一张废纸。上面写着一些潦草的字迹，你可以勉强看清 "血疗 "这几个字，后面是一个原料清单。

messages.msgid: I'm sorry that I won't be there to greet you when you awaken into sentience my offspring, but this world is dying and I must take the roads back home before they darken and grow cold.  Even if I were here you would likely find my company to be short lived as the tradition of our people is to witness the waking and greet our offspring then leave them to explore the world on their own.  However, I have summoned some lesser creatures of the underhill realms to guard this place and you for as long as they can.  Most everything else in this world will attempt to kill you.  I have included instructions for how to make a healing item as well as a developmental potion that you can take to bring yourself further into your destiny and will grant new abilities, somewhat randomly I'm afraid.  I hope that you survive long enough to become what I hoped for you to be and that you are able to find one of the trodden paths from this place into the borderlands and from there deeper into Fae where you will hopefully find me.  All of my hopes and dreams ride with you.
translations: 我很抱歉，当你唤醒我的孩子时，我不能在那里迎接你，但这个世界正在消亡，我必须在它们变暗变冷之前回家的路上。即使我在这里，你也可能会发现我的陪伴是短暂的，因为我们人民的传统是见证醒来的人，问候我们的后代，然后让他们自己探索世界。然而，我已经召唤了一些潜山王国的次要生物来守卫这个地方和你们，只要他们能做到这一点。这个世界上几乎所有的东西都会试图杀了你。我已经包括了如何制造治疗物品的说明，以及一种发展药水，你可以服用它来进一步了解你的命运，并授予新的能力，恐怕这是随机的。我希望你活得足够长，成为我希望你成为的人，并且你能够找到一条被践踏的小路，从这个地方进入边疆，并从那里更深地进入异种，在那里你将有希望找到我。我所有的希望和梦想都与你同在。

messages.msgid: My dearest child, you are awaking into a cold dying world alone and without parents.  Honestly, this is for the best, for I was brought to life amongst the mortals of this realm and the parenting I would be able to pass on to you is entirely tragic.  I will spare you from that fate.  However, I have summoned some lesser creatures of the underhill realms to guard this place and you for as long as they can.  Most everything else in this world will attempt to kill you.  I have included instructions for how to make a healing item as well as a developmental potion that you can take to bring yourself further into your destiny and will grant new abilities, somewhat randomly I'm afraid.  I hope that you survive long enough to become what I hoped for you to be and that you are able to find one of the trodden paths from this place into the borderlands and from there deeper into Fae where you will hopefully find me.  All of my hopes and dreams ride with you.
translations: 我最亲爱的孩子，你正在醒来，进入一个孤独和没有父母的冰冷的垂死世界。老实说，这是最好的，因为我被带到这个王国的凡人中，我将能够传递给你们的育儿方式完全是悲惨的。我会让你免于那样的命运。然而，我已经召唤了一些潜山王国的次要生物来守卫这个地方和你们，只要他们能做到这一点。这个世界上几乎所有的东西都会试图杀了你。我已经包括了如何制造治疗物品的说明，以及一种发展药水，你可以服用它来进一步了解你的命运，并授予新的能力，恐怕这是随机的。我希望你活得足够长，成为我希望你成为的人，并且你能够找到一条被践踏的小路，从这个地方进入边疆，并从那里更深地进入异种，在那里你将有希望找到我。我所有的希望和梦想都与你同在。

messages.msgid: If you are reading this you have woken up to sentience as I planned.  My timing however was not great in that I've been forced to leave before showing you the hunting ground that I've brought you into existence in.  How I envy the experience you will have rampaging through the ashes of the old world.  There is significant danger in this world and in time you will be one of the most dangerous beings in it.  However, since that time is not yet I have summoned some lesser creatures of the underhill realms to guard this place and you for as long as they can.  Most everything else in this world will attempt to kill you.  I have included instructions for how to make a healing item as well as a developmental potion that you can take to bring yourself further into your destiny and will grant new abilities, somewhat randomly I'm afraid.  I hope that you rise to the top of this crush of predators I've been forced to abandon you among.  Good luck and good hunting.
translations: 如果你正在阅读这篇文章，你已经像我计划的那样觉醒了。然而，我的时机不是很好，因为我被迫离开，然后带你去看我带你存在的狩猎场。我多么羡慕你在旧世界的灰烬中横冲直撞的经历。这个世界上有很大的危险，随着时间的推移，你将成为这个世界上最危险的生物之一。然而，由于那个时间还没有到来，我已经召唤了一些潜山王国的次要生物来守卫这个地方和你们，尽可能长时间地守卫。这个世界上几乎所有的东西都会试图杀了你。我已经包括了如何制造治疗物品的说明，以及一种发展药水，你可以服用它来进一步了解你的命运，并授予新的能力，恐怕这是随机的。我希望你能站到这群掠食者的顶端，我已经被迫抛弃了你。祝你好运，祝你狩猎愉快。

messages.msgid: Spawn of my intentions, I address you from across space and time on today the day of your hatching.  As is the custom of our people you have been left in an uncivilized and barbaric place.  You must make your way back to us to become one of us.  For now you will take a name like those of the dead civilization we've deposited you in.  While you must develop on your own and find your way back to us, I have summoned some lesser creatures of the underhill realms to guard this place and you for as long as they can.  Most everything else in this world will attempt to kill you, be sure to kill it first.  I have included instructions for how to make a healing item as well as a developmental potion that you can take to bring yourself further into your destiny and will grant new abilities, somewhat randomly I'm afraid.  The depths will tremble one day in your wake and upon that day you will know how to find us.  If you fail we shall never know your name, like all the other lost children.
translations: 萌生我的意图，我从时空向你致敬，就在今天你孵化的那一天。按照我们人民的习俗，你们被留在了一个不文明和野蛮的地方。你必须回到我们身边才能成为我们的一员。现在你要取一个名字，就像我们把你放进去的那个死去的文明的名字。虽然你必须自己发展并找到回到我们这里的路，但我已经召唤了一些潜山王国的次要生物来守卫这个地方和你，尽可能长时间地守卫他们。这个世界上几乎所有的东西都会试图杀了你，一定要先杀了它。我已经包括了如何制造治疗物品的说明，以及一种发展药水，你可以服用它来进一步了解你的命运，并授予新的能力，恐怕这是随机的。有一天，深渊会在你的觉醒下颤抖，到那一天，你会知道如何找到我们。如果你失败了，我们将永远不会知道你的名字，就像所有其他走失的孩子一样。

messages.msgid: My beloved child, the Cataclysm struck at this world at a crucial time in your development and we were forced to leave you behind to be born alone or to mercy kill the life you were becoming.  When that was the choice upon us it felt like no choice at all.  If that was the kinder fate, I am sorry but my hopes to meet you one day were too strong.  I am shamed that our clan will be unable to provide you shade and company but, I have summoned some lesser creatures of the underhill realms to guard this place and you for as long as they can.  Most everything else in this world will attempt to kill you.  I have included instructions for how to make a healing item as well as a developmental potion that you can take to bring yourself further into your destiny and will grant new abilities, somewhat randomly I'm afraid.  I hope that you survive long enough to become what I hoped for you to be and that you are able to find one of the trodden paths from this place into the borderlands and from there deeper into Fae where you will hopefully find me.  All of my hopes and dreams ride with you.
translations: 我亲爱的孩子，大灾变降临此界之时，正值你成长的关键时刻。我们别无选择，只能将你遗弃于此，任你独自降生，或是……亲手扼杀你这尚未成形的生命，以求解脱。当抉择仅限于此，那便已无从选择。若后者是更仁慈的宿命，请原谅我——因为有朝一日与你相见的希望，是如此强烈。我们的氏族无法为你遮风挡雨、与你相伴，我为此深感羞愧。但我已召唤了一些来自山丘之下领域的次级精怪，只要它们一息尚存，便会守护此地与你。在这世上，其他绝大多数东西都会想取你性命。我附上了一份治疗物品的制作说明，还有一剂成长秘药的配方。服下它，你将进一步踏上自己的天命之路，并获得新的能力——恐怕能力的赋予会有些随机。我希望你能活下去，长成我所期望的模样；希望你能从此处找到一条前人踏出的小径，通往边境之地，再从那里深入妖精乡，最终与我重逢。我所有的希望与梦想，都寄托在你身上。

messages.msgid: Brethren of soil and stone.  How our tribe longed to see you stretch forth from the forming pit like so many others before you.  It is shame that will take many generations of our people to wash away that we were unable to stay to bring you with us.  However, I have summoned some lesser creatures of the underhill realms to guard this place and you for as long as they can.  Most everything else in this world will attempt to kill you.  I have included instructions for how to make a healing item as well as a developmental potion that you can take to bring yourself further into your destiny and will grant new abilities, somewhat randomly I'm afraid.
