I hope that you survive long enough to become what I hoped for you to be and that you are able to find one of the trodden paths from this place into the borderlands and from there deeper into Fae where you will hopefully find me.  We await you joining our chorus in the deep caves of Fae, once you find your way here.
translations: 泥土和石头的兄弟。我们的部落多么渴望看到你像你之前的许多其他人一样从形成的坑中伸展出来。遗憾的是，我们不能留下来带你们一起走，这将需要我们几代人的努力来洗刷。然而，我已经召唤了一些潜山王国的次要生物来守卫这个地方和你们，只要他们能做到这一点。这个世界上几乎所有的东西都会试图杀了你。我已经包括了如何制造治疗物品的说明，以及一种发展药水，你可以服用它来进一步了解你的命运，并授予新的能力，恐怕这是随机的。我希望你活得足够长，成为我希望你成为的人，并且你能够找到一条被践踏的小路，从这个地方进入边疆，并从那里更深地进入异种，在那里你将有希望找到我。一旦你找到了这里的路，我们就在异种深处的洞穴里等待你加入我们的合唱团。

messages.msgid: Walking the shadowed path of Blood
messages.plural: copies of Walking the shadowed path of Blood

messages.msgid: This handwritten book contains a very thorough detailing of all what a vampire needs to reach their full potential.  You already know most of it, but some parts have yet to be read.
translations: 这本手抄本极为详尽地记述了吸血鬼发挥全部潜能所需的一切。其中大部分内容你已了然于心，但仍有部分未曾阅览。

messages.msgid: The map on which you wrote the cryptid's location.
translations: 你用来记录隐秘生物位置的地图。

messages.msgid: You already know where this map leads.
translations: 你已经知道这张地图指向哪里了

messages.msgid: You reference your map with your location, determining the path to take to find the cryptid.
translations: 你对照地图和当前位置，确定了寻找隐秘生物的路线。

messages.msgid:
The notes you have taken about the cryptid you're hunting.
Also known as the mongolian death worm, the Olgoi-khorkhoi is a massive acid-spewing burrowing worm.  Finding acid-resistant gear will prove useful to survive the encounter.  According to most of the credible stories you've read, the lethal poison covering its skin is nothing but exaggerations.
translations:
你为狩猎的隐秘生物所作的笔记。
它又被称为“蒙古死亡蠕虫”，学名“奥尔戈伊-科尔科伊”，是一种会喷吐酸液的巨型穴居蠕虫。若想在此次遭遇中幸存，寻找抗酸装备会大有裨益。根据你读到的大多数可靠说法，其皮肤上覆盖着致命剧毒的传闻纯属夸大其词。

messages.msgid:
The notes you have taken about the cryptid you're hunting.
The man of the Nineteenth Hour is peaceful for most of the day but becomes incredibly violent against those who are still awake when he enters his active phase.  Some stories tell that his presence shields those who are sleeping against everything that could disturb their sleep.
translations:
你为狩猎的隐秘生物所作的笔记。
“第十九小时之人”在一天中的大部分时间里都很平和，但一旦进入活跃期，他便会对那些仍醒着的人表现出极度的暴力。一些传说提到，他的存在能庇护沉睡之人，使其免受一切扰其清梦的事物侵扰。

messages.msgid: This handwritten book contains the detailed yet disorganized notes of a vampire who found how to consume other vampires for power.  Reading it might tell you how to do it, if it is what you want.
translations: 这本手抄本是一位吸血鬼的笔记，内容详尽却又杂乱无章，记录着他发现的吞噬同类以攫取力量的方法。如果你也想染指这种力量，阅读此书或许能告诉你该如何下手。
《关于“欢笑舞者”的冶金学研究》
messages.plural: copies of Report: LAUGHING DANCER metallurgy

messages.msgid: A series of documents discussing the properties of the armor and weapons used by a group or organization only referred to as "LAUGHING DANCER".  Some of these described specifications don't seem physically possible.
translations: 这一系列文件探讨了一个代号为“欢笑舞者”的团体所使用的装甲与武器之特性。其中描述的一些规格参数似乎已超出了物理法则的范畴。

messages.msgid: A magazine for occult investigators.  These types of magazines proliferated in the decade prior to the Cataclysm.
translations: 一本面向神秘学调查员的杂志。这类杂志在大灾变之前的十年间大量涌现。

messages.msgid: A tabloid paper with a rather unusually out-of-this-world articles even for tabloids' standard, ranging from something like an article about morticians selling the deceased's 'dreams' to the government to a sensational headline about a half-bat half-human boy causing 40-car pileup in the highway while driving away from police pursuit.  While most thought of The Noon as an amusing but otherwise mostly fake news paper in the past, the Cataclysm might bring the articles' presumably fake facts to light.
translations: 一份小报，即便以小报的标准来衡量，其文章内容也堪称光怪陆离。从报道殡仪师向政府贩卖死者“梦境”，到头条爆料半人半蝠的男孩为逃避警方追捕而在高速公路上造成四十车连环追尾，其内容无所不包。尽管在过去，大多数人只把《正午报》当作一份有趣的消遣读物，认为其内容纯属子虚乌有，但大灾变或许会印证其中那些看似荒诞不经的报道。

messages.msgid: The Holmesian Guide to Magickal Practice
translations: 福尔摩斯魔法实践指南
messages.plural: copies of The Holmesian Guide to Magickal Practice

messages.msgid: It's big and heavy, but full of great information about esoteric investigations.
translations: 一本又大又重的书，但是记载着大量深奥的调查知识。

messages.plural: copies of Scraggy-Boo and the Mystery Crew

messages.msgid: A guide for teens interested in pursuing occult knowledge.  Readers often speak of encountering a guide in their dreams of a Russian Sheepdog, who introduces himself as Scraggy-Boo.
translations: 一本面向对神秘学知识感兴趣的青少年的指南。读者们经常说他们会在梦中受到一位俄罗斯牧羊犬的引导，他自称斯格拉布。

messages.plural: copies of Escaping the Black Iron Prison

messages.msgid: A hardbound book detailing numerous rituals and thought modifications in order to teach its readers how to break the shackles of mundanity.
translations: 一本精装书，详细介绍了许多仪式和控制思维的方法，以教导读者如何打破世俗的束缚。

messages.msgid: This book always feels like it shouldn't be where it is.  Its texts are incoherent and illogical, but they promise to help you understand something.  Reading a few words from its pages is enough to give you a headache.
translations: 这本书总让你觉得它不该出现在这里。书里的文字语无伦次，毫无逻辑可言，却似乎承诺能让你领悟到什么。仅仅阅读几行字，就足以让你头痛欲裂。

messages.msgid:
A haphazardly-written book filled with ramblings about something it calls "the Lies".  You feel threatened by this book, uneasy at the thought of having it on your person, but parsing its texts could give you insight on how things truly are.
Only the first third of the pages are filled with text, and the last written page is splattered in red.
translations:
一本胡乱写就的书，里面满是关于其所谓的“谎言”的疯言疯语。这本书让你感到威胁，光是带着它就让你坐立不安。然而，细究其文，或许能让你洞悉事物的本来面目。
书页仅有前三分之一写有文字，而写有字的最后一页上，溅满了红色的污渍。

messages.msgid: These organs came from a beast from the nether.
translations: 从异界怪物身上切下的奇怪器官。

messages.msgid: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from a fur-bearing animal from a specific region of the Nether.  It still has the fur attached.  You can cure it for storage and tanning, or eat it if you're desperate enough.
translations: 一块从有毛皮的异界怪物身上仔细地削下来的生皮。还连着毛。你可以加工它来存储并进一步的鞣制，或者直接吃掉它，如果你的肚子里真的是一根毛都没有了的话。

messages.msgid: Freshly butchered meat from a fae beast.  You could eat it raw, but cooking it is better.
translations: 屠宰妖精怪物得到的肉，可以直接食用，但烹饪加工后更美味并且更加安全。

messages.msgid: This is a tiny scrap of edible meat from a fae beast.  It's not much, but it'll do in a pinch.
translations: 一小块尚可食用的妖精碎肉。虽然量不多，但是应急用也足够了。

messages.msgid: Blood, from a specific part of the Nether.  Disgusting!
translations: 一些来自异界生物的鲜血。看着可真恶心！

messages.msgid: This is a chunk of freshly cooked fae meat.  It's filling and nutritious, but unseasoned and a bit bland.
translations: 一块经过简单烹饪的妖精肉。能够填饱肚子，营养也还丰富，但没有调过味，吃上去有点枯燥乏味。

messages.msgid: The stomach of an omnivorous creature.  It is surprisingly durable.
translations: 杂食生物的胃袋，出人意料地结实耐用。

messages.msgid: The four stomachs of a grazing creature.  It is surprisingly durable.
translations: 反刍生物的四个胃室，出人意料地结实耐用。

messages.msgid: The stomach of a herbivore.  It is surprisingly durable.
translations: 食草生物的胃袋，出人意料地结实耐用。

messages.msgid: The stomach of an carnivorous creature.  It is surprisingly durable.
translations: 食肉生物的胃袋，出人意料地结实耐用。

messages.msgid: The stomach of a small carnivorous creature.  It is surprisingly durable.
translations: 小型食肉生物的胃袋，出人意料地结实耐用。

messages.msgid: The stomach of a small omnivorous creature.  It is surprisingly durable.
translations: 小型杂食生物的胃袋，出人意料地结实耐用。

messages.msgid: The stomach of a small herbivore.  It is surprisingly durable.
translations: 小型食草生物的胃袋，出人意料地结实耐用。

messages.msgid: The two stomachs of a giant ant.  One stomach is for digestion and one stomach is for storing food for the colony.
translations: 巨蚁的两个胃袋。一个用于消化，另一个则用来为蚁群贮藏食物。

messages.msgid: Blood extracted from a vampire.  Drinking it feels like a bad idea but there might be other ways to use it.
translations: 从吸血鬼身上提取的血液。喝下它似乎不是个好主意，但可能也有其他方式能够利用它。

messages.msgid: An empty casing from a 9x21mm round.

This seed might be more accurately compared to a bulb, because like a bulb you dug it out of the home it had made and chopped off its extremities and are now preparing to plant it in a new location; only, in this instance the hole was dug into the chest of a dead vampire minion and the new location is nestled against the still-beating heart of a patient.
translations: 这颗种子更像是一个鳞茎，因为就像鳞茎一样，你挖出它原本存在的位置，并切去了末端的部分，现在正准备把它种在一个新的地方；只不过，在这种情况下，你是在一个死亡的吸血鬼手下的胸部挖了个洞，并将它种在了一个仍在跳动的病人心脏旁。

messages.msgid: What reason could anyone have making a bionic power generator that runs off the blood of vampires?  After some thought, one option that occurs to you would be the possibility that by limiting the fuel options, a vampire is also limiting the opportunities for a rogue minion to use its bionics against its master.
translations: 为什么会有人用吸血鬼的血来驱动燃料电池呢?经过一番思考，你想到了一种可能，即吸血鬼通过限制燃料来源，以此防止它们的仆从依靠CBM来反抗主人。

messages.msgid: A jar-like container that includes a set of vocal cords with a large hood at the top of them and rootlike tendrils at the base connecting to a microchip.
translations: 一个类似罐子的容器，内含一组带有大罩子的声带，顶部有根状的藤蔓与连接到微芯片的基部。
巨型嗜血蝙蝠音频装置

messages.msgid: A jar-like container that includes a set of oversized and reinforced vocal cords with a large hood at the top of them and rootlike tendrils at the base connecting to a microchip.
translations: 一个类似罐子的容器，内部装有一组超大号和加固的声带，顶部有一个大罩子，底部连接着类似根状的触须，与一个微芯片相连。

messages.msgid: A syringe that extends out into two tubes that snake up through the nostrils and down to the lungs in order to get the spores deep into their new home, where they can best spread through the body.
translations: 一种注射器，伸出两根管子，蜿蜒穿过鼻孔，延伸至肺部，以便将孢子深入它们的新家，从而最好地在体内传播。

messages.msgid: A short-sleeved cotton tee featuring a uniquely odd design that sets it apart from any you've seen before.
translations: 一件纯棉短袖T恤。上面的图案设计得奇特又罕见，和你以往见过的所有款式都截然不同。

messages.msgid: Seven Faceless Voids for Seven Brothers t-shirt
messages.plural: Seven Faceless Voids for Seven Brothers t-shirts

messages.msgid: A pink t-shirt with seven ominous figures in bridal wear facing towards seven identical men.  There are tears running down from the eyes of the men.
translations: 一件粉色T恤，上面有七个身穿婚纱的不祥人物，面向七个一模一样的男人。男人们的眼睛里流下了泪水。

messages.msgid: A shirt that says Sawzall the Musical in bold letters, over a giant Sawzall tool.
translations: 一件衬衫，上面用粗体字母写着Sawzall the Musical，上面有一个巨大的往复锯图标。

messages.msgid: This t-shirt displays a picture of a man standing behind a go table, the text is using an unfamiliar alphabet.  His features seem subtly off.
translations: 这件T恤展示了一张照片，照片上一名男子站在一张围棋桌后面，里面的文字来自一个陌生的字母表。他的五官似乎有点不对劲。

messages.msgid: A short-sleeved cotton shirt with the logo of a Tachli team printed on its front and back.  It looks like it might be a violent sport.
translations: 棉一件正面和背面印有Tachli团队标志的短袖棉质衬衫。看起来这可能是一项激烈的运动。

messages.msgid: A short-sleeved cotton shirt with the logo of a rollerball team, whatever that is, printed on its front and back.
translations: 一件印有滚球队标志的短袖棉质衬衫，无论是什么，正面和背面都印着。

messages.msgid: This t-shirt displays a purple sun rising over a town that looks like it came out of a Doctor Seuss book.
translations: 这件T恤展示了一个小镇上升起的紫色太阳，看起来就像是出自苏斯博士的书中。

messages.msgid: A short-sleeved cotton shirt with a globe at the bottom with a C above the globe with an S to the left and A to the right.  The background is like a flag with the top left being the corner of a black triangle and the bottom right is a red triangle.  They meet in the middle with the globe.
translations: 一件纯棉短袖衫，图案底部是一个地球，地球上方是字母C，左右两侧分别是字母S和A。背景图案形似一面旗帜，左上角是黑色三角的一角，右下角是红色三角。两个三角在中间与地球图案交汇。

messages.msgid: A simple garment made of gossamer.  It's very light, and the fabric shimmers in a rainbow of colors in the sunlight.
translations: 一件由蛛丝般轻薄材料制成的简易衣物。它极其轻盈，在阳光下织物闪耀着彩虹般的绚丽色彩。

messages.msgid: A simple, sleeveless garment made of gossamer.  It's very light, and the fabric shimmers in a rainbow of colors in the sunlight.
translations: 一件由蛛丝般轻薄材料制成的无袖设计的简易衣物。它极其轻盈，在阳光下织物闪耀着彩虹般的绚丽色彩。

messages.msgid: A thick overshirt of gossamer, shimmering in a rainbow of colors.  This would have made you the king of the Renn Faire.
translations: 一件厚厚的月之纱套衫，闪烁着彩虹般的色彩。 这件衣服会让你成为雷恩狂欢节之王。

messages.msgid: A gossamer dress, shimmering in a mix of rainbow colors.
translations: 一件月之纱的连衣裙，闪烁着混合彩虹色的微光。

messages.msgid: A full-length gossamer gown, like a waterfall of coruscating light.
translations: 一袭月之纱长裙，宛如瀑布般璀璨夺目。

messages.msgid: A gossamer cloak meant to be thrown over your body.  It looks like ripples of multicolored light when worn.
translations: 一件可以披在身上的月之纱斗篷。 披上后，就像荡漾着五颜六色的涟漪。

messages.msgid: A thin gossamer jacket.  Despite its lack of heft, its surprisingly warm.
translations: 一件薄薄的月之纱夹克。 尽管没有厚重感，却出奇地保暖。

messages.msgid: A flowing gossamer robe, like a waterfall of light.  There are a surprising amount of pockets cunningly hidden in the iridescent folds.
translations: 一件流动的月之纱长袍，像一道瀑布般的光。彩虹色的褶皱中隐藏着数量惊人的口袋。

messages.msgid: A gossamer covering for your loins, for when you want to feel like you're wearing moonbeams.
translations: 为你的腰部披上一层月之纱，让你感觉像披上了月光。

messages.msgid: A pair of gossamer pants with two pockets.  They shimmer opalescently.
translations: 一条有两个口袋的月之纱裤子。 闪烁着乳白色的光泽。

messages.msgid: A pair of tight-fitting gossamer pants with no pockets.  They would have been the absolute height of fashion five hundred years ago.
translations: 一条没有口袋的月之纱紧身裤子。 五百年前，这绝对是时尚的顶峰。

messages.msgid: A loose gossamer skirt, like a waterfall of light.
translations: 一条宽松的月之纱短裙，宛如瀑布般闪烁。

messages.msgid: A long gossamer skirt that shimmers like a woven rainbow.  It's warmer and more fashionable than a shorter gossamer skirt.
translations: 一条月之纱长裙，如锦似虹，闪闪发光。它比一条月之纱短裙更暖和、更时尚。

messages.msgid: Gossamer socks.  Whether your shoes are made of leather or canvas or moonlight or nightmares, they'll keep your feet from rubbing in them.
translations: 月之纱的袜子。无论你的鞋子是皮革、帆布甚至是月光、噩梦啥的材质，它都能防止你的脚与鞋的摩擦。

messages.msgid: A pair of gossamer stockings that shimmer in a rainbow of muted colors.
translations: 一双闪烁着彩虹般柔和色彩的长筒袜。

messages.msgid: Soft indoor shoes, suitable for wearing whie drinking liquid light from goblets of unmelting ice and dancing the night away.
translations: 柔质室内鞋，适合穿着它们时，自永不消融之冰所制高脚杯中啜饮流光，彻夜翩然起舞。

messages.msgid: A heavy cloak made of living leaves with long twigs and branches connecting them, meant to be thrown over your body.
translations: 由活树叶和长树枝连接而成的厚重斗篷，可以披在身上。

messages.msgid: A five-liter ingot of solid cold iron.

A classic medieval sword, just the right size to use one-handed.

Made with cold iron and lacking a proper grip, this is better than the sticks you swung around as a kid, but you know you can do better.
translations:
一把经典的中世纪剑，大小正好可以单手使用。

这把剑由寒铁制成，而且缺乏合适的握柄，虽然比你小时候挥舞的棍子好，但你知道你可以做得更好。

messages.msgid: A huge cold iron axe designed for early warfare.  Though intended for use as a weapon, it can also be pressed into service as a rather clumsy woodcutting tool.
translations: 一把专为早期战争设计的寒铁巨斧。虽然只建议作为武器使用，但也可以勉强当作一把相当笨拙的伐木工具。

messages.msgid: A medieval dagger forged from cold iron.  It is not the sharpest tool in the shed, but it is certainly one of the largest.
translations: 寒铁锻造的中世纪短剑，不是最锋利的匕首，但肯定是最大的。

messages.msgid: A pin-shaped piece of steel.  It can be used to construct various things with a hammer.  Forged from dreamdross, which makes it much lighter.  They do curse and scream at you in an eldritch tongue while you hammer them in and sometimes refuse to be used in specific purposes.
translations: 一枚钉子形状的钢材。可以用锤子将其打造成各种东西。它由浮梦残渣锻造而成，因此轻便了许多。在你捶打它们时，它们会用怪诞的语言对你咒骂尖叫，有时甚至会拒绝用于特定目的。

messages.msgid: "Wyld Candy, our flavors span the possible" is emblazoned proudly upon this shiny colorful wrapper.
translations: "怀尔德糖果，我们的口味跨越无穷可能。"被自豪地印在这张闪亮多彩的包装纸上。

messages.msgid: A large moon tear canteen.  It radiates the cold of the grave and smells strongly of blood.  Any blood stored inside is protected from spoilage by some kind of fae enchantment.
translations: 一个大号的月之泪水壶。它散发着阴森的气息和浓浓的血腥味。任何储存在里面的血液都受到某种奇异魔法的保护而免于变质。

messages.msgid: A slim and lightweight insulated moon tear bladder worn on the back or within a hydration pouch in a backpack.  Perfect for the renfield on the go.  It has a large pocket and a capped mouth for filling with blood, with a hose that allows the wearer to drink hands-free.  Any blood stored inside is protected from spoilage by some kind of fae enchantment.
translations: 一个纤薄轻巧的月之泪制成的水袋，可背在背上或背包的水袋位内。它有一个大口袋和一个用于填充血液的带盖嘴，带有一根软管，可以让佩戴者时解放双手。 任何储存在里面的血液都受到某种魔法的保护而不会变质。"很适合血仆出行携带"

messages.msgid: A broken sniper bot.  Total scrap, but some stuff is still useful.
translations: 一台坏掉的狙击机器人。完全是废品，但有些东西仍然有用。

messages.msgid: A broken shotgun bot.  Total scrap, but some stuff is still useful.
translations: 一个坏掉的霰弹枪机器人。完全是废品，但有些东西仍然有用。

messages.msgid: A broken cutthroater.  Total scrap, but some stuff is still useful.
translations: 一台坏掉的割喉者机械蜘蛛。完全是废品，但有些东西仍然有用。

messages.msgid: A broken Exodii Jotunn walker.  Still looks incredibly intimidating despite being permanently inoperative, due to the sheer size, mass, and protruding weapons.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台损坏的流亡族巨人机器人。可能因为巨大的体积、质量和怪异武器的缘故，就算已经永久无法继续运作，依旧看起来可怕无比。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: The automaton is now much more broken than it was before.  It resembles a pile of random parts and its internals are fried beyond salvage but could be gutted for materials.
translations: 这台机偶的损坏程度比之前严重得多。它形如一堆散乱的零件，内部构件已烧毁，无法回收，但可以拆解以获取材料。

messages.msgid: The dead body of a changeling.  There are multiple bites across the body and numerous scratches.  It looks like blood loss might have brought them down.
translations: 一具换生灵的尸体。尸体上有多处遍布全身的咬伤和巨大的爪痕。看起来似乎是失血过多将它带进鬼门关的。

messages.msgid: Extreme burns cover the body of this changeling.  In multiple locations the charring goes all the way to the bone.
translations: 剧烈的烧伤遍布了这具换生灵的尸体。在许多部位，炭化的伤口深入尸骨。

messages.msgid: Several ballistic wounds seem to have brought down this changeling.  It probably happened elsewhere and they escaped to here.
translations: 看起来几处枪伤将这只换生灵杀死了。这种事可能在别处发生过，而它们逃到了这里。

messages.msgid: This lifeless body is covered in a rime of frost, that seems resistant to the prevailing weather.
translations: 这具没有生命体征的尸体上布满了白霜，看起来这些白霜能耐受当下天气。

messages.msgid: This changeling seems to have gotten themselves impaled upon an unhealthy number of large thorns.  What kind of plant could do this?
translations: 这个换生灵似乎被异常多的大型荆棘刺穿了。哪种植物能做到这种事？

messages.msgid: This changeling corpse has a belly wound that appears to be caused by a sword and is also missing its hand.
translations: 这具换生灵尸体的腹部上有一道刀剑造成的伤口，手也被砍了下来。

messages.msgid: dreamforged bed of restful repose, folded for travel
messages.plural: dreamforged beds of restful repose, folded for travel

messages.msgid: A large object folded up into a box for itself, the size of a keyboard.
translations: 一个折叠起来后能装入自带盒子的大物件，大小与键盘相仿。

messages.msgid: A shimmering silvery dust.  Narcotic with the street name of Faewild.  Causes the user to see colors not normally visible to the naked human eye.
translations: 一小撮闪闪发光的银色微尘。在街头被成为“狂妖”的毒品。让使用者能看到肉眼通常不可见的颜色。

messages.msgid: You rub the glittering dust into your gums.
translations: 你把闪闪发光的微尘擦到牙龈上。

messages.msgid: A drug that became popular over the last few years before the Cataclysm.  It appears to be exactly as its street name, a dark purple lotus blossom.  It's known to be a strong painkiller while also causing vivid hallucinations.
translations: 一种在大灾变前几年里流行起来的药。它看起来和它的绰号一模一样，是一朵深紫色的莲花。已知是一种强效止痛药，同时也会引起强烈幻觉。

messages.msgid: You eat the purple lotus blossom.
translations: 你吃下了这朵紫色的莲花。

messages.msgid: Mixed candies purporting to come from 'Fair Folk Industries' these candies appear in areas of the country thought to have significant crossover events.  It remains unknown whether these candies are produced by a company from here taking advantage of a thin place or if they came from somewhere else.
translations: 一些据称来自"美人工业"的混合糖果。这些糖果出现在被国家认为存在重大跨世界活动的地区。目前尚不清楚这些糖果是由此公司在这些地点利用稀薄结界生产的，或是来自其他世界。

messages.msgid: This homemade blood treatment purports to reduce the cravings brought on by vampirism and if applied often and early to even reverse some stages of the disease.  But vampires surely can't be real, can they?
translations: 这种自制的血液疗法声称可以减少吸血鬼症带来的渴求，如果经常和及早使用，甚至可以逆转疾病的某些阶段。 但吸血鬼肯定不是真的，不是吗？

messages.msgid: A poultice made from the elements of the earth.  You could use it to heal your wounds, if you were made of stone.
translations: 由大地元素制成的膏药。 如果你是石头做的，你可以用它来治愈伤口。

messages.msgid: A poultice made from plant life.  You could use it to heal your wounds, if you were grown from plants.
translations: 用植物制成的膏药。 如果你是从植物中生长出来的，你可以用它来治愈伤口。

messages.msgid: A poultice made from the elements of the sea.  You could use it to heal your wounds, if you were liquid as well.
translations: 由海洋元素制成的膏药。 如果你也是液体，你可以用它来愈合伤口。

messages.msgid: A devotion to the powers of fire.  You could use it to heal your wounds, if you were born of the flames.
translations: 皈依火之力。若你身为火焰，此法可治愈伤口。

messages.msgid: A paste made from paint and glue.  You could use it to heal your wounds, if you were made in man's image.
translations: 由油漆和胶水制成的糊状物。如果你是按人的形象制造的，你可以用它来治愈伤口。

messages.msgid: A concoction made from honey and bread.  You could use it to heal your wounds, if you were born of air and darkness.
translations: 由蜂蜜和面包调制而成 如果你是由空气和黑暗所生，你可以用它来治愈伤口。
翻腾的吸血鬼血液混合物

messages.msgid: Vampire blood mixed with blood none would consume and different toxic substances.  The hostile environment is already driving the vampire blood to devour itself.  It will be ready to consume in a few days.
translations: 吸血鬼的血液与某种不宜饮用的血液及多种有毒物质混合在一起。恶劣的环境正促使吸血鬼的血液自我吞噬。数日后即可饮用。

messages.msgid: The vampire blood has completely devoured itself, leaving a small dose of very potent vampire blood behind.
translations: 吸血鬼的血液已将自身完全吞噬，只余下一小份极其强效的同源血液。

messages.msgid: The vampire blood is still devouring itself.
translations: 吸血鬼的血液仍在自我吞噬。

messages.msgid: Vampire blood that been forced to gain the ability to devour vampire blood to survive.  Consuming it will allow you to devour vampire blood to gain power, like that vampire did before you caused their end.
translations: 这种吸血鬼血液被迫获得了吞噬同类血液以求生存的能力。饮用它，你便能像那个被你终结的吸血鬼一样，通过吞噬同类的血液来获取力量。

messages.msgid: A heavy, dark laptop with a swappable battery slot.  The back panel is labeled "PROPERTY OF XEDRA".  It uses a non-standard OS, so there's not much you can use it for without reinstalling it.
translations: 一台厚重的深色笔记本电脑，配有可插拔的电池仓。背板上标有“XEDRA公司财产”字样。它使用非标准操作系统，若不重装系统，基本派不上用场。

messages.msgid: You can guess a password and check some classified information, if it has any.
translations: 你可以猜测一个密码，并检查一些机密信息，如果有的话。
尝试打开锁定的文件夹

messages.msgid: You can reinstall the OS to use it as a common laptop.
translations: 你可以重新安装操作系统，将其作为普通笔记本电脑使用。

messages.msgid: Your edges blur and expand and contract in ways that don't reflect reality.  Allows you to dodge two extra attacks in a given turn.
translations: 你身体的边缘模糊、膨胀、收缩，似乎并不反映现实。让你在每回合中可以额外闪避两次攻击。

messages.msgid: A precognitive aura that allows you to dodge things you didn't see coming.
translations: 预知光环可以让你躲避尚未看到的袭来事物。

messages.msgid: This is a thin ephemeral sword with an ornate hand guard.  It looks like the preferred weapon of gentlemen and swashbucklers.  Light and quick, it makes any battle a stylish one.
translations: 这是一把短暂存在的带有华丽护手的细剑，看起来像是绅士和剑客的首选武器。 它轻便快捷，让每场战斗都充满时尚气息。

messages.msgid: This ephemeral dagger is 15 inches long from the hilt to the tip, the double-edged blade itself is a pearly white color and extremely sharp.
translations: 这把短暂存在的匕首全长15英寸，两面开刃的刀身呈珍珠白色，十分锋利。

messages.msgid: A summoned medieval armor made from dreamdross.  It shimmers in the light and provides some protection.
translations: 一套召唤出的中世纪盔甲，由浮梦残渣构成。它在光线下闪闪发光，提供了一些保护。

messages.msgid: Hey I thought this was America…
translations: 哈我想这里可是美利坚……

messages.msgid: The platonic embodiment of a blacksmiths hammer.  This hammer is necessary to forge or repair items made of forged dreamstuff.
translations: 一把铁匠锤的柏拉图式化身。这把锤子是锻造或修理铸梦材料制品的必备工具。

messages.msgid: A long handle ending in a two-sided head, one of which is hollow, and the other… does not exist.  Weirdly, both heads are equally useful, and the balance of hammer is pretty good to be useful as a weapon.  By activating and attacking with the hollow part, the hammer creates a tremendous force, able to break a thick tree (or someone's spine) in half, but will be destroyed afterwards.
translations: 长柄的末端是一个两面的锤头，其中一面是空心的，而另一面……并不存在。 奇怪的是，这两个头都同样有用，而且锤子的平衡性相当好，可以作为武器使用。 启动锤子并用空心部分进行攻击，锤子就会产生巨大的力量，可以将粗大的树木（或人的脊柱）砸成两半，但之后就会被摧毁。

messages.msgid: A small token that floats near your right hand.  It pulls you to determined coordinates when you command it.
translations: 一个漂浮在你右手附近的小令牌。 只要你发出指令，它就会把你拉到确定的坐标处。

messages.msgid: A large pouch of churning water on your back, containing a sealed air bubble.  It shifts and adjusts itself to minimize encumbrance.
translations: 翻涌搅动的水在你的背上形成了一个可以储物的袋子，包裹着内部空间形成了一个密封的空气泡。它不断改变和调整，以减小累赘。

messages.msgid: A long whip made of red-hot fire.  It crackles menacingly and casts a flickering red glow.
translations: 由炽热殷红的火制成的长鞭。它发出危险的噼啪声和闪烁的红光。

messages.msgid: The waters reveal themselves to you.
A large, hollow sphere of plant matter, bark, and wood.  Food placed inside will rot one-fifth as fast as it would if left out in the open air.
translations: 由植物物质、树皮和木头组成的空心大球。放在里面的食物的腐烂速度是暴露在外时的五分之一。

messages.msgid: You are protected from extremely bright lights.
translations: 你将免受极强光线的伤害。

messages.msgid: A magical transparent sphere.  You can use it to store any type of blood, at least until the sphere vanishes.
translations: 一个透明的魔法球。你可以用它存储任何类型的血液，至少直到它消失前。

messages.msgid: A very large wooden cabinet for storing clothes, effectively an upright closet.  It's all made of a single, solid piece of wood, with twists and curves like it grew in place rather than being made.
translations: 一个用来存放衣物的巨型木柜，相当于一个立式衣橱。它通体由一整块实木构成，其上的扭曲与弧度，仿佛是原地生长出来的一样，而非后天打造。

messages.msgid: An organ that allows a mature Gracken to convert their arms back to a base state.
translations: 一种能让成年格拉肯将其臂膀转化回基础形态的器官。

messages.msgid: An organ that allows a mature Gracken to convert their arms to a stronger form.
translations: 一种能让成年格拉肯将其臂膀转化成更强壮形态的器官。

messages.msgid: An organ that allows a mature Gracken to convert their arms to a longer form.
translations: 一种能让成年格拉肯将其臂膀转化成更长形态的器官。

messages.msgid: An organ that allows a mature Gracken to convert their hands back to a base state.
translations: 一种能让成年格拉肯将其手部转化回基础形态的器官。

messages.msgid: An organ that allows a mature Gracken to convert their hands to a sharper form.
translations: 一种能让成年格拉肯将其手部转化成更锐利形态的器官。

messages.msgid: An organ that allows a mature Gracken to convert their hands to a more agile form.
translations: 一种能让成年格拉肯将其手部转化成更敏捷形态的器官。

messages.msgid: An organ that allows a mature Gracken to convert their diet to an herbivorous one.
translations: 一种能让成年格拉肯将其饮食习性转化为草食性的器官。

messages.msgid: An organ that allows a mature Gracken to convert their diet to an omnivorous one.
translations: 一种能让成年格拉肯将其饮食习性转化为杂食性的器官。

messages.msgid: An organ that allows a mature Gracken to convert their diet to an carnivorous one.
translations: 一种能让成年格拉肯将其饮食习性转化为肉食性的器官。

messages.msgid: An organ that allows a mature Gracken to convert their legs back to a base state.
translations: 一种能让成年格拉肯将其腿部转化回基础形态的器官。

messages.msgid: An organ that allows a mature Gracken to convert their legs to a shorter form.
translations: 一种能让成年格拉肯将其腿部转化成更短形态的器官。

messages.msgid: An organ that allows a mature Gracken to convert their legs to a longer form.
translations: 一种能让成年格拉肯将其腿部转化成更长形态的器官。
谢尔久科夫 SR-1 "斑蝰蛇"手枪 18发弹匣

messages.msgid: An 18-round box magazine for use with the SR-1 Vektor 9x21mm pistol.
translations: 一个18发弹匣，可用于 SR-1 Vektor 9x21mm 手枪。

messages.msgid: A removable plastic 8-round box magazine, for use with the AA-12 shotgun.
translations: 一个可拆卸的8发塑料弹匣，可用于 AA-12 霰弹枪。

messages.msgid: A removable plastic 32-round drum magazine, for use with the HAMMER dual AA-12 turret system.
translations: 一个可拆卸的32发塑料弹鼓，可用于悍马双联装 AA-12 霰弹枪。

messages.msgid: A removable plastic 64-round drum magazine, for use with the AA-12 shotgun.
translations: 一个可拆卸的64发塑料弹鼓，可用于 AA-12 霰弹枪。

messages.msgid: This is the integrated suppressor for the FN Five-seveN suppressed.  Its large expansion chamber decelerates ammunition via several ports in the barrel, rendering most ammo subsonic at the cost of terminal performance.  It is not as effective as modern designs.
translations: 这是FN 五七式手枪（消音版）的整合式消音器。其巨大的膨胀室通过枪管上的数个开孔为弹药减速，以牺牲终端性能为代价，使大多数弹药降至亚音速。其效果不如现代设计。
FN 五七式手枪（消音版）

messages.msgid: Designed to work with FN's proprietary 5.7x28mm round and with a built in suppressor, the Five-seveN is a lightweight integrally suppressed pistol with a very high capacity, best used against armored opponents.
translations: 这是一款专为 FN 赫斯塔尔公司特有的5.7x28mm口径子弹设计的轻型手枪，内置了消音器，有着较高的准确度和弹容量，对穿戴护甲的敌人特别有效。
谢尔久科夫 SR-1 "斑蝰蛇"手枪

messages.msgid: The SR-1 Vektor also known as the Gyurza (Гюрза, Russian for 'blunt-nosed viper') or Serdyukov SPS is a 9×21mm Gyurza semi-automatic pistol designed for the Russian military.  It fires 9x21mm ammunition, which is rare in the States.
translations: SR-1 Vektor 手枪也称为 Gyurza（Гюрза，俄语"斑蝰蛇"）手枪或谢尔久科夫 SPS 手枪，是专为俄罗斯军方研发的一款使用 9×21mm Gyurza 弹的半自动手枪。它使用 9x21mm 弹药，这种型号在美国很少见。

messages.msgid: The Atchisson Assault Shotgun, is an automatic combat shotgun developed in 1972 by Maxwell Atchisson.  The most prominent feature is reduced recoil.
translations: 艾奇逊突击霰弹枪是麦克斯韦·艾奇逊于1972年研发的一款全自动战斗霰弹枪。最突出的特点是降低了后坐力。
悍马双联装 AA-12 炮塔

messages.msgid: An electrically driven dual AA-12s mounted together to match to a turret.
translations: 一对电动双联装AA-12霰弹枪，安装在一起，与炮塔匹配。

messages.msgid: Thanks to the words of the charm you spoke, you won't get wet.
translations: 由于你的咒语，你不会被淋湿。

messages.msgid: A bobbing ball of blueish-green light, just bright enough to read by.
translations: 一个蓝绿色的光球，亮度刚好可供阅读。

messages.msgid: Use this to fertilize your crops.
The item that starts fires when using To Kindle the Flames.  This should be summoned and deleted as part of the spell, so you should never actually see it.
translations: 施展法术“薪火之咒”时用于生火的物品。此物本应在法术生效时召出、并随之立即消散，所以你按理说是绝不会看见它的。

messages.msgid: A small sack with herbs in it to warn you if the Fair Folk are nearby.  You had better wear it under your clothes.  You wouldn't want them to know you're avoiding them.  It's awaiting you to speak the final words of the charm and activate it.
translations: 一个装有草药的小布囊，若仙灵临近，便会向你示警。你最好将它贴身佩戴，可别让那些家伙知道你在躲着他们。它正静待你诵出最后的咒文，以将其激活。

messages.msgid: You recite that last part of the charm.
translations: 你念诵了咒文的最后部分。

messages.msgid: A small sack with herbs in it to warn you if the Fair Folk are nearby.  You had better wear it under your clothes.  You wouldn't want them to know you're avoiding them.
translations: 一个装着草药的小袋，用于探测附近是否有精灵。你最好把它藏在衣服里，毕竟你可不想让妖精们知道你有意避开他们。

messages.msgid: A small sack with herbs in it to warn you if the Fair Folk are nearby.  You had better wear it under your clothes.  You wouldn't want them to know you're avoiding them.  This charm seems lifeless somehow, its energy spent.
translations: 一个装有草药的小布囊，若仙灵临近，便会向你示警。你最好将它贴身佩戴，可别让那些家伙知道你在躲着他们。不知何故，这枚护符似乎已了无生气，其能量全然耗尽。

messages.msgid: A yarn contraption similar to a cat's cradle that looks like a three dimensional maze.  When placed properly, it can fascinate the changeling blooded.
translations: 一种形似翻花绳的线结造物，看起来像一座三维迷宫。只要放置得当，便能迷惑身负换生灵血统之人。

messages.msgid: A disgusting mixture of blood, ashes, and certain herbs.  Using it will allow you to see otherworldly creatures even through walls or in darkness.
translations: 由血液、灰烬及某些特定草药调配而成的恶心混合物。使用它能让你无视墙壁或黑暗的阻碍，洞见异界生物。

messages.msgid: Tea with herbs, iron, and a bit of magick.  If you're sick, there's nothing better for your body than this.
translations: 含有药草，铁和些微魔力的茶。如果你生病了，没有什么是能比它对你身体更好的东西。

messages.msgid: A heavy fur mantle attached to the skull of a bear.  The charm worked into it has been expended.
translations: 一件与熊颅相连的厚重毛皮斗篷。其中蕴含的咒力已经消散。

messages.msgid: A heavy fur mantle attached to the skull of a bear.  When you put it on, the charm will take effect and grant you the bear's power.
translations: 一件与熊颅相连的厚重毛皮斗篷。当你披上它时，其中蕴含的咒法便会生效，赐予你巨熊之力。

messages.msgid: magic square (To Walk Upon the Water)
messages.plural: magic squares (To Walk Upon the Water)

messages.msgid: A piece of paper.  A magic square is carefully written on it.
translations: 一张纸片，上面精心绘制着一个魔法方阵。

messages.msgid: Activate the charm using the magic square.
translations: 使用魔法方阵激活咒法。

messages.msgid: magic square (To Operate Under the Water)
messages.plural: magic squares (To Operate Under the Water)

messages.msgid: magic square (To Demolish Buildings and Strongholds)
messages.plural: magic squares (To Demolish Buildings and Strongholds)

messages.msgid: magic square (To Cause Armed Men to Appear)
messages.plural: magic squares (To Cause Armed Men to Appear)

messages.msgid: magic square (To Cause the Spirits to Bring us Anything We May Wish to Eat or to Drink)
messages.plural: magic squares (To Cause the Spirits to Bring us Anything We May Wish to Eat or to Drink)

messages.msgid: magic square (To Render Oneself Invisible Unto Every Person)
messages.plural: magic squares (To Render Oneself Invisible Unto Every Person)

messages.msgid: This is a knife that seems to be made of glass, but significantly more durable, like some sort of crystal with the strength of metal.
translations: 这是一把似乎是玻璃制成的刀，但要耐用得多，就像某种具有金属强度的晶体。

messages.msgid: A thin piercing sword no wider than two fingers side by side, it's mirrored surface reflects the world back at it's wielders opponents and is difficult to see to parry.  You've never felt a sword like this before.
translations: 一把宽度不超过两根并排手指的细刺剑，它的镜面将整个世界反射到持剑者对手的眼中，这让它很难招架。你以前从未摸过这样的剑。

messages.msgid: This sword is covered in shifting frost and seems to move of its own volition in your hands.
translations: 这把刺剑上覆盖着流动的白霜，在你手中似乎按照自己的意志移动。

messages.msgid: This sword is made all of a single piece of wood and so black any details are lost.  Some kind of shimmering leather is wrapped around the grip.
translations: 这把剑完全由一整块木头制成，颜色漆黑，所有细节都消失不见。剑柄上缠绕着某种闪闪发光的皮革。

messages.msgid: A giant bloodstained club, barely human wieldable with two hands.  You see shadowy tendrils of blood whenever it connects with an enemy, sticking to whatever it hits and burning like acid.
translations: 一根沾满鲜血的巨棍，两只手几乎无法挥舞。 每当它与敌人连接时，你都会看到朦胧的血卷须，粘在它击中的任何东西上，像酸一样燃烧。

messages.msgid: Brownish reddish tendrils connect from the club to your enemies.
translations: 棕红色的触手从木棒上接触到你的敌人。

messages.msgid: A gladius covered in the whorls of Celtic knots.  Sparks seems to pop off the edge of the blade.
translations: 一条盖满了凯尔特结的短剑。火花似乎从剑刃上迸发出来。

messages.msgid: A one-handed combat axe, the blade is slightly larger than a tomahawk.
translations: 一柄单手战斧，斧刃比手斧略大。

messages.msgid: A huge axe designed for warfare.  Made of forged dreamdross, and enchanted to channel heat into those it wounds.
translations: 专为战争设计的巨斧。以浮梦残渣锻造而成，并附有魔法，可将灼热传导至受害者体内。

messages.msgid: Astute observers of Mesoamerican history may recognize this as a macuahuitl, the favored weapon of the Aztecs.  This macuahuitl looks as though it was made deep inside of a black mirror.
translations: 熟悉中美洲历史的敏锐观察者或许能认出，这就是马夸威特——阿兹特克人钟爱的武器。这把马夸威特看起来仿佛由一面黑镜的深处孕育而成。

messages.msgid: Covered with thin layer of dreamdross, this knife is a light and sharp tool to work with.
translations: 被一层薄薄的浮梦残渣包裹，这把匕首轻便又锋利。

messages.msgid: It was a good tool before, but now it's covered with a thick layer of dreamdross, and it works as a light but deadly weapon.
translations: 它以前是一把很好的工具，但现在的它覆盖上一层厚厚的浮梦残渣，可以作为一种迅捷但致命的武器使用。

messages.msgid: A long stick that's been covered with dreamdross, but lacks any magical properties.
translations: 覆盖着浮梦残渣的长棍，没有魔法特性。

messages.msgid: A long quarterstaff, forged entirely from dreamdross.  Twice as heavy than a wooden one, but lot sturdier, and still useful as a weapon.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 完全由浮梦残渣锻造而成的长棍。比木制的重上一倍，但要坚固得多，作为武器也相当实用。浮梦残渣赋予了它些许微末的魔法特性，但其效果非你所能驾驭。

messages.msgid: A longsword, forged entirely from dreamdross.  It is much lighter than one made of steel, but applies much less force to its target.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 完全由浮梦残渣锻造而成的长剑。它比钢制的轻盈许多，但对目标造成的力道也因此小了许多。浮梦残渣赋予了它些许微末的魔法特性，但其效果非你所能驾驭。

messages.msgid: A warhammer, forged entirely from dreamdross.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 完全由浮梦残渣锻造而成的战锤。浮梦残渣赋予了它些许微末的魔法特性，但其效果非你所能驾驭。

messages.msgid: A spear, forged entirely from dreamdross.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 完全由浮梦残渣锻造而成的长矛。浮梦残渣赋予了它些许微末的魔法特性，但其效果非你所能驾驭。

messages.msgid: A two-handed halberd, forged entirely from dreamdross.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 完全由浮梦残渣锻造而成的双手戟。浮梦残渣赋予了它些许微末的魔法特性，但其效果非你所能驾驭。

messages.msgid: A two-handed glaive, forged entirely from dreamdross.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 完全由浮梦残渣锻造而成的双手长柄刀。浮梦残渣赋予了它些许微末的魔法特性，但其效果非你所能驾驭。

messages.msgid: A sturdy naginata, forged entirely from dreamdross.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 完全由浮梦残渣锻造而成的坚固薙刀。浮梦残渣赋予了它些许微末的魔法特性，但其效果非你所能驾驭。

messages.msgid: A light mace, forged entirely from dreamdross.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 完全由浮梦残渣打造的钉头锤。浮梦残渣赋予了它一些魔法特性，但你不能控制魔法的效果。

messages.msgid: A light morningstar, forged entirely from dreamdross.  So light that you can't properly apply any force on it.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 一柄由浮梦残渣锻造的轻型钉头锤。此物轻盈异常，令你难以发力。浮梦残渣赋予了它些许微末的魔法特性，但其效果非你所能驾驭。

messages.msgid: An estoc, forged entirely from dreamdross.  So light that you can't properly apply any force on it.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 一柄由浮梦残渣锻造的刺剑。此物轻盈异常，令你难以发力。浮梦残渣赋予了它些许微末的魔法特性，但其效果非你所能驾驭。

messages.msgid: An arming sword, forged entirely from dreamdross.  So light that you can't properly apply any force on it.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 一柄由浮梦残渣锻造的武装剑。此物轻盈异常，令你难以发力。浮梦残渣赋予了它些许微末的魔法特性，但其效果非你所能驾驭。

messages.msgid: A broadsword, forged entirely from dreamdross.  So light that you can't properly apply any force on it.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 一柄由浮梦残渣锻造的阔剑。此物轻盈异常，令你难以发力。浮梦残渣赋予了它些许微末的魔法特性，但其效果非你所能驾驭。

messages.msgid: A battle axe, forged entirely from dreamdross.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 由浮梦残渣锻造的战斧。浮梦残渣赋予了它些许魔法特性，但其效果不受你的控制。

messages.msgid: A katana, forged entirely from dreamdross.  So light that you can't properly apply any force on it.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 完全由浮梦残渣打造的武士刀。这把刀太轻了，不方便发力。浮梦残渣赋予了它一些魔法特性，但你不能控制魔法的效果。

messages.msgid: A small military knife, forged entirely from dreamdross.  You barely feel any weight.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 完全由浮梦残渣打造的战术匕首。你几乎感受不到它的重量。浮梦残渣赋予了它一些魔法特性，但你不能控制魔法的效果。

messages.msgid: A small curved knife, forged entirely from dreamdross.  You barely feel any weight.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 完全由浮梦残渣打造的反曲刀。你几乎感受不到它的重量。浮梦残渣赋予了它一些魔法特性，但你不能控制魔法的效果。

messages.msgid: A small kukri, forged entirely from dreamdross.  You barely feel any weight.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 完全由浮梦残渣打造的廓尔喀弯刀。你几乎感受不到它的重量。浮梦残渣赋予了它一些魔法特性，但你不能控制魔法的效果。

messages.msgid: A long nodachi, forged entirely from dreamdross.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 完全由浮梦残渣打造的野太刀。浮梦残渣赋予了它一些魔法特性，但你不能控制魔法的效果。

messages.msgid: A short rapier, forged entirely from dreamdross.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 完全由浮梦残渣打造的迅捷剑。浮梦残渣赋予了它一些魔法特性，但你不能控制魔法的效果。

messages.msgid: A long tanto, forged entirely from dreamdross.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 完全由浮梦残渣打造的日式短刀。浮梦残渣赋予了它一些魔法特性，但你不能控制魔法的效果。

messages.msgid: A long wakizashi, forged entirely from dreamdross.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 完全由浮梦残渣打造的胁差。浮梦残渣赋予了它一些魔法特性，但你不能控制魔法的效果。

messages.msgid: A huge two-handed sword, forged entirely from dreamdross.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 完全由浮梦残渣打造的双手巨剑。浮梦残渣赋予了它一些魔法特性，但你不能控制魔法的效果。

messages.msgid: A light khopesh, forged entirely from dreamdross.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 完全由浮梦残渣打造的镰状剑。浮梦残渣赋予了它一些魔法特性，但你不能控制魔法的效果。

messages.msgid: A lucerne hammer, forged entirely from dreamdross.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 完全由浮梦残渣打造的琉森锤。浮梦残渣赋予了它一些魔法特性，但你不能控制魔法的效果。

messages.msgid: A pair of thick dreamdross plates covering your proximal phalange.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 一副能包裹到指根的浮梦扳指。浮梦残渣赋予了它一些魔法特性，但你不能控制魔法的效果。

messages.msgid: A pair of fiery-red knuckles with tiny blades on the end.  They are fed with your energy and the blood of your enemies, and will fuel different items with berserk properties.
translations: 火红的指虎，末端有小刀刃。它们会吸食你的能量和敌人的血，为狂战士物品供能。

messages.msgid: A two-handed glaive, forged entirely from dreamdross.  It can steal life from creatures it attacks, healing you a bit.
translations: 完全由浮梦残渣锻造而成的双手长柄刀。它能从被击中的生物身上窃取生命，为你带来些许疗愈。

messages.msgid: A classic Japanese tsurugi sword with a razor sharp blade.  You start to think you need to move faster, and the effect intensifies when you are surrounded.
translations: 经典的日本剑，剑刃锋利。你开始觉得自己移动得更快，效果在被包围时更为强烈。

messages.msgid: A long, straight stick.  A simple weapon empowered by your experience in fighting against dreadful creatures.
translations: 一把长而直的棒子。一把被你与恐惧生物战斗的经验所强化的简单武器。

messages.msgid: A well designed steel knife that used to be stuck in your belly.  It lightly flickers in the air and is tainted an unnatural gray.  Despite your best efforts, you aren't even able to smear the gray streaks of your blood that remain frozen along the edge, much less damage the actual metal.
translations: 一把设计精良的钢制匕首，曾经插在你的腹部。 它在空气中轻轻闪烁，染上了不自然的灰色。 即使尽最大努力也无法抹去凝固在刀刃上的灰色血痕，更不用说损坏真正的金属了。

messages.msgid: Shimmering like a beam of moonlight, this sword seems to minutely shift its position when not looked at directly.  It exerts a slight pull on your hand when you hold it, moving your body to the proper position.
translations: 这把剑如月光般闪烁，当你不直视它时，它的位置似乎会微微变动。当你握住它时，它会在你的手中产生一股轻微的拉力，将你的身体调整到合适的姿势。

messages.msgid: A dagger forged from some silvery metal that seems to shine with a soft internal light.  It's surprisingly sharp.
translations: 这把匕首由一种内蕴微光的银色金属锻造而成，出奇地锋利。

messages.msgid: A broad sword forged from some silvery metal that seems to shine with a soft internal light.  It's surprisingly sharp.
translations: 这把阔剑由一种内蕴微光的银色金属锻造而成，出奇地锋利。

messages.msgid: A classic medieval sword, just the right size to use one-handed, and forged from some silvery metal that seems to shine with a soft internal light.  It's surprisingly sharp.
translations: 一柄古典的中世纪长剑，尺寸恰好适合单手挥舞。它由一种内蕴微光的银色金属锻造而成，出奇地锋利。

messages.msgid: A medieval weapon consisting of a wood handle with a heavy metal head forged from some silvery metal that seems to shine with a soft internal light.  It looks delicate but hits very hard.
translations: 一种中世纪武器，配有木制握柄与一个沉重的金属锤头，锤头由一种内蕴微光的银色金属锻造而成。它看似精致，实则威力惊人。

messages.msgid: A curved sword associated with various Middle Eastern and Central Asian countries, forged from some silvery metal that seems to shine with a soft internal light.  It's surprisingly sharp.
translations: 一柄常见于中东与中亚诸国的弯刀，由一种内蕴微光的银色金属锻造而成，出奇地锋利。

messages.msgid: A thin thrusting sword, a sort of predecessor to the rapier, forged from some silvery metal that seems to shine with a soft internal light.  It's surprisingly sharp.
translations: 一柄细长的刺剑，可算是迅捷剑的前身，由一种内蕴微光的银色金属锻造而成，出奇地锋利。

messages.msgid: A stout wooden pole with a spearhead forged from some silvery metal that seems to shine with a soft internal light.  It's surprisingly sharp.
translations: 一杆结实的木柄长矛，其矛尖由一种内蕴微光的银色金属锻造而成，出奇地锋利。

messages.msgid: A huge axe designed for warfare, forged from some silvery metal that seems to shine with a soft internal light.  It's surprisingly sharp.
translations: 一柄专为战争设计的巨斧，由一种内蕴微光的银色金属锻造而成，出奇地锋利。

messages.msgid: A stout wooden pole sharpened on one end, all formed from a single piece of wood, with twists and curves like it grew in place rather than being made.
translations: 一杆结实的木矛，一端削尖，通体由一整块木头浑然天成。其上遍布着扭曲与弧线，仿佛是自然生长而非人力所造。

messages.msgid: A giant spear over three meters long, all formed from a single piece of wood, with twists and curves like it grew in place rather than being made.
translations: 一杆超过三米长的巨矛，通体由一整块木头浑然天成。其上遍布着扭曲与弧线，仿佛是自然生长而非人力所造。

messages.msgid: A weapon with a long wooden handle connected to a knobby wooden head, all formed from a single piece of wood, with twists and curves like it grew in place rather than being made.
translations: 一种武器，长长的木柄连接着一个多节瘤的木制锤头，通体由一整块木头浑然天成。其上遍布着扭曲与弧线，仿佛是自然生长而非人力所造。

messages.msgid: A sturdy staff all formed from a single piece of wood, with twists and curves like it grew in place rather than being carved.
translations: 一根坚固的长棍，通体由一整块木头浑然天成。其上遍布着扭曲与弧线，仿佛是自然生长而非雕刻而成。

messages.msgid: A long hammer with a spike on one end, all formed from a single piece of wood, with twists and curves like it grew in place rather than being carved.
translations: 长长的锤子，末端带有一根尖刺，由一整块实心的木头制成，木头的扭曲和曲线看起来就像是天然生长出来的一样。

messages.msgid: A sturdy polearm with a curved blade, all formed from a single piece of wood, with twists and curves like it grew in place rather than being carved.  You're not sure how long it will hold its edge, but it's surprisingly sharp.
translations: 一柄坚固的带刃长兵，通体由一整块木头浑然天成，其上遍布着扭曲与弧线，仿佛是自然生长而非雕刻而成。你不知道它的锋刃能维持多久，但它却出奇地锋利。

messages.msgid: A large knife, all formed from a single piece of wood, with twists and curves like it grew in place rather than being carved.  You're not sure how long it will hold its edge, but it's surprisingly sharp.
translations: 一柄大号的匕首，通体由一整块木头浑然天成，其上遍布着扭曲与弧线，仿佛是自然生长而非雕刻而成。你不知道它的锋刃能维持多久，但它却出奇地锋利。

messages.msgid: This magical potion will further your transformation from newly sentient creature to elemental powerhouse.
translations: 这种神奇的药水将促进你从新智生物向元素强者的转变。

messages.msgid: A sample of verdant plant life.
translations: 鲜灵的翠绿色植物样本
一个装得满满当当的文件夹。

messages.msgid: A paper plaque.  It has words printed on it.
translations: 一块纸质铭牌。上面印有文字。

messages.msgid: An incredibly hard cracker.  Squeezing it in your hand it feels as though your teeth might break before the cracker does.  The packaging on the side shows a tall being feeding these crackers to a horned and four legged creature.
translations: 一个非常硬的饼干。把它捏在手里，感觉就像你的牙齿可能会比饼干先碎。侧面的包装展示了一个高个子正在给一个有角的四条腿的生物喂食这些饼干。

messages.msgid: A golden bridle made of spun moon tears, gold, and incredibly strong hair including associated tack that can be placed on a tamed mythical animal that is capable of being ridden.
translations: 一根金色的缰绳，由月之泪、和某种金色难以置信的坚韧的毛发编织而成的绳索制成，包含配套的各类马钉，能够装在已驯服的神话动物身上，让它供你骑乘。

messages.msgid: A six-foot bow, forged entirely from dreamdross, including its strings.  Primitive look, devastating power.
translations: 弓，六英尺（约1.8米）长，连同弓弦在内，全由浮梦残渣锻造而成。 外观原始，威力惊人。

messages.msgid: A dreamforged arrow with a razor-sharp tip.

A medieval crossbow, forged entirely from dreamdross, including its strings.  Probably not the optimal weapon in our modern world, but still capable of doing devastating damage while being completely silent.
translations: 一把中世纪风格的十字弩，通体由浮梦残渣锻造而成，就连弩弦也不例外。在当今世界，这或许并非上上之选，但它仍能悄无声息地造成毁灭性的打击。

messages.msgid: A dreamforged crossbow bolt with broadhead tip.
A wooden shortbow with a thin vine for a string, all formed from a single piece of wood, with twists and curves like it grew in place rather than being made.
translations: 一张木制短弓，以细藤为弦，通体由一整块木头浑然天成。其上遍布着扭曲与弧线，仿佛是自然生长而非人力所造。

messages.msgid: A truly enormous wooden bow with a thin vine for a string, all formed from a single piece of wood, with twists and curves like it grew in place rather than being made.
translations: 一张巨大无比的木弓，以细藤为弦，通体由一整块木头浑然天成。其上遍布着扭曲与弧线，仿佛是自然生长而非人力所造。

messages.msgid: An arrow all formed from a single piece of wood, with twists and curves like it grew in place rather than being made.  It even has leaves for fletching.
translations: 一支通体由一整块木头浑然天成的箭矢。其上遍布着扭曲与弧线，仿佛是自然生长而非人力所造。它甚至以树叶为箭羽。

messages.msgid: An ingot of moon tears.  About 3cm by 7cm by 12cm in size, ready to be used for various blacksmithing tasks.
translations: 一块月之泪锭。约有3x7x12厘米大小，能被用于各种锻造任务。

messages.msgid: A length of thin, relatively stiff moon tear wire.
translations: 一截细的，坚韧的月之泪丝线

messages.msgid: A bulky assortment of small bits of scrap moon tears, useful for forging into ingots and wire.
translations: 各式各样的月之泪废料，可用于锻造成锭和丝。

messages.msgid: A bulky assortment of small bits of scrap shadowstuff, possibly useful in ephemeral crafting.
translations: 一大堆细小的影质废料，或许能用于塑念造物。

messages.msgid: A bulky assortment of larger bits of scrap shadowstuff, possibly useful in ephemeral crafting.
translations: 一大堆较大的影质废料，或许能用于塑念造物。

messages.msgid: A bulky assortment of small bits of scrap dreamdross, useful in all kinds of ephemeral crafting.
translations: 一堆各式各样的小块浮梦碎片，在所有的梦境系列制造中都很有用。

messages.msgid: A heavy formed piece of dreamdross.  Useful for some crafting recipes.
translations: 一大块沉重的经过成型的浮梦残渣，可以用来制造物品。

messages.msgid: A forged ingot of dreamdross.  About 3cm by 7cm by 12cm in size, ready to be used for various reality forging tasks.
translations: 一块浮梦锭。约有3x7x12厘米大小，能被用于各种梦境制品锻造。

messages.msgid: The extracted essence of human dreams, used to fuel fae magicks.
translations: 从人类梦境中提取出的精萃，是驱动妖精魔法的燃料。

messages.msgid: A folded sheet of glimmer fur made from carefully tanned fae animal pelt.  Can be cut up or used as is.
translations: 一块折叠的微光毛皮，由精心鞣制的妖精动物毛皮制成。可以按原样切割或使用。

messages.msgid: A treated fae animal pelt that is undergoing the chemical processes required to become fur.  You will be able to activate it to unroll and make use of it when it is done.
translations: 一种经过处理的毛皮，正在经历成为毛皮所需的化学过程。你将能够激活它来展开，并在完成后使用它。

messages.msgid: You carefully unfold the tanning fae fur pelt and shake it clean.
translations: 你小心地展开晒黑的毛皮，把它抖干净。

messages.msgid: The tanning fae fur pelt isn't done yet.
translations: 鞣制毛皮的工作还没有完成。

messages.msgid: A rolled-up fae animal hide which has been scraped of extraneous hair and flesh and treated to prevent decay.  It still requires tanning to become usable fur.
translations: 一种卷起来的妖怪兽皮，刮去多余的毛和肉，并处理以防止腐烂。它仍然需要鞣制才能成为可用的皮毛。

messages.msgid: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of gossamer fabric, like a swatch plucked from a rainbow.
translations: 一块 12 英寸乘 24 英寸的月之纱布料，就像从彩虹上摘下的色块。

messages.msgid: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of gossamer sewn together from patches of various clothing parts.  Suitable for making clothing if you lack proper material sheets.
translations: 一张12英寸×24英寸（约30厘米×61厘米）的月之纱面料，由各种衣服部件的补丁缝制而成。 如果你缺乏适当的其它材料片，可以用它来制作服装。

messages.msgid: A 6-inch square gossamer patch, suitable for repairing and tailoring clothing.
translations: 一块约6英寸（约15厘米）见方的月之纱布片，可以用来修补或缝制衣物。

messages.msgid: Filmy bits of gossamer, barely there.  Not useful for much.
translations: 丝丝缕缕的月之纱，存在感若有若无。用处不大。

messages.msgid: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of elemental gossamer fabric, like a swatch plucked from a rainbow.
translations: 一张12英寸乘24英寸的元素薄纱布料，绚烂得像是从彩虹上扯下的一块。

messages.msgid: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of elemental gossamer sewn together from patches of various clothing parts.  Suitable for making clothing if you lack proper material sheets.
translations: 一张12英寸乘24英寸的元素薄纱布，由各种衣物的零碎布块拼接缝制而成。如果你缺少合适的整块布料，便可用来制作衣物。

messages.msgid: A 6-inch square elemental gossamer patch, suitable for repairing and tailoring clothing.
translations: 一块6英寸见方的元素薄纱补丁，适合用来修补和缝制衣物。

messages.msgid: Filmy bits of elemental gossamer, barely there.  Not useful for much.
translations: 一些薄如蝉翼的元素薄纱碎片，轻盈得若有若无，基本派不上什么用场。

messages.msgid: A pile of shredded gossamer, like wisps of solid moonlight, which could be used to stuff the fabric layers of a gambeson.
translations: 一块由零碎月之纱组成的布料，像一束束纯净的月光，可以用来填充软铠的织物层。

messages.msgid: A large log of living wood, sung from a tree by elemental magick.
translations: 一段巨大的活木原木，经由元素魔法对树木咏唱而来。

messages.msgid: A chunk of obsidian, smashed from a larger rock vein.  It has several wickedly sharp edges and could probably be formed into a weapon with some work.
translations: 一大块的黑曜石，是从更大的黑耀石岩脉上砸下来的。它有几个非常锋利的边缘，经过稍稍加工可以当作武器。

messages.msgid: A chunk of darkness, torn from a powerful shadow.  It is so dark that no light reflect from it.
translations: 一块从强大暗影中撕扯下来的黑暗实体，它漆黑到极致，不反射任何光线。

messages.msgid: The skull of a march lord.  You can feel its lingering power as you touch it.
translations: 征战领主的头骨。当你触摸它时，你能感受到其中残存的力量。

messages.msgid: A ball of almost-solid blood, needing to bath in the energies of a portal storm before being useful.
translations: 一团近乎固态的血液，需要沐浴在空间风暴的能量中才能发挥作用。

messages.msgid: A ball of almost-solid blood with ripples across its surface.  It has been exposed to the energies of the portal storms enough to be used in the ritual.
translations: 一团近乎固态的血液，表面荡漾着层层波纹。它已经吸收了足够的空间风暴能量，可以在仪式中使用了。

messages.msgid: The distilled essence of the Fae.  Can be used as part of rituals.
translations: 妖精的蒸馏精萃，可作为仪式的一部分使用。

messages.msgid: You drink some concentrated underhill essence.
translations: 你喝下了一些浓缩丘下精萃。

messages.msgid: A heartlike object made from dreamdross.  It feels as if it were still beating despite its lack of movement.
translations: 由浮梦残渣制成的心脏状物体。 虽然没有运动，但感觉它仍在跳动。

messages.msgid: A small pearl brightly shining with moonlight.
translations: 一颗闪耀着明亮月光的小珍珠。

messages.msgid: A strange object you brought back from the insides of the Abyssal Hunger.
translations: 一个你从深渊之饥体内带回来的奇怪物体。

messages.msgid: This is a high quality kit consisting of a variety of needles, some wooden spools for thread, some small scissors, and an awl.  Use a tailor's kit to customize your clothing and armor.  This uses your tailoring skill.
translations: 一个装着各种针、几卷线，几把小剪刀，以及一把锥子的高品质缝纫套件。使用它可以修改你的衣服和装甲。它主要运用你的裁缝技能。

messages.msgid: A sturdy saw, useful for cutting through metal objects.  Forged from dreamdross, which makes it much lighter.
translations: 一把结实的锯子，适合用来切割金属物品。 由浮梦残渣锻造而成，重量更轻。

messages.msgid: A classic carpenter hammer with claw.  Forged from dreamdross, which makes it much lighter.
translations: 经典的羊角木工锤。 由浮梦残渣锻造而成，重量更轻。

messages.msgid: A small tool for breaking into closed locations.  Forged from dreamdross, which makes it really light.
translations: 用于破门进入封闭场所的小型工具。由浮梦残渣锻造而成，非常轻巧。

messages.msgid: A pair of strong pliers with an adjustable mechanism.  Forged entirely from dreamdross, which makes it much lighter.
translations: 一把坚固的可调节钳子。完全由浮梦残渣锻造而成，重量更轻。

messages.msgid: A classic pickaxe, used for digging.  Forged from dreamdross, which makes it really light, albeit a bit weaker.
translations: 一把用于挖掘的经典十字镐。它由浮梦残渣锻造而成，因此异常轻巧，不过强度也稍逊一筹。

messages.msgid: A set of light and sturdy dreamforged lockpicks and wrenches.
translations: 一套轻巧坚固的梦铸开锁工具和扳手。

messages.msgid: A very sharp medical knife for surgical operations.  Almost weightless.
translations: 一把用于外科手术的锋利医用刀，几乎毫无重量。

messages.msgid: A collapsible spade for digging small pits.  Forged from dreamdross to make it even lighter than before.
translations: 用于挖掘小坑的可折叠铲子。 用浮梦残渣锻造而成，比以前更轻。

messages.msgid: A dreamdross mesh that condenses within the center.  Use it to set it on the ground, creating a trap that will freeze anything that steps on it for several hours.
translations: 一张压缩在中心的浮梦之网。如果有东西踩过它的话，会将其冻结数个小时。

messages.msgid: You set the time trap on the ground.
translations: 你将时间陷阱设置在地上。

messages.msgid: A pocket watch made entirely of dreamdross.  It somehow still accurately tells the time.  Once per day, press the button on the right to briefly stop time for everything but you.
translations: 一块完全由浮梦残渣制成的怀表，不知为何竟仍能准确报时。每天可使用一次，按下右侧的按钮，便能让你之外的万物时间短暂静止。

messages.msgid: A large, two-handed axe for chopping wood.  Light, but still useful.
translations: 一把用于砍柴的大型双手斧。它很轻，但依然堪用。

messages.msgid: A magickal space where offerings are sacrificed and transformed.
translations: 一个供奉祭品并进行转化的魔法空间。

messages.msgid: A small ball of dreams, Fae blood and illicit substances from Under the Hill.  Your book claims it will transform any mosquito ingesting it in a dream-eating nightmare.
translations: 一个由梦境、妖精之血与来自丘下的违禁品混合而成的小球。据书中记载，任何摄入此物的蚊子都会转变为吞噬梦境的梦魇。

messages.msgid: A macabre effigy made of meat and bone, with a heart filled with glass and faewild dust.  When the full moon will shine upon it, you will be able to use it to summon the Luna-attuned revenant.
translations: 一座由血肉白骨制成的骇人塑像，其心脏处填满了玻璃与妖精荒野的尘土。当满月之光照耀其上时，你便能用它召唤出亲月的归亡者。

messages.msgid: A thick, hulking mass of plant matter and wood that's easily the size of your head, torn from a triffid heart.
translations: 一大块从三尖树心脏上撕下的厚重组织，由植物和木质构成，足有你头颅般大小。

messages.msgid: An elementally manifested combustion engine.  Despite operating entirely off of mana rather than normal fuel, it otherwise functions exactly as a conventional internal combustion engine.
translations: 一台元素形式的内燃机。尽管完全使用魔力作为燃料而非普通燃料，在其它方面它却和普通的内燃机没有什么不同。

messages.msgid: A white piece of plastic with a picture of an agent and a barcode underneath.  The lack of other details on badges like it led to them being called 'Zebra Badges'.  It might grant basic access to some Xedra areas.
translations: 一张白色塑料卡片，上面印有一名特工的照片，照片下方是条形码。由于这类证章上缺少其他详细信息，它们便被称作“斑马证章”。它或许能让你获得进入某些Xedra区域的基本权限。

messages.msgid: Boots lined with glimmer fur for warmth.
translations: 一双微光毛皮内衬的靴子，十分暖和。

messages.msgid: A hefty pair of fae fur-lined pants.
translations: 一条带有妖精毛皮内衬的厚实裤子。非常保暖。

messages.msgid: A heavy glimmer fur cloak meant to be thrown over your body.  The shimmering nature of the fur made these garments coveted before the Cataclysm.
translations: 一件套在衣服外面、覆盖全身的微光毛皮披风。毛皮闪闪发光的特性使这件披风在大灾变前备受垂涎。

messages.msgid: A glimmer fur coat with a couple small pockets.  Extremely warm and very rare before the Cataclysm.
translations: 一件微光毛皮大衣，有些口袋，保暖效果非常棒，在大灾变前非常罕见。

messages.msgid: A thick glimmer fur trenchcoat, lined with pockets.  Great for storage.
translations: 一件厚厚的微光毛皮风衣，缝着不少口袋，提供非常大的存储空间。

messages.msgid: A thick glimmer fur trenchcoat without sleeves, leaving your arms unencumbered.  Has plenty of storage space due to its many pockets.
translations: 一件无袖的厚实微光毛皮风衣，让你的手臂不受束缚。它有很多口袋，提供了相当充足的存储空间。

messages.msgid: A thick glimmer fur full-length duster.  Has many pockets for storage.  Shimmers in direct sunlight and would have been fancy clothing prior to the Cataclysm.
translations: 一件厚实的微光毛皮长款风衣，带有许多口袋便于收纳。在直射阳光下会微微闪烁，在大灾变之前算是相当考究的服饰。
微光毛皮防尘风衣（无袖）

messages.msgid: A thick glimmer fur full-length duster without sleeves, leaving your arms unencumbered.  Has plenty of storage space due to its many pockets.
translations: 一件厚实的微光毛皮全身长无袖防尘风衣，让你的手臂有足够的伸展自由。它有很多口袋，提供了相当充足的存储空间。

messages.msgid: A padded greatcoat assembled by quilting gossamer and stuffing the layers with more scraps of gossamer.  It shimmers in a soft rainbow of colors.
translations: 这是一件软垫大衣，通过填充绗缝的月之纱并且在层间填充更多的月之纱碎片而制成。 它闪烁着柔和的彩虹色。

messages.msgid: Thick pants made of gossamer, meant to be worn alongside a gambeson under or without armor.  Stylish and as comfortable as armor can be.
translations: 一件由月之纱制成的绗缝厚裤子，用来穿在链甲或其他护甲底下。既时尚，又像盔甲一样舒服。

messages.msgid: A gossamer coif with neck and forehead protection.  Resting on your shoulders, it serves as padding for a helmet.  The sort of thing a fae knight guarding a crossroads would wear when challenging travelers to duels.
translations: 一件保护颈部与前额的月之纱头巾。垂落于肩头，可为头盔提供衬垫。正是驻守十字路口的妖精骑士向旅人提出决斗挑战时会佩戴的护具。

messages.msgid: pair of moon tears chainmail sleeves
messages.plural: pairs of moon tears chainmail sleeves

messages.msgid: Moon tears chainmail arms, found in places where changeling bannermen are numerous.  Each sleeve has straps to connect them with each other.  The lack of fingers makes them less cumbersome and allows them to be used with gloves.
translations: 一对月之泪链甲护臂，在换生灵领主频繁出现的地方找到。套筒间有带子连接，无指的设计使它们不那么笨重，并留下了戴手套的空间。

messages.msgid: pair of moon tears chainmail chausses
messages.plural: pairs of moon tears chainmail chausses

messages.msgid: Moon tears chainmail chausses that cover the feet, like booties made of chainmail.  Found in places where changeling bannermen are numerous.
translations: 月之泪制成的锁环镫靴，覆盖了整个腿部，如同锁环制成的长筒女靴一样。在换生灵领主频繁出现的地方找到。

messages.msgid: Moon tears chainmail chausses that cover the feet, like booties made of chainmail.  Found in places where redcap aspirants are numerous.
translations: 月之泪制成的锁环镫靴，覆盖了整个腿部，如同锁环制成的长筒女靴一样。在红顶妖精频繁出现的地方找到。

messages.msgid: Moon tears chainmail chausses that cover the feet, like booties made of chainmail.  Found in places where pooka aspirants are numerous.
translations: 月之泪制成的锁环镫靴，覆盖了整个腿部，如同锁环制成的长筒女靴一样。在普卡妖精频繁出现的地方找到。

messages.msgid: pair of moon tears chainmail gloves
messages.plural: pairs of moon tears chainmail gloves

messages.msgid: Moon tears chainmail gloves that fully enclose the hand.
translations: 一副月之泪制成的完全覆盖了双手的锁环手套。

messages.msgid: A fine moon tears chainmail hood.  Can be worn comfortably under helmets.
translations: 一条能舒适地戴在头盔之下的月之泪链甲兜帽。

messages.plural: pairs of moon tears chainmail leggings

messages.msgid: Moon tears chainmail leggings.  Their straps keep everything in place, and the lack of toes and heels allows them to work perfectly well with footwear.
translations: 一套月之泪制成的锁环腿甲，各个部件之间采用带子连接固定在一起，脚趾和脚跟处的空缺使它们能够与鞋类很好地兼容。

messages.msgid: Moon tears chainmail leggings for the largest of redcaps.  Their straps keep everything in place, and the lack of toes and heels allows them to work perfectly well with footwear.
translations: 一套月之泪制成的锁环腿甲，专为大个子红顶妖精设计。各个部件之间采用带子连接固定在一起，脚趾和脚跟处的空缺使它们能够与鞋类很好地兼容。

messages.msgid: Moon tears chainmail leggings for the smallest of pooka.  Their straps keep everything in place, and the lack of toes and heels allows them to work perfectly well with footwear.
translations: 一套月之泪制成的锁环腿甲，专为小个子普卡妖精设计。各个部件之间采用带子连接固定在一起，脚趾和脚跟处的空缺使它们能够与鞋类很好地兼容。

messages.msgid: A fully customized high steel chainmail outfit, leaving the head uncovered.  Combine with a gambeson or other padded layer for optimal protection.
translations: 一件自制的高碳钢锁环服，没有覆盖头部。与软铠或其他内衬一同穿着时能提供更好的保护效果。

messages.msgid: A fully customized moon tears chainmail suit.  Combine with a gambeson or other padded layer for optimal protection.
translations: 一套自制的完整月之泪链甲套装。与软铠或其他内衬一同穿着，能够提供最佳保护。

messages.msgid: A customized moon tears chainmail vest.  It's a sleeveless piece of chainmail with small straps designed to better distribute the weight.
translations: 一件自制的月之泪锁环胸甲，这件无袖胸甲由多条带子连结，均匀地分散装甲的重量。

messages.msgid: Manually forged ballistic plate, made to fit the common ballistic plate.  Probably not as good as steel one, but lightweight, and additionally hardened with magic.
translations: 手工锻造的防弹板，用于安装普通的防弹板设备。可能没有钢制的好，但重量很轻，而且还用魔法加固了。

messages.msgid: Manually forged ballistic plate, made to fit the common ballistic plate.  Probably not as good as steel one, but lightweight, and additionally hardened with magic.  Smaller in size, and can fit a side pocket of plate carrier.
translations: 手工锻造的防弹板，用于安装普通的防弹板设备。可能没有钢制的好，但重量很轻，而且还用魔法加固了。体积较小，可装在携板背心的侧袋中。

messages.msgid: Manually forged helmet, that resemble the shape of modern army helmets.  This one protect both face and eyes, using a special forged mask, but has no visor, and not so comfortable.  The dreamdross grant it some small magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 手工打造的头盔，形状像现代军队头盔。这个头盔保护你的眼睛和脸部，有一个面罩但没有面甲，不是很舒服。浮梦残渣赋予了它一些魔法特性，但你不能控制魔法的效果。

messages.msgid: Manually forged helmet in the that resemble the shape of modern army helmets.
translations: 手工锻造的头盔，形状类似于现代军用头盔。

messages.msgid: Lightweight armor, forged using dreamdross.  The only reason it feels soft enough is the magic.  It also has few MOLLE-compatible strips that you can utilize.  The dreamdross grant it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 轻质盔甲，由浮梦残渣制成。穿起来柔软的唯一原因是魔法。上面还有几个兼容的MOLLE绑带供你使用。浮梦残渣赋予了它一些魔法特性，但你不能控制魔法的效果。

messages.msgid: Pair of arm protectors, forged entirely from dreamdross.  Instead of straps this one uses a pretty smart locking mechanism, which allows you to adjust it to your hands.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 完全由浮梦残渣打造而成的一对护臂。没有采用传统的绑带固定，而是使用了一套巧妙的锁扣结构，供你将其调整到适合自己的尺寸。浮梦残渣赋予了它一些魔法特性，但你不能控制产生的效果。

messages.msgid: Light set of boots, forged from dreamdross.  Surprisingly comfortable for clothing that has no physical padding.  The dreamdross grants it some minor magical properties, but you can't control their effects.
translations: 由浮梦残渣打造的一双靴子。令人意外的是，没有物理内衬却也十分舒适。浮梦残渣赋予了它一些魔法特性，但你不能控制魔法的效果。

messages.msgid: Thin, smooth helmet, that cover your head, with a wide, sharp two-teeth blade from the forehead.  Fueled by damage of berserk knuckles, your feel the helmet pump the tension right into your veins.
translations: 薄而光滑的头盔，覆盖着你的头，额头上有一个宽而锋利的两颗牙齿的刀片。在狂战指虎伤害的推动下，你会感觉到头盔将紧张直接注入你的血管。

messages.msgid: Pair of fiery red armguards, they glow red the more damage you deal, using berserk knuckles, and your physical strength grows respectively.
translations: 一对火红色的护臂，受到的伤害越多，护臂的红光就越是光芒四射，通过使用狂战士指虎，你的力量会随之增长。

messages.msgid: Pair of fiery red boots, they are fueled by damage you deal with berserk knuckles, and increase your speed respectively.
translations: 一双火红色的靴子，它们从狂战士指虎造成的伤害中获得能量，并随之提高你的速度。

messages.msgid: Dreamforged helmet with side protection, and carved runes outside.  It grant you an ability to understand more, and with better world investigation your mana regeneration grows.  Runes are just decorations actually.
translations: 梦铸奥术头盔，可以防护侧面，外边刻有符文。它能使你更好地理解魔法和更好的研究世界，提高你的魔力再生速度。其实那些符文仅仅是装饰。

messages.msgid: Pair of flat armguards, fully carved with numbers and crosses.  Inside the left guard there is a text, cut with something sharp, that starts from "Sent onto those that escaped limbo's clutches, and unleash the rage of all hell…".
translations: 一对扁平护臂，通体雕刻着数字与十字图案。左护臂内侧刻有一段文字，以尖锐之物划出，起首为“赠予逃离炼狱魔爪之人，释放地狱众怒……”。

messages.msgid: A helmet made from the of living plant matter, with bark covering the outer surface.  This is definitely not anything that could have existed before the Cataclysm.
translations: 一顶由活体植物物质制成的头盔，外表覆盖着一层树皮。这绝对不是大灾变之前可能存在的东西。

messages.msgid: A cuirass made of living plant matter, with bark covering the outer surface.  This is definitely not anything that could have existed before the Cataclysm.
translations: 一件由活体植物构成的胸甲，外表覆盖着一层树皮。这东西绝不可能是大灾变之前存在的造物。

messages.msgid: A pair of fingerless gauntlets made from living plant matter, with bark covering the outer surface.  This is definitely not anything that could have existed before the Cataclysm.
translations: 一对由活体植物构成的无指手甲，外表覆盖着一层树皮。这东西绝不可能是大灾变之前存在的造物。

messages.msgid: A pair of leg guards made from living plant matter, with bark covering the outer surface.  This is definitely not anything that could have existed before the Cataclysm.
translations: 一对由活体植物构成的护腿，外表覆盖着一层树皮。这东西绝不可能是大灾变之前存在的造物。

messages.msgid: Boots made from living plant matter, with bark covering the outer surface.  This is definitely not anything that could have existed before the Cataclysm.
translations: 一双由活体植物构成的靴子，外表覆盖着一层树皮。这东西绝不可能是大灾变之前存在的造物。

messages.msgid: A old-fashioned padded coat with deep pockets.  As you touch it, you feel that this coat could allow you to fall asleep whenever and wherever you want.
translations: 一件带有深口袋的老式软垫外套。当你触摸它时，便能感觉到这件外套可以让你随时随地安然入睡。

messages.msgid: A back mounted flag identifying the loyalties of troops.  The heraldry on this banner is of a dark and gloomy forest with red eyes staring out from between the trees.
translations: 一面可识别部队忠诚度的背旗。 旗帜上的纹章是一片阴暗的森林，树丛间有一双红色的眼睛。

messages.msgid: A back mounted flag identifying the loyalties of troops.  The heraldry on this banner is of a brilliantly colored butterfly in flight, ridden by a knight in armor.  The knight is striking down a foe with a scythe while the butterfly appears to have bitten the head off a different opponent.
translations: 一面用于标明部队归属的背旗。旗帜上的纹章描绘了一位身披甲胄的骑士，他骑乘着一只振翅欲飞、色彩斑斓的蝴蝶。骑士正挥舞着长柄镰刀斩杀敌人，而他座下的蝴蝶似乎也咬掉了另一名对手的头颅。

messages.msgid: A back mounted flag identifying the loyalties of troops.  The heraldry on this banner is of, well you aren't quite sure.  It's a dark cloud, or blackness.  You feel hate radiating from this banner.
translations: 一面用于标明部队归属的背旗。至于旗帜上的纹章……说实话，你也不太确定那是什么。像是一片乌云，又或是一团纯粹的黑暗。你能感觉到这面旗帜正散发出浓烈的恨意。

messages.msgid: A back mounted flag identifying the loyalties of troops.  The heraldry on this banner is of the night sky shining with ancient wisdom, full of stars.
translations: 一面用于标明部队归属的背旗。旗帜上的纹章描绘了缀满繁星的夜空，其间闪耀着古老的智慧光芒。

messages.msgid: A back mounted flag identifying the loyalties of troops.  The heraldry on this banner is of lightning striking a tower that is falling.
translations: 一面背装旗帜，用于识别部队的忠诚度。 旗帜上的纹章是闪电击中一座正在倒塌的高塔。

messages.msgid: A soft conical hat with the apex bent over.  Commonly worn in antiquity by various cultures in Eastern Europe and Anatolia.  It later signified freedom in both the American and French Revolutions.
translations: 顶端弯曲的柔软圆锥形帽子。 在古代，东欧和安纳托利亚的各种文化普遍佩戴。 它后来在美国和法国大革命中都象征着自由。

messages.msgid: A soft conical hat with the apex bent over.  Commonly worn in antiquity by various cultures in Eastern Europe and Anatolia.  It later signified freedom in both the American and French Revolutions.  Along the brim the cap appears to be the rusty red of old blood.
translations: 顶端弯曲的柔软圆锥形帽子。 在古代，东欧和安纳托利亚的各种文化普遍佩戴。 它后来在美国和法国大革命中都象征着自由。 沿着帽檐，帽子似乎是旧血的锈红色。

messages.msgid: Blood starts seeping out of the cap, down your face.
translations: 血开始从帽子里渗出来，流到你的脸上。

messages.msgid: The cap develops a fearsome aura as the blood pours back out of the fibers.
translations: 帽子散发出某种恐怖光环，鲜血随之从纤维中渗出。

messages.msgid: A layer of bulging rootlike structures distending the upper layers of skin.  Helps protect your body from damage.
translations: 一层凸起的根状结构，使皮肤的上层膨胀。 有助于保护你的身体免受伤害。

messages.msgid: Your skin has begun to harden and pebbles have begun to surface.
translations: 你的皮肤开始变硬，鹅卵石开始浮出表面。

messages.msgid: Your skin has hardened into a granite like covering.
translations: 你的皮肤硬得像花岗岩一样。

messages.msgid: Your eyes now reflect your mood in the colors of stone.  You are also immune to the glare of the sun.
translations: 你的双眸如今会随着情绪变幻，呈现出岩石般的色彩。同时，你也对刺眼的阳光免疫。

messages.msgid: Your stone-like skin means your hands hit like hammers, and can be used like hammers as well.
translations: 你像石头一样的皮肤意味着你的拳头能像锤子一样痛击敌人，同时也可以像真正的锤子一样使用。

messages.msgid: A pliable but hefty layer of living plant matter impregnated with various waxy polymers.
translations: 一层柔韧但厚重的活植物物质，浸有各种蜡状聚合物。

messages.msgid: A thin layer of bark covers your body.
translations: 一层薄薄的树皮覆盖着你的身体。

messages.msgid: Your eyes now reflect the seasons: green, yellow, red, orange, or brown.  You are also immune to the glare of the sun.
translations: 你的眼睛现在能反映季节:绿色、黄色、红色、橙色或棕色。你也对刺眼的阳光免疫。

messages.msgid: Your skin is covered in thick, woody thorns.
translations: 你的皮肤上覆盖着厚厚的、木质的刺。

messages.msgid: Your hands and fingers have transformed into jagged wooden claws.
translations: 你的手和手指已经变成了锯齿状的木爪。

messages.msgid: Your skin has magical flames flaring out of it on occasion.  You can operate in warmer climates than normal humans but begin to take damage from getting wet.
translations: 你的皮肤会适时迸发出魔法火焰。相比普通人你可以在比更温暖的气候下活动，但一旦被淋湿就会受到伤害。

messages.msgid: Your skin exudes magickal flames constantly, you can operate in almost any heat now without danger but rain may be a lethal threat.
translations: 你的皮肤不断散发着神奇的火焰，你现在几乎可以在任何高温下活动而没有危险，但雨水会是致命威胁。

messages.msgid: Your eyes now reflect your mood, the warm red of a campfire or the searing heat of an incendiary weapon.  Glare no longer affects you.
translations: 你的眼睛现在会反映你的心情，无论是营火的暖红还是燃烧武器的灼热。眩目不再影响你。

messages.msgid: Heat from your hands.  You may cook with it at will.
translations: 热量从你的手上散发。如果你愿意，你可以用它来烹饪。

messages.msgid: Your skin has become vaguely gelatinous.  Provides some extra bash defense and immunity to wet effects.
translations: 你的皮肤变得有点像凝胶。提供一些额外的重击防御和对潮湿效果的免疫力。

messages.msgid: Your skin is completely replaced by magickal water.  You have become immune to acid effects.
translations: 你的皮肤完全被神奇的水所取代。你已经对酸的作用免疫了。

messages.msgid: Your eyes now reflect your mood in the colors of the deep waters.  From an aquamarine blue when you are pleased to the pitch black of the depths when you are angry or sad.  You are also immune to the glare of the sun and can see under water.
translations: 你的眼睛现在会用深水的颜色反映你的心情。从你高兴时的海蓝宝石，到你生气或悲伤时的漆黑深渊。你也不因阳光眩目，还可以看到水下的东西。

messages.msgid: You have an organ inside of your body that grows a material you can create improved versions of your body parts with.  You must combine it with components taken from monsters with abilities you wish to gain and magickal essence.
translations: 你体内有一个器官，它能生成一种特殊物质，你可以用这种物质来强化自身的器官。你必须将它与从怪物身上获取的、承载着你所渴求能力的组件，以及魔法精华相结合才行。

messages.msgid: Your skin is clearly separate from the air around you but has become its own weather system.  If someone reaches out and touches you, they will clearly feel you but you look like someone might reach right through you.
translations: 你的皮肤显然与周围的空气分离，但它已经成为自己的天气系统。如果有人伸出手来触摸你，他们会清楚地感觉到你，但你看起来像是有人直接通过你。

messages.msgid: Your skin is a roiling storm.  Your flexibility is greatly increased, your ability to ignore temperatures hot and cold have greatly increased but your ability to carry objects has been reduced.
translations: 你的皮肤就像一场翻腾的风暴。你的灵活性大大提高，你忽视冷热温度的能力大大提高，但你携带物体的能力却降低了。

messages.msgid: Your eyes now reflect your mood in different weather patterns.  Clear blue skies when you are pleased and storms when you are mad.  You are also immune to the glare of the sun.
translations: 你的眼睛现在会用不同的天气反映你的心情。 高兴时晴空万里，生气时狂风暴雨。 你还可以免受阳光的眩目。

messages.msgid: You can now exist as your own source of oxygen.  Anywhere that you would be impacted by a lack of oxygen should no longer trouble you.
translations: 现在，你可以作为自己的氧气源。​​任何会受到缺氧影响的地方都不再会困扰你。

messages.msgid: Your skin has smoothed and all your prior blemishes have faded away.  This somewhat reduces wet effects and leads to a more durable yet harder to heal body.
translations: 你的皮肤变得光滑无比，此前的瑕疵都已褪去。这能在一定程度上减轻潮湿效果，并使你的身体更为坚韧，但代价是更难愈合。

messages.msgid: Your skin has become latex like.  While it provides additional protection and attractiveness it also heals at a much slower rate.
translations: 你的皮肤呈现出乳胶般的质感。这虽然能为你提供额外的防护与魅力，但愈合速度也会因此变得极为缓慢。

messages.msgid: Your eyes now stare out at the world, impassive and blank like the eyes of a doll.  You are also immune to the glare of the sun.
translations: 你的双眼如今凝视着世界，如同人偶一般无神、空洞。同时，你也对刺眼的阳光免疫。

messages.msgid: The spirits of past artisans guide your hands.
translations: 先辈巧匠的魂灵指引着你的双手。

messages.msgid: With but a touch, you can override the circuits of electronics and grant yourself access.
translations: 仅需触碰，你就能覆盖电子设备的线路，获取权限。

messages.msgid: You can vaguely sense this organ… somewhere in your body.
translations: 你隐隐感受到这个器官……在你身体的某个部位。

messages.msgid: Breathing is now something you decide to do, rather than a biological necessity.
You have massive claws on your end of your furry fingers.
translations: 你毛茸茸的指尖末端长出了巨大利爪。

messages.msgid: A mouth full of vicious sharp teeth, almost twice as large as a wolf's.
translations: 满嘴狰狞的利齿，尺寸几乎是普通狼牙的两倍。

messages.msgid: Thick fur-like hair covering your entire body.
translations: 浓密的毛发覆盖着你的全身，质感如同野兽的皮毛。

messages.msgid: Your thick skin and nails means your hands can be used as simple tools.  You also do slightly more damage when punching.
translations: 你厚实的皮肤和指甲使你的双手能充当简易的工具。此外，你的拳击伤害也会略有提高。

messages.msgid: The song contained in the fruit is now struck in your head until it goes away.  Fortunately this song is enjoyable, increasing your mood while it lasts.
translations: 果实中的歌声现在会驻足于你的脑海中，直到它离去。幸好这种歌声很悦耳，当它持续时你的心情会变好。

messages.msgid: The fruit's melody fills your mind.
translations: 这枚果实的旋律充盈在你的脑海之中。

messages.msgid: Something is preventing this fruit from working.  Please report it on github.
Some sort of fruit sealed in a thick shell.  The shell is rigid but seems surprisingly brittle; you could easily peel it open to see what's inside with your bare hands.
translations: 一种被封在厚壳里的果实。外壳虽然坚硬，但似乎出奇地脆弱，你徒手就能轻易剥开，一探究竟。

messages.msgid: This round goblin fruit is reddish-orange with a waxy texture.  It smells sweet with a hint of petrichor.
translations: 这种圆形的妖精果实呈橙红色，质地像蜡，闻起来很甜，略带一点雨后泥土的清香。

messages.msgid: This oblong goblin fruit shimmers slightly in a rainbow of colors.  It smells like a mix of peach and freshly-baked bread.
translations: 这个柱状的妖精果实微微带着一点彩虹色的反光，闻起来像桃子和刚出炉的面包混合起来的味道。

messages.msgid: This round goblin fruit looks like a metal sculpture but has the yielding texture of a peach.  It smells like the tang in the air before a storm.
translations: 这种妖精果实是圆的，看起来像金属制品，但手感像桃子。它闻起来像暴风雨前的水气。

messages.msgid: This long, thin goblin fruit is a subdued green color but has a smell that burns your nostrils.
translations: 这种妖精果实是长条形的，颜色是柔和的绿，但闻起来能辣掉你的鼻子。

messages.msgid: This round goblin fruit is a bluish color changing to red at the ends.  It smells like a freshly-roasted hunk of meat.
translations: 这种圆形的妖精果实是蓝色的，末端逐渐变红。它闻起来像刚烤好的肉排。

messages.msgid: This round goblin fruit has a thick red rind with a leaf still attached to the stem.  The leaf seems to move occasionally even when there is no wind.
translations: 这种妖精果实呈圆形，有一层厚厚的红色外皮。果子上还连着叶子，即使没有风，叶子似乎也会不时飘动。

messages.msgid: This dark purple goblin fruit has an overpowering minty smell.  The smell even escapes sealed containers.
translations: 这种妖精果实是深紫色的，其浓烈的薄荷味甚至连密封容器都无法完全阻挡。

messages.msgid: This pale blue goblin fruit is a cube, and the edges are fine enough to leave a line in your thumb when you press on them.  It smells incredibly sour.
translations: 这种淡蓝色的妖精果实是一个立方体，边缘笔直，用拇指按在边上能留下一道直直的印子。闻起来特别酸。

messages.msgid: This sharply-curved goblin fruit is an off-white color turning red toward the ends.  It smells like the alley outside a club.
translations: 这种具棱角的妖精果实总体是灰白色的，其末端慢慢趋近红色，闻起来就像酒吧门口那条小巷。

messages.msgid: This large goblin fruit is such a deep black color you can't actually tell exactly what shape it is.  It's roundish, but when you hold it, it seems more like you're holding a hole in the fabric of the world.  It smells like an apple.
translations: 这种妖精果实很大，黑得估摸不清形状。大体上它是圆的，但当你拿着它的时候，你觉得自己拿着的比起说是水果，不如说是世界之幕的一个洞。它闻起来像苹果。

messages.msgid: This yellow-green goblin fruit is shaped like a donut, with six reddish stems spaced equidistantly around its circumference.  You can't imagine what the plant that grew this one looks like.
translations: 这个黄绿色的妖精果实看着像一只甜甜圈，外层圆周等距排列六个红色的果柄。你实在想不出怎样的植物会结出这种果实。

messages.msgid: This teardrop-shaped goblin fruit hurts to look at.  Sometimes it's a dark blue, sometimes it's a feverish red, and sometimes it's a mix of the two that you would previously have sworn could not exist.  It smells faintly peppery with a hint of lemon.
translations:
这种妖精果实是泪滴状的，看着就令人难过。它的颜色有时是深蓝色，有时是疯狂的红。有时它是二者混合的颜色，你曾发誓这不可能。它闻起来有淡淡的胡椒味和一点柠檬香气。
注：Dolm是1920年出版的《大角星之旅》一书中虚构的一种颜色，它是红外线和蓝色的混合色。

messages.msgid: This dark-colored goblin fruit is covered in spikes like a pineapple.  Unlike a pineapple, the spikes are yielding and seem part of the fruit, not a rind.  It smells of freshly-cut grass.
