translations: 这种深色的妖精果实上长满了像菠萝一样的尖刺。与菠萝不同的是，这些刺是软的，看着像是果实的一部分，而非果皮。它闻起来像新割的草地。

messages.msgid: A dark red goblin fruit with a heavy iron smell.  It feels warm to the touch.
translations: 这种妖精果实是暗红色的，有很重的铁锈味。它摸着很温暖。

messages.msgid: This goblin fruit looks like a globe of water with seeds and a stem suspended within it.  Despite that, it feels like kiwi, with a slight fuzz and no moisture left on your fingers when you touch it.  It smells like roses.
translations: 这种妖精果实看起来像一个装满水的透明地球仪，你能看到其中的种子和横穿的果柄。尽管如此，它摸起来像猕猴桃，有轻微的的粗糙质感，指尖也不会因此留下水痕。它闻起来像玫瑰。

messages.msgid: This goblin fruit looks like a pear and feels like a pear and smells exactly like a pear.  You have no idea how it tastes because the instant you put your tongue to it, your entire mouth goes numb.
translations: 这种妖精果实看着像梨，摸着像梨，闻起来分明就是梨。但你并不清楚它味道如何，因为舌头一碰它就麻了。

messages.msgid: This large, curved goblin fruit is a dark blue color and feels like it's already on the verge of rotting.  It takes very little pressure for your fingers to bruise the skin and the flesh inside flakes off when you touch it.  It smells like sun-ripened strawberries.
translations: 这种大而弯曲的妖精果实呈深蓝色，看着感觉马上要腐烂了。只需轻轻一碰便能压伤它的果皮，剥落它的果肉。它闻起来像自然成熟的草莓。

messages.msgid: This greenish-white goblin fruit is shaped like a star in a much more literal way than a starfruit.  It's almost like if a starfish was an apple.  It smells like freshly-laundered clothing.
translations: 这种绿调白色的妖精果实比杨桃更像一颗星星，就字面意思而言，它看起来就好像是由海星变来的水果。它闻起来像刚洗好的衣服。

messages.msgid: This greyish goblin fruit is shaped like a pear, if pears had scales like a pinecone.  There is a pulpy meat underneath the scales.
translations: 这颗灰蒙蒙的妖精果实形状酷似一只梨，只不过它的表面长满了松果般的鳞片。鳞片之下是柔软的果肉。

messages.msgid: This round blue goblin fruit glows bright enough to read by.  The light flickers like firelight, even when the fruit is simply placed on the table.  It smells like pine needles soaked in strong alcohol.
translations: 这种圆形的蓝色妖精果实发着光，亮度足以阅读。只是把它简单地放在桌子上，光芒便跃动如炉火。闻起来像烈酒浸过的松针。

messages.msgid: This small brown goblin fruit constantly forms bubbles that erupt from its skin.  Despite that, its surface remains smooth at all times.  It has a subtle, sugary smell.
translations: 这颗小小的棕色妖精果实，其表皮会不断冒出气泡然后破裂。尽管如此，它的表面却始终保持着光滑。它散发着一股若有若无的甜香。

messages.msgid: This goblin fruit is hard to perceive.  You think it's black, you believe it's small and you're certain it's near you, but all its other details slip from your memory the instant you stop looking at this fruit.
translations: 这颗妖精果实难以被清晰地感知。你觉得它是黑色的，相信它个头很小，也确定它就在你身边，可一旦你的视线移开，关于它的所有其他细节便会瞬间从你的记忆中滑落。

messages.msgid: This green goblin fruit is much heavier than it should be.  Its scent is heavy, pressing down your nose and throat as you smell it.
translations: 这颗绿色的妖精果实分量惊人，远超它应有的重量。它的气味也同样沉重，吸入时甚至让你的鼻腔和喉咙都感到一股压迫感。

messages.msgid: This sky blue fruit slows the thoughts racing in your mind a little as you stare at it, making you feel sightly more calm until you put it away.
translations: 这颗天蓝色的果实能让你的思绪稍稍放缓，只要凝视着它，你心中纷乱的念头便会平息几分，直到你将它收起。

messages.msgid: This sinewy, beak-shaped fruit produces a faint melody.  This melody grows a little louder when you bring the fruit next to your mouth.
translations: 这枚布满筋络的鸟喙状果实会奏鸣出一段微弱的旋律。当你将它凑近嘴边时，那旋律便会更响亮一些。

messages.msgid: You can see your reflection in the mirror-like surface of this fruit.  This reflection of you seems angrier, closer to a feral human than to your own image.
translations: 你可在这枚果实镜面般的表皮上看见自己的倒影。倒影中的你似乎更为愤怒，与其说是你本人，倒不如说更像一个野性未驯的原始人。

messages.msgid: The many colors of this oblong fruit shift to mimic what's behind it, trying to imitate other things with the best of its ability.
translations: 这颗椭圆形果实上的斑斓色彩会不断变幻，竭力模仿其背后的景物。

messages.msgid: This fruit wrapped in barbed vines fills you with bitterness as you hold it.  It slightly resists inertia as you move it, as if it moved through molasses.
translations: 这枚果实被带刺的藤蔓包裹着，握在手中便会让你心生苦涩。移动它时，能感到一股轻微的惯性阻力，仿佛它正穿过粘稠的糖浆。

messages.msgid: This yellow half-liquid fruit is hard to hold, as it actively tries to escape your grasp.  You hope it won't try to escape your innards after you eat it.
translations: 这颗黄色的半流体果实很难握住，因为它总想主动从你的手中挣脱。真希望你吃下它之后，它不会再试着从你的五脏六腑里逃出来。

messages.msgid: This translucent fruit is filled with a network of tubes not unlike veins and arteries.  Judging by the way its brown surface turns blue when bruised, it probably contains a fluid similar to blood.
translations: 这颗半透明的果实内部布满了酷似动静脉的管道网络。从它棕色的表皮在受损时会变为蓝色的情况来判断，它体内很可能含有一种类似血液的液体。

messages.msgid: This fruit shines a light bright enough to be painful to look at.  From the little you can see, it appears to be a purple ovoid fruit.
translations: 这颗果实散发着刺眼的光芒，令人无法直视。从依稀可辨的轮廓来看，它似乎是一枚紫色的椭圆形果实。

messages.msgid: This spiraled fruit ceaselessly spins on itself.  No matter how tight your grasp, you cannot stop its spinning.
translations: 这枚螺旋状的果实永不停歇地自旋着，无论你如何紧握，也无法令其停下。

messages.msgid: This fruit pulses at regular intervals like a beating heart.  As you hold it its rhythm changes, mimicking your own heart.
translations: 这颗果实如心脏般规律地搏动着。当你将它握在手中，它的节奏便会悄然改变，与你的心跳同频共振。

messages.msgid: You understand everything about this pale green fruit.  You know that it will taste like an apple and you know that it will have the inner structure of a kiwi, the texture of a durian, the smell of a dragon fruit and the colors of an orange.  you also know that eating it will help you understand anything you could try to learn for a few hours.
translations: 你对这颗淡绿色的果实了如指掌。你知道它有苹果的味道，猕猴桃的内部结构，榴莲的口感，火龙果的香气，以及橙子的颜色。你还知道，吃了它，就能让你在几小时内对任何想要学习的事物都融会贯通。

messages.msgid: This dark red half-liquid fruit fills you with dread and sadness as it endlessly tries to split but fails to do so.  You sense that it wants you to eat it, but you're not sure if it would be worth it.
translations: 这枚暗红色的半流质果实让你心中充满了恐惧与哀伤，因为它在无休止地尝试分裂，却总是徒劳无功。你能感觉到它渴望被你吞下，但你不确定这是否值得。

messages.msgid: This fruit is closer to an art project than to a fruit.  Numerous stitches hold together red-tinted parts of many different fruits so tightly it acts as a single, consistent whole.
translations: 与其说这是一枚果实，不如说它是一件艺术品。无数针脚将许多不同水果的泛红部分缝合得天衣无缝，使其成为一个完整统一的整体。

messages.msgid: This fruit has a perfectly unblemished surface that cannot be tarnished or dirtied, no matter what happens to it.
translations: 这枚果实的表皮光洁无瑕，无论如何都不会被玷污，也不会沾染上一丝尘垢。

messages.msgid: This gray dented fruit numbs your fingers as you hold it and its smell numbs your nose the same way.
translations: 当你握住这颗布满凹痕的灰色果实时，手指便会失去知觉，而它的气味也同样会麻痹你的嗅觉。

messages.msgid: This fruit is similar to a sphere of smoke.  Faint sounds come from this fruit.  They almost sound like whispers.
translations: 这颗果实宛如一团烟球。果实中传来隐约的声响，听起来像是窃窃私语。

messages.msgid: This rectangle fruit smells of lavender and has a mushy texture.  Its colors grow more vibrant for a second when you blink.
translations: 这颗长方形的果实散发着薰衣草的香气，质地软烂。每当你眨眼，它的色彩便会鲜艳一瞬。

messages.msgid: This spherical fruit is made of smaller versions of itself, which are also made of smaller versions of themselves.  Should you have a microscope, you could look at the fractal as it becomes smaller and smaller.
translations: 这枚球形果实由无数个更小的自己构成，而它们又由更小的自己所构成。倘若有显微镜，你便能一窥其无限缩小的分形结构。

messages.msgid: Reeking of glass cleaner, this disk-shaped fruit sticks to anything it touches.  Despite this, you have no issue removing any dust sticking to it.
translations: 这枚圆盘状的果实散发着一股玻璃清洁剂的臭味，能粘附于任何触碰到的物体。但奇怪的是，你却可以轻松拂去粘在上面的任何尘埃。

messages.msgid: This capsule-shaped goblin fruit behaves as a pressurized tank when you press its surface with your finger.  Fortunately, it doesn't appear to be able to explode if pierced or bitten.
translations: 这枚胶囊状的妖精果实，用指尖按压其表皮时，它会像一个高压气罐般鼓胀起来。万幸的是，就算被戳穿或咬破，它似乎也不会爆炸。

messages.msgid: This fruit is nothing more than a thin layer of fruit filled with air.  It has a heady aroma that makes you a little lightheaded.
translations: 这枚果实无非是一层充了气的薄薄果肉。它有一种令人醺然的芬芳，闻了会让人有些晕乎乎的。

messages.msgid: This fruit is the most boring thing you've ever seen.  Everything about it is boring: its drab dark brown color, its smell, its lack of feature, even its taste is boring.  It's not a good fruit.  It's not a bad fruit.  It's just boring.
translations: 这是你见过最平平无奇的果实。关于它的一切都索然无味：暗淡的深棕色，寡淡的气味，平庸的外表，甚至连味道都十分乏味。它不好吃，也不难吃，就只是……很无聊。

messages.msgid: This fruit is always covered in fresh mud.  You try to wipe it away, but it always come back.
translations: 这枚果实上总是沾满新鲜的泥土。你试图将其擦拭干净，但泥土总会去而复返。

messages.msgid: This fruit has the shape of a hollow cylinder.  It has a notable smell of freshly-upturned earth.
translations: 这枚果实形如一个中空的圆筒，带有一股新翻泥土的浓郁气息。

messages.msgid: This fruit reminds you of a small bowling ball.  You can hear it as it tries to convince you to not eat it.  It won't succeed, right?
translations: 这颗果实让你联想到一个小号的保龄球。你能听到它正试图说服你别吃它。它不会得逞的，对吧？

messages.msgid: This spherical fruit bears many spines, yet all of of them are dulled.  It smells faintly of cinnamon and aftershave.
translations: 这枚球形果实虽生有许多尖刺，但刺尖却都圆润无锋。它隐约散发着肉桂和须后水的香气。

messages.msgid: This pale fruit is surrounded by small lines of wind revolving around it.  The lines grow thicker the further the fruit is from the ground.
translations: 这枚淡白色的果实周身萦绕着几道细微的气旋。果实离地面越远，这些气旋就愈发粗壮。

messages.msgid: This fruit is easily mistakable for a fist-sized sapphire.  Its color, rigidity and facets bring to mind a gemstone, unlike its green stem.
translations: 这枚果实很容易被当成一块拳头大小的蓝宝石。无论是其色泽、硬度还是棱角分明的切面，都与宝石如出一辙，只有那根绿色的果柄除外。

messages.msgid: This fruit shaped akin to a chunk torn from a beehive is warm, but becomes cold as long as anyone is looking at it.  It has a strong odor, between maple and oak, but only when unobserved.
translations: 这枚果实形状好似一块从蜂巢撕下的残片，握在手里是温的，但只要被目光触及，就会变得冰凉。它有股枫木与橡木混合的浓烈气味，但也只在无人注视时才会散发出来。

messages.msgid: This blue tear-shaped fruit drips with water.  You try to collect it, but it fades away before touching the container.
translations: 这枚蓝色的泪滴状果实，不断有水从中滴落。你试图收集，但水滴在触及容器前便会凭空消失。

messages.msgid: This fruit what a kiwi would be if kiwi had decimeter-long beige fur.  It smells of steel and lilies.
translations: 倘若猕猴桃长出几寸长的米色软毛，大概就是这枚果实的模样。它散发着钢铁与百合混合的香气。

messages.msgid: This gray fruit is hard to pierce, as it reshapes itself to close any hole you make in it.  Ironically, the fruit keeps tearing its surface apart, making its reshaping a sisyphean task.
translations: 这颗灰色的果实很难咬开，因为它会自动塑形，弥合你造成的任何破口。但讽刺的是，它的表皮也在不断自行撕裂，让这种弥合变成了西西弗斯式的徒劳之举。

messages.msgid: This fruit looks like a crystal ball filled with clouds.  When you look into it, you see fragments of your most intense dreams.
translations: 这种水果看起来像一个装满云的水晶球。当你审视它时，你会看到你最激烈的梦的碎片。

messages.msgid: Alchemically altered aspirin.  Take to relieve pain and injury.
translations: 用炼金术改进的阿司匹林，服用以减轻疼痛。

messages.msgid: DOES YOUR PARTNER FIND YOUR LACK OF SEXUAL POTENCY PATHETIC?!??!  SMASH YOUR BEDROOM LIKE A WILD ANIMAL ALL NIGHT LONG!!!  -ingredients not confirmed with the FDA.
translations: 你的伴侣是否觉得你性能力匮乏到可悲？！？？！如野兽般彻底不眠地砸烂你的卧室！！！- 成分未经 FDA 确认。

messages.msgid: You take the %s.  Your skin feels like it is vibrating.
translations: 你服用了%s。你的皮肤感觉在振动。

messages.msgid: You imbibed the concoction and you feel your veins flex in a warm glow.
translations: 你吸收了混合物，你感觉到你的静脉在温暖的光芒中弯曲。

messages.msgid: A small salads worth of hawthorn petals.
Dense clusters of edible red berries grow enormously during autumn, but try not to eat the seeds as they contain cyanide.  Too tart to be very enjoyable they are often used in jams and jellies.
translations: 在秋季，密集的可食用红色浆果簇大量生长，但尽量不要吃种子，因为它们含有氰化物。 太酸了，不能非常愉快，它们经常用于果酱和果冻。

messages.msgid: Figs are a unique fruit resembling a teardrop.  They're about the size of your thumb, filled with hundreds of tiny seeds, and have an edible purple or green peel.  The flesh of the fruit is pink and has a mild, sweet taste.  The scientific name for the fig is Ficus carica.
translations: 无花果是一种形似泪珠的独特水果。它们约有拇指大小，果内有数百颗微小种子，紫色或绿色的果皮可以直接食用。果肉呈粉红色，味道温和甘甜。无花果的学名为Ficus carica。

messages.msgid: A clump of off white roots in the shape of a humanoid body.  It feels strange to the touch, almost alive.
translations: 一团灰白色的人形根茎。摸起来感觉很奇特，像活的一样。

messages.msgid: The helmet of creative juices may look like a child's homemade toy, but its effects when turned on are real enough.  While wearing it, your thoughts are buffered from the outside world by a soft white noise that varies from person to person as to what they actually hear.  Some hear the ocean, a fan blowing or paper crumpling.  Whatever the sound, it helps you to think faster and more creatively than before.
translations: 这个创造力提取头盔或许看上去像小孩的自制玩具，但它开启后的效果却足够真实。当戴上它时，你的思想被一种柔和的白噪声所缓冲，而这种白噪声因人而异，因为他们实际上听到了什么。 有些人听到的是大海，风扇的声音或纸张的破碎声。 不管是什么声音，它都能帮助你比以前更快、更有创造性地思考。

messages.msgid: A backpack with lot of light aluminum bars inside that hold a perfect vacuum, making the backpack much lighter than it should be.
translations: 这个背包内有大量空心铝棒，铝棒内的完美真空让背包比正常情况下更轻。

messages.msgid: Compact leg attachments that distribute your weight onto the ground nearby using some kind of force.  It makes you leave giant spherical footprints, but makes carrying heavy weight much easier.
translations: 紧凑型腿部挂件，能通过某种力场将你的体重传导至附近的地面。它会让你留下巨大的球形脚印，但能让你在负重时轻松得多。

messages.msgid: You turn on the weight suspension system.
You turn off the weight suspension system.
Heavily mechanized boots with small integrated battery slot inside.  Upon activation make you jump higher and farther.
translations: 高度机械化的靴子，内有小型内置电池接口。激活时让你跳得更高更远。

messages.msgid: A small, thin torus with a huge battery case, and a belt.  You can activate it to emit a field that covers your whole body which will decelerate all objects it touches.
translations: 小而薄的环形装置，配有腰带和巨大的电池盒。 你可以启动它，使其发出一个覆盖全身的场，并使其接触到的所有物体减速。

messages.msgid: The torus start to emit an invisible waves.
translations: 环带开始发出无形的波动。

messages.msgid: A compact crown boasting a built-in processor and several tiny projectors that beam information directly onto your eye.  It's equipped with enough internal storage and RAM to support a basic AI.  Along with multiple cameras providing 360-degree coverage, this setup enables you to tackle tasks far more efficiently than before.  Plus, there's a battle mode that activates an energy-intensive radiation detector.
translations: 这顶紧凑的头冠内置了处理器和几个微型投影仪，能将信息直接投射到你的眼球上。它配备了足以支持一个基础AI的内部存储和内存。配合提供360度全景覆盖的多个摄像头，这套装置能让你以远超以往的效率处理各项任务。此外，它还有一个战斗模式，可以激活一个高耗能的辐射探测器。

messages.msgid: The halo's charge is too low.

This robust system begins at your hands, where it features a squarish steel frame enhanced with strategic protrusions to amplify impact damage by focusing the point of contact.  It extends along your forearms with thick, hardened steel shields protecting both your limbs and the underlying hydraulic mechanisms.  Aluminum tubes channel these hydraulics up into your upper arms, culminating at your back where the central hub for the hydraulic servos is located.  While the system recovers some energy with each movement, its substantial weight and bulk significantly limit the use of your hands for anything else.
translations: 这套坚固的系统始于双手，其特征是一个方形钢架，上面附有经过精心设计的突起，用以集中接触点、放大冲击伤害。系统沿着前臂延伸出厚重的硬化钢护盾，保护着肢体与下方的液压机械装置。铝制管道将这些液压装置引至上臂，最终汇集于背部的液压伺服中枢。尽管该系统能从每次运动中回收部分能量，但其庞大的重量和体积，极大地限制了你双手从事其他活动的能力。

messages.msgid: An advanced version of the heavy CQC system.  It contain a self-recharging pneumatic tank that slowly builds pressure that you can use in a fight.
translations: 重型近战系统的高级版本。它包含一个可自我充能的气缸，可以缓慢地构建起压力，并在战斗中使用。

messages.msgid: A bulky mess of coils and wires that goes from your fists to your shoulder, and a slot for a small battery behind the elbow.  Upon activation it will start to emit huge electrical charges, frying your enemies when attacked in melee.
translations: 从拳头一直延伸到肩膀的笨重玩意儿，满是线圈和电线，手肘后面还有一个小型电池插槽。一旦启动，它就会释放出强大的电流，在近战攻击时把你的敌人电个外焦里嫩。

messages.msgid: A huge, respirator-like mask covering the whole head except for the right eye.  Upon activation it protects you lungs from toxic gases as well as improving your breathing and stamina.
translations: 一个形似呼吸器的巨大面罩，覆盖了除右眼以外的整个头部。一旦启动，它就能保护你的肺部免受毒气侵袭，同时改善呼吸、提升耐力。

messages.msgid: The mask's charge is too low.
A long strap with small, powerful gravity field emitters on the surface.  Allows one to strap and carry almost anything.
translations: 长长的背带表面装有小而有力的重力场发射器。几乎可以捆绑和携带任何物品。

messages.msgid: A bulky wristwatch that attaches to your arm.  Using it will revert the last injury that you have suffered.  Also tells the time.
translations: 一只绑在你手臂上的笨重腕表。使用它可以回溯你最后受到的伤，同时也可以显示当前时间。

messages.msgid: A compressed sniper sentry.  Ludicrous, physical law violating compression allows you to fit them into a small metal cylinder, but the weight compression is not as effective.
translations: 压缩的狙击机器人。可笑的是，违反物理定律的压缩允许将它们放入小的金属圆筒中，但重量压缩却没有那么有效。

messages.msgid: A compressed shotgun sentry.  Ludicrous, physical law violating compression allows you to fit them into a small metal cylinder, but the weight compression is not as effective.
translations: 压缩的霰弹枪机器人。可笑的是，违反物理定律的压缩允许将它们放入小的金属圆筒中，但重量压缩却没有那么有效。

messages.msgid: A compressed melee sentry.  Ludicrous, physical law violating compression allows you to fit them into a small metal cylinder, but the weight compression is not as effective.
translations: 压缩的近战机器人。可笑的是，违反物理定律的压缩允许将它们放入小的金属圆筒中，但重量压缩却没有那么有效。

messages.msgid: A small bill covered in odd symbols.  Tearing it will in turn cause a small dimensional tear located within a nearby entity.  Despite only lasting a few milliseconds, an internal tear in reality should be enough to kill anything.  Hopefully.
translations: 一张画满了古怪符号的小小符纸。撕开它，就会在附近某个实体内部引发一道小型的次元裂隙。尽管这道裂隙只持续几毫秒，但一道体内的现实裂痕，理应足以杀死任何东西……但愿如此。

messages.msgid: The greatest sandwich that will ever be made, in this universe and the next.  A quadruple stacker with beer-batter fried poultry, caramel chocolate chili, and topped with a specially made sauce of egg, blue cheese, honey mustard, BBQ and extremely concentrated vinegar that oozes down the other layers, before the entire thing is pressed and grilled in a waffle iron and finished with a garnish of gold and silver flakes and a fresh fruit skewered on top.  All the gourmet chefs in existence could not even conceive such a combination which, by all means, should not taste this good - But you did it.  And you don't plan on sharing.
translations: 空前绝后的至尊三明治，无论此世抑或来生，皆无可匹敌。四层堆叠的啤酒糊炸禽肉，浇上焦糖巧克力辣酱，再淋上用鸡蛋、蓝纹奶酪、蜂蜜芥末、烧烤酱和超浓缩醋特制的酱汁，任其缓缓流淌、浸润各层，最后用华夫饼烤盘压烤而成。成品以金箔银箔作点缀，顶上还串着一颗新鲜水果。世间所有美食家联手，也构想不出这般组合。按理说，它绝不该如此美味——但你做到了。而且没打算跟任何人分享。

messages.msgid: A homemade general purpose reality implosion device.  Use this item to pull the pin and start the fuse.  After 5 seconds, everything nearby will be violently sliced, warped, aged, and partially teleported straight into many different sections of the nether.  After a short moment of instant death, the dimensional gap will probably heal.  Probably.
translations: 这是一枚自制的通用现实内爆装置。使用此物即可拔掉插销，点燃引信。5秒后，附近的一切都将被粗暴地切割、扭曲、老化，并被部分传送至虚空的诸多不同区域。在短暂的即死时刻过后，维度裂隙大概会自行愈合吧。大概。
已激活的虚质扭曲手雷

messages.msgid: This netherium warp grenade is active, and will explode any second now.  Continue holding it to die in the messiest and most violent of ways imaginable
translations: 这枚虚质扭曲手雷已被激活，随时都会爆炸。继续拿着它，你就能体验到所能想象到最血肉模糊、最惨烈的死法。

messages.msgid: In this device the Mad Genius creates an extremely strong magnetic field.  Then in the next step of its creation they split that field in two in such a way it is perpetually trying to reconnect.  When activated the timer counts down til the moment the two fields reconnect.  Upon reconnection, energy is released in the form of EMP.
translations: 在这个装置中，疯狂天才创造了一个极强的磁场。然后在下一步中，它被分裂成两个永远在尝试重连的磁场。当激活时，计时器会开始倒计时，直到两个磁场重新连接。在重连时，能量会以EMP的形式释放出来。

messages.msgid: You activate the portable dark age.
translations: 你激活了便携黑暗纪元。

messages.msgid: The Portable Dark Age™ is now active and will soon end all electronic devices in range.  Prepare yourself for a life without mp3s and cell phones, at least in the closest 60 meters.
translations: 便携黑暗纪元™现在处于激活状态，不久后它就会终结范围内的所有电子设备。准备好度过一个没有MP3和电话的余生，至少在60米以内。

messages.msgid: This handgun looks like it came from some sci-fi journal.  It has a recharge slot that is somehow capable of using almost any type of battery.
translations: 这把手枪看起来像是从科幻杂志上拿来的。它有一个充电槽，不知何故能够使用几乎任何类型的电池。

messages.msgid: A ray gun with lots of cylinders and whorling cables that light up. It has a recharge slot that is somehow capable of using almost any type of battery.
translations: 一个有很多圆柱体和螺纹电缆的射线枪，可以发光。它有一个几乎可以使用任何类型的电池充电槽。

messages.msgid: Pretty bulky, this laser rifle has double the amount of lenses and emitters, which makes it really devastating after some modding.
translations: 这把笨重的激光步枪有双倍的透镜和发射器，改造后能够发挥极大威力。

messages.msgid: The Aetheric Death Ray, glowing a menacing green.  It hums with a barely controlled hatred of organic life.  It must recharge on its own, as there are no ports or battery slots on it.  It's sleek and smooth and evil.
translations: 以太死亡射线，闪烁着慑人的绿色光芒。它低鸣着对有机生命的憎恨。它上面没有接口或电池槽，必须自行充能。光滑流畅，邪恶无比。

messages.msgid: A long, huge barrel drum mortar with a small device in the very end.  It is collapsible, and you can comfortably wear it using a strap.
translations: 一个长而巨大的桶状迫击炮，末端装有一个小装置。它可以折叠，用一根带子就可以舒适地穿着。

messages.msgid: So you decided to become an inventor and instead of inventing something good for mankind, you invented this?  You should be ashamed.
translations: 你决定成为发明家，不去造福人类，而是发明这东西？可耻。

messages.msgid: Something something ion, something something wide area.  Don't even ask.
translations: 一些些离子，再来片空旷的区域，剩下的无需再问了。

messages.msgid: A hand-made lever action sniper rifle with an extremely long barrel.  Logically such a barrel shouldn't function properly, but somehow it not only works well enough, it also accelerates the bullet much more than anyone could expect.  Two internal magazine tubes under the barrel accept 15 7.62x51 rounds each.
translations: 手工自制的杠杆式狙击步枪，枪管极长。常理而言，这么长的枪管是无法正常工作的，但不知何故，它不仅能正常工作，还能加快子弹的速度，远远超出预期。枪管下的两个内置弹匣可各装入15发7.62x51mm子弹。

messages.msgid: An abominably huge, two barrel Gast system shotgun.  Recoil from the first shot powers the piston that loads a shell into the second barrel, and vice versa, making it shoot approximately 1000rpm at max.  The biggest part of this weapon is a giant, multi tube magazine, which can store 240 shells at once.  It makes the weapon extremely bulky, so the only way you can utilize it is by handling it like a chainsaw or installing it on a turret base.
translations: 巨大无比的双管加斯特自动机霰弹枪。第一发子弹的后坐力为活塞提供动力，将炮弹装入第二发枪管，反之亦然，使其最大射速约为 1000 RPM。武器最大的部分是一个巨大的多筒弹匣，一次可储存 240 枚霰弹。它使武器非常笨重，因此唯一的使用方法就是像电锯一样操作它，或者将它安装在炮塔底座上。

messages.msgid: A carbine-sized particle cannon.  It shoots microscopic particles, and due the size of projectile you don't need to reload it for decades.  Instead, you need a ton of energy to generate enough magnetic force.  The damage of the weapon is not great, but it has perfect armor penetration, and no physical armor can stop its bullets.
translations: 这是一把卡宾枪尺寸的粒子炮。它发射微观粒子，由于弹体极小，数十年都无需重新装弹。不过，它需要消耗巨大能量来产生足够强的磁力。这把武器的破坏力不算强大，但穿甲能力堪称完美，任何物理装甲都无法阻挡它的子弹。

messages.msgid: Transformed from a tool, this weapon can emit giant clouds of energy, destroying everything on their path.
translations: 这把武器由工具改造而成，能发射巨大的能量云，摧毁其路径上的一切。

messages.msgid: A default energy transformer that converts the power into raw energy.
translations: 一种默认的能量转换器，能将电力转化为纯粹的能量。

messages.msgid: A modified energy transformer.  It converts the power flow into a slow heat cloud that ignites everything around it.
translations: 一个改装的能量变换器。将能量流转化为缓慢的热云，点燃周围的一切。

messages.msgid: Instead of converting energy this transformer emits it as it is, generating a giant high-voltage cloud.
translations: 此转换器并非转化能量，而是将其直接释放，形成一团巨大的高压云。

messages.msgid: A bunch of powerful lenses and reflectors that transform the energy output into a powerful directed laser beam.
translations: 一组强大的透镜和反射镜，能将能量输出转化为一束强力的定向激光束。

messages.msgid: A small energy grenade with an additional timer slapped onto it.  When triggered, the timer will start to count to 70 seconds.  As it ends a massive explosion will rip your enemies apart.
translations: 一个加装了计时器的小型能量手雷。触发后，计时器将开始倒数70 秒。倒计时结束时巨大的爆炸将撕碎你的敌人。

messages.msgid: You trigger the mechanism, and it starts to whistle!
translations: 你触发了装置，它开始发出哨声！
发明家噪音电磁脉冲手雷

messages.msgid: A small energy grenade with an additional timer and a whistle slapped onto it.   When triggered, the timer will start to count to 70 seconds.  As it ends a huge EMP explosion will cover the zone.
translations: 一枚小型能量手雷，上面加装了额外的计时器和哨子。触发后，计时器将开始70秒的倒计时。倒计时结束时，一场巨大的电磁脉冲爆炸将覆盖整个区域。

messages.msgid: A small energy grenade with an additional timer slapped onto it.  When triggered, the timer will start to count to 70 seconds.  As it ends a massive fire explosion will rip your enemies apart.
translations: 一个加装了计时器的小型能量手雷。触发后，计时器将开始倒数70 秒。倒计时结束时巨大的火焰爆炸将撕碎你的敌人。

messages.msgid: You trigger the mechanism, and it start to whistle!
translations: 你触发了装置，它开始发出哨声！

messages.msgid: A small, square tube with a pistol grip that can emit a sonic waves, creating cavitation and tissue damage inside living creatures.  It's pretty weak as a weapon, but using extremely high frequency sounds makes it silent for most creatures you can met.  It would be fun to listen some music using it, but alas.
translations: 一根带有手枪式握把的小型方管，能发射声波，在生物体内造成空穴效应和组织损伤。作为武器，它威力相当弱，但其使用的极高频声波对你能遇到的大多数生物而言都是无声的。用它来听听音乐想必会很有趣，可惜啊。

messages.msgid: A rifle-sized tool that can concentrate heat in a huge range.  It lost its ability to work as a tool as you don't want to accidentally evaporate your materials, but the damage output pays for this with interest.
translations: 一件步枪尺寸的工具，能在大范围内集中热量。它已经失去了作为工具的功能，毕竟你可不想一不小心把你的材料给蒸发了。但其伤害输出足以弥补这一缺憾，甚至绰绰有余。

messages.msgid: A square abomination resembling a pistol, but with a collapsible outer magazine under the barrel.  This overengineered piece of metal is able to vary the size of chamber, which makes it able to shoot any round up to shotgun shells.  You spent a really long time to make it fit into a common holster.
translations: 外形酷似手枪的方形武器，但枪管下有一个可折叠的外弹匣。这块过度设计的金属可以改变枪膛的大小，因此可以发射任何子弹，甚至霰弹。你花了很长时间才把它装进一个普通枪套。

messages.msgid: A small cylinder, reminiscent of a muzzle booster.  It can be mounted onto the end of your barrel, which somehow increases the speed of the projectile.  It also makes the gun much louder and difficult to hold after each shot.
translations: 一个小圆筒，能让人联想到枪口助推器。 它可以安装在枪管末端，以某种方式提高弹丸的速度。 每次射击后，它还会使枪声更大，而且难以握住。

messages.msgid: You can't properly explain how this thing works, but the end result should be clear - faster bullet with better damage, but awful dispersion.
translations: 你无法解释这东西的原理，但结果很明显——子弹更快、伤害更高，但散布很烂。

messages.msgid: This barrel attachment drastically decreases any sound that your gun emits.  Sadly, the damage and range of the weapon decrease respectively.
translations: 这种枪管附件可以大幅降低枪支发出的声音。遗憾的是，武器的伤害和射程也会降低。

messages.msgid: A choke that makes the pellets spread out wide to hit multiple enemies.  The pellets will have shorter range but somehow deals higher damage.
translations: 使霰弹弹丸朝横向散开的鸭嘴喉缩，利于同时击中多个敌人。每颗弹丸的射程会变短，但不知为何造成的伤害更高。

messages.msgid: A set of mechanisms, that alter the action of the blocky pistol enough to make it something in-between a machine pistol and a submachine gun.
translations: 这套枪机可以改变方块手枪的发射模式，使其整体表现介于全自动手枪和冲锋枪之间。

messages.msgid: A set of modified weapon lens that increase the output energy of the laser at expense of its range.
translations: 一套改良型武器透镜，可增加激光的输出能量，但会牺牲其射程。

messages.msgid: A set of modified weapon lens that increases the range of the weapon at the price of its damage.
translations: 一套改良型武器透镜，可增加武器的射程，但会牺牲其伤害。

messages.msgid: A set of powerful capacitors that increase the damage of a beam at the price of doubling power consumption.
translations: 一组功能强大的电容器，可以增加光束的伤害，但代价是功耗增加一倍。

messages.msgid: A set of extremely powerful capacitors which can turn a common laser beam into powerful anti-materiel penetrator.  It spends five times more energy than the default capacitor, so you need a lot of batteries to use it.
translations: 一组超级强力电容，能把普通激光变成强力反器材武器。它消耗的能量是默认电容器的五倍，因此需要大量电池。

messages.msgid: A set of improved electric discharges, that uses energy more efficiently then standard.  It makes you spend much less energy per shot, but the overall output of a system is a bit smaller.
translations: 改良型放电设备，比标准版更为高效。它让射击消耗更少能量，但输出稍有降低。

messages.msgid: A set of fins in mathematically precise order, that make heat transferring much more efficient than your original implementation.
translations: 一组按数学上的精确顺序排列的散热片，其热传导效率比你最初的设计更有效。

messages.msgid: A small piece of completely frozen metal.  It grants a massive cooling improvement, but the weapon circuits don't work properly with this mod, making you spend more energy per shot.
translations: 一小块完全冻结的金属。 它能显著改善冷却效果，但武器电路在使用这种模组时无法正常地工作，导致每次射击消耗更多能量。

messages.msgid: Put some amount of the heat exchange from the gun back into platform loop.  Decrease amount of energy used, and increase the heat output of the weapon, but also its heat generation within the loop.
translations: 将枪体部分热交换重新导回平台回路。降低能量消耗，增加武器的热辐射输出，也增加回路内生成的废热。

messages.msgid: Alter the energy loop in the platform - instead of doing multiple shots, it store all the power, and use most of it in a single shot.  Effectively transform the weapon into one or two shot recoilless rifle.
translations: 改变平台的能量循环--不再进行多次射击，而是储存所有能量，并在一次射击中使用大部分能量。 有效地将武器转化为单发或双发无后坐力步枪。

messages.msgid: Additional radiator for your energy weapon.  Someone may say it's because you don't know how to use your gun properly.
translations: 能量武器的额外散热器。 也许有人会说这玩意的存在是因为你不知道如何正确地使用你的枪。

messages.msgid: Replace the entire radiator in the platform into this hefty and bulky piece of metal, trading a portability of a gun for a massive overheat buffer.
translations: 将平台上的整个散热器换成这块又沉又笨重的金属，用枪支的便携性换取巨大的过热缓冲。

messages.msgid: Replace a large part of the weapon's radiator with an additional cooling unit.  The gun overheats faster, but recovers from it at a faster rate.
translations: 将大部分散热器换成额外的冷却单元，导致武器过热速度加快，但过热后的恢复速率也相应提升。

messages.msgid: Replace a large portion of the radiator with additional capacitors.  The gun will barely cool off, but the damage output may be worth it.
translations: 用额外的电容器替换大部分的散热器。枪几乎不会冷却，但伤害输出可能是值得的。

messages.msgid: A long, solid, crafted steel haft, and a bulky, comma-like head.  It feels really massive, but it is surprisingly easy to swing, and you will do more damage as your level increases.  You can throw it like a boomerang, and the damage of throw depend on your throwing skill level.
translations: 长而坚固的精钢枪柄，带有笨重的逗号状枪头。它给人的感觉非常巨大，但挥动起来却出乎意料地轻松，而且伤害会随等级提高。你可以像投掷回旋镖一样投掷它，投掷伤害取决于投掷技能等级。

messages.msgid: A hand-made lightened engine, with chain blades on a long stick.  The only reason it works without falling apart is because your calculations can't be wrong.
translations: 手工制造、装有刃链的轻型引擎，安装在长木棍上。它还能运转不散架的唯一原因是你肯定没计算错。

messages.msgid: You turn on the chainsaw spear.
The chainsaw spear battery is dead.
You turn off the chainsaw spear.
Probably a great weapon, it is folded now.
translations: 也许是把好武器，不过现在折叠起来了。

messages.msgid: With a quiet click, the megachette is unfolded.
translations: 咔嗒一声，开山刀展开了。

messages.msgid: A completely flat, single-edged blade.  While very visually appealing, it is no less deadly.  It can be folded more times than makes sense.
translations: 一把扁平的单刃刀。不仅视觉上很吸引人，还极具杀伤力。它可以折叠的次数超过了常理范围。

messages.msgid: With a few moves, the megachette is folded.
translations: 只需几步，开山刀就被折叠起来了。

messages.msgid: A relatively heavy two-handed sword with "100111100" inscribed on the blade, perhaps to appear fancier than it truly is.  Still, it is a surprisingly good weapon.
translations: 这是一把相对较重的双手剑，剑刃上刻有 "100111100 "字样，也许是为了显得比实际重量更重。 不过，这仍然是一把出人意料的好武器。

messages.msgid: A light, hollow aluminum bar with an installed plasma torch on the end in the form of a circle, emitting 28000 centrigrades of heat on demand.  This probably violates dozens of OSHA regulations.
translations: 一根轻质的空心铝棒，末端安装了一个环形等离子炬，可按需喷射出28000摄氏度的高温。这玩意儿大概违反了几十条职业安全与健康条例。

messages.msgid: A light battery cell that was modified and replaced with much more effective cells inside.
translations: 一枚经过改造的轻型电池，新的内部电芯效率高得多。

messages.msgid: A medium battery cell that was modified and replaced with much more effective cells inside.
translations: 一枚经过改造的中型电池，新的内部电芯效率高得多。

messages.msgid: A tool battery cell that was modified and replaced with much more effective cells inside.
translations: 一枚经过改装的工具电池，新的内部电芯效率高得多。

messages.msgid: A lightweight, battery-powered tool to weld metal pieces together using a plasma-inducted electric arc.  A decent tool, but you think you can do more with some modifications.
translations: 一款轻便的电池供电工具，可利用等离子电弧将金属片焊接在一起。这是个不错的工具，但你觉得稍加改装后可以做得更多。

messages.msgid: An extremely small and light tool that creates and transfers the heat in an extremely effective way.  You think it would be interesting to develop it further.
translations: 一件极其小巧轻便的工具，能以极高的效率产生和传导热量。你觉得它很有进一步开发的潜力。

messages.msgid: A simple intelligent agent to provide support in parsing big layers of information.
translations: 一个简单的智能代理软件，为大量信息的解析提供支持。

messages.msgid: An enormous industrial press shaped device, covered in sensors, circuits, and other doodads.  Two inverted teleporters are located on each side of the hammers, poised to perfectly align at the end of a strike.  Doing so will smoothen the overall local barrier between Earth and other realities, filling in any holes at the expense of weakening it in a much wider area.  This is an overall positive effect, allowing you to heal tears that would never naturally close, but expect large temporary side-effects.
translations: 一台形似工业冲压机的巨型装置，上面布满了传感器、电路和其他小玩意儿。撞锤两侧各设有一个反向传送器，准备在撞击结束时完美对齐。这样做会平滑地球与其他现实之间的局部屏障，填补任何空洞，但代价是在更广阔的区域内削弱屏障。总的来说，这是一种积极效应，能让你治愈那些永远无法自然闭合的裂隙，但也要准备好迎接巨大的暂时性副作用。

messages.msgid: A small remote with a sharp spike at the end.  You can activate this device while poking it into a zone of frozen time in order to unfreeze the area you're touching.
translations: 一个小遥控器，末端有尖锐的刺。你可以激活这个小装置，将其刺向一片时间冻结的区域，使其解冻。

messages.msgid:
An incredibly intricate clock where every visible surface appears to be gilded or chrome.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
极其复杂的时钟，每个可见表面似乎都镀了金或铬。
它可能有未知的力量，试试激活它。

messages.msgid:
This crystal rod changes hue at random.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
随机改变颜色的晶体棒。
它可能有未知的力量，试试激活它。

messages.msgid:
A strange monitor with a variety of knobs and dials.  When you turn it on, it crackles and then begins tracking things that either aren't there or aren't visible to the naked eye.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
奇怪的监视器，带有一堆旋钮和仪表盘。启动时，它会开始跟踪不存在于此或肉眼不可见的存在。
它可能有未知的力量，试试激活它。

messages.msgid: a mess of tubes and wires
messages.plural: several messes of tubes and wires

messages.msgid:
What is it for?  What could it do?
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
这是什么？它能干什么？
它可能有未知的力量，试试激活它。

messages.msgid:
It's a sculpture, but you can't identify what it depicts.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
这是一尊雕塑，但你辨认不出它描绘的是什么。
它或许拥有未知的力量，试试激活它吧。

messages.msgid:
It hums louder when you touch it.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
你触摸时它的嗡鸣声变大了。
它可能有未知的力量，试试激活它。

messages.msgid:
This looks like a musical instrument.  But how would you play it?
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
这看起来像一件乐器。但是你会怎么玩呢
它可能拥有未知的力量；试着激活它们。

messages.msgid:
A sheet so light and thin that viewing it horizontally makes it almost invisible.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
轻薄得侧面几乎看不到的薄膜。
它可能有未知的力量，试试激活它。

messages.msgid:
A prickly ball that, no matter the force you apply, somehow never feels as if it could cut.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
带刺的小球，无论你用多大的力气，都感觉不到它能割伤你。
它可能有未知的力量，试试激活它。

messages.msgid:
Despite its looseness, this mass of goo keeps its shape as you fold it in your hands.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
尽管松松垮垮，但这团黏糊糊的东西在你手中折叠时却能保持形状。
它可能有未知的力量，试试激活它。

messages.msgid:
A rod with a bulbous, spiralling knob on the end that seems to spin as you look.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
一根杆子的末端有一个螺旋状的球形旋钮，似乎会随着你的视线旋转。
它可能有未知的力量，试试激活它。

messages.msgid:
One of those pins you wear on your shirt, but this one has indecipherable symbols in place of a witty slogan.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
可以别在衬衫上的别针，但这个别针用难以辨认的符号代替了诙谐的标语。
它可能有未知的力量，试试激活它。

messages.msgid:
A tube of unknown material.  A strange noise from nowhere can be heard when you place it next to your ear, as if something's inside.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
未知材料的空管。当你放在耳边时会听见不知哪来的奇怪声音，像是里面有什么。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid:
A triangular pyramid, inconspicuous in every way.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
一个三角形锥体，在各方面都不显眼。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid:
A beautiful crystal, which seems to suck in detail rather than merely obscuring it as light passes through.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
美丽的晶体，它似乎能吸住细节，而不仅仅是在光线通过时将其遮住。
它可能有未知的力量，试试激活它。

messages.msgid:
A bit of spiralling rope, disorienting you as your eyes vainly try to complete following the loop.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
一段螺旋状绳索，你的眼睛徒劳地跟随环路后最终迷失方向。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid:
The sound of the tide can be heard from this stone, as if it were a miniature moon moving the oceans.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
能听见来自这块石头的潮汐声，仿佛一个引动海洋的微型月亮。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid: A jagged and eldritch looking QR code ready to be placed wherever you are concerned about mechanical eyes.  Will trap robots if they wander into it.
translations: 一个外形参差、透着诡异气息的二维码，可以放置在你担心有机械眼窥探的任何地方。机器人一旦误入其中，便会被困住。

messages.msgid: A jagged and eldritch looking QR code ready to be placed wherever you are concerned about mechanical eyes.  Will trap cyborgs if they wander into it.
translations: 一个外形参差、透着诡异气息的二维码，可以放置在你担心有机械眼窥探的任何地方。半机械人一旦误入其中，便会被困住。

messages.msgid: An old-school cylinder hat, used by illusionists around the world.  Maybe it still remembers some cool tricks?
translations: 一顶老派的圆筒礼帽，为世界各地的幻术师所使用。或许它还记得一些炫酷的戏法吧？

messages.msgid: A small and light ball of glass with flickering flames inside.  The surface feels scalding hot, yet the temperature does not change.
translations: 一个小而轻的玻璃球，里面有闪烁的火焰。表面感觉很烫，但室温并未因此改变。

messages.msgid: A fortune-telling device from the 1950s.  If you shake it and look at the bottom it will give you detailed step by step instructions on how to do… something.
translations: 一个源自20世纪50年代的占卜工具。如果你摇晃它，并盯着底部，它会给你提供详细逐步指示去……做些什么。

messages.msgid: This paperweight in the shape of a small glass dagger emits a wet wheeze like a punctured lung when held.
translations: 这个玻璃匕首形状的小型镇纸握住时会发出湿漉漉的呼气声，就像刺破的肺一样。

messages.plural: copies of Caravaggio on his deathbed

messages.msgid: A previously unknown painting in Caravaggio's style of the artist himself lying prone on his deathbed as black ichor seeps from a sword wound in his side.  His own sword rests near his hand and his ever dying breath asks you to take up his blade.
translations: 一幅卡拉瓦乔风格的尚不为人所知的画，画中的艺术家自己躺在临终的病床上，黑色血液从他身体侧面的刀伤中渗出。他自己的匕首放在手边，他那垂死的气息仿佛正叫你拿起那把匕首。
劲对太不些有。镜持手小个一

messages.msgid: A pair of a common glasses.  They have no lens or glass inside, only casing.  There is a strange engraving of vines, snakes, and foxes covering every surface of the frames.  You think that maybe the engravings are moving when you aren't looking at them.
translations: 一副普通的眼镜。它们的内部没有镜头或玻璃，只有外壳。框架的每一个表面都刻着奇怪的藤条、蛇和狐狸的图案。你认为当你不看雕刻品的时候，它们可能在移动。

messages.msgid: A photo of a smiling family on a camping trip.  The background is always the same, but people are not.  Do you recall them?
translations: 一张露营旅行中微笑的一家人的照片。背景依旧，但人却不再。你是否又回想起他们了？

messages.msgid: A small, black sphere.  It constantly changes its position.  It even tries to roll out of corners you wedge it into.
translations: 一个黑色的小球体。它不断地改变自己的位置。它甚至试图从你楔入的角落里滚出来。

messages.msgid: This looks like a typical household flashlight.  It has no battery holder and it hums when you touch it.
translations: 这看起来像一个典型的家用手电筒。它没有电池座，当你触摸它时它会发出嗡嗡声。

messages.msgid: A pin-shaped piece of iron.  You feel the need to hammer it.
translations: 一块针状的铁片。你觉得有必要敲打它。

messages.msgid: A small, transparent bubble.  It divides itself into two, then four, eight, sixteen, endlessly, before turning back to single bubble and repeating the process.
translations: 透明的小气泡它把自己分成两个，然后四个，八个，十六个，没完没了，然后又变成一个气泡，重复这个过程。

messages.msgid: A small shard of amber.  Looking carefully, you think you see some manner of creature trapped within.
translations: 一小块琥珀碎片。仔细观察，你似乎看到里面困着某种生物。

messages.msgid: A small, flat case used to carry currency.  Each time you open it, it reveals new pockets, but all of them hold the same one coin, which you can't remove.
translations: 一个用来装货币的扁平小盒子。 每次打开它，都会出现新的口袋，但所有口袋都装着同一枚硬币，而且无法取出。

messages.msgid: A delicate figurine of a renaissance angel.  It looks oddly human.
translations: 文艺复兴时期天使的精美雕像。它看起来像是奇怪的人类。

messages.msgid: A small action figurine of a man with an old computer.  It appears he is attempting to hack it.
translations: 一个拿着一台旧电脑的人的小动作小雕像。看起来他是在试图黑掉它。

messages.msgid: You see an incredibly detailed stone feather, almost lifelike in appearance.
translations: 你看到一根极其精细、栩栩如生的石制羽毛。

messages.msgid: You see a blocky arrow, unerringly pointed in some far off direction.  It is completely colorless.
translations: 你看到一个块状箭头，准确无误地指向某个遥远的方向。 它没有丝毫颜色。

messages.msgid: A circular unit of energy, surrounded by a few other circles that almost connect around the center.
translations: 一个环形的能量单元，周围环绕着几圈几乎围拢于中心的圆环。

messages.msgid: You feel like something took a glance at this place, and it was so menacing that the world itself curled up.
translations: 你感觉有什么东西瞥了一眼此地，其威势之骇人，令世界本身都为之蜷缩。

messages.msgid: A small lizard tail that was ripped off.  Looks like someone's joke.
translations: 一条被扯掉的小蜥蜴尾巴。 看起来像是某人的玩笑。

messages.msgid: These brass cylinders are engraved with cuneiform and could be rolled across wet clay to create a page of writing per cylinder.  When you touch one of the cylinders you hear a faint voice whisper 'Enki'.
translations: 这些黄铜圆柱上雕刻着楔形文字，可以在湿黏土上滚动，每个铜柱能印出一页。当你触摸其中一个圆柱时，你能听到一个微弱的声音在低语"Enki"。

messages.msgid: A deck of intricately designed tarot cards.  When you lay out your future they seem to be trying to tell you to take a leap of faith.
translations: 一副设计复杂的塔罗牌。当你用它占卜未来时，它似乎在告诉你要向前一步信仰之跃。

messages.msgid: An intricate occult seal.  When you glance at the bottom left corner you hear the sound of the ocean and smell the salty air of the sea, and sense a river flowing through each point of the seal.
translations: 一个错综复杂的神秘印章。当你瞥一眼左下角的时候，你会听到海洋的声音，闻到大海里咸咸的空气，感觉到一条河流过印章的每一个点。

messages.msgid: An old style hurricane lamp.  The handle appears to made of vines covered in sharp thorns.
translations: 一顶老式防风灯。手柄似乎是由覆盖着尖刺的荆棘制成的。

messages.msgid: A box full of glass berries, when you get distracted you find yourself crunching them in your mouth.  Each one tastes like a mouthful of blood that slowly changes to espresso.
translations: 一个装满玻璃浆果的盒子，当你分心时，你会发现自己在嘴里嚼着它们。每一杯都尝起来像一口慢慢变成浓缩咖啡的血液。
失踪人员的拍立得照片

messages.msgid: A polaroid of someone you remember going missing before the Cataclysm.  It caught a ton of media attention due to them being seen near what was shortly after identified as a thin place between dimensions.  The more you stare at the picture, the more you begin to see wounds appear and disappear on the person.  Sometimes they match your old scars.
translations: 一张你记得在大灾变前失踪的人的宝丽来。它吸引了大量媒体的注意，因为它们被发现在不久之后被确认为维度之间的薄薄之处附近。你越盯着这张照片，你就越能看到这个人身上的伤口出现和消失。有时它们会和你以前的伤疤相配。

messages.msgid: A small jar with coffee, moving in weird patterns with no apparent cause.  After watching the swirls for some time, you are sure that it loops back on its movements, like some sort of message.
translations: 一个小罐子里的咖啡，以奇怪的模式移动，没有明显的原因。观察这些漩涡一段时间后，你确定它们循环着移动，就像某种信息一样。

messages.msgid: A red fabric blindfold with a cartoonish devil over the eyes.  You feel some anger when you put it on.  Did that devil just wink at you?
translations: 一个红色布料的眼罩，眼部上有一个卡通恶鬼。 当你戴上它时，你感到有些愤怒。 那个恶魔刚才是在向你眨眼吗？

messages.msgid: A human heart grown in mother of pearl.  It beats loudly when you raise it to your ear.
translations: 在珍珠母中生长着一颗人心。将它举到耳边时，心跳声会增大。

messages.msgid: A tiny human eye.  You can clearly see the green iris and red capillaries.  While holding it in the dark you feel it watching you.
translations: 一只小小的人眼。你可以清楚地看到绿色的虹膜和红色的毛细血管。当你在黑暗中拿着它时，你会感觉到它在看着你。

messages.msgid: A small, smooth part of the human brain.  Looks slippery.  Feels like rubber.
translations: 人脑的一个小而光滑的部分。看起来很滑。摸起来像橡胶。

messages.msgid: A tiny human skull.  His empty orbits are watching you.
translations: 一个小小的人类头骨。他的空洞在注视着你。

messages.msgid: A small ring.  There is nothing special about it, except the word "Republic" embossed on it.
translations: 一枚小戒指。它没有什么特别之处，只是上面浮雕了一个“共和国”的字样。

messages.msgid: A tiny human eye.  You can clearly see it has a blue iris and red capillaries.  You feel it can see you no matter how you hide.
translations: 一只小小的人眼。你可以清楚地看到它有蓝色的虹膜和红色的毛细血管。无论你如何隐藏，你都能感觉到它能看到你。

messages.plural: copies of Enemy of the World

messages.msgid: A small Korean novel that describes the journey of an incredibly strong protagonist attempting to save the world.
translations: 一本韩国微小说，讲述了一位强大到逆天的主角试图拯救世界的故事。

messages.msgid: A large, straight horn of some unknown creature.  It could easily injure a careless person.
translations: 某种未知生物的大而直的角。它很容易伤到粗心大意的人。

messages.msgid: A long fleshy tendon with joints on both sides.  They contract from time to time.
translations: 一条两侧都有关节的又长又多肉的肌腱。他们时不时地会收缩。

messages.msgid: There is nothing here.  It's uncomfortable to hold it.
translations: 这里什么都没有。拿着它很不舒服。

messages.msgid: Two perfect spheres.  The first does not move at all, and the second constantly rotates around.  You feel a connection to both of them.
translations: 两颗完美的球体。第一颗纹丝不动，第二颗则围绕其不停旋转。你感觉自己与它们二者皆有联系。

messages.msgid: A solid, full size cast of a human fist, made out of some gray metal.  Looks menacing.
translations: 一个实心的、全尺寸的拳头模型，由灰色的金属制成。它想要和你打一架。

messages.msgid: A miniature anchor with an earthly sheen.  You feel more stable looking at it.
translations: 一枚散发着尘世光泽的微型锚。注视着它，你感觉心神更加安稳了。

messages.msgid: A pile of gray sand that is clumped together.  When you separate the pieces they seem to flow back together.
translations: 一堆凝结在一起的灰色沙子。当你把它们分开时，它们似乎又会流淌到一起。

messages.plural: copies of String Theory For Dummies

messages.msgid: A small hardcover book describing a quite preposterous version of string theory.
translations: 一本小型精装书，描述了一种相当荒谬的弦理论版本。

messages.msgid: A 3-ft (or about 1 m) jumper cable, wrapped with blue insulating tape.  Both sides lack connectors.
translations: 一根3英尺（约1米）长的跨接电缆，用蓝色绝缘胶带包裹。两端没有连接器。

messages.plural: copies of Goody Osborne's Booke of Remedies

messages.msgid: This purports to be the 'Reale and True Acounting of the Works and Devices of Sarah Osbourne, a Most Puissant Wiche', but you're pretty sure it's all a front and it was actually written within the last couple decades.  There are some pretty detailed descriptions of rituals in here, mixed among diary entries and accounts of fanciful meetings in the woods.
translations: 此书号称是“萨拉·奥斯本，一位至强女巫，其行迹与术法之真实记述”，但你相当确定这全是幌子，实际上是近几十年内写就的。书中混杂着日记条目和林中奇会的记述，其间不乏对某些仪式的详尽描绘。

messages.msgid: A hardcover translation of the infamous 15th century book used as a reference work for witchcraft trials for centuries.  This translation seems to have some handwritten notes in some of the margins.
translations: 这是一本声名狼藉的15世纪著作的精装译本，数百年来一直被用作猎巫审判的参考书。这本译本的页边空白处似乎有一些手写笔记。

messages.msgid: The Cunning Book of Home and Hearth
messages.plural: copies of The Cunning Book of Home and Hearth

messages.msgid: This mass-market paperback purports to pass down the ancient traditional secrets of English cunning folk, though if that were true, they probably could have gotten more than $12.95 for it.  There are a lot of descriptions of rituals and procedures in here, though--maybe some of them deserve further investigation.
translations: 这本面向大众市场的平装书，号称传授了英格兰巫传古老的传统秘术——不过，倘若此言非虚，其售价恐怕就远不止12.95美元了。话虽如此，书中确实记载了大量的仪式和流程，或许其中一些值得深入探究。

messages.msgid: Bloodstoppers and Bearwalkers: Folk Traditions of Michigan's Upper Peninsula
messages.plural: copies of Bloodstoppers and Bearwalkers: Folk Traditions of Michigan's Upper Peninsula

messages.msgid: This is an anthropological collection of American folk beliefs in the Upper Peninsula of Michigan, consisting of stories, legends, descriptions of rituals, tall tales, and anything else the author heard during his period of study.  The "Bloodstoppers" of the title are individuals believed to be able to stop the flow of blood from a wound, with an incantation or ritual or sheer force of will, and the bearwalkers were allegedly sorcerers who could assume the shape of a bear and cause misfortune.
translations: 这是一本关于美国密歇根上半岛民间信仰的人类学文集，内容收录了故事传说、仪式记述、奇闻异事，以及作者在研究期间听闻的一切。书名中的“止血师”，据信能通过咒语、仪式或纯粹的意志力止住伤口流血；而“熊行者”，则据说是能化身为熊、招致灾厄的巫师。

messages.msgid: Ward your Dreams for a Good Night's Sleep!
messages.plural: copies of Ward your Dreams for a Good Night's Sleep!

messages.msgid: This is a very thin booklet, more of a pamphlet, about various ways to protect from nightmares.  There are quite a few techniques in here, though you're a bit skeptical about whether the author took the end of the world into their calculations.
translations: 这是一本很薄的小册子，更像是一本宣传册，内容是关于各种防止噩梦的方法。书中确实有不少技巧，但你有点怀疑作者在设计这些方法时是否把世界末日考虑进去了。

messages.msgid: This is a thin reproduction of John Dee's Monas Hieroglyphica.  A complicated work whose meaning has long been lost without access to the occult oral tradition of it's time.  It's possible that some remnants of that oral tradition still exist today, but it is unknown if they would be able to fully interpret this spellbook.
translations: 这是约翰·迪伊所著《莫纳斯象形文》的一本薄页影印本。此书晦涩复杂，因缺乏那个时代的神秘学口述传统，其真意早已失传。或许如今仍有部分口述传统尚存于世，但未知其能否足以完全解读这本法术书。

messages.msgid: A short parchment that will supposedly teach you how to see through walls.
translations: 一卷短羊皮纸，据说能教你如何看穿墙壁。

messages.msgid: The Bathhouse at Midnight: An Historical Survey of Magic and Divination in Russia
translations: 《俄罗斯魔法与占卜的历史考察》
messages.plural: copies of The Bathhouse at Midnight: An Historical Survey of Magic and Divination in Russia

messages.msgid: This encyclopediac tome by W. F. Ryan concerns a wide variety of folk magic practices in pre-modern Russia, including their social context, the way that the Church had to work against folk practices like leaving items on the altar for six weeks so they would gain protective powers, the dangers of being alone in the bathhouse, ways to find and keep a husband or wife, when to throw an axe handle over your shoulder when walking into the forest, and how the government mostly suppressed magic because magical power (real or imagined) would have been a threat to secular power.  The description of some of these rituals are extremely detailed.
translations: 这本由W·F·瑞安撰写的百科全书式巨著，详考了前现代俄罗斯的种种民间魔法实践。书中包罗万象，既探讨了其社会背景，也记述了教会如何与民间习俗角力——例如，人们会将物品置于祭坛六周以求庇佑；此外，书中还提及了独处澡堂的凶险、寻觅良缘的秘法、入林时何时该将斧柄抛于身后，乃至政府镇压魔法的主因——只因魔法力量（无论真假）都会威胁到世俗王权。书中对某些仪式的描述细致入微。

messages.msgid: The Book of the Sacred Magic of Abramelin the Mage
messages.plural: copies of The Book of the Sacred Magic of Abramelin the Mage

messages.msgid: Translated from the French edition by Samuel L MacGregor Mathers, this tome compiles the journeys of a man named Abraham of Worms to Egypt, where he learned occult secrets from the wizard Abramelin who lived in a small town near the Nile.  The magic contained within focuses mostly on the creation of magic squares which, when used in ceremonies by an initiate, provide magical effects.
translations: 此书由塞缪尔·L·麦格雷戈·马瑟斯自法文版译出，汇编了一位名叫“沃姆斯之亚伯拉罕”的男子游历埃及的见闻。他在尼罗河畔的一座小镇上，从巫师亚伯拉梅林处习得了玄奥秘法。书中所载魔法，核心在于创造各类魔法方阵；当入门者在仪式中运用这些方阵时，便能引发种种奇效。

messages.msgid: Psychic Self-Defense: The Classic Instruction Manual for Protecting Yourself Against Paranormal Attack
messages.plural: copies of Psychic Self-Defense: The Classic Instruction Manual for Protecting Yourself Against Paranormal Attack

messages.msgid: A very popular 20th century occult book about protecting yourself against psychic attack, haunting, vampirism (the psychic kind, not the kind with fangs), and other otherworldly phenomenon.
translations: 这是一本极富盛名的20世纪神秘学著作，论述了如何保护自己免遭心灵攻击、鬼魅缠扰、灵性吸食（指精神层面，而非尖牙利爪那类）以及其他超凡现象的侵害。

messages.msgid: You spent years before the Cataclysm researching esoteric sciences and occult mysteries but only now in the heat of survival, have you experienced the epiphany that will allow you to create alchemical substances.
translations: 在大灾变之前，你花了数年时间研究神秘科学和秘传，但直到现在，你才在生死存亡的紧要关头领悟创造出炼金物质的诀窍。

messages.msgid: The days and weeks since the Cataclysm have been a blur of ideas and thoughts that you can only wish you had been able to think of before everything ended.
translations: 大灾变之后的几天和几周里，各种想法和想法都变得模糊，你只能希望在一切结束之前能够想到这些。

messages.msgid: The things you've learned would have changed your life in the old days, you could have dropped out of the rat race and become a hidden master of the occult.
translations: 你所学到的东西可能会改变你过去的生活，你可能会退出激烈的竞争，成为隐秘的神秘学大师。

messages.msgid: You've mastered the technique of cold forging iron from ingots into various items and weapons that are particularly effective against creatures from faerie myths.
translations: 你已经掌握了冷锻铁锭制造各种物品和武器的技巧，这些东西在对付传说生物时尤为有效。

messages.msgid: At this stage in your occult education, normally you would start a small cabal of your own with apprentices that would engage in research and material gathering.  You would likely have several rich patrons financing you in return for alchemical medicines and goods to give them health and longevity.
translations: 在你接受神秘学教育的这一阶段，通常你会建立一个自己的小团伙，带着学徒从事研究和材料收集工作。你很可能会有几个有钱的赞助人资助你，以换取让他们健康长寿的炼金药品和物品。

messages.msgid: Truly you have become one of the hidden occult masters of the world.  It's a pity that so few people are around for you to enjoy the benefits of your knowledge.  At least it's helping you to survive and maybe even thrive in this post-Cataclysm world.
translations: 你确实已经成为世界上隐藏的神秘学大师之一。遗憾的是，周围只有很少的人能让你享受到你的知识所带来的好处。至少它可以帮助你在这个大灾变后的世界中生存，甚至可能蓬勃发展。

messages.msgid: Maybe you aren't a genius, but something inside of you grants previously hidden reserves of mana.
translations: 也许你不是天才，但你内心的某些东西会赋予你以前隐藏的魔力储备。

messages.msgid: One of your ancestors spent their life fighting the monsters that stalk the night, and you have finally taken up their legacy, though you've also adopted their unusual weapon choice.  When wielding a whip, you do greatly-increased damage to vampires and renfields, and have a much easier time hitting their weakpoints.
translations: 你的其中一个祖先穷极一生与暗夜的怪物战斗，而你终于继承了他们的遗志，尽管这也包括习惯他们奇怪的武器偏好。当手持鞭子时，你对吸血鬼和血仆造成的伤害大幅提升，并且攻击他们的弱点也更加容易。

messages.msgid: Your knowledge of spirits, the unseen world, and other mystical topics, occult is a path to abilities many might consider to be unnatural.
translations: 神秘学是研究灵魂、无形世界及其他神秘事物的知识。它是一条通往非凡能力的道路，而这些能力在许多人看来或许……并不那么自然。

messages.msgid: Your mind is set in order, walled and guarded
Shiny reflective throwing knife at the ready.
translations: 闪亮的反光飞刀准备好了。

messages.msgid: This causes the dot when attacking targets with the erosion buff.  Having the spell is a bug.  Monster version
translations: 当你具有失序打击状态时，对你攻击的目标造成持续伤害。这是怪物使用的版本。

messages.msgid: This gives the monster the erosion buff.  Having the spell is a bug.  Monster version
You have an intimate sense for the flow of time, and you can use your power to manipulate it.  Activate this trait to spend learned insight.
translations: 你对时间的流逝有着敏锐的感知，并能运用自己的力量操控时间。 激活这一特性，就能消耗得到的洞悉。

messages.msgid: You have suffered a time looped wound, forcing you to repeatedly endure the harm of an earlier wound.  Every 24 hours you are impaled by a non-existent knife.
translations: 你有一个时间循环的伤口，导致你不得不反复忍受之前的伤害。 每隔 24 小时，你就会被一把不存在的匕首刺中。

messages.msgid: Your timestream remains slightly slower than baseline reality.  You act 10% slower.
translations: 你的时间流比基准现实稍慢。 你的行动速度慢 10%。

messages.msgid: Your chronomantic powers have inherent instability.  While attempting to maintain them over long periods of time, your powers may randomly fail.
translations: 你的司辰能力有固有的不稳定性。当你试图长时间保持它们时，你的能力可能会在某一刻突然失效。

messages.msgid: Dreamers are people who are able to tap into the power of dreams and nearby dimensions and create fantastical effects as a result.  They can even pull some of this dream material into our world to build other things with it.  Sometimes they hear outside voices that offer help and presents, and with enough power, dreamers can pull them right from beyond.  Their power scales with their natural perception and intellect.
translations: 梦行者是那些能够利用梦想和附近维度的力量并创造奇妙效果的人。他们甚至可以将一些梦想材料引入我们的世界，用它来建造其他东西。有时，他们会听到外界提供帮助和礼物的声音，只要有足够的力量，梦行者就可以将它们从远处拉出来。他们的力量随着他们的自然感知和智力而变化。

messages.msgid: These people are aware of this cross-dimensional contamination and while they can't pull anything over and make new things, they can eat anything they find in our world that doesn't belong and gain abilities and powers from that consumption.  They have larger than normal mana pools but regen that mana much slower as a result, they can cast a spell to convert dreamdross scraps directly into mana.  Their power scales with their natural strength and dexterity.
translations: 这些人意识到这种跨维度的污染，虽然他们不能把任何东西拉过来制造新事物，但他们可以吃掉他们在我们的世界中发现的任何不属于他们的东西，并从中获得能力和力量。 它们魔力总量更多，但魔力再生速度更慢。他们能施法将浮梦残渣直接转化为魔力值。 他们的能力与力量和敏捷值成比例。

messages.msgid: Dreamsmiths can forge dreamdross into a more durable form and create permanent items that can be repaired.
translations: 铸梦师可以将浮梦残渣锻造成可以存在更久的形态，并制造出可以修复的永久物品。

messages.msgid: The Mad Genius uses their connection to other dimensions in order to manipulate or even replace the physics of this realm with that of another.  They turn toys and nonsense inventions into machines of incredible sophistication and power, temporarily.
translations: 疯狂天才利用他们与其他维度的联系来操纵甚至用另一个维度的物理法则来取代这个维度中的法则。他们把玩具和无意义的发明变成了难以置信的复杂和强大的机器，但只是暂时的。

messages.msgid: The craft of the wise, provenance of cunning men, wise women, soothsayers, knowers, herb-witches, and curse-lifters throughout history.  With the proper components, and at the proper times and places, they can perform miracles.
translations: 属于智者的技艺，历史上那些狡猾的男人、智慧的女人、预言家、通晓者、草药女巫和解咒者皆源于此。只要有适当的材料，身处适当的时间和地点，他们就能展现奇迹。

messages.msgid: The compact bionic command and control interface interwoven with your nervous system had a previous life inside of a cybernetic tribesperson.  Best case scenario, none of them are on this Earth.
translations: 紧凑型生化插件的控制指令界面与你的神经系统交织在一起，曾经属于某个改造部落民体内。最好的情况，他们不在这个位面的地球上。

messages.msgid: You extend your arms and push the %s away from you!
translations: 你伸出双臂，将%s从你身边推开！

messages.msgid: You have ascended into your fae nature.
translations: 你已经觉醒到你的妖精本性。

messages.msgid: You live firmly in reality and never experience extremely vivid dreams about choices that have real world consequences.  ( You will be unable to gain Dream magicks from sleeping after strange events)
translations: 你安稳地生活在现实中，从未体验过在其中做出选择能影响现实的极其逼真的梦境。（你无法经历奇异事件从睡眠获得梦境魔法。）

messages.msgid: You feel like you've left behind your old life and form.
translations: 你感觉自己舍弃了自己的旧生命和旧形体。

messages.msgid: Who needs weapons?  You deal more melee damage while fighting barehanded and without gloves.  This damage improves as your unarmed skill increases.
translations: 谁说要用武器呢？你在赤手空拳不戴手套时能够造成更多的近战伤害。伤害随着你的徒手格斗技能等级提升而提升。

messages.msgid: You swallow the potion and feel younger already.  Though the taste lingers long past when you'd hope it would pass.
translations: 你吞下药水，感觉自己更年轻了。尽管当你希望它会过去时，味道却久久挥之不去。

messages.msgid:
You are a dhampir, the child of a vampire.  You have inherited a portion of their vampiric power, as well as the ability to drink blood.  Hopefully you can keep your urges under control.

As a dhampir, your blood naturally slowly fills with power over time, which you can use to fuel your abilities.
translations: 你是血裔，吸血鬼的子嗣。你继承了他们一部分的吸血鬼异能，以及汲饮血液的能力。希望你能克制住自己的欲望。身为血裔，你的血液会随着时间的推移而自然地、缓慢地充满力量，你可以用这份力量来驱动你的异能。

messages.msgid: You can use the connection of your heritage to sense nearby vampires and their minions.
translations: 你可以利用血脉的联系，感知到附近的吸血鬼和他们的爪牙。

messages.msgid: You sense one of the vampires' servants here.
translations: 你感知到此处有一名吸血鬼的仆从。
你感知到此处有一名吸血鬼。

messages.msgid: You have a set of small fangs, not as long as a true vampire's, but on the other hand, you can retract them to more easily conceal them.  Activate to extend your fangs.
translations: 你有一副小巧的獠牙，不及真吸血鬼那般长，但好在可以收回，便于隐藏。激活即可伸出獠牙。

messages.msgid: Your half-dead flesh is inured to winter's chill.  As long as you have empowered blood in your body, you suffer much less from colder temperatures.
translations: 你这半死的肉体已对冬日严寒习以为常。只要体内流淌着强化的血液，你在低温下所受的苦楚便会大大减轻。

messages.msgid: The deathly energies that course through your veins are inimical to mundane poisons and diseases.  As long as you have empowered blood in your body, you are more resistant to disease, poison, and infection.
translations: 在你脉管中奔流的死灵能量，乃是凡俗毒素与疾病的克星。只要体内流淌着强化的血液，你对疾病、毒素和感染的抵抗力就会更强。

messages.msgid: While unable to ignore gravity like a true vampire, it has less of a hold on you.  You can fall one story without ill effect and take greatly-reduced fall damage as long as you have empowered blood in your body.
translations: 你虽无法像真吸血鬼那般无视重力，但它对你的束缚已然减弱。只要体内流淌着强化的血液，你便能从一层楼高处坠落而安然无恙，受到的坠落伤害亦会大幅降低。

messages.msgid: Being born closer to death, you feel the sensations of the living less strongly.  You suffer much less pain from your injuries than a human would, and the pain affects your capabilities less.
translations: 你生来便更接近死亡，对生者的感觉已不那么强烈。你从伤痛中感受到的痛苦远少于凡人，且痛苦对你能力的影响也更小。

messages.msgid: You are only half-alive now, sustained as much by the energy in your blood as by biological processes.  You age far slower than a mortal, and when your limbs break, they heal more quickly in proportion to how much empowered blood you have.
translations: 你如今只有一半是活着的，维系你生命的，既有血液中的能量，也有生物的机能。你的衰老速度远慢于凡人，且当你的肢体断裂时，其愈合速度与你拥有的强化血液量成正比。

messages.msgid:
While you must normally eat, sleep, and drink as a mortal must, in times of need you can put that off.  Activate this trait to reduce your need for food, water, and sleep to zero.  While active, the Blood is the Life will continually expend the power in your blood, and when it wears off, you will become exhausted in proportion to how long the trait was active.  You spend <color_yellow>much more blood</color> if outdoors in the sunlight.

<color_light_red>Initial Blood Cost:</color> 1 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current)
<color_light_red>Periodic Blood Cost:</color> 1 ml per minute
translations:
你虽如凡人一般需要吃喝与睡眠，但在危急之时，你可将这些需求暂且搁置。激活此特性可将你对食物、水和睡眠的需求降至为零。激活期间，此能力会持续消耗你血液中的力量，而当效果消退后，你会陷入疲惫，其程度与特性激活的时长成正比。若在日光下的户外，你<color_yellow>消耗的血液会多得多</color>。

<color_light_red>初始血液消耗：</color>1毫升（当前<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph>毫升）
<color_light_red>持续血液消耗：</color>每分钟1毫升

messages.msgid: While you won't burn in the sunlight like a true vampire, it's not comfortable.  You suffer a -1 penalty to all stats when outdoors during the daytime, and an additional -2 if it's sunny or clear.
translations: 虽然你不会在日光下像真正的吸血鬼一样燃烧，但也会很难受。当白天在室外时，你的所有属性-1，阳光明媚或天气晴朗时，会额外-2。

messages.msgid: You aren't forced to slumber the day away, but you sure want to.  Your sleepiness accumulates much faster while the sun is in the sky, but you have an easier time sleeping during the day.
translations: 你并没有被迫睡上一整天，但你肯定想这样。在白天时你的困意加剧得更快，但同时你也更容易入睡。

messages.msgid: Being so close to death has slowed down the processes of your living cells considerably.  You heal at 50% of the normal rate.
translations: 过于接近死亡的肉体大幅减缓了你的细胞生命活动。你的愈合速度只有原来的50%。

messages.msgid: Animals can sense your dead blood and they hate it.  They may run or be aggressive to you.
translations: 动物能感知到你体内毫无生气的血液，并对其感到厌恶。它们可能会逃跑，或对你展现攻击性。

messages.msgid: While running water is not deadly to you, it is uncomfortable.  Moving through running water without a boat will cause pain.
translations: 流水虽不足以致命，却令你感到不适。在没有船只的情况下趟过流水会让你感到痛苦。

messages.msgid: Your skin has the obviously-unnatural grayish-white tinge of a corpse, and mortals will react appropriately to seeing it.
translations: 你的皮肤带着尸体般显而易见的、不自然的灰白色调，凡人见到后自会作出相应的反应。

messages.msgid: The vampires are right about one thing; they are better than humans, and your vampire blood makes you better as well.
translations: 有一件事吸血鬼们说对了：他们确实优于人类，而你的吸血鬼之血也让你变得同样优越。

messages.msgid: You have tasted blood and that taste forever lingers in the back of your mind.  You will get cravings for blood that only time or drinking more blood can sate.
translations: 你已品尝过鲜血的滋味，那味道永远在你脑海深处萦绕。你将对血液产生渴求，唯有时间流逝或再次饮血方能满足。

messages.msgid: Fresh blood has an energy that mortal food simply cannot compare to.  You gain 33% reduced kcal from the food you eat, but additional calories from drinking blood.
translations: 新鲜的血液有着一种普通食物无法比拟的能量。你从食物中获得的卡路里减少33%，但可以在饮用血液时获得额外的能量。

messages.msgid: The power of fresh stolen blood lingers in your veins.  The natural rate that your blood empowers itself is cut in half.
translations: 新窃之血的力量在你脉管中流连。你血液自我强化的自然速率减半。

messages.msgid: You have developed a thirst for the blood of your fellow humans.
translations: 你对你人类同伴的鲜血产生了渴求。

messages.msgid: This provides the school trait for vampire blood powers.  It should not be visible.
translations: 此为吸血鬼血能力提供学派特性，不应对外可见。

messages.msgid:
Your eyes gleam lightly red as the light catches in them and with a few drops of the stolen blood in your veins you are able to see in the dark.

<color_light_red>Initial Blood Cost:</color> 100 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current)
<color_light_red>Periodic Blood Cost:</color> 50 ml
translations:
当光线映入你眼中，你的双眸便会泛起淡淡红光，仅需脉管中几滴窃来之血，你便能在黑暗中视物。

<color_light_red>初始血液消耗：</color>100毫升（当前<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph>毫升）
<color_light_red>持续血液消耗：</color>50毫升

messages.msgid: Your palate adapted to your new condition.  Drinking human blood will make you feel great.
translations: 你的味觉已经适应了新的体质。饮用人血会让你感到由衷愉悦。

messages.msgid:
Your stolen blood reinforces your muscles, making your grip crack bone and your punches dent steel.

<color_light_red>Initial Blood Cost:</color> 150 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current)
<color_light_red>Periodic Blood Cost:</color> 75 ml
translations:
你窃来的血液强化了你的肌肉，使你的抓握能捏碎骨骼，拳击能砸凹钢铁。

<color_light_red>初始血液消耗：</color>150毫升（当前<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph>毫升）
<color_light_red>持续血液消耗：</color>75毫升

messages.msgid:
Your cold flesh is not as vulnerable as it once was.  Activate to render it even more resistant to physical damage.

<color_light_red>Initial Blood Cost:</color> 150 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current)
<color_light_red>Periodic Blood Cost:</color> 75 ml
translations:
你冰冷的肉体已不复往昔那般脆弱。激活此能力，可使其对物理伤害的抵抗力更上一层楼。

<color_light_red>初始血液消耗：</color>150毫升（当前<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph>毫升）
<color_light_red>持续血液消耗：</color>75毫升

messages.msgid: Your senses are heightened, allowing you to see more clearly, hear even tiny sounds, and smell nearby fresh human blood.
translations: 你的感官得到了强化，让你能看得更清晰，听见最微小的声响，并嗅到附近新鲜的人类血液。

messages.msgid: The power of stolen blood keeps you feel amazing.  As long as you are not suffering from the Withering, you gain a bonus to your health.
translations: 窃来之血的力量让你感觉好极了。只要你没有遭受“凋零”之苦，你的健康值就会获得加成。

messages.msgid: Your movements don't make nearby as much noise as they used to.
translations: 你行动时发出的声响远不及以往那么大了。

messages.msgid: Your fingers have developed bloodsucking properties, you can now suck up blood through them.  You're not sure where the blood goes but with a thought you can use these deposits.
translations: 你的手指获得了吸血能力，现在你可以通过手指吸血。你不确定这些血流到了哪里，但只要一个念头，你就能将这些存货投入使用。

messages.msgid: Your exhaust some of the blood in your veins to boost and recover some of your spent stamina.
translations: 你消耗血管中的一些血液，以增强和恢复一些消耗掉的体力。

messages.msgid: Learn from the Children of the Night
You call out to the creatures that inhabit the night.  Wolves, bats, rats and more.  They tell you about what terrain surrounds you.
translations: 你呼唤夜行生物。狼、蝙蝠、老鼠等等。它们会告诉你你周围的地形。

messages.msgid: Sense the Children of the Night
You can sense the presence of nearby predatory night creatures.
translations: 你能感知到附近掠食性夜行生物的存在。

messages.msgid: You sense one of the creatures of the night.
translations: 你感知到了一个黑夜中的生物。

messages.msgid: Walking the shadowed path of blood
You have new fangs to go along with your thirst for blood.
translations: 你有了新的尖牙和对鲜血的渴望。

messages.msgid:
Your body prepares to prevent the loss of any blood to combat damage.

<color_light_red>Initial Blood Cost:</color> 500 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current)
<color_light_red>Periodic Blood Cost:</color> 250 ml
translations:
你的身体正准备着，以防止在战斗中损失任何血液。

<color_light_red>初始血液消耗：</color>500毫升（当前<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph>毫升）
<color_light_red>持续血液消耗：</color>250毫升

messages.msgid: Your flesh heals visibly while blood disintegrates hidden inside your veins.
translations: 你的皮肉显著愈合，而隐藏在血管中的血液则会分解。

messages.msgid:
You can move faster than the eye can see, avoiding the claws and teeth and weapons of your enemies.

<color_light_red>Initial Blood Cost:</color> 250 (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current)
<color_light_red>Periodic Blood Cost:</color> 125 ml
translations:
你的移动快逾目力所及，能让你避开敌人的爪牙与武器。

<color_light_red>初始血液消耗：</color>250毫升（当前<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph>毫升）
<color_light_red>持续血液消耗：</color>125毫升

messages.msgid:
When indoors or at night, you can cloud the minds of nearby enemies, making it harder for them to spot you.  This does not make you invisible.

<color_light_red>Initial Blood Cost:</color> 100 (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current)
<color_light_red>Periodic Blood Cost:</color> 50 ml
translations:
在室内或夜晚，你可以蒙蔽附近敌人的心智，让他们更难发现你。这并不会让你隐形。

<color_light_red>初始血液消耗：</color>100毫升（当前<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph>毫升）
<color_light_red>持续血液消耗：</color>50毫升

messages.msgid: With a bit of stolen blood and a savage expression, you can send your enemies fleeing.
translations: 仅凭些许窃来的血液与一抹狰狞之色，你便能令敌寇望风而逃。

messages.msgid: You are close enough to death now that you can easily imitate it; your heartbeat slows to a near-stop, your breathing ceases, your flesh grows pale, and you show no signs of life.  You will be unable to move or act while feigning death, but enemies will generally ignore you.  You will be unable to feign death twice in a short time if you are seen ending your masquerade.
translations: 你如今已与死亡咫尺之遥，故能轻易模仿其态；你的心跳减缓至近乎停滞，呼吸随之断绝，肌肤变得惨白，不露丝毫生命迹象。诈死之时，你将无法移动或行动，但敌人通常会无视你。若你的伪装被人识破，短时间内你将无法再次诈死。

messages.msgid: Gravity seems to have less of an effect than it used it.  With barely an effort you can ascend or descend even sheer walls, and you can fall any distance and land on your feet uninjured.
translations: 重力对你的影响似乎远不及往昔。你几乎不费吹灰之力便能攀上或降下万仞绝壁，更能从任何高度坠落而安然落地，毫发无伤。

messages.msgid:
You can twist your fingernails into sharp claws, allowing you to inflict extra damage in unarmed combat.

<color_light_red>Initial Blood Cost:</color> 125 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current)
<color_light_red>Periodic Blood Cost:</color> 62 ml
translations:
你可以将指甲扭曲为锋利之爪，让你在徒手格斗中造成额外伤害。

<color_light_red>初始血液消耗：</color>125毫升（当前<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph>毫升）
<color_light_red>持续血液消耗：</color>62毫升

messages.msgid: Your vision has improved and now you can see flowing blood in the vein, like bright trails in the dark.
translations: 你的视力已然精进，如今能看见脉管中流淌的血液，宛如黑暗中明亮的轨迹。

messages.msgid: Blood fills you with a surge of power.  You gain a bonus to your strength and dexterity for one hour after drinking blood.
translations: 血液让你充满了力量的洪流。饮血后一小时内，你的力量与敏捷都将获得加成。

messages.msgid: Mortal hungers are replaced with immortal hungers
translations: 凡俗之饥渴，已为不朽之欲念所替代。

messages.msgid: You replace some of your regular caloric intake with blood and begin to see some of the more esoteric abilities inherent to vampirism.
translations: 你用血液代替了一些常规的热量摄入，并开始获知吸血鬼固有的一些更深奥的能力。

messages.msgid: You can mesmerize your prey, gazing into their eyes and freezing them in their tracks.
translations: 你可以迷惑你的猎物，凝视其双眼，令其动弹不得。

messages.msgid:
Your body exceeds normal human reaction limits as blood turns to ash in your veins.

<color_light_red>Initial Blood Cost:</color> 750 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current)
<color_light_red>Periodic Blood Cost:</color> 375 ml
translations:
当血液在你的脉管中燃尽成灰，你的身体便会超越凡人反应的极限。

<color_light_red>初始血液消耗：</color>750毫升（当前<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph>毫升）
<color_light_red>持续血液消耗：</color>375毫升

messages.msgid: Your exhaust some of the blood in your veins to recover some of your spent mana.
translations: 你消耗血管中的一些血液，以恢复一些消耗掉的魔力。

messages.msgid: You are a supreme predator, and other predators bow at your feet.
translations: 你是超凡的捕猎者，而其他捕猎者对你鞠躬屈膝。

messages.msgid: You can sleep within the earth itself, avoiding the hateful light of the sun.
translations: 你可以睡在大地之中，避免惹人生厌的阳光。

messages.msgid: The stolen blood within your body provides you with a fountain of energy.  You gain a bonus to your Cardio rating.
translations: 你体内窃来的血液为你提供了源源不绝的能量。你的心肺能力获得加成。

messages.msgid: Your senses are so fine they can alert you to danger even while you slumber.  Activate to cause yourself to wake up if danger approaches while you sleep.
translations: 你的感官如此敏锐，即使在你沉睡时也能对危险发出警示。激活此能力，若你在睡眠时有危险靠近，便会即刻惊醒。

messages.msgid: Your flesh is more resilient and you can suffer much more damage than a mortal before expiring.  Your hit points are increased.
translations: 你的肉体更具韧性，在殒命之前，你能比凡人承受多得多的伤害。你的生命值已获提升。

messages.msgid: You have become a true vampire and are beginning to see some of the most potent abilities vampirism has to offer.
Your new status as a true vampire has empowered your other abilities.
translations: 你身为真吸血鬼的新身份，已让你其他的异能愈发强大。

messages.msgid: You can enter a deathlike stake known as torpor, in which your wounds will close faster, your fatigue will fully recover and your blood thirst will be less intense.  Be careful, though, as nothing will be able to wake you up until eight hours have passed.
translations: 你可以进入蛰眠一样的假死状态，此时伤口加速愈合、疲劳完全恢复、嗜血渴望大幅减轻。但请注意，在八个小时内没有东西能把你唤醒。

messages.msgid: You can focus your gaze and take control of your target.  Only works against targets that have a mind.
translations: 你可以集中你的目光，取得对目标的控制。只对有意识的目标生效。

messages.msgid: You do not need to breathe air to live anymore.  It prevents you from being drowned or suffocated and allows you to ignore inhaled gases.
translations: 你不必再呼吸空气以维持生命了。你不会溺水和窒息，同时可以无视吸入的毒气。

messages.msgid: Your undead body is now much more dead than alive.  It prevents mundane illnesses and parasites from affecting you, while granting you a total immunity against radiation.  In addition, your scent is now something most mundane creatures cannot understand.
translations: 你这不死的身体如今愈发趋近于死物，而非生灵。它能阻止凡俗的疾病与寄生虫侵袭你，同时让你完全免疫辐射。此外，你的气味也变得令绝大多数凡俗生物所无法理解。

messages.msgid: You can transform yourself into a bat and take wing on the night air.
translations: 你可以化为蝙蝠来飞行，在深夜的高空中张开你的双翼。

messages.msgid: You can transform yourself into a wolf and stalk your enemies.
translations: 你可以将自己变为一头恶狼，潜行追踪你的敌人。

messages.msgid: You can transform yourself into a cloud of mist and flee any dangers.
translations: 你可以将自己化为一团浓雾，逃离任何险境。

messages.msgid: By reaching the final stage of vampirism, you have freed yourself from your mundane needs.  The only sustenance you need now is blood.

Your ability to influence others has amplified.  You can now spend blood while talking with someone else to make them like you more, with the costliest application of this power being able to turn them into your obsessed servants.  Not all can be influenced by this power, for anger, panic and strong ties to a group that isn't yours will disrupt the process.  Other vampires and the rare saint-blooded are also immune to it.
translations: 你影响他人的能力已然大增。如今，你可在与人交谈时消耗血液，以博取对方的好感，而此能力最极致的运用，便是能将他们变成对你痴迷不已的仆从。并非所有人都会受此能力影响，因为愤怒、恐慌以及与非你所属团体的紧密联系都会干扰此过程。其他吸血鬼和罕有的圣血后裔也对此免疫。

messages.msgid: Unlike lesser vampires who bloat as they gorge on blood, you concentrate the blood you consume, making it fit nicely in your veins.  This removes the penalties for containing too much blood, but doesn't expand your maximal capacity.
translations: 不同于那些因暴饮鲜血而臃肿不堪的低等吸血鬼，你能够精粹你所汲取的血液，使其完美地容纳于你的脉管之内。这消除了容纳过多血液的惩罚，但并不会扩大你的最大容量。

messages.msgid: You can shroud your body and what you are carrying with shadows, amplifying your combat ability but preventing communication and using other powers until you return to your normal form.  It also costs blood for every second you spend in that state.
translations: 你可以用阴影笼罩你的躯体与随身之物，以此来增强你的战斗能力，但在恢复原形之前，你将无法与人交流或使用其他能力。在你维持此状态的每一秒，它都会消耗血液。

messages.msgid: Your mastery over your mist form has increased to the point that you can now instinctively activate it should you be about to die.  It requires you to have a lot of stolen blood in your body and can't trigger more than once a week but might save your life.
translations: 你对雾之形态的掌握已精进如斯：如今，你可在濒死之际本能地激活它。这需要你的体内储有大量窃来的血液，且每周仅能触发一次，但或可救你一命。

messages.msgid: Your vampiric potency has reinforced your mind beyond anything a mortal could ever hope.  You are immune to anything that could negatively impact your mind.
translations: 你的血族之力已经将你的意志强化到了凡人所不能及的境界。你对任何能对你的意志造成负面影响的事物免疫。

messages.msgid:
You mastery over the shadowed path of blood has become much more potent, allowing you to use your vampiric powers and a massive expense of blood to blot out the sun for a few dozen minutes.

<color_light_red>Initial Blood Cost:</color> 3000 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current)
This person is now a renfield, a human obsessed with serving their vampire masters.  This obsession impedes their cognition as they struggle to think about anything but serving said vampire masters.
translations: 此人现在是一位血仆，一个痴迷于服侍吸血鬼主人的人类。因为只知伺服所谓的吸血鬼主人，心中空无一物，所以这种痴迷妨碍了他们的认知。

messages.msgid: You're not supposed to see this.  Open a bug report on Github about having the Mentor's Peace trait.
You thirst for blood is more intense than usual.  You now need much more blood to prevent blood starvation.
translations: 你对血液的渴求比平常更加强烈。你需要更多的血液才能遏制血渴。

messages.msgid: Your body brings to mind a rotting corpse.  Social interactions will be much harder for you.
translations: 你的身体让人想到腐烂的尸体。对于你而言社交会更加困难。

messages.msgid: You now depend on the proximity to the earth to sleep well.  Should you sleep or torpor aboveground or not surrounded by earth, you will suffer penalties for the next day.
translations: 你现在需要依靠大地才能睡得安稳。如果你睡眠或者死眠时在地上或者没有被大地环绕，你第二天会受到惩罚。

messages.msgid: Vampiric weakness: rebuked by holy ground
Your flesh will burn should you ever enter a sanctified area.  Only places that are holy will burn you, so holy places filled with vampires or unholy humans are safe for you to enter.
translations: 当你进入一个圣洁的地方时，你的血肉会燃烧。只有神圣的地方会灼烧你，所以充满了吸血鬼和不洁人类的神圣之地对你而言是安全的。

messages.msgid: Vampiric weakness: melted by vast water

Your flesh will melt should you ever try to cross a large body of water or get too close to them.  Only rivers, lakes and oceans have enough water to trigger this weakness, but it will take effect even if floating or water-walking.
translations: 一旦你试图穿越大片水域或离其太近，你的血肉便会消融。只有江河、湖泊与海洋才拥有足以触发此弱点的水量。即便处于漂浮或凌波而行的状态，也无法幸免。

messages.msgid: Animals cannot tolerate your wicked presence.  Expect any animal you encounter to either flee or attack you on sight.
translations: 动物无法容忍你的邪恶存在。你视野里的所有动物都会逃离你或攻击你。

messages.msgid: Fire damages you far more than it should.  You take massive damage from fire and flames, mundane and magical.
translations: 火焰对你造成的伤害远比它本应该的要大。你受到巨大的伤害，无论来自火苗还是烈焰，普通的还是魔法的。

messages.msgid: Vampiric weakness: cold as a corpse
You now lack amy body heat.  You feel colder at all times, and being cold will slow you down.

You now need to drink some fresh, warm blood from a living being once in a while or suffer growing penalties.  You better find someone willing to share their blood, as blood from fresh corpses won't satisfy this need.
translations: 你现在需要饮用来自不时复活或正遭受活罪者的新鲜、温暖的血液。因为来自新鲜尸体的血液无法满足欲望，你最好找到愿意分享血液的人。

messages.msgid: Your ability to process varied types of blood is now hampered.  Blood that isn't regular human blood will only sate your thirst half as much.
translations: 你消化血液的能力受到了阻碍。非普通人类的血液只会满足你一半的饥渴。
