messages.msgid: Your thirst for blood will occasionally magnify, causing painful cravings.  You can calm these cravings as or before they happen by consuming blood.
translations: 你对血液的饥渴偶尔会扩大，导致痛苦的成瘾症状。你可以通过在症状发作或更早时饮用鲜血以安抚这种欲望。

messages.msgid: Vampiric weakness: barred from mortal joys
Blood is the only thing that can bring a smile to your lips.  Nothing else gives you any lasting joy or pleasure.  It is impossible for you to be truly happy unless you recently consumed blood.
translations: 鲜血是唯一能让你嘴角上扬的东西了。别的东西再也给不了你快乐和喜悦。除非你最近饮用鲜血了，否则你不可能感受到真正的快乐。

messages.msgid: Through the consumption of self-cannibalizing vampire blood, you gained the ability to consume vampire blood to gain vampiric abilities undreamt of by other vampires.
translations: 通过吞食自噬性的吸血鬼之血，你已能通过汲饮同类之血，来获得其他吸血鬼梦寐以求的异能。

messages.msgid: Your vestigial circulatory system is now better at holding stolen blood.  You can hold five more liters inside you.
Your ability to see in the dark has expanded.  You no longer need to spend blood to maintain your gleaming eyes.
translations: 你的夜视能力已然扩展，不再需要消耗血液来维持那双闪耀的眼眸。

messages.msgid: You can now attract the blood within a corpse's veins, extracting it all in a second through a small cut.  In addition, you can create temporary blood containers by spending mana.
In comparison to you, regular vampires are the same as mortals.  You can now detect nearby vampires, your new prey, even through walls.
translations: 在你面前，一般的吸血鬼都相形见绌，仿似凡人。即使隔着墙壁，你现在也可以探测附近的吸血鬼，你的新猎物。

messages.msgid: Your digestive system has warped to repurpose some vestigial parts, making you much better at drinking blood.  Drinking reasonable amounts of blood won't ever stretch your stomach, and you drink blood much faster now.
translations: 你的消化系统发生了变形，以再利用那些残余部位，旨在让你更好地饮血。饮用适量的血液不再会占用你的胃，同时你饮用血液的速度更快了。

messages.msgid: Your supernatural senses have expanded.  You can now see anything close to some nocturnal creatures, even if they lack sight.
translations: 你的超凡感官已然扩展。现在，即便某些夜行生物自身并无视觉，你也能洞悉其周遭的一切。

messages.msgid: Becoming more vampire than vampires are has affected your new palate, making the consumption of blood feel even better than before.  You now enjoy drinking blood so much that enough of it will bolster your resolve for a while.
translations: 超越吸血鬼使得你的品味也发生了改变，吸血变得比以往更令人愉悦。现在你非常享受饮血，以至于足量的血液会在一段时间内坚定你的决心。

messages.msgid: Your lack of movement noise is now encompassing any noise you could do in combat.  All such noises you would've made by attacking in melee are nullified.
translations: 你行动上的无声现在囊括了你在战斗中发出的所有噪音。你在近战中发出的这些噪音都会被消除。

messages.msgid: You drank enough vampire blood to gain access to power the mentors never thought possible.  There is no more limit to how powerful of a vampire you can be.
translations: 你饮下了足量的吸血鬼之血，从而获得了导师们未曾设想过的力量。身为吸血鬼的你，其潜能的成长已再无止境。

messages.msgid: Your new power allows you to store even more stolen blood inside your body.  You can hold another ten liters inside you.
translations: 你的新能力允许你在体内储存更多窃取的血液。你可以在体内储存额外的十升血液。

messages.msgid: Darkness is your home, and you can call it to shroud you from others.  When away from the sun, you can become invisible with a constant expense of blood.
translations: 黑暗是你的归宿，你可以呼唤它将你笼罩，与外界隔绝。只要不为日光所照，你便能持续消耗血液以维持隐形。

messages.msgid: Darkness is your new friend, and like a good friend it helps you through hard times.  Passively heal your wounds and reduce your pain while away from the sun.
translations: 黑暗是你的新朋，一如挚友，它会助你渡过难关。只要不为日光所照，你的伤口就会自行愈合，痛苦也会随之减轻。

messages.msgid: The powers of vampires come through their sustenance of blood, and you now know how to use this at your advantage.  You can increase your need for blood to boost your vampiric potency until you decide to stop the effect.  If you do not have enough blood, it will have no effect until you drink more blood.
translations: 吸血鬼的力量源于其对血液的汲取，而你现在已深谙此道，并知如何善加利用。你可以主动增加血液需求来大幅提升吸血鬼潜能，直到你决定中止此效果。若血液不足，此效果便会失效，直到你饮下更多血液为止。

messages.msgid: Increases blood potency and drain while the player-visible version is active and has enough blood.  You should never see this.

Being protected against mundane afflictions only is something your flesh has stopped tolerating.  Your condition now protects you from any illness, parasite and poison, no matter how dangerous they are.
translations: 你的肉体已无法再容忍仅仅抵御凡俗病痛。你如今的体质能让你免受任何疾病、寄生虫和毒素的侵害，无论其有多么凶险。

messages.msgid: You are much more attuned to your other forms, and they are now easier to activate than ever.  The cost to activate them is halved.
translations: 你对其它形态的协调性已远胜以往，现在激活它们变得前所未有的容易。激活消耗减半。

messages.msgid: Your instinctive mastery of your mist form has expanded.  You now recover from triggering Last Breath's Mist twice as quickly.
translations: 你对雾形态的本能掌控力已然扩展。现在，你从“终息之雾”中恢复的速度快了一倍。

messages.msgid: Vampires, mortals, they are all the same for you now.  Drinking vampire blood now gives all the benefits of drinking regular blood, in addition to growing your power.
translations: 吸血鬼，凡人，于你而言，如今已别无二致。饮用吸血鬼之血，除了能增长你的力量外，还能带来饮用凡人血液的全部增益。

messages.msgid: Your own blood now reveals its secrets to you.  Every week, you will gain a new gift of the blood.  It will only give you what researching your blood gifts could give you.
translations: 你自身的血液现已向你揭示其奥秘。每周，你都将获得一份新的血之恩赐。它只会给予你通过研究血之恩赐所能获得的东西。

messages.msgid: Maximal Mastery of the Mortal Mind
Your mind-control abilities are much simpler to use now, halving their cost.
translations: 你的心灵控制能力如今运用起来更为简便，其消耗减半。

messages.msgid: Anathema's Weakness: Slain by the Sun
Vampires burn under the sun, and becoming more of a vampire made you burn far more than any other vampire would.  While under the sun, you will take constant damage no matter how covered you are.

Your constant consumption of vampire blood has permanently destabilized your mind, and it will only grow worse with each new vampire drained.  Each time you drink vampire blood, you have a growing chance to gain a new mental affliction.
translations: 你对吸血鬼之血的无尽索求已永久地动摇了你的心智，且每吸干一名新的吸血鬼，情况便会愈发恶化。每当你饮用吸血鬼之血，你都有不断增长的几率染上一种新的精神顽疾。

messages.msgid: Drinking all this vampire blood has left your body yearning for more.  Going too long without drinking vampire blood will progressively increase your thirst for blood with each passing day until you starve or drink vampire blood.
translations: 痛饮了如此之多的吸血鬼之血，你的身体已然渴望更多。若长时间不饮用吸血鬼之血，你对血液的渴求便会与日俱增，直至你饿死或再次饮血为止。

messages.msgid: Through a complicated ritual utilizing a saint's relic, you have transubstantiated your own blood with the holy blood of the saints.  It'll prevent you from becoming infected with vampirism while you live, effects postmortem unknown.
translations: 通过使用圣人遗物的复杂仪式，你已经用圣人的圣血转化了你自己的血液。它会防止你在活着的时候感染吸血鬼，死后效果未知。

messages.msgid: You are no longer limited to the five senses common to most humans in your hunt for the unnatural.
translations: 在追捕非自然生物的过程中，你不再局限于大多数人类常见的五种感官。

messages.msgid: Boann bestowed upon you the right to summon a few daffodil warriors once a day.
translations: 博安女神赐予你权力，让你能每日一次召唤数名水仙花战士。

messages.msgid: The Fair Folk can sense the stolen power within you and their vengeance will be terrible.
translations: 仙灵们能够察觉到你体内窃取而来的魔力，他们的报复将超乎想象的恐怖。

messages.msgid: The arvore can sense the stolen power within you and they will not react well to it.
translations: 木灵能感知到你体内那份窃来的力量，它们对此的反应可不会友善。

messages.msgid: The homullus can sense the stolen power within you and they will not react well to it.
translations: 仿灵人能感知到你体内那份窃来的力量，它们对此的反应可不会友善。

messages.msgid: The salamanders can sense the stolen power within you and they will not react well to it.
translations: 火妖精能感知到你体内那份窃来的力量，它们对此的反应可不会友善。

messages.msgid: You have awakened your long-slumbering heritage as one of the nobility of the Fair Folk.
translations: 你已唤醒了沉眠已久的血脉传承，正式成为仙灵贵族的一员。

messages.msgid: This tracks your heritage, used to pick a subcategory.  You shouldn't see it.

You are a member of the Summer Court, sometimes called the Seelie Court, the faeries recognized as benevolent by mortals.  Or, at least, the faeries who are slightly less likely to levy a generational curses on those who wrong them.
translations: 你是夏日庭的一员——也被凡人称为"希利庭"，即那些被人类视为仁慈的精灵。至少不是那些因受冒犯就降下世代诅咒的精灵。

messages.msgid: You are a member of the Winter Court, sometimes called the Unseelie Court, the faeries most feared by mortals.  Too bad there's so few of them around nowadays.
translations: 你是冬之庭的一员——凡人称之为"安希利庭"，正是人类最畏惧的那类精灵。可惜如今你们这样的存在已所剩无几。

messages.msgid: This provides the school trait for Changeling magic.  It should not be visible.
This provides the school trait for Spring seasonal magic.  It should not be visible.
This provides the school trait for Summer seasonal magic.  It should not be visible.
This provides the school trait for Autumn seasonal magic.  It should not be visible.
This provides the school trait for Winter seasonal magic.  It should not be visible.

You grew up thinking you were human, just another person among billions, but you were born Under the Hill and swapped for a human baby shortly after birth.  While you find it uncomfortable ever since your heritage asserted itself, your time in the mortal realm has inured you to the presence of iron.  However, it has not done so enough to allow you to install any CBMs.
translations: 你自小以为自己是人类，是亿万凡人中的一员，殊不知你实则诞生于山丘之下，并在出生后不久便与一个人类婴孩做了交换。尽管自你的血脉觉醒以来，此事一直让你颇感不适，但你在凡间的岁月已让你对铁的存在习以为常。然而，这种习惯尚不足以让你安装任何CBM。

messages.msgid: You have awakened your long-slumbering heritage as a brownie, hard-working and mostly unseen.
translations: 你唤醒了沉睡已久的棕仙血脉，继承了他们勤劳且行踪隐秘的特质。

messages.msgid: You have awakened your long-slumbering heritage as a pooka, a shapeshifter close to nature.
translations: 你已唤醒了沉眠已久的血脉传承，成为一名普卡精——一种亲近自然的变形者。

messages.msgid: You have awakened your long-slumbering heritage as a selkie, with one foot on the land and one in the sea.
translations: 你唤醒了沉睡已久的海豹精血脉，从此一足立于大地，一足踏入海洋。

messages.msgid: You have awakened your long-slumbering heritage as a trow, strong and enduring as the mountains.
translations: 你已唤醒了沉眠已久的血脉传承，成为一名石窟妖——如山峦般强壮而坚韧。

messages.msgid: The end of winter brings hope for the coming of spring, and in the light of the candles lit at Imbolc the dust and gloom of the long nights end.
translations: 冬日的终结带来了春天的希望，在为迎接圣烛节而燃起的烛光之中，漫漫长夜的阴霾与尘埃也随之烟消云散。

messages.msgid: The bonfires of Bealtaine drive away evil and purify both man and beast.
translations: 圣炎祭火，焚尽邪祟，泽被万物。

messages.msgid: Lughnasadh is a time for bringing in the harvest and for contests of skill and stamina.
translations: 丰收节是庆贺丰收的时节，亦是考验技艺与耐力的赛会。

messages.msgid: As the year dies and winter's winds begin to blow, the dead return for a short time to visit the living.
translations: 当一年将尽，冬风渐起，逝者便会短暂归返，探望生者。

messages.msgid: The Fair Folk have dealt with many mortal civilizations over the aeons, and have come to mutually beneficial arrangements with some of them.  Activate this trait to make your fae nature obvious, invoking those ancient agreements.  This <color_yellow>may anger</color> some who have especially bad relationships with the fae.
translations: 在万古岁月中，仙灵与诸多凡人文明皆有往来，并与其中一些缔结了互惠互利的协定。激活此特性可彰显你的妖精天性，以援引那些古老协定。此举或会<color_yellow>激怒</color>一些与妖精宿怨已久的家伙。

messages.msgid: You are strong enough to defend a crossroads at twilight against all comers.  +3 Strength.
translations: 你强大到足以在暮色中独守十字路口，击退一切来犯之敌。力量+3

messages.msgid: You are graceful enough to dance the night away beneath a crystal dome on a floor of mirror-bright silver.  +3 Dexterity.
translations: 你的身姿优雅至极，能在水晶穹顶下的镜银地板上彻夜起舞。敏捷+3

messages.msgid: Your reactions are inhumanly quick.  +15 Speed.
translations: 你的反应速度非比寻常。+15速度。

messages.msgid: Like the legendary salmon who ate the nine acorns, you have gained a plethora of wisdom.  +3 Intelligence.
translations: 你如同传说中吞食九颗橡子的鲑鱼，已获浩瀚智慧。智力+3

messages.msgid: You senses are far more attuned to your surroundings than previously.  +3 Perception.
translations: 你的感官对周遭环境的洞察力远胜以往。+3感知。

messages.msgid: From the dreams of mortals, you can spin remnants of fantasy into material substance.  When you sleep near mortals, you have a chance to awaken with some dreamdross nearby.
translations: 你可以从凡人的梦境中，将虚无缥缈的幻想纺织成实体。当你在凡人附近安眠时，醒来后便有几率在身旁发现一些浮梦残渣。

messages.msgid: Invoke your rights as one of noble birth and exert your authority over the commoner fae, forcing them to obey your commands.  The glamour will only last a short time, and the target is under no obligation to look on your favorably afterwards.
translations: 援引你与生俱来的贵族权利，向平民妖精施展你的权柄，迫使他们听命于你。此幻惑仅能持续片刻，且事后，目标并无义务对你青眼有加。

messages.msgid: Glamour a human into defending you for a short period of time.  When the glamour ends, all effects end and the human will not be well-disposed toward you afterwards.
translations: 对一名人类施以幻惑，令其在短时间内护你周全。幻惑终止后，所有效果亦会消失，且该人类将不再对你抱有好感。

messages.msgid: Empty Your Heart of its Mortal Dream
Your mindset is shifting to the alien morality of those from Under the Hill.  You can control this to some extent, though it may also overtake you in times of pain or stress.
translations: 你的思维模式正在向山丘之下来客（妖精）那异样的道德观靠拢。你尚能对此加以控制，但在痛苦或重压之下，它也可能将你彻底吞噬。

messages.msgid: The brownies are the unassuming crafters of the Fair Folk, and it's easy for you to build and repair things, as long as no one is nearby to watch you do it.
translations: 棕仙是妖精一族中朴实无华的工匠。只要无人旁观，你建造和修理东西就会变得轻而易举。

messages.msgid: The brownies are the unassuming crafters of the Fair Folk, and it's very easy for you to build and repair things, as long as no one is nearby to watch you do it.
translations: 棕仙是妖精一族中朴实无华的工匠。只要无人旁观，你建造和修理东西便可信手拈来。

messages.msgid: The brownies are the unassuming crafters of the Fair Folk, and it's almost effortless for you to build and repair things, as long as no one is nearby to watch you do it.
translations: 棕仙是妖精一族中朴实无华的工匠。只要无人旁观，你建造和修理东西便几乎不费吹灰之力。

messages.msgid: Your appearance hasn't changed, but people don't seem to notice you as much as they used to.  As long as you don't engage in combat, you're easy to overlook.
translations: 你的外表并未改变，但人们似乎真的不像以前那般注意你了。只要你不参与战斗，你就极易被人忽略。

messages.msgid: Your appearance hasn't changed, but people really don't seem to notice you as much as they used to.  As long as you don't engage in combat, you're very easy to overlook.
translations: 你的外表并未改变，但人们似乎真的不像以前那般注意你了。只要你不参与战斗，你就极易被人忽略。

messages.msgid: The cold doesn't seem to bother you quite as much anymore.
translations: 寒冷似乎不再像以前那般困扰你了。

messages.msgid: Even on a winter day, you need only a light jacket now.
translations: 即使在冬天，你也可以只穿着一件轻薄的夹克。

messages.msgid: Legends say that brownies went about naked clad only in their almost-furry coat, and while you wouldn't go that far, you could wear a swimsuit in a blizzard without much trouble.
translations: 传说棕仙赤身裸体，仅以一身绒毛蔽体。虽然你不至于如此，但也足以让你在暴风雪中身着泳衣而安然无恙。

messages.msgid: Churning As Quick as a Wink
Brownies are famous for their ability to do household chores, and you now have an instinctive understanding of making milk and cheese.
translations: 棕仙以擅长操持家务而闻名，如今，你对牛奶和奶酪的制作也有了本能般的领悟。

messages.msgid: Your hair has thickened to almost the level of fur covering your entire body.  It's very warm and provides some level of protection against attacks.
translations: 你的毛发变得十分浓密，几乎成了一层覆盖全身的皮毛。这身皮毛十分保暖，还能提供一定的攻击防护。

messages.msgid: With a few quick glances you can take in the contents of an entire room.  +3 Perception.
translations: 只需匆匆扫上几眼，你便能将整个房间的情形尽收眼底。感知+3。

messages.msgid: It takes a keen mind to keep a household running smoothly.  +2 Intelligence.
translations: 要将家务打理得井井有条，你需要一颗聪慧的头脑。智力+2。

messages.msgid: Brownies know every corner of their homes, all the well-worn grooves in the floor and the quick paths from place to place.  Your speed is increased the longer you spend in the same area.
translations: 棕仙对自己家中的每个角落都了如指掌，熟悉地板上每一道磨损的凹痕，也知晓往来各处最快的捷径。你在同一区域停留的时间越长，移动速度就越快。

messages.msgid: With the knowledge of one's home comes the knowledge that something is off about it.  You can sense any intruders nearby, as long as you are indoors and have been in the same location for some time.
translations: 熟悉自己的家，便能察觉家中的任何异样。只要你身处室内并在同一地点停留了一段时间，你就能感知到附近的任何入侵者。

messages.msgid: You can tell every nook and cranny of indoor spaces, and know how to quickly get from one place to another.
translations: 你对室内空间的每个角落都了如指掌，并且知道如何在其中快速穿行。

messages.msgid: You can return home from anywhere, as quick as a wink.
translations: 你可以从任何地方返回家中，快如眨眼。

messages.msgid: You are close enough to the birds and beasts that you can speak their language and ask them for aid.
translations: 你与鸟兽十分亲近，因此能与它们交谈，并请求其援助。

messages.msgid: Grow an impressive rack of antlers, allowing you to make a headbutt attack but preventing you from wearing a helmet.
translations: 长出一副壮观的鹿角，使你可以发动头槌攻击，但同时也让你无法佩戴头盔。

messages.msgid: Grow a set of spiraling curled horns, allowing you to make a headbutt attack but preventing you from wearing a helmet.
translations: 长出一对盘曲的螺旋犄角，使你可以发动头槌攻击，但同时也让你无法佩戴头盔。

messages.msgid: Grow a set of sharp fangs, allowing you to make a bite attack.
translations: 长出一副锋利的尖牙，使你可以发动啃咬攻击。

messages.msgid: Grow a set of long, saber-like fangs, preventing you from wearing mouth gear but allowing you to make rending bite attacks.
translations: 长出一副剑齿般的长尖牙，使你无法佩戴口部装备，但能发动撕裂性的啃咬攻击。

messages.msgid: Change your ears into the ears of a wolf, granting you increased hearing.
translations: 将你的耳朵变为狼耳，从而提升听力。

messages.msgid: Change your ears into the ears of a great cat, granting you increased hearing.
translations: 把你的耳朵变成大猫的耳朵，让你的听力得到增强。

messages.msgid: Grow a set of claws, improving your unarmed damage if you aren't wearing gloves.
translations: 长出一副利爪，在不佩戴手套时，可以提升你的空手伤害。

messages.msgid: Grow a powerful set of claws, nearly as hard as steel, greatly improving your unarmed damage if you aren't wearing gloves.
translations: 长出一副强有力的利爪，其硬度堪比钢铁，在不佩戴手套时，可以大幅提升你的空手伤害。

messages.msgid: Transform your arms into bird wings, allow you to slow your fall when jumping from a high place and glide short distances.
translations: 将你的双臂化为鸟翼，使你从高处跃下时能够减缓下落速度，并进行短距离滑翔。

messages.msgid: Grow a coat of thick fur, keeping you warm in the winter and protecting you from attacks.
translations: 长出一身厚实的皮毛，既能在冬日里为你保暖，又能保护你免受攻击。

messages.msgid: Grow an armored suit of chitin, protecting you and making your punches hit harder.
translations: 长出一身甲壳质外壳，它能保护你，并让你的拳击更具威力。

messages.msgid: Grow paws and animal-like legs, allowing you to run much faster on all fours, but preventing you from wearing shoes or gloves.
translations: 长出兽爪与兽腿，使你四足奔跑时速度大增，但也让你无法穿戴鞋履和手套。

messages.msgid: Your arms, hands, and legs are animal-like, allowing you to move quickly when running on all fours, but preventing you from wearing shoes or gloves.
translations: 你的双臂、双手和双腿都呈现出野兽的形态，使你四足奔跑时行动迅捷，但也让你无法穿戴鞋履和手套。

messages.msgid: Grow strong frog- or cat-like legs, allowing you to leap great distances.
translations: 长出蛙类或猫科动物般的强壮双腿，使你能跳出极远的距离。

messages.msgid: Grow the tail of a wolf, making it harder to wear pants but improving your balance.
translations: 长出一条狼尾，这会让你更难穿上裤子，但能提升你的平衡能力。

messages.msgid: Grow the tail of a cat, making it harder to wear pants but improving your balance.
translations: 长出一条猫尾，这会让你更难穿上裤子，但能提升你的平衡能力。

messages.msgid: Grow the tail of a scorpion, making it harder to wear pants but allowing you to attack with the stinger.
translations: 长出一条蝎尾，这会让你更难穿上裤子，但能用其尾刺进行攻击。

messages.msgid: Even when not shapeshifted you can bring part of a wild animal's strength to bear.  +2 Strength.
translations: 即便没有变形，你也能发挥出部分野兽的力量。力量+2。

messages.msgid: You have the quick reactions of a wild animal.  +3 Dexterity.
translations: 你拥有野兽般迅捷的反应能力。敏捷+3。

messages.msgid: You are getting better at shapeshifting and are able to maintain one more simultaneous shapeshift without drawing on your mana.
translations: 你的变形能力正在提升，现在可以额外同时维持一种变形形态而无需消耗魔力。

messages.msgid: You are getting much better at shapeshifting and are able to maintain two more simultaneous shapeshifts without drawing on your mana.
translations: 你的变形能力大有长进，现在可以额外同时维持两种变形形态而无需消耗魔力。

messages.msgid: You are a master of shapeshifting and are able to maintain four more simultaneous shapeshifts without drawing on your mana.
translations: 你已是变形大师，现在可以额外同时维持四种变形形态而无需消耗魔力。

messages.msgid: You can transform yourself into a bat.
translations: 你可以将自己变为一只蝙蝠。

messages.msgid: You can transform yourself into a raven.
translations: 你可以将自己变为一只渡鸦。

messages.msgid: You can transform yourself into a bear.
translations: 你可以将自己变为一头熊。

messages.msgid: You can transform yourself into a wolf.
translations: 你可以将自己变为一匹狼。

messages.msgid: You can transform yourself into a cougar.
translations: 你可以将自己变为一头美洲狮。

messages.msgid: You're getting used to moving and reacting like an animal.  When without weapons or armor and using your gifts of shapeshifting, your natural attacks do more damage.
translations: 你越来越习惯像野兽一样移动和反应。当你赤手空拳、不着片甲，并施展你的变形天赋时，你的天生攻击会造成更多伤害。

messages.msgid: The best defense is not getting hit, especially if you're a wild animal.  When using your shapeshifting and not wearing armor or using a weapon, you gain a bonus to your dodging.
translations: 最好的防御不是挨打，尤其对于野生动物。当使用变身能力，同时不穿戴盔甲、不使用武器时，你的闪避能力获得提升。

messages.msgid: Like the animals you mimic, you're quicker than you seem.  You gain a speed bonus while shapeshifted as long as you're unarmed and unarmored.
translations: 如同你模仿的野兽一般，你的速度远超表象。只要你处于变形状态，并且赤手空拳、不着片甲，就能获得速度加成。

messages.msgid: Your movements are graceful whether on land or in the water.  +3 Dexterity.
translations: 无论在陆地还是水中，你的动作都十分优雅。敏捷+3。

messages.msgid: Your sight is keen whether in or out of the water.  +2 Perception.
translations: 无论在水中还是水外，你的视力都同样敏锐。感知+2。

messages.msgid: Your mind flows easily from topic to topic while remembering the important details.  +2 Intelligence.
translations: 你的思维能在不同话题间轻易转换，同时又能牢记重要细节。智力+2。

messages.msgid: Surround yourself with a thick fog, obscuring your position.
translations: 将你包裹在浓雾中，隐藏你的位置。

messages.msgid: Call up a thick mist, shrouding the nearby landscape.
translations: 呼唤一片浓雾，遮蔽附近的环境。

messages.msgid: Call a rain shower, letting the rains water the earth.
translations: 呼唤一场阵雨，让雨水滋润大地。

messages.msgid: Call a heavy rainstorm, soaking everything.
translations: 呼唤一场大雨，淹没万物。

messages.msgid: You can breathe water just as easily as you can breathe air, and have no trouble switching between them.
translations: 你在水中呼吸就像在空气中呼吸一样容易，并且切换呼吸方式对你来说毫无困难。

messages.msgid: You can breathe water just as easily as you can breathe air, and have no trouble switching between them.  In addition, being wet is pleasant in a way it never was before.
translations: 你在水中呼吸就像在空气中呼吸一样容易，并且切换呼吸方式对你来说毫无困难。除此以外，身体湿透的感觉变得前所未有地令人愉悦。

messages.msgid: Falling asleep underwater is easy for you, and you spend less time asleep when you rest there.
translations: 在水下入睡对你来说很容易，当你在水下睡眠时，你花费的时间会更少。

messages.msgid: Your hands and feet haven't changed at all, but they seem to be much better at swimming than before.  You gain a speed bonus when in water, increased when not wearing shoes.
translations: 你的手脚没有任何改变，但它们在游泳的时候似乎比以前更灵活了。在水中时你获得速度加成，不穿鞋子时提升更大。

messages.msgid: You are a master of meteorological enchantments, and your weather manipulations will last much longer.
translations: 你是气象魔法的大师，你对天气的操纵会持续更久。

messages.msgid: Create a loud knocking sound within the glamour's range, to distract or lure your enemies away.
translations: 在幻术笼罩的范围内制造出一阵响亮的敲击声，以分散或引开敌人的注意。

messages.msgid: Your tough skin and thick nails allow you to use yours hands to replace some simple tools.  Your punches hit harder as well.
translations: 你坚韧的皮肤与厚实的指甲让你能徒手替代一些简单的工具，你的拳击也因此更具威力。

messages.msgid: The trow don't literally eat stones, but merely being underground fills you with strength and vigor.  You need half as much food and water while you're underground, and cold underground does not affect you.
translations: 并非真的吃石头，不过身处地下确实能让你充满力量与活力。在地下生存时，所需的食物和水只有平时的一半，而且身处地下寒冷的环境中也不会对身体造成影响。

messages.msgid: Once you begin mining, you can do it for hours without rest or sleep.  You need neither food nor drink nor rest for as long as you continue mining.
translations: 一旦开始采矿，你便能连续数小时不眠不休。只要你持续采矿，便无需进食、饮水或休息。

messages.msgid: While on rock or underground, you seem to subtly blend into your surroundings.  You are harder to spot on rocks or underground.
translations: 当立于岩石之上或身处地底之时，你会巧妙地融入周遭，令人更难察觉你的踪迹。

messages.msgid: You are as hardy as the rock.  When underground, you suffer much less pain.
translations: 你像岩石一样坚韧。当你在地下时，你受到的疼痛更少。

messages.msgid: You have learned the secrets of forging moon's tears.  Sometimes in your dreams, a new recipe might be revealed to you.
translations: 你已经知晓了塑造月之泪的秘密。有时当你在梦中时，一项新的配方会向你揭示。

messages.msgid: You are as hardy as the rock.  When underground you suffer much less pain, and your strength is not reduced by the pain you suffer.
translations: 你像岩石一样坚韧。当你在地下时，你受到的疼痛更少，同时你的力量不会因为疼痛而降低。

messages.msgid: Your sharp eyes can pierce the darkness.
translations: 你锐利的眼现在可以看破黑暗。

messages.msgid: Whether woods under trees or the cavern depths, you can see through the murk.
translations: 无论是林间树影之下，还是洞穴幽邃深处，你都能洞穿黑暗。

messages.msgid: The Fair Folk can remain hidden among rocks or trees or whispers of wind, and now you can too.
translations: 仙灵一族善于藏身于岩石、树木乃至风吟之中，而今，你也习得了这份技艺。

messages.msgid: Like the Fair Folk of legend, you can remain unseen when you wish.
translations: 仿若传说中的仙灵，你可随心所欲地隐匿身形。

messages.msgid: You can conjure up bobbing lights in the distance that will lead your enemies astray.
translations: 你可于远处召唤出跃动的光团，将敌人引入歧途。

messages.msgid: You seem to have stopped aging.  That would have been an amazing gift before the Cataclysm, but now at least you might live long enough to find some way back to your birthplace Under the Hill.
translations: 你的年龄看起来似乎停止了增长。在大灾变以前这本应是一种惊人的馈赠，但现在至少你可以活到找到山下的出生地的时候。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Selkie gains the ability to grow a goblin fruit when near water or under the rain.
translations: 掌握此技后，海豹精便能在临近水源或身处雨中时，催生出一枚妖精果实。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Brownie gains the ability to grow a goblin fruit when indoors and unobserved.
translations: 掌握此技后，棕仙便能在室内且不被察觉时，催生出一枚妖精果实。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Pooka gains the ability to grow a goblin fruit when near animals.
translations: 掌握此技后，普卡精便能在靠近动物时，催生出一枚妖精果实。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Trow gains the ability to grow a goblin fruit when underground or at night.
translations: 掌握此技后，石窟妖便可在身处地底或夜幕降临时，催生出一枚妖精果实。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Noble gains the ability to grow a goblin fruit when near humans or Fae.
translations: 掌握此技后，贵族妖精便能在靠近人类或妖精时，催生出一枚妖精果实。

messages.msgid: You were born a shapeshifter, and after your gifts manifested themselves, you gained other benefits as well.  Even in human form, you heal a little faster than normal and your broken bones heal straight and true.
translations: 你天生就是一位易形者，在天赋显现之后，你还获得了其他增益。即便处于人形，你的自愈速度也比常人稍快，断骨亦能完美愈合。

messages.msgid: You can transform yourself into a wolf and run through the forests.
translations: 你可以化身为狼，在林间穿行。

messages.msgid: You can transform yourself into a wolf-human hybrid and rip your enemies to shreds.
Eating that goblin fruit has made you grow to enormous size!
translations: 吃了那个妖精果实，你变得巨大无比！

messages.msgid: A wide set of ethereal wings sprouts from your back.  Despite them phasing through every form of matter you've encountered, they still somehow lift you off the ground.  Their mere appearance makes you feel lighter
translations: 一对宽大的虚翼从你背后猛然展开。尽管它们能穿透你所见的任何物质，却不知为何依然能将你托离地面。光是它们的存在，就让你感觉身轻如燕。

messages.msgid: Ethereal hands appear behind your back, making you looks like an ancient god.
translations: 空灵的双手出现在你的背后，让你看起来就像一个古老的神。

messages.msgid: While not actually a devil's, this long, triangular pointed tail can stretch very far, allowing it to easily kill someone nearby.
translations: 其实并不是魔鬼，这条尾部有三角尖的长尾巴可以伸展很多，可以轻易杀死附近的人。

messages.msgid: Your eyes transform into the orbits of an unknown creature.  You now see much better in the light and dark.
translations: 你的双眼化为了某种未知生物的形态。现在，无论光明还是黑暗，你的视力都大大增强了。

messages.msgid: You still sleep, yet your dreams still can impact the world.  Activate to wake up.
translations: 你仍在沉睡，但你的梦境仍能影响世界。 激活以唤醒。

messages.msgid: You are a bush and no one can see you.
Thanks to your torpor you are healing and recovering quickly
translations: 在休眠状态下，你的身体正在快速愈合与恢复。

messages.msgid: You have ascended in power and can rival the mighty night-creatures of old.  The night is your home, now, out of the light of the sun.
translations: 你的能力在不断的擢升后，已足以与那些古且强大的黑夜生命相媲美。 现在，黑夜成为了你的领域，你已栖于日光之外。

messages.msgid:
You are one of the lilin, a hunter in the night, driven to feed on the spiritual essence (some might say the soul) of your prey.  Probably you were born that way, but maybe it happened to due to a malediction, or some artifact you found in a place best forgotten.  Regardless, it is your gift and your curse now, and you must use your powers to survive.

You may activate this trait to spend some ruach toward increasing your power.  You must be outside under the moonlight to have a chance of gaining new lilin powers.
translations:
你是莉莉丝中的一员，是黑夜中的猎手，以猎物的精神精萃（也有人说是灵魂）为食。 也许生来如此，也许是因为诅咒，亦或许是因为在一个最好已被遗忘的地方发现的神器。 无论如何，这既是你的天赋，也是你的诅咒，你必须利用你的能力活下去。

你可以激活这个特性，花费一些灵息来提升你的能力。仅当在月光的照耀下时，你才能被赐予新的能力。

messages.msgid: With but a touch, you can drain the vitality and spiritual essence from your targets.
translations: 只需轻轻一触，你就能榨干目标的生命力和精神精萃。

messages.msgid: You no longer need to touch your targets to drain their ruach; you can do it at a short distance through their breath.
translations: 不需要接触目标，你现在凭借它们的呼吸就可以从近处榨干它们的灵息。

messages.msgid: You no longer need to touch your targets to drain their ruach; you can do it at a great distance through their breath.
translations: 不需要接触目标，你现在凭借它们的呼吸就可以从远处榨干它们的灵息。

messages.msgid: In sleep, a person's defenses are down and it is easier for the things in the night to prey upon them.  You gain additional ruach from sleeping targets.
translations:
睡眠中的人对你的抵抗力会下降——黑夜中的猎物总是更容易捕猎。 你能从那些熟睡的目标身上榨取额外的灵息。
『我不容我的眼睛睡觉，也不容我的眼目打盹 。』——《圣咏集》132:4

messages.msgid: Call up thick clouds of fog, allowing you to hide from your enemies.  This power <color_green>lasts longer</color> when closer to the new moon.
translations:
召来浓密的云雾，以让你在其中躲避敌人。 当接近新月时，这种能力会<color_green>持续更长时间</color>。
『当祂在穹苍巡弋时，
密云挡住祂的视线。』
——《约伯记》22:14

messages.msgid: With a baleful gaze and a heart full of malice, curse a single target with misfortune.
translations: 以怨毒的目光和满腔的恶意，诅咒一个目标遭遇不幸。

messages.msgid: Let out a piercing cry, disorienting both enemies and allies nearby.
translations: 发出极具穿透力的啼鸣，以同时迷惑附近的敌人和盟友。

messages.msgid: You can transform yourself into an owl and take wing on the night air.  You won't be able to drain ruach while you are in this form.
translations: 你可以化为夜枭来飞行，在深夜的高空中张开你的双翼。 化身为夜枭时，你将无法榨取灵息。

messages.msgid: When shrouded in shadows, you make as little noise as one.  Your movement is fully silent at night unless you're out of ruach.
translations:
当被阴影所笼罩时，你几乎不会发出任何声音。 除非你的灵息已经耗尽，否则夜晚将以静谧遮掩你的行动。
『他必保护圣民的脚步；使恶人在黑暗中寂然不动。人都不能靠力量得胜。』——《撒母耳记上》2:9

messages.msgid: You were born to walk the night, and have a much easier time sleeping during the day.
translations:
你生来就应行于夜，眠于日。白日中更易入眠。
『神称光为昼，称暗为夜。有晚上，有早晨，这是头一日。』——《创世记》1:5

messages.msgid: While sleep is restful, the ruach you gain fills you with more energy than even a good night's rest.  You may spend ruach to alleviate your sleepiness.
translations:
固然睡眠能补充你的精力，但你获得的灵息同样能让你精力充沛，甚至更胜一夜好眠。 你可以花费灵息来缓解困倦。
『保护以色列的，也不打盹，也不睡觉。』——《圣咏集》121:4

messages.msgid: Your presence is intoxicating, and humans have a hard time resisting your charms.  You gain a bonus to your persuasion chance as long as you aren't empty of ruach.
translations:
你的存在是如此醉人，人类难以不沉醉于你的魅力。 只要你体内的灵息还没有耗尽，你就能获得说服成功几率的加成。
『因为淫妇的嘴滴下蜂蜜，她的口比油更滑。』——《箴言》5:3

messages.msgid: You have a much easier time spinning lies and making people believe them.  You gain a bonus to your lying chance as long as you aren't empty of ruach.
translations:
你善于编织花言巧语，使人们听信你的谎言。 只要你体内的 “灵息”没有耗尽，你就能获得说谎成功几率的加成。
『不可作假见证指证你的邻人。』——《出埃及记》20:16

messages.msgid: You can temporarily beguile a single human, fey, or avian target, causing them to stand senseless or wander in a daze.  Any damage will bring the target out of their trance.
translations:
你可以暂时迷惑一个人类、精灵或鸟类目标，使他们失去知觉或在茫然中徘徊。 任何伤害都会让目标从恍惚中醒来。
『各人都成了畜类，毫无知识；各银匠都因他雕刻的偶像羞愧。』——《耶利米书》10:14

messages.msgid: Your body has now stopped aging, massively extending your longevity.  You can still be killed but as long as your body can heal, all your wounds will eventually fully heal no matter how severe they are.
translations:
你的身躯不再衰老，寿命得以极大的延长。你仍然可能被杀死，但只要你的身体还能够愈合，那么无论你受到有多么严重的创伤，最终都会完全治愈。
『因为罪的工价乃是死；惟有神的恩赐，在我们的主基督耶稣里，乃是永生。』——《罗马书》6:23

messages.msgid: With eternal youth comes the strength to endure past anything one could face.  Your speed won't be lower than its default as long as you have some ruach in you.
translations:
永恒定格的青春，为你带来足以承担一切磨损的生命力。只要你体内还有灵息，你的速度就不会低于默认值。
『太阳还存，月亮还在，人要敬畏你，直到万代！』——《圣咏录》72:5

messages.msgid: You may unleash a foul miasma on your enemies, sickening them.
translations: 你可以向敌人释放污秽的瘴气，带去瘟疫和疾病。

messages.msgid: You may greatly enhance the power of the miasma from Unleash the Night-Wind, doing serious damage and crippling your target.
translations: 你可以大大增强 “掀起黑夜之风 ”释放出的瘴气的威力，瘫痪目标并造成大额伤害。

messages.msgid: You may cut a single target off from light, completely blinding them.  You may only do this at night, and only indoors or out in the wilderness.
translations: 你以将一个目标与所有光线割离，使其完全失明。 您只能在夜间的室内或野外使用这个能力。

messages.msgid: You can use your powers to spin a web of illusion around yourself, increasing your attractiveness to a supernatural degree.  While the harsh light of the sun destroys the illusion, you need merely to move back into the shadows to restore it.
translations:
你可以使用你的能力编织起一张美轮美奂的幻象之网，以将自己的魅力提升到超自然的程度。 虽然刺眼的阳光会破坏幻象，但你只需回到阴影中就能将其恢复。
『利亚的眼睛没有神气，拉结却生得美貌俊秀。』——《创世纪》29:17

messages.msgid: You can use your powers to spin a web of illusion around yourself, increasing your attractiveness to a supernatural degree.  While the harsh light of the sun destroys the illusion, you need merely to move back into the shadows to restore it.  You have grown so powerful that this illusion requires almost no effort and can be <color_green>maintained for weeks</color> at a time.
translations:
你可以使用你的能力编织起一张美轮美奂的幻象之网，以将自己的魅力提升到超自然的程度。 虽然刺眼的阳光会破坏幻象，但你只需回到阴影中就能将其恢复。 你已经如此强大，以至于这种幻觉可以毫不费力地<color_green>维持数周之久</color>。
『无人像押沙龙那样俊美，得人的称赞，从脚底到头顶毫无瑕疵。』——《撒母耳记下II》14:25

messages.msgid: Like the monstrous children of angels and humans, your prowess surpasses mortal limits.  Activate this trait to empower yourself.
translations: 你宛如天使与人类所诞下的怪胎，拥有超越凡人极限的力量。 激活这一特性以增强你的力量。

messages.msgid: You can drain essence from your targets with your unarmed attacks.  Not well enough to absorb their ruach, should they have any, but enough to cause additional damage at night.  This damage is strongest during the half to full moon and weakest during the new moon.  It functions only slightly during the day.
translations:
你可以通过徒手的攻击榨出目标的精萃，虽然这不足以吸收他们的灵息（如果他们有的话），但足以在夜间造成额外伤害。 这种伤害在半月到满月期间最强，在新月期间最弱。 这在白天只发挥微乎其微的作用。
『阿鲁卡有两个女儿』——《箴言》30:15

messages.msgid: With an expenditure of ruach you can drastically enhance your speed for a short period of time.
translations:
通过消耗灵息，你可以在短时间内大幅提高速度。
『他们种的是风，收的是暴风。』——《何西阿书》8：7

messages.msgid: You can leap away from attacks like shadows dancing in candlelight.  You gain Uncanny Dodge while under the effects of Reaping the Whirlwind.
translations: 你在对手的攻击之间腾挪，一如在烛光中舞动的阴影。 在“收获昔日之风”的影响下，你会获得不可思议的闪避能力。

messages.msgid: Your eyes have adapted to the darkness of the night, allowing you to see further through the shadows.  This is most effective out under the moon but still has an effect indoors.
translations: 你的眼睛已经适应了黑夜，可以透过阴影看得更远。 这在月下最显著，但在室内仍有一定效果。

messages.msgid: The owl is a symbol of wisdom in culture after culture, and you are the heir to that wisdom.  You find it easier to learn things, and even easier the more ruach you're holding on to.
translations: 在各种文化中，夜枭都是智慧的象征，而你是那智慧的继承者。 你掌握的灵息越多，学东西就越容易。

messages.msgid: Attuned to darkness and disease, you can easily spot the cracks in your enemies' defenses.  You have an easier chance to hit enemy weakpoints, increasing as your ruach rises.
translations: 与黑夜和疾病相随，你能轻易找到对手防御之中的那些“裂缝”。 击中敌人的几率增大，并随着你的灵息上升而增加。

messages.msgid: The Pestilence that Stalks in Darkness
You are at home in the darkness and it clings to you to cover your movements.  In a half- or smaller moon, and when out of the daylight, it is harder for your enemies to spots you.
translations:
黑夜是你的家，依附在你身上，遮掩你的行动。 在半月或更小的月亮下，于日光所及之外，你的敌人更难发现你。
『也不怕黑夜流行的瘟疫，
或是午间灭人的灾害。』
——《圣咏录》91:6

messages.msgid: As a hunter in the night, you are well-conditioned to the cold after the sun goes down.  You are resistant to chill temperatures, and more so the more ruach you have.
translations:
作为黑夜中的猎人，你对落日后袭来的的寒冷有很好的适应力。 你能抵御寒冷的气温，拥有的灵息越多，抵御寒冷的能力就越强。
『他掷下冰雹如碎渣，他发出寒冷，谁能当得起呢？』——《圣咏录》147:17

messages.msgid: When filled with ruach, no other food or drink compares.  The more ruach you have, the less mundane hunger or thirst troubles you.
translations:
当体内充满灵息时，其他食物或饮品都无法与这些灵息相比。 你拥有的灵息越多，世俗的饥饿或干渴就越难以干扰你。
『你得了蜜吗？只可吃够而已，恐怕你过饱就呕吐出来。』——《箴言》25:16

messages.msgid: Your stolen ruach speeds your healing in proportion to how much of it you have.
translations: 你所榨取的灵息会按比例加速你的恢复。

messages.msgid: Sometimes, you cannot passively wait for your ruach to heal your wounds, you need it to happen immediately.  You may activate this trait to greatly speed your healing at a continual cost of ruach.
translations: 有些时候，你不满足于等待你的灵息治愈你的伤口，而需要一些更快的治疗。这时，你可以激活这个特性，以持续消耗灵为代价，大大加快伤口愈合的速度。

messages.msgid: Your powers have expanded and you are now capable of holding more ruach.
translations: 你的能力得到了增强，现在你能够容纳更多的灵息。

messages.msgid: Your powers have expanded and you are now capable of holding even more ruach.
translations: 你的能力得到了增强，现在你能够容纳甚至更多的灵息。

messages.msgid: Your powers have expanded and you are now capable of holding an enormous amount of ruach.
translations: 你的能力得到了增强，现在你能够容纳海量的灵息。

messages.msgid: You've learned how to more efficiently use your ruach, greedily keeping some behind for yourself when you activate your powers.  Powers that cost ruach have their initial and periodic costs reduced by 15%.  This does not reduce the continual ruach cost of staying alive.
translations: 你学会了如何更有效地使用你的灵息，在激活能力时贪婪地为自己截留一部分。消耗灵息的能力，其初始与周期性消耗都会降低15%。此效果不降低维持生命的持续灵息消耗。

messages.msgid: Like a Cage Full of Birds

You jealously parcel out your ruach, only spending exactly as much as you need and no more.  Powers that cost ruach have their initial and periodic costs reduced by 15%, with an additional reduction that grows based on your total amount of ruach, to a maximum reduction of 33%.  This does not reduce the continual ruach cost of staying alive.
translations: 你小心翼翼地分配着你的灵息，精打细算，绝不多耗一分一毫。消耗灵息的能力，其初始与周期性消耗都会降低15%，外加一个基于你灵息总量的额外减免，最高可达33%。此效果不降低维持生命的持续灵息消耗。

messages.msgid: The Night Shines Like the Day
You have adapted so well to the night that it doesn't hinder your actions at all.  You can read and craft in any light levels.
translations: 你已完全适应了夜晚，以至于它丝毫不会妨碍你的行动。你可以在任何光照水平下阅读和制作。

messages.msgid: The Darkness is not Dark to You
Your eyes have fully adapted to the darkness, allowing you to see as well in the dark as humans see in the light.
translations: 你的双眼已完全适应了黑暗，使你在黑暗中的视力如同人类在光明中一样。

messages.msgid: The Moon Shall Shine at Night

You are closely attuned to the moon, and some of your powers grow stronger with it.  Any ability you have that is amplified the fuller the moon is will not be weakened as much by an incomplete but non-new moon.
translations: 你与月亮紧密协调，你的一些能力会随之增强。任何月相越是圆满、增幅效果越是强大的能力，在月相不全但并非新月之时，其削弱程度会有所减轻。

messages.msgid: Your owl form is half spirit and half flesh.  You have a high chance to dodge any attacks against you, and may pass straight through walls as long as it is night.
translations: 你的猫头鹰形态半是血肉，半是灵魂。你有很高的几率闪避任何对你的攻击，并且只要是在夜晚，你便能径直穿墙而过。

messages.msgid: You are at home in the night, and your prowess is heightened while the moon is up as long as you have any ruach within you.
translations: 你在夜晚如鱼得水，只要体内尚存灵息，那么当月亮升起之时，你的威能就会得到增强。

messages.msgid: You can combine your forms, transforming into a large owl-human hybrid with wings, rending talons, and a deadly beak.  You won't be able to drain ruach while you are in this form.
translations: 你可以融合你的形态，变为一个巨大的人枭混合体，拥有双翼、撕裂血肉的利爪和致命的尖喙。在此形态下你将无法汲取灵息。

messages.msgid: While you cannot fly, with your bird-like legs and your wings, you can leap quite a distance.
translations: 虽然你无法飞行，但凭借你鸟一般的双腿和双翼，你可以跳出相当远的距离。

messages.msgid: When filled with ruach, no other food or drink compares.  The more ruach you have, the less mundane hunger or thirst troubles you.  In addition, drinking ruach from your victims assuages your hunger and thirst.
translations: 当体内充满灵息时，其他任何食物或饮品都无法与之相比。你拥有的灵息越多，凡俗的饥饿或干渴对你的困扰就越小。此外，从你的受害者身上汲取灵息也能缓解你的饥渴。

messages.msgid: When you wish it, your very touch bears the contamination of plague.  Your unarmed attacks have a chance to infect your targets, scaling with the amount of ruach you have.
translations: 只要你愿意，你的触碰本身就会带有瘟疫的污秽。你的徒手攻击有几率感染你的目标，几率大小取决于你拥有的灵息量。

messages.msgid: You are a being of darkness, closer to it than almost anything else is.  It quickens your essence, and with it your actions, the longer you stay in it.  Each night, you receive an increase to your speed that is higher for each consecutive day spent without being exposed to the sun, up to ten.  The light of the sun breaks this quickening, forcing you to wait once more for the shadows to empower you in this way.
translations: 你是一个黑暗造物，比几乎任何存在都更接近黑暗。黑暗会强化你的精萃，进而加快你的行动，你在其中待得越久，效果越强。每个夜晚，你的速度都会得到提升，每连续一天不暴露在阳光下，提升幅度就会增加，最多叠加十天。阳光会打破这种加速效果，迫使你再次等待暗影来赋予你力量。

messages.msgid: The Moon to Rule the Night
At night, under the moonlight, you can knit grievous wounds together in seconds with a great expenditure of ruach.
translations: 在夜晚，于月光之下，你可以通过大量消耗灵息，在数秒内缝合重创。

messages.msgid: When taking fatal damage, instead of dying you assume the form of an owl, allowing you to fly away from danger and recover.  This does not function during the day, if you are out of ruach, or if you are killed by fire.
translations: 当你受到致命伤害时，你不会立即死亡，而是会化作一只猫头鹰，从而飞离险境并得以恢复。此能力在白昼、灵息耗尽或被烈焰焚身时无效。

messages.msgid: You squat down, build up tension in your legs, then with a mighty beat of your wings, you leap.
translations: 你蹲下身，双腿蓄力，然后猛力一振双翼，纵身跃起。

messages.msgid: A traveler from another dimension.  A dimension of shadows with few bright lights.  Once your species matures, they gain the ability to create new alterations to their body from ingredients harvested from their kills, shadowstuff and magickal essence.
translations: 一位来自异次元的旅者，其家乡是一个光亮稀少的暗影次元。一旦你的种族成熟，就能利用从猎物身上收获的材料、暗影物质和魔法精华，对自己的身体进行新的改造。

messages.msgid: You have become a fully mature Gracken and have gained the ability to reform your body in ways previously blocked to you in your immature state.
translations: 你已完全成熟为一名格拉肯，并获得了重塑身体的能力，打破了幼体状态下的种种限制。

messages.msgid: Bright yellow eyes shine out from the shadowy crevices of your face.
translations: 明黄色的双眼从你面部的阴影缝隙中闪耀而出。

messages.msgid: Gracken are about the same size as humans, though they look like shadow demons.
translations: 格拉肯的身形与人类相仿，不过他们看起来就像是暗影恶魔。

messages.msgid: Your legs are human sized but appear to be made of swirling shadows.
translations: 你的双腿与人类大小相仿，但看起来像是用涡旋的暗影构成的。

messages.msgid: Your legs have decreased in length providing you with a lower center of gravity and a slight improvement to agility.
translations: 你的双腿变短了，这让你获得了更低的重心，敏捷性也略有提升。

messages.msgid: Your legs have lengthened.  You can cross flat terrain more easily.
translations: 你的双腿变长了，使你能够更轻松地穿越平坦的地形。

messages.msgid: Your feet are humanoid but appear to be made of swirling shadows.
translations: 你的双足呈人形，但看起来像是用涡旋的暗影构成的。

messages.msgid: Your arms are humanoid but appear to be made of swirling shadows.
translations: 你的双臂呈人形，但似乎由涌动的暗影构成。

messages.msgid: Your arms have begun bulking up and become stronger.  +1 Strength
translations: 你的双臂已然壮硕，力量也随之增强。力量+1

messages.msgid: Your arms have lengthened.  You can push a target away from you.
translations: 你的双臂已然伸长，现在可以将目标推开了。

messages.msgid: Your hands are humanoid but appear to be made of swirling shadows.
translations: 你的双手呈人形，但似乎由涌动的暗影构成。

messages.msgid: Your hands are humanoid but appear to be made of swirling shadows.  At the end of each finger you sport a razor sharp nail.  It increases your damage when unarmed.
translations: 你的双手呈人形，但似乎由涌动的暗影构成。每根指尖都生有利如剃刀的指甲，能增加你的徒手伤害。

messages.msgid: Your hands are humanoid but appear to be made of swirling shadows.  You sport an extra digit on every finger that improves your ability to get into tight situations..
Your skin is the color of shadows moving in the twilight.
translations: 你的肤色如同暮光中流转的暗影。

messages.msgid: Your dietary needs are so minimized that you could travel months or years without eating.  There are consequences to this.  One is an inability to process normal food.  Another is a pretty constant state of weariness, but this is the best way to handle interdimensional travel until you are able to develop an organ to consume local foods.  The ambient energies here are much weaker than what you normally encounter out in the Nether between universes, you need exposure to nuclear radiation to gain calories on this planet, for now.
translations: 你的营养需求被降到了最低，即使数月甚至数年不进食也无妨。但这么做是有代价的：其一，你将无法消化普通食物；其二，你会持续感到疲惫不堪。不过，在进化出能够消化本地食物的器官之前，这仍是应对跨维度旅行的最佳方式。此地的环境能量远比你在宇宙间的虚空中所习惯的要弱，就目前而言，你需要暴露在核辐射下才能在这颗星球上获取热量。

messages.msgid: You eat a wide variety of foods native to this world that would be appropriate for the dominant species.
translations: 你能进食这个世界上种类繁多的食物，就像此地的优势物种一样。

messages.msgid: You eat an exclusively meat-based diet as befits an apex predator of this planet.
translations: 你的食谱完全以肉类为基础，与这颗星球的顶级掠食者相称。

messages.msgid: You eat a herbivorous diet.  The benefit of this is you never have to kill for your food.  Unless the plants were trying to kill you first.
translations: 你以植物为食。这样做的好处是你永远不必为了食物而杀生——除非那些植物想先杀了你。

messages.msgid: You have a gland that grows a small amount of the material needed to make biological improvements to yourself.  You must gather dreamdross and components from monsters you wish to gain the abilities of and combine them with this shadowstuff into new organs and abilities.
translations: 你体内有一个腺体，能够生成少量用于自我生物改良的材料。你必须从那些你希望获得其能力的怪物身上收集怪物组件和浮梦残渣，并将其与这种暗影物质相结合，从而创造出新的器官和能力。

messages.msgid: Your system has adapted to radiation.  While irradiated, you will convert the radiation into calories.
translations: 你的身体系统已经适应了辐射。当你受到辐照时，你会将辐射转化为热量。

messages.msgid: The forest nervously whispers to you about the presence of humans.
translations: 森林紧张地向你低语，告知了人类的存在。

messages.msgid: The forest gently whispers to you about the creatures of nature.
translations: 森林轻柔地向你低语，诉说着自然生灵的踪迹。

messages.msgid: The forest whispers warnings of unnatural creatures nearby.
translations: 森林低声私语，警示着附近有非自然的生物。

messages.msgid: You concentrate on nature around you and commune with it, improving your health and calming the nearby wildlife.  This spell may only be cast outdoors in natural surroundings.
translations: 你专注于你周围的自然，与它交流，改善你的健康，安抚附近的野生动物。这个法术只能在户外自然环境中施展。

messages.msgid: You may spin a bit of fae magic into a plant, bringing forth a goblin fruit.  Goblin fruit have a variety of effects, never predictable but always at least somewhat beneficial.  This spell may only be cast outdoors in natural surroundings.
translations: 你可以向植物中注入一点妖精魔法，结出妖精果实。 果实的效果多种多样，虽然无法预测，但至少总能带来一些益处。 此咒语只能在户外自然环境中施放。

messages.msgid: Using your voice and your magic, bring forth living wood from a tree to provide resources without harming the forest.
translations: 通过你的歌声和魔力，从树木中催生出活体木材，在不伤害森林的前提下获取资源。

messages.msgid: You close your eyes and sing to the trees.
translations: 你闭上双眼，向林木咏唱。

messages.msgid: You draw on your own connection to nature and infuse some of its power into one of your allies, healing them for a small amount and increasing their overall health.
translations: 你利用自己与自然的联系，将自然的一些力量注入到你的一个盟友身上，用少量的药物治愈他们，并增加他们的整体健康。

messages.msgid: Roots can grow through even concrete given time.  With this spell, you can compress that time into a single instant to shatter walls or rip doors off their hinges.
translations: 只要有时间，即使是混凝土也能长出根来。 有了这个咒语，你就可以瞬间击碎墙壁或把门从铰链上扯下来。

messages.msgid: Call the Children of the Roots
A lesser wood spirit is summoned to support you.
translations: 一个较小的森林精灵被召唤来支持你。

messages.msgid: While in the wild, weave together some leaves and grasses and magick to form a container that will keep its contents from rotting for a length of time.  The container will only last a few weeks at most.
translations: 在野外，把一些树叶和草编织在一起，用魔法做成一个容器，让里面的东西在一段时间内不会腐烂。

messages.msgid:
Trees require water but will still drown if submerged.  This spell allows the Arvore to create a floral boat with the help of a nearby tree, letting them travel safely across water.

You must be standing <color_yellow>next to a tree</color> and <color_yellow>near the water</color> for the spell to be effective.
translations:
树木需要水，但若被完全浸没，也同样会溺亡。此法术能让木灵借助附近的树木创造一艘花木小舟，从而安全地渡过水域。

你必须<color_yellow>站在树旁</color>且<color_yellow>临近水源</color>，此法术方能生效。

messages.msgid: Call up thick briars and thorns, either in a line to form a wall or an arc to trap an enemy.  They will grow to full size in moments.
translations: 召唤厚厚的蒺藜和荆棘，要么排成一条线，形成一堵墙，要么形成一个弧形，用来诱捕敌人。它们很快就会长到完整的尺寸。

messages.msgid: Invasive weeds must be rooted out, lest they choke the life from the garden.  This spell inflicts a rapid withering on plants and fungus within its area of effect.
translations: 必须铲除入侵的杂草，以免它们扼杀花园的生命。这个法术对其作用区域内的植物和真菌造成快速枯萎。

messages.msgid: You can greatly speed plant growth.  Grass can grow from seed in moments, crops can be brought to ripeness, and even young trees will reach their full bloom.
translations: 你可以大大加速植物的生长。草可以瞬间从种子长出来，庄稼可以成熟，即使是幼小的树木也会盛开。

messages.msgid: Rather than fostering the growth of a single plant, you can cause a wave of growth all around you, affecting an entire field and bringing it towards ripeness.
translations: 此法术并非培育单株植物，而是掀起一阵席卷周遭的生长浪潮，催熟一整片田地。

messages.msgid: In natural surroundings, you can create structures out of living wood--walls, floors, doors, and roofs all together.
translations: 在自然环境中，你可以用活的木头建造结构--墙、地板、门和屋顶都在一起。

messages.msgid: Cause a cluster of vines to burst out of diggable ground and rise up into the sky in moments.  It will be easy to climb once its growth is finished.
translations: 从可挖掘的地面瞬间催生出一丛藤蔓，令其破土而出，直冲天际。待其生长完毕，便可轻松攀爬。

messages.msgid: The soil churns as thick vines burst forth and shoots toward the sky.
translations: 泥土翻涌，粗壮的藤蔓破土而出，直射天穹。

messages.msgid: When outside on diggable ground, create a small structure of wood near the Arvore, offering shelter against the elements.
translations: 当身处室外可挖掘的地面时，在木灵身边创造一个小型木质结构，以抵御恶劣天气。

messages.msgid: Your command over plants allows you to cause grass to grow in profusion from the soil, making the terrain very difficult for enemies to traverse.
translations: 你对植物的掌控力能令草木从土壤中疯长，使敌人难以在这种地形上通行。

messages.msgid: Your command over plants allows you to call forth roots from the earth to clutch and grasp at your enemies.
translations: 你对植物的指挥使你能够从大地上拔出根来抓住你的敌人。

messages.msgid: Bind your soul to the heart of the forest, rebirthing yourself if you should die.  You may only perform this in thick forests or at an arvore altar, you may be reborn no more than once in a lunar month.
translations: 将自己的灵魂与森林之心绑定，死后可重生。 你只能在茂密的森林中或在木灵祭坛上进行这项仪式，一个月内你只能重生一次。

messages.msgid: While outdoors and not underground, the Arvore can create a profusion of life around themselves, causing grass to grow through pavement, bushes and flowers to sprout, and trees to grow to full height in moments.
translations: 只要身处室外且不在地下，木灵便能在周身催生万物：草木破开路面，灌木与花卉萌发，树木在片刻间长成参天大树。

messages.msgid:
Even the mightiest tree returns to soil in the end.  The Arvore may channel this natural process into an area around themselves, infecting everyone within with the energies of rot.

<color_yellow>This spell is indiscriminate</color> and <color_red>should not be used near allies</color>.
translations:
即使是最高大的树，最终也会归于泥土。木灵可能会将这一自然过程引导到他们周围的一个区域，用腐烂的能量感染里面的每个人。

<color_yellow>这个法术是不分青红皂白的</color>和<color_red>不应该在盟友附近使用</color>。

messages.msgid: Roots grow together and so forests are connected.  The Arvore may use this connection to quickly transport themselves tree to tree, stepping into an adjacent tree and then stepping out of another one within the spell's range.
translations: 树根相连，森林亦因此彼此互通。木灵可以利用这种连接在树木之间快速穿行：踏入身边的一棵树，再从法术范围内的另一棵树中迈出。

messages.msgid: From Root to Root the Forest Is Joined
All forests are connected at their hearts.  You can use this connection to travel from the depths of a forest to the depths of another forest, if you properly attune to your destination.
translations: 所有森林的中心都彼此相连。若你与目的地妥善同调，便可利用这种连接，从一片森林的深处去往另一片森林的深处。

messages.msgid: Attune to a location for later traveling.  You must attune within the depths of a forest.
translations: 与一个地点同调，以便日后传送。你必须在森林深处进行同调。

messages.msgid: The ultimate expression of nature's power, you can turn your target into a tree that might have stood for a century or more.  It works best on an already-weakened target, and does not work at all on non-organic targets.
translations: 这是自然之力的终极体现。你能将目标变成一棵仿佛已伫立了百年之久的古树。此法术对已被削弱的目标效果最佳，对非有机目标则完全无效。

messages.msgid:
While outdoors and not underground, the Arvore can unleash the power of nature against their enemies.  The walking dead and most creatures not native to the world suffer the Earthmother's wrath, while animals and humans are healed.  Triffids, being plants, are healed as well.

Note that this power is <color_yellow>indiscriminate</color>: if the Arvore has somehow bound a Nether creature to their service, it will be damaged, and hostile humans will be healed.
translations:
当木灵身处室外而非地下时，便可释放自然之力对抗敌人。行尸走肉与绝大多数非此世之物都将承受地母之怒，而动物和人类则会被治愈。作为植物的巨型三尖树，同样会得到治愈。

请注意，此力量<color_yellow>不分敌我</color>：如果木灵以某种方式束缚了一个下界生物为其效力，它也会受到伤害，而敌对的人类也会被治愈。

messages.msgid: Your skin has turned the color of spring growth.  Your skin is now a viridian green.  This has no gameplay effects.
translations: 你的皮肤已经变成了春天生长的颜色。你的皮肤现在是翠绿的。这没有游戏效果。

messages.msgid: Your skin has turned into a type of plant matter, which in addition to any armoring slows your loss of fluids.
translations: 你的皮肤已经变成了一种植物物质，除了任何铠甲之外，它还能减缓你的液体流失。

messages.msgid: The skin on your body has grown into a barklike state.  This provides significantly more armor but reduces flexibility.
translations: 你身上的皮肤已经长成了树皮状。这提供了更多的装甲，但降低了灵活性。

messages.msgid: A viridian moss has grown on your skin, forming whorls and eldritch patterns, providing some protection from the cold and the wet.  It also provides a small amount of armor against acid or fire.
translations: 你的身上长出了一层青苔，形成了螺旋状的奇异图案，为你抵挡寒冷和潮湿提供了一些保护。它还能提供少量的抗酸或抗火护甲。

messages.msgid: You are in tune with the forest and the triffids will allow you safe passage in their lands, so long as you do not harm them.
translations: 你与森林相融无间，只要你不伤害三尖树，它们便会容你在其领地安然穿行。

messages.msgid: The trees recognize you as one of their own and allow you to pass easily beneath their boughs.  The grass moves under your feet to speed your passage, and shrubs bend out of the way.  When walking on grass, trees, or other natural foliage, your movement speed is increased.
translations: 树木将你视为它们的一员，并允许你轻松地从它们的树枝下通过。草在你脚下移动，以加快你的通行速度，灌木丛也会弯腰让开。当在草地、树木或其他自然树叶上行走时，你的移动速度会增加。

messages.msgid: The trees recognize you as one of their own and allow you to pass easily beneath their boughs.  The grass moves under your feet to speed your passage, and shrubs bend out of the way.  When walking on grass, trees, or other natural foliage, your movement speed is increased.  In addition, when in a forest, the trees bend out of your way, allowing you to pass
translations: 林木视你为同类，任你于枝桠下轻松穿行。你脚下的青草为你加速，路旁的灌木也为你弯腰。当你在草地、林地或其他天然植被上行走时，移动速度会得到提升。此外，身处森林之中时，树木会为你让开道路，使你通行无阻。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Arvore may greatly speed plant growth.  With enough practice, you will even be able to bring forth mighty trees from the dry earth.
translations: 获得这种能力后，木灵可以极大地加速植物的生长。通过足够的练习，你甚至可以从干燥的土地上长出参天大树。

messages.msgid: Arvore with this ability have a seed pocket on their body that over time fills with a set of from this region of the world.  Each time new seeds appear they will all be of the same type, but the types will vary at random.
translations: 拥有此能力的木灵身上有一个种子囊，它会随着时间推移，逐渐装满一批产自此地的种子。每次生成新种子时，它们都属于同一类型，但具体类型会随机变化。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Arvore may create structures of living wood on natural terrain.
translations: 获得这种能力后，木灵可以在自然地形上建造活木结构。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to draw on the peace and strength of nature while standing in a wild area.
translations: 获得这种能力后，木灵就能够在野外站立时汲取自然的和平与力量。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to summon thick tangles of briars to form walls or entrap their enemies.
translations: 在获得这个技能后，木灵就可以召唤厚厚的蒺藜组成城墙或诱捕他们的敌人。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to transport themselves from tree to nearby tree while within a forest.
translations: 获得此能力后，木灵就能够在森林中将自己从一棵树传送到附近的一棵树。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to induce decay and dissolution in the surrounding area.
translations: 获得此能力后，木灵获得了在周围区域引起腐烂和溶解的能力。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to summon a wood spirit.
translations: 获得此能力后，木灵获得了召唤木精的能力。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability, the Arvore gains the ability to summon semitangible roots that will shatter walls and furniture.
translations: 获得此能力后，木灵获得了召唤半实体根的能力，可以粉碎墙壁和家具。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability, the Arvore gains the ability to travel great distances, even dozens of miles, in moments, as long as they start and end their journey within the depths of a forest.
translations: 获得此能力后，木灵便可在瞬息之间穿行遥远的距离，甚至远达数十里，只要旅途的起点和终点都位于森林深处。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability, the Arvore gains the ability to cause rapid plant growth in a radius around themselves.
translations: 获得此能力后，木灵便可令周遭半径范围内的植物急速生长。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to bind their soul to the heart of the forest, rebirthing themselves when on the verge of death.
translations: 获得这种能力后，木灵就能将自己的灵魂束缚在森林的中心，在死亡边缘重生。

messages.msgid: You have bound your soul to the forest, and death will merely be a momentary inconvenience.
translations: 你已将灵魂与森林紧紧相连，死亡只是一时的不便。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to infuse their companions with the vitality of the forest.
translations: 获得这种能力后，木灵就能够为同伴注入森林的活力。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to cause grass to rapidly grow on fertile terrain, slowing their enemies.
translations: 获得此能力后，木灵便可在肥沃的土地上催生茂密的草丛，以此减缓敌人的速度。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to summon a thick climbing vine from diggable ground.
translations: 获得此能力后，木灵便可从可挖掘的地面上召唤出粗壮的攀援藤蔓。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to damage plant and fungal entities, including others of their own kind.
translations: 获得这种能力后，木灵就获得了伤害植物和真菌实体（包括其他同类）的能力。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to grow a goblin fruit when in natural areas away from civilization.
translations: 获得这项能力后，木灵在远离文明的自然区域就能培育妖精果实。

messages.msgid: The Arvore are closely tied with the forests and may commune with the trees to learn the layout of the land.  Activate this ability to enter the communion.
translations: 木灵与森林紧密相连，可以与树木交流以了解大地的布局。激活此能力即可进入交流。

messages.msgid: Drawing out the power inherent in growing wood makes weapons composed of it more deadly in your hands.  You do increased damage when wielding a weapon primarily made of wood.
translations: 你能引出活木中蕴含的力量，令你手中的木制武器更具杀伤力。当你挥舞主要由木材制成的武器时，造成的伤害会增加。

messages.msgid: With a brief effort of will, the Arvore may infuse their blood with a poison that harms any who bite them.
translations: 只要有短暂的意志努力，木灵就可以在他们的血液中注入一种毒药，伤害任何咬他们的人。

messages.msgid: The Arvore may release clouds of pollen that ruin the coordination of their enemies when breathed in.
translations: 木灵可以释放出大片花粉，敌人吸入后，身体的协调性会遭到破坏。

messages.msgid: Like a tree, you are fueled by the sun.  When standing in the sunlight, you will absorb its energy as nutrients and heal slightly faster.
translations: 就像一棵树，你的能量来自阳光。 当站在阳光下时，你会吸收阳光的能量作为养分，愈合的速度也会稍快一些。

messages.msgid: Like a tree, you are fueled by the sun.  When standing in the sunlight, you will absorb its energy as nutrients, heal slightly faster, and your mana regenerates much quicker.
translations: 就像一棵树，你的能量来源于阳光。 当站在阳光下时，你会吸收阳光的能量作为养分，愈合速度会稍快，魔力再生也会更快。

messages.msgid: Your energy changes with the seasons: in spring and summer, you're more awake and need less sleep, and the reverse is true in autumn and winter.
translations: 你的精力会随着季节更迭：春夏之时，你神清气爽，所需睡眠更少；秋冬之际则反之。

messages.msgid: Like a tree, you draw nourishment from the sun and the soil.  When standing in the sunlight and on natural terrain, you absorb its energy as food.  You still need to drink water and you will still get hungry.
translations: 就像一棵树，你从阳光和土壤中汲取养分。 当你站在阳光下，站在自然的土地上，你会吸收阳光的能量作为食物。 你仍然需要喝水，仍然会感到饥饿。

messages.msgid: Filled with the energy of life, pain does not affect you as strongly.
translations: 充满生命的能量，疼痛对你的影响就不会那么强烈。

messages.msgid: At will, you can extend a cluster of grasping vines to grab one target and drag them in.  They have a range equal to 1/2 your Dexterity.
translations: 只要愿意，你可以伸出一团贪婪的藤蔓，抓住一个目标并将它拖近身边。范围等于你敏捷的1/2。

messages.msgid: At will, you can transform your hands into jagged wooden claws.  They are potent weapons but make anything other than combat more difficult.
translations: 你可以随意将双手变成锯齿状的木爪。 它们是有力的武器，但会使战斗以外的任何事情变得更加困难。

messages.msgid: Your hands are transformed into jagged wooden claws.  You can use them to attack, but performing mundane tasks will be harder.
translations: 你的双手会变成锯齿状的木爪。 你可以用它们进行攻击，但执行日常任务会更加困难。

messages.msgid: Plants lose their leaves in winter, but that does not kill them, they simply sleep until the spring comes.  The cold bothers you less now.
translations: 植物在冬天落叶，但这并不会杀死它们，它们只是睡到春天来。现在感冒不那么让你烦恼了。

messages.msgid: Pine trees keep their leaves even in the coldest winter.  The cold bothers you now not at all.
translations: 即使在最寒冷的冬天，松树也能保持叶子的生长。 现在，寒冷已经完全不再困扰你了。

messages.msgid: By the places of the sun and the moon, you can always tell exactly what time it is, as long as you're not underground.
translations: 通过观测日月的位置，只要你不在地下，你永远能知道现在的时间。

messages.msgid: The wilderness welcomes you as one of its own, and you have an easier time surviving there and making things from its bounty.  +1.5 Survival skill.
translations: 荒野欢迎你成为它的一员，你会更容易在那里生存，并从它的恩惠中获得东西。+1.5生存技能。

messages.msgid: Like green wood, you can bend your limbs easily.  You gain a +4 bonus to Dexterity.
translations: 就像绿枝一样，你的四肢很容易弯曲。 你会获得 +4 的敏捷。

messages.msgid: Like the seedling poking through the soil, you have great strength hidden within you.  +1 Strength.
translations: 就像探出土壤的幼苗一样，你的体内蕴藏着强大的力量。 +1 力量。

messages.msgid: Like the young tree reaching for the sun, your limbs are filled with power.  +3 Strength.
translations: 就像那棵朝向太阳的小树，你的四肢充满了力量。+3力量。

messages.msgid: Like forest giants that have stood for a hundred years, you are unshakeable.  +5 Strength.
translations: 你就像屹立百年的森林巨人，不可动摇。 力量 +5

messages.msgid: When one tree in a grove is attacked by insects, soon all trees will produce the deterrent.  +3 Perception.
translations: 当小树林中的一棵树受到昆虫攻击时，很快所有的树都会感知。 +3 感知

messages.msgid: The forest recognizes your kinship and will hide you beneath its boughs.  When in a forest or in thick foliage, enemies will have a harder time spotting you.
translations: 森林认可你的血脉，愿将你藏于枝叶之下。身处森林或茂密草木之中时，敌人将更难发现你的踪迹。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Arvore's eyes begin reflecting the seasons: a bright yellow-green in spring; verdant green in summer; red, yellow, or orange in autumn, and dark brown in winter.  Glare no longer impacts them.
translations: 获得这种能力后，木灵的眼睛就会开始反映四季的变化：春天是明亮的黄绿色；夏天是苍翠的绿色；秋天是红色、黄色或橙色；冬天是深褐色。 眩光不再影响它们。

messages.msgid: The Arvore's ears are longer and pointed, more "leaf-shaped."  While they cannot hear any better, like the trees in the deep forest, they are unphased by loud sounds.
translations: 木灵的耳朵更长更尖，更像 "树叶"。 虽然它们听力不好，但就像森林深处的树木一样，它们不会被巨大的声音吓到。

messages.msgid: The Arvore's blood is now composed of sap and vegetable matter.  This does not benefit or harm them in any ways, but humans will be discomfited by it.
translations: 木灵的血液现在由树液和植物物质组成。 这对它们没有任何好处或坏处，但人类会因此感到不适。

messages.msgid: The Arvore's blood is a sticky sap that oozes rather than gushes from their wounds.  They will bleed more slowly than normal.
translations: 木灵的血液是一种粘稠的汁液，从伤口中渗出而不是涌出。他们的出血速度比正常人慢。

messages.msgid: The Arvore's blood is a sticky sap that oozes rather than gushes from their wounds and has potent defensive properties.  They will bleed more slowly than normal and are immune to parasites and infection.
translations: 木灵的血液是一种粘稠的汁液，从伤口渗出而不是涌出，具有强大的防御特性。它们出血更慢，并且对寄生虫和感染免疫。

messages.msgid: The Arvore's blood is a sticky sap that oozes rather than gushes from their wounds and aggressively fights back against invading organisms.  They will bleed much more slowly than normal, are immune to parasites and infection, and cannot be transformed by the Mycus.
translations: 木灵的血液是黏稠的树汁，自伤口缓缓渗出而非喷涌而出，并能主动抗击入侵的有机体。它们的流血速度远慢于常人，对寄生虫与感染免疫，且无法被蕈人转化。

messages.msgid: At will, the Arvore can grow long vines from their shoulders and back.  They can be used to climb or to lash at enemies, and can also be detached to serve as a rope if necessary.  Activate to toggle vines on and off.
translations: 你可以随意从肩膀和背部长出长长的藤蔓。它们可以用来攀爬或鞭打敌人，必要时也可以分离成绳子。激活以打开和关闭藤蔓。

messages.msgid: In the whispers of the leaves and the movement of the grasses, the forest warns you of nearby creatures.  While the forest can distinguish between a bird and a zombie, some fine distinctions are still lost to it.
translations: 在叶片的私语和草丛的摇曳中，森林向你警示着附近的生物。虽然森林能够分辨飞鸟与丧尸，但仍无法做出某些更精细的区分。

messages.msgid: In the whispers of the leaves and the movement of the grasses, the forest warns you of nearby creatures.  While the forest can distinguish between a bird and a zombie, some fine distinctions are still lost to it.  Also, you can see further when you're standing in a forest.
translations: 在叶片的私语和草丛的摇曳中，森林向你警示着附近的生物。虽然森林能够分辨飞鸟与丧尸，但仍无法做出某些更精细的区分。此外，当你身处森林时，视野会变得更开阔。

messages.msgid: Your hair now has flowers and small vines and leaves growing in it.  It's pleasant to look at but has no further game effect.
translations: 你的头发上现在长出了花朵、小藤蔓和叶子。 这很好看，但对游戏没有进一步的影响。

messages.msgid: The flowers in your hair produce a pleasant smell, obvious without being overpowering.  You no longer smell anything like a human and other beings will react to you appropriately.
translations: 你头发上的花朵会散发出令人愉悦的香味，明显而不刺鼻。 你闻起来不再像人类，其他人也会对你做出适当的反应。

messages.msgid: Every rose has its thorn and so do you.  With a moment's concentration, you can exude thorns through your skin that have a chance of damaging attackers while increasing the damage of your unarmed attacks.  However, you cannot wear rigid armor over your thorns.
translations: 每朵玫瑰都有它的刺，你也一样。 只要集中片刻的注意力，你就能通过皮肤散发出荆棘，有几率对攻击者造成伤害，同时增加你徒手攻击的伤害。 不过，你不能在刺上穿戴坚硬的盔甲。

messages.msgid: You are exuding thorns through your skin that have a chance of damaging attackers while increasing the damage of your unarmed attacks.  However, you cannot wear rigid armor over your thorns.
translations: 你的皮肤会刺出荆棘，有几率对攻击者造成伤害，同时增加你徒手攻击的伤害。 不过，你不能在荆棘上穿戴坚硬的护甲。

messages.msgid: The flowers in your hair produce an intoxicating smell.  You no longer smell anything like a human and other beings will react to you appropriately.  You can enhance this scent to an overpowering level, beguiling humans and making them more suggestible at the cost of greatly increasing the range at which others can smell you.
translations: 你发间的花朵散发出醉人的芬芳。你闻起来再也不像人类，其他生物也会因此对你做出相应的反应。你可以将这股香气强化到令人沉醉的程度，以此迷惑人类，让他们更容易受到暗示，但代价是你的气味散播范围也会因此大增。

messages.msgid: When in wild areas, you can draw on the revitalizing power of the land to heal yourself.  When in natural areas, your limbs will heal much faster.
translations: 在野外，你可以借助土地的活力来治愈自己。 在自然环境中，你的肢体会愈合得更快。

messages.msgid: You may transform into a tree, extending roots and spreading leaves out to the sun.  You will heal faster, gain more benefit from sleep, and almost all monsters will ignore you, but you will only be dimly aware of the outside world and will be nearly unable to move.
translations: 你可以变成一棵树，伸展树根和向太阳展开树叶。 你会更快地痊愈，从睡眠中获得更多益处，几乎所有的怪物都会无视你，但你只能模糊地感知外界，几乎无法移动。

messages.msgid: You are a tree.  You will heal much more quickly and resting is more beneficial.  You are unable to see, hear, or move, but have a dim awareness of nearby movement.
translations: 你是一棵树。 你的伤口会愈合得更快，休息也更有益。 你看不到、听不到或动不了，但能模糊地感知到附近的动静。

messages.msgid: Like a tree, you are fueled by the sun.  When standing in the sunlight, you will absorb its energy as nutrients, heal slightly faster, your mana regenerates much quicker, and you gain a bonus to your maximum mana.
translations: 就像一棵树，你的能量来源于阳光。 当你站在阳光下时，你会吸收阳光的能量作为养分，愈合速度会稍快，魔力值的再生速度也会更快，而且你还会获得最大魔力值的加成。

messages.msgid: Like a tree, you are fueled by the sun.  When standing in the sunlight, you will absorb its energy as nutrients, heal slightly faster, your mana regenerates much quicker, you gain a bonus to your maximum mana, and you gain a +2 bonus to all stats.
translations: 就像一棵树，你的能量来源于阳光。 当你站在阳光下时，你会吸收阳光的能量作为养分，治疗速度会稍快一些，魔力值的再生速度会更快，你的最大魔力值会获得加成，所有属性都会获得 +2 加成。

messages.msgid: Insinuate yourself into a feral human's mind, tricking them into thinking you are an ally.
translations: 潜入一个野人的心智，使其误以为你是盟友。

messages.msgid: Calling the Lost and the Damned
Feral humans come to your aid.
translations: 无名的迷失者们前来援助你。

messages.msgid: Sometimes, it is best to focus on the positive.  This spell increases the Homullus's mood when cast.
translations: 有时人最好往积极的那面想。 施放该法术能提升仿灵人心情。

messages.msgid: Though the teeming masses of humanity are gone, the Homullus can evoke their anonymizing essence with magick, rendering them invisible to any humans affected by the spell.
translations: 尽管熙攘的人潮早已散去，仿灵人仍能通过魔法唤起那种隐于人群的精萃，从而让受此法术影响的人类无法看到自己。

messages.msgid: Weaving this glamour will allow you to sense the presence of nearby vampires.
translations: 编织这道幻术，你就能感知到附近吸血鬼的存在。

messages.msgid: You mutter a charm under your breath and feel for those who subsist on stolen blood.
translations: 你低声念诵咒语，探知那些以窃血为生的存在。

messages.msgid: Weave a cloak of glamour around a target, making it more difficult for enemies to spot them.  This is not invisibility, and getting to close to a hostile target will allow them to see through the magick.
translations: 将一件魔法披风缠绕在目标上，使自己更难被发现。这不是隐形，敌对的目标能在被接近时看穿魔法。

messages.msgid: Fueled by the power charging your leylines, touch a target to restore some of the power in a vehicle or power grid.
translations: 借助为你地脉充能的力量，触摸一个目标，为车辆或电网恢复部分电力。

messages.msgid: Unlike plants or animals, humans study subjects unrelated to survival.  This spell focuses the Homullus's mind, allowing easier learning.
translations: 与动植物不同，人类会研究与生存无关的课题。此法术能集中仿灵人的心神，使其学习起来更加轻松。

messages.msgid: With the aid of a bit of fae magick, you may find a goblin fruit abandoned among the ruins.  Goblin fruit have a variety of effects, never predictable but always at least somewhat beneficial.  This spell may only be cast in the remnants of civilization.
translations: 在精灵魔法的帮助下，你可能在废墟中找到无主的妖精果实。 果实的效果多种多样，虽然无法预测，但至少能带来一些益处。 此咒语只能在文明的遗迹中施放。

messages.msgid: Humanity crisscrossed the Earth with roads, first small tracks, then earthen projects, and finally mighty asphalt webs upon which billions of people traveled every day.  The Homullus can stand on the remnants of that web and return to any remaining locus of civilization that they have attuned to.
translations: 人类曾在地球上建起纵横交错的道路网：起初是羊肠小道，然后是土石路，最终是每天有数十亿人穿行的宏伟沥青巨网。仿灵人可以站在这些路网的残迹之上，返回任意一个已与之共鸣的文明中心。

messages.msgid: All Roads Lead to Rome Attunement
Attune to a location for later traveling.  You must attune at one of the remaining bastions of civilization or concentrations of humanity.
translations: 与一处地点同调，以便日后旅行。你必须在尚存的文明堡垒或人类聚集地之一进行同调。

messages.msgid: Your skin has turned pearlescent white, similar to antique dolls.  This has no gameplay effects.
translations: 你皮肤的颜色变成珠光般的白，就像古董娃娃那样。这一变异对游戏方面没有影响。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Homullus's eyes begin change to look like doll's eyes, always staring at the world.  Glare no longer impacts them.
translations: 获得这种能力后，仿灵人的眼睛开始变得像洋娃娃的眼睛，永远注视着世界。眩光不再对他们产生影响。

messages.msgid: 'Men were deceivers ever,' as the quotation runs.  To be human is to be a liar.  You are much more successful at lying to people now.
translations: "人天性是骗子"，莎翁如是说。人生来就要骗人。你现在更会骗人了。

messages.msgid: With this ability, the Homullus can reach out to a feral's fractured mind and twist it, convincing them to function as an ally.
translations: 凭借此能力，仿灵人能触及失控者的破碎心智并加以扭曲，说服其转变立场，成为盟友。

messages.msgid: The Dollkin has resistance to attacks on its ability to act on it's choices.
translations: 人偶裔对于那些企图干涉其抉择能力的攻击拥有抗性。

messages.msgid: Your powers enhance your mundane senses and allow you to detect human beings.
translations: 你的力量强化了你的凡俗感官，使你能够察觉到人类的存在。
你在此处感知到了人类。

messages.msgid: This and other abilities native to Dollkin suggest that if vampires did create cities to concentrate their prey, something evolved afterwards to complicate the hunting grounds.
translations: 人偶裔的这项能力，以及其他与生俱来的天赋，都暗示着：即便吸血鬼真的曾为聚集猎物而建立城市，之后亦有某种存在应运而生，使这片猎场变得波谲云诡。

messages.msgid: The world crawls with the hungry dead and those who may as well be dead while they still live.  This allows the Homullus to call one of the latter to their side.
translations: 这个世界遍布着饥渴的死者，以及那些虽生犹死的行尸走肉。此能力可让仿灵人将后者之一召唤至身侧。

messages.msgid: A habit of lying is hard to break, even when, or especially when, talking to oneself.  This trait grants the Homullus a spell that allows them to smooth out any negative moods they experience.
translations: 人一旦习惯说谎便难以改口，即使是在自言自语的时候。不如说，尤其是在自言自语的时候。这一特性赋予仿灵人一种法术，让他们能够消除任何负面情绪。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Homullus gains the ability to render themselves invisible to humans.
translations: 获得此能力后，仿灵人便能使自身在人类眼中隐形。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Homullus gains the ability to render one of their allies inconspicuous.
translations: 获得此能力后，仿灵人便能使自己的一名盟友变得不引人注目。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Homullus gains the ability to recharge vehicles or power grids.
translations: 获得此能力后，仿灵人便能为载具或电网充能。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Homullus gains the ability to focus their mind to increase their learning ability.
translations: 获得此能力后，仿灵人就能集中注意力以提高学习能力。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Homullus gains the ability to travel along a road to any bastion of civilization they have attuned to.
translations: 获得此能力后，仿灵人便能沿路行进，前往任何已与之同调的文明堡垒。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Homullus gains the ability to find a goblin fruit when in the remnants of civilization.
translations: 获得此能力后，仿灵人就能在文明的遗迹中找到妖精果实。

messages.msgid: The Homullus gains the ability to stop emitting scent at will.  They can use this to control when scent-tracking creatures will be able to find them.
translations: 仿灵人获得了随意消除自身气味的能力，他们可以利用这个能力来躲避能追踪气味的生物。

messages.msgid: At will, you can recede from the foreground of people's perceptions.  They will still notice you if you make yourself known.  Conversation with actual humans will be harder while this trait is active.
translations: 从人们的视野中随意消失并不是难事。当然，假如说你做些引人注目的事，他们还是会发现你的。当这一特性被激活时，与真人对话会变得更加困难。

messages.msgid: You have faded into the background.
Your flesh and bones can instinctively shift to allow manually installing cybernetics.  You no longer need external aid to install CBMs.
translations: 你的血肉和骨骼可以本能地移动，以便手动安装义体。你不再需要外部协助来安装 CBM。

messages.msgid: Your leylines have begun adapting to electronic interference.  Halves the mana penalty caused by stored bionic power.
translations: 你的魔脉已开始适应了电子干扰。储存生化能量引发的魔力上限惩罚减半。

messages.msgid: Your leylines have fully adapted to electronic interference.  You no longer suffer any mana penalty for stored bionic power.
translations: 你的魔脉已经完全适应了电子干扰。你的魔力上限再也不会因储存生化能量而降低了。

messages.msgid: You are capable of storing power directly in your flesh.  You gain 50 kJ of bionic power storage per Homullus trait you have.
translations: 你能够将能量直接储存在你的血肉之中。你拥有的每一项仿灵人特性，都能为你增加50千焦的仿生电容。

messages.msgid: Humans are flimsy creatures compared to even natural animals, yet by crafting armor they obtain durability that unthinking creatures will never reach.  You draw on this legacy, increasing the strength of armor you wear by 20%
translations: 与寻常野兽相比，人类亦属脆弱，但他们凭借打造的甲胄获得了浑噩之物永远无法企及的耐久。你承袭了这份遗产，使你穿戴甲胄的强度提升20%。

messages.msgid: You embody the tales of ancient knights, increasing the strength of armor you wear by 40%.
translations: 你仿佛化身为古代骑士传说的化身，使你穿戴甲胄的强度提升40%。

messages.msgid: You conceptually harden your tools and armor, reducing the chance that they are damaged.
translations: 你可以从概念上硬化你的工具和盔甲，降低它们受损的概率。

messages.msgid: You conceptually harden your tools and armor, immensely reducing the chance that they are damaged.
translations: 你可以从概念上硬化你的工具和盔甲，大幅降低它们受损的概率。

messages.msgid: Though much of humanity has died, their echoes remain in the places they once called home.  The Homullus can draw on those echoes to restore their bionic power.
translations: 尽管大部分人已经死亡，他们的回声仍然停留在他们称为家的地方。仿灵人可以利用他们的回声以恢复生化能量。

messages.msgid: Though much of humanity has died, their echoes remain in the places they once called home.  The Homullus can draw on those echoes to restore their bionic power and mana.
translations: 尽管大部分人已经死亡，他们的回声仍然停留在他们称为家的地方。仿灵人可以利用他们的回声以恢复生化能量和魔力。

messages.msgid: You are at home in the artificial environments constructed by humanity.  You move slightly faster within.
translations: 你自在地生活在人类创造的人工环境中。在其中你的移动稍微变快了。

messages.msgid: Early humans chased prey for miles before it dropped dead from exhaustion, and the Homullus is heir to that legacy.  You have 33% more stamina.
translations: 早期人类能追逐猎物数里，直至其力竭倒毙，而仿灵人正是这份遗产的继承者。你的耐力提升33%。

messages.msgid: By standing together, humanity was able to overcome all threats, and it was only when they turned on each other that the Cataclysm grew out of control.  The Homullus regains Stamina 5% faster per ally within 30 meters (10% faster per ally if they have the Homullus trait).
translations: 通过团结一致，人类得以战胜所有威胁，而一旦自相残杀，大灾变才会蔓延失控。在30米范围内，每存在一名盟友，仿灵人便会获得5%的耐力恢复速度提升（如果盟友同样拥有仿灵人特性的话则提升10%）。

messages.msgid: The Top of the Food Chain

Humanity are omnivores in the most literal sense.  You can eat anything not human without any moral qualms.  However, the food that pre-Cataclysm humanity would slowly poison themselves with is anathema to you, and you will eat only good-tasting food unless you are starving.
translations: 人类是字面意义上最彻底的杂食动物。你可以毫无道德负担地吃掉任何非人之物。然而，大灾变前人类用来慢性毒害自己的那些食物，于你却是禁忌之物，除非饥肠辘辘，否则你只愿享用珍馐。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm there were cities all across the world.  From above the Arctic Circle to directly on the equator, humanity built their dwellings.  You are more comfortable with temperature extremes.
translations: 大灾变前，城市遍布世界。从北极圈之上到赤道之畔，人类建起了自己的居所。你对极端温度的耐受性更强。

messages.msgid: Though they had no claws or fangs or armored skin, humanity mastered the world through their tools.  When near civilization, your crafting speed is increased.
translations: 人类虽无利爪、尖牙或坚甲，却凭借工具主宰了世界。身处文明遗迹附近时，你的制作速度会得到提升。

messages.msgid: Though they had no claws or fangs or armored skin, humanity mastered the world through their tools.  When near civilization, your crafting speed and ability are increased.
translations: 人类虽无利爪、尖牙或坚甲，却凭借工具主宰了世界。身处文明遗迹附近时，你的制作速度和技艺会得到提升。

messages.msgid: Though they had no claws or fangs or armored skin, humanity mastered the world through their tools.  When near civilization, your crafting speed and ability are greatly increased.
translations: 人类虽无利爪、尖牙或坚甲，却凭借工具主宰了世界。身处文明遗迹附近时，你的制作速度和技艺会得到极大提升。

messages.msgid: With their tools, humanity built weapons, grew food, made homes, and tamed the wilderness.  The Homullus has internalized that essence into themselves, allowing them to use their bare hands to accomplish many tasks that would otherwise require tools.
translations: 通过工具，人类制造了武器，培育食物，建造房屋，并征服了荒野。仿灵人将这种精萃内化进自身，允许它们空手完成许多本来其他人使用工具才能完成的任务。
