messages.msgid: While some other animals use simple tools, complex machinery is humanity's legacy alone.  The Homullus can log into a computer or hack electronics with but a touch.
translations: 当某些动物仅能使用简单的工具时，人类早已留下了独属于自己的复杂机械。仿灵人可以一触之间登入电脑或者骇入电子设备。

messages.msgid: As a spirit of humanity, you lack the natural biology required for mutagens to function.  However, your powers have grown far enough to allow you to use even the most abstract of human tools, allowing you to consume mutagens to change your body.  Unlike humans, however, there are thresholds you will never be able to reach, and should you choose this route, further development of your native spirit powers will be closed off to you.
translations: 作为人类精神的化身，你缺乏突变原生效所需的自然生理基础。然而，你的力量已成长到足以让你使用哪怕最为抽象的人类工具，从而得以通过吞食突变原来改变自己的身体。但与人类不同，有些门槛你永远无法企及，而一旦选择此道，你与生俱来的灵力也将再无精进之途。

messages.msgid: You have chosen the path of human mutation and further Homullus mutation is closed off to you.  You should not see this in-game.
Early humans chased prey for miles before it dropped dead from exhaustion, and the Homullus is heir to that legacy.  You have 33% more stamina and you can run for much longer before tiring.
translations: 早期人类能追逐猎物数里，直至其力竭倒毙，而仿灵人正是这份遗产的继承者。你的耐力提升33%，且奔跑更久才会感到疲惫。

messages.msgid: One person may die, but their compatriots will carry their torch.  You too will have your legacy maintained if you die, but in a way far less metaphorical.  When you die, you will reincarnate within any nearby human, immediately shifting their form to match your own.  You will not be able to do this more than once per month.
translations: 一人倒下，自有同伴高举其火炬；当你逝去，传承亦将延续——延续得远远更加直接。你死亡时，你的意识将在附近任意人类中重生，顷刻将其形体重塑为你的模样。每月仅能触发一次。

messages.msgid: You may transform yourself into a doll in truth, ignoring the needs of the flesh and making most monsters less likely to attack you.  However, your stiff limbs will inhibit your movement.
translations: 你可以化身为真正的人偶，从而无视肉身需求，并使大多数怪物更倾向于忽略你。然而，你僵硬的肢体会妨碍你的行动。

messages.msgid: You are a doll in truth.  You do not need to eat or drink, and monsters will mostly ignore you, but you do not heal at all and crafting, as well as movement over any ground not almost-perfectly flat, is very difficult due to your stiff limbs.
translations: 你已是真正的人偶。你无需饮食，怪物大多也会无视你，但你无法自愈，且因肢体僵硬，制作物品以及在非平坦地面上移动都将变得异常困难。

messages.msgid: Anger relations are here in a separate mutation so that they're removed on attacking a target or moving too quickly.
This blocks you from gaining the anger relations mutation so you can't just turn Mien of the Mannequin on and off between attacks.
Stomp on the ground and cause a minor local earthquake, damaging buildings and knocking anyone nearby off their feet.
translations: 践踏地面，造成小型的局部地震，破坏建筑并击退附近的每一个人。

messages.msgid: You stomp the ground and it quakes!
translations: 你猛跺地面，大地随之震颤！

messages.msgid: While on living earth or stone, the Ierde may infuse their body with fae iron, slowing their movement and attacks but rendering them much safer from harm.
translations: 只要身处有生命的大地或岩石之上，土妖精便能将妖精之铁注入体内，此举虽会减缓其行动与攻击速度，却能大大降低所受伤害。

messages.msgid: You infuse yourself with the resilience of the earth.
translations: 你为自身注入了大地的坚韧。

messages.msgid: With the force of a landslide behind it, punch a single target and knock them backwards.
translations: 崩山之力寄宿其后，拳击一个目标并将其击退。

messages.msgid: You wide up and deliver a punch with the strength of a rockslide.
translations: 你抡圆了拳头并打出了具有山崩地裂之力的一拳。

messages.msgid: Commune with the earth, whispering to it to reveal its secrets to you.  This spell will reveal natural features within a large radius around the Ierde.  The spell must be cast while standing on the living earth.
translations: 与大地通感，低语相询，探其奥秘。此法术将揭示土妖精周边大范围内的自然地貌，施法时必须立于有生命的大地之上。

messages.msgid: You can mold earth like clay, turning it to stone and back, or raising it and lowering it into pits or ramps or walls.
translations: 你能如抟土般塑造大地，使其化为岩石或归于尘土，亦能升起地面，或使其下陷为坑洞、斜坡与墙壁。

messages.msgid: The earth moves at your command
Infuse your enemies with the rigidity of stone, slowing their movements.
translations: 向你的敌人注入岩石之僵，使其行动迟缓。

messages.msgid: Infuse the resilience of the earth into one of your allies.  Their skin will repel some of the physical damage they take, and they will be more resistant to losing blood, but they will be slightly slower due to the magicks.
translations: 为你的盟友注入大地的坚韧。其肌肤将能抵御部分物理伤害，且更不易流失血液，但受魔法影响，行动会稍显迟缓。

messages.msgid: While standing on the living earth or stone, infuse your skin with the hardness of bedrock.  You will take no damage at all while the spell is in effect, though repeated blows can wear through the shield until it breaks.
translations: 立于有生命的大地或岩石之上，为你的皮肤注入基岩的硬度。法术生效期间，你将不会受到任何伤害，但反复的打击会不断磨损这层护佑，直至其破碎。

messages.msgid: Summon up a series of spikes around a single target, imprisoning them in a cage of stone.  The target must be on earth or stone for the spell to take effect.
translations: 在单个目标周围召唤出一圈地刺，将其禁锢于岩石囚笼之中。目标必须身处大地或岩石之上，法术方能生效。

messages.msgid: Calling the Children of the Stones
A lesser earth elemental is summoned to support you.
translations: 一个低级的土元素被召唤来支持你。

messages.msgid: Open the ground beneath your enemies' feet, dumping them into pits.
translations: 在你敌人脚下敞开大地，将他们尽数坠入陷坑。

messages.msgid: Traveling the Veins of the Earth

The earth is crisscrossed with fissures, with layers of rock and veins of metal, and deeper, with flows of molten rock.  The Ierde can flow along those paths, traveling deep within the earth to any point they have previously been to.
translations: 大地之中裂隙纵横，岩层与矿脉交错，更深处还有熔岩奔流。土妖精能沿此路径而行，在地底深处穿行至任何曾到过的地方。

messages.msgid: You may spin a bit of fae magic into the earth, bringing forth a goblin fruit.  Goblin fruit have a variety of effects, never predictable but always at least somewhat beneficial.  This spell may only be cast on earth or stone.
translations: 你可以向大地中注入一点精灵魔法，结出妖精果实。 果实的效果多种多样，虽然无法预测，但至少能带来一些益处。 此咒语只能在大地或岩石上施放。

messages.msgid: Your skin has turned the color of manganese stained soil.  Your skin is now a purplish black.  This has no gameplay effects.
translations: 你的皮肤变成了锰污染土壤的颜色。 你的皮肤现在呈紫黑色。 这对游戏没有影响。

messages.msgid: Your skin has toughened and formed pebble-like growths in some places, acting as natural armor.  Somewhat reduces wet effects.
translations: 你的皮肤已经变硬，并且在某些地方形成了卵石状的生长物，充当天然的盔甲。一定程度上减少了潮湿的影响。

messages.msgid: Your skin has developed into strong granite-like covering that retains some flexibility and has grown to cover most of your body, acting as natural armor.  While difficult to penetrate, it also limits your flexibility.  Greatly reduces wet effects.
translations: 你的皮肤已经发展成坚固的花岗岩状覆盖物，保留了一定的灵活性，并且已经覆盖了你身体的大部分，虽然难以被穿透，但它也限制了你的灵活性。极大减少湿身惩罚。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Ierde's eyes begin reflecting their mood: a pale white streaked with rose when happy; pale green or grey when calm, and pure obsidian black when angry.  Glare no longer impacts them and they are not bothered by light levels when sleeping.
translations: 获得此能力后，土妖精的双眼会开始映照其心绪：开心时，双眼会呈现出带有玫瑰色条纹的灰白；平静时，则是淡绿或灰色；而愤怒时，会化为纯粹的黑曜石之色。强光不再能影响他们，睡眠时也不会再被光亮所困扰。

messages.msgid: The Ierde's ears are longer and pointed, like the peak of a high mountain.  They can hear slightly better and are unphased by loud sounds.
translations: 土妖精的耳朵又长又尖，像高山的峰顶。他们的听力稍微好一些，对大声的声音不敏感

messages.msgid: The Ierde's stony skin makes their fists hit like hammers.  Though their attacks are slower, the Ierde does more bashing damage with punches and can use their hands to replace some simple tools.
translations: 土妖精的岩石皮肤使其拳击如锤。尽管攻击速度有所减慢，但土妖精的拳头能造成更高的钝击伤害，双手甚至能替代一些简易工具。

messages.msgid: Just as their body is now one with the stone, the Ierde can infuse the strength of the earth into their equipment, rendering it more resilient.  While on natural earth or stone or underground, the Ierde's equipment is twice as difficult to damage.
translations: 正如其身已与岩石合一，土妖精也能将大地的力量注入他们的装备，使其更具韧性。只要身处自然大地、岩石之上或地下，土妖精的装备将变得加倍坚固，不易受损。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Ierde gains the ability to, while underground, rest and recover energy as though sleeping.  Activate to begin the vigil.
translations: 获得此能力后，土妖精便能在身处地下时，通过休息来恢复精力，效果等同于睡眠。启用即可开始守望。

messages.msgid: The Soil Knows Those Who Tread Upon It
Upon gaining this ability the Ierde gains the ability to sense the movements of nearby creatures, as long as they maintains contact with natural earth or stone, or are underground.
translations: 获得此能力后，只要与自然大地或岩石保持接触，或身处地下，土妖精便能感知到附近生物的动向。

messages.msgid: The Ierde's ability to sense small movements is heightened to such a degree that with small movements of their fingers, they can sense the exact shape and position of objects nearby.  They can craft in darkness, as long as "The Soil Knows Those Who Tread Upon It" is active.
translations: 土妖精对微小动静的感知能力已登峰造极，只需指尖微动，便能探知附近物体的确切形状与位置。只要“踏土留痕，大地知闻”处于激活状态，他们便能在黑暗中制作物品。

messages.msgid: With a brief moment to stabilize themselves, the Ierde strikes a wall, door, or other terrain feature with the force of a falling boulder, doing many times their normal damage.
translations: 土妖精稍作蓄力，便可对墙壁、门扉或其它地形施以重击，其力道堪比巨石坠落，造成的伤害远超寻常。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Ierde gains the ability to stomp on the ground and cause a minor local earthquake.
translations: 获得此能力后，土妖精就能践踏地面，造成小型局部地震。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Ierde gains the ability to strike an enemy with a blow that does extra damage and knocks them backwards.
translations: 习得此技后，土妖精便可对敌人施以重击，造成额外伤害并将其击退。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Ierde gains the ability to learn the terrain layout in a large area around themselves.
translations: 习得此技后，土妖精便可探知周遭大片区域的地形布局。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Ierde gains the ability to create large pits on diggable ground, dumping their enemies into them.
translations: 习得此技后，土妖精便可在可挖掘的地面上制造巨大的陷坑，并将敌人坠入其中。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Ierde may infuse the rigidity of stone into their enemies, slowing their movements.
translations: 习得此技后，土妖精便可将岩石般的凝滞注入敌人体内，减缓其行动。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Ierde may reshape the earth, raising or lowering earth or stone or turning the one into the other.
translations: 习得此技后，土妖精便可重塑大地，不仅能升降土石，更能将其相互转化。

messages.msgid: Allows the Ierde to summon a minor earth elemental to support them in the world for a short time.
translations: 允许土妖精召唤一只小型土元素，以支持他们现身一小段时间。

messages.msgid: Stone endures but armor is made of metal.  While standing on natural earth or stone, the Ierde can infuse their skin with metal, slowing their movement and encumbering them but rendering them much harder to damage.
translations: 岩石恒久，铠甲却是金铁所铸。当立于天然的泥土或岩石之上时，土妖精可为肌肤覆上金铁，此举虽会减缓其行动并带来累赘，却也让他们更难受到伤害。

messages.msgid: While standing on natural earth or stone, the Ierde can summon up an earthen shield to protect themselves.  They will be invulnerable until the shield breaks.
translations: 当立于天然的泥土或岩石之上时，土妖精可召唤一面土石巨盾护身。在护盾破碎前，他们将刀枪不入。

messages.msgid: When gaining this ability, the Ierde gains the ability to infuse the resilience of the earth into one of their allies.
translations: 习得此技后，土妖精便可将大地的坚韧注入一名盟友体内。

messages.msgid: An Iron Taste and an Iron Smell

The Ierde has taken the essence of iron into themselves.  They no longer smell anything like a human, smelling only like a faint whiff of iron if they have any scent at all, and can produce all their iron their body needs themselves.
translations: 土妖精已将铁之精粹融入己身。他们不再有任何人类的气味，即便有，也只是一缕淡淡的铁锈味。同时，他们的身体能自行产生所需的一切铁质。

messages.msgid: The Ierde can draw on the boundless strength of the earth, increasing their stamina.
translations: 土妖精可以利用大地的力量，增加耐力上限。

messages.msgid: The Ierde can draw even deeper on the boundless strength of the earth, greatly increasing their stamina.
translations: 土妖精可以更深入地汲取大地的力量，大幅增加耐力上限。

messages.msgid: The Ierde can draw from boundless strength of the very depths of the earth, enormously increasing their stamina.
translations: 土妖精可以从大地的最深处汲取无限的力量，极大地增加耐力上限。

messages.msgid: When underground or on natural earth, the Ierde recovers Stamina 50% faster.
translations: 当身处地下或天然的土地之上时，土妖精的耐力恢复速度提升50%。

messages.msgid: When underground or on natural earth, the Ierde recovers Stamina 50% faster and heals 33% faster.
translations: 当身处地下或天然的土地之上时，土妖精的耐力恢复速度提升50%，自愈速度提升33%。

messages.msgid: Like the stone, the Ierde suffers little from blows.  All pain is halved.
translations: 如同岩石一般，土妖精几乎感受不到打击的痛楚。所有痛楚减半。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Ierde gains the ability to sink into the living earth, where they will heal faster, they will not need to eat or drink, and sleep will be more restful for them.
translations: 在获得这种能力后，土妖精获得了沉入大地的能力，在那里他们将更快地康复，他们将不需要进食，睡眠将更加宁静。

messages.msgid: You are resting in the depths of the earth.  You should never actually see this.
The Ierde's blood has turned black and grown thick and tar-like.  They will bleed much more slowly.
translations: 土妖精的血液是浓稠的黑色液体。他们的出血速度会慢得多。

messages.msgid: The Ierde's blood has turned into a black sludge that barely flows.  They no longer bleed at all.
translations: 土妖精的血像沥青一样几乎不能流动。他们不会流血。

messages.msgid: Though the earth shivers and shakes, the mountain stands tall.  The Ierde is immune to knockback.
translations: 大地虽然颤抖，山却巍然屹立。山石裔对击退免疫。

messages.msgid: When standing on the living earth or underground, the Ierde can root themselves in place.  While doing so, they cannot move, but they are immune to being stunned, dazed, or downed, and gain additional armor.
translations: 当立于活土之上或身处地下时，土妖精可将自己扎根于原地。扎根期间，他们无法移动，但会免疫震荡、眩晕或倒地效果，并获得额外的护甲。

messages.msgid: The Ierde has some of the toughness of the earth.  +15% hit points.
translations: 土妖精拥有部分大地的坚韧。生命值上限+15%。

messages.msgid: The Ierde has some of the toughness of the stone.  +30% hit points.
translations: 土妖精拥有部分岩石的坚韧。生命值上限+30%。

messages.msgid: The Ierde has the toughness of the enduring mountains.  +45% hit points.
translations: 土妖精拥有恒久山峦般的坚韧。生命值上限+45%。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Ierde gains the ability to grow a goblin fruit from a earth or stone.
translations: 获得此能力后，土妖精就能从泥土或石头中种出妖精果实。

messages.msgid: Like the bountiful soil, the Ierde is filled with power.  +3 Strength.
translations: 就像肥沃的土壤，土妖精充满了力量。+3 力量。

messages.msgid: Like the stone, the Ierde can withstand any punishment.  +5 Strength.
translations: 就像岩石一般，土妖精可以承受任何刑罚。+5 力量。

messages.msgid: Like the mountain, the Ierde is unmoved by calamity.  +7 Strength.
translations: 就像高山一般，土妖精面对灾厄也岿然不动。+7 力量。

messages.msgid: Like the bedrock, the Ierde's might can support the entire world.  +9 Strength.
translations: 就像基岩一般，土妖精的力量足以支撑整个世界。+9 力量。

messages.msgid: Like an observer on a mountaintop, the Ierde sees more than most.  +3 Perception.
translations: 如同山巅的瞭望者，土妖精的视野远超常人。感知+3。

messages.msgid: While on living earth or stone or underground, the Ierde is as impassive as the mountains and feels no pain at all.
translations: 当立于活土、岩石之上或身处地下时，土妖精便会不动如山，感觉不到任何疼痛。

messages.msgid: The stones do not rot as the trees or humans do, and neither is the Ierde affected by the frailties of the flesh.  They are immune to disease and cannot suffer from parasites.
translations: 石头不会像树木或人类那样腐败，它们对疾病有免疫力，也不会受到寄生虫的侵害。

messages.msgid: The Ierde's mind has the resilience of iron, and they cannot be affected by delusions, hallucinations, or other mental problems.
translations: 土妖精的意志如铁一般坚韧，他们不会被妄想、幻觉或其他心理问题影响。

messages.msgid: The Ierde meditates on the nature of stone and removes themselves from the highs and lows of mortal emotions.
translations: 土妖精冥想岩石的本质，借此超脱凡人的喜怒哀乐。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Ierde gains the ability to travel through stone to another underground location they have previously been to.
translations: 习得此技后，土妖精便可穿行于岩石之中，前往另一处他们曾到访过的地下地点。

messages.msgid: The Ierde may transform into rock and earth.  They become incredibly resilient and nearly immune to some forms of damage, but will be much, much slower.
translations: 土妖精可以转化为岩石和泥土。他们变得难以置信的坚硬，而且近乎免疫某些形式的伤害，但会变得非常，非常慢。

messages.msgid: You are a mass of stone and earth.  You are incredibly resilient, but you are extremely slow.
translations: 你化身为一团土石聚合体，坚韧无比，但行动也变得极其缓慢。

messages.msgid: The Ierde is so infused with the power of stone they are approaching invincibility.  There is a small chance that attacks against them simply rebound off their rocky skin, and their limbs are so resilient that they will never break.
translations: 土妖精体内充盈着岩石之力，已近乎无敌。攻击他们的招式有微小几率会从其岩石般的皮肤上弹开，且其四肢坚韧无比，绝不会折断。

messages.msgid: You bring forth a cloud of boiling water.
translations: 你带来一团沸腾的水汽。

messages.msgid: The Wind Blows, the Willow Bends
Like the flitting wind or the flexible willow, the spell allows you to avoid attacks much more easily.  It has <color_yellow>reduced effects</color> when on artificial terrain.
translations: 如掠风，似柔柳，此法术能让你更轻易地避开攻击。在人造地形上，其效果会有所<color_yellow>减弱</color>。

messages.msgid: Like the flitting wind or the flexible willow, the spell allows you to avoid attacks much more easily.  It has <color_yellow>reduced effects</color> indoors.
translations: 如掠风，似柔柳，此法术能让你更轻易地避开攻击。在室内，其效果会有所<color_yellow>减弱</color>。

messages.msgid: Under the light of the moon, you can weave cotton into gossamer.
translations: 在月光下，你可以把棉花织成薄纱。

messages.msgid: When this spell is cast, the target will somehow begin to care about you very much and can't not help but talk to.
translations: 施放此术后，目标会莫名地开始非常在意你，并且会情不自禁地想要与你交谈。

messages.msgid: Seeming to want to talk to you
This person wants to talk with you.
A spirit of earth and stone.
A spirit of leaf and bark.
You are born of the deep waters.
A spirit of the image of humans given life.
A spirit of air and wind.
You have gained a portion of the might of your fae ancestors.  +1 Strength and Dexterity.
translations: 你获得了部分妖精先祖的力量。力量+1，敏捷+1。

messages.msgid: You have gained the might of your fae ancestors.  +2 Strength and Dexterity.
translations: 你获得了妖精先祖的力量。力量+2，敏捷+2。

messages.msgid: You have gained a portion of the wits of your fae ancestors.  +1 Intelligence and Perception.
translations: 你获得了妖精先祖的一部分智慧。+1智力与感知。

messages.msgid: You have gained the wits of your fae ancestors.  +2 Intelligence and Perception.
translations: 你获得了妖精先祖的才智。智力+2，感知+2。

messages.msgid: You can sense other nearby creatures from the Bright Lands.  Activate to enable your fae senses.  It has a small chance to cost some of your mana each turn it is in use.
translations: 你可以感知到附近来自光明之地的其他生物。激活以开启你的妖精感官。每回合都会有小概率消耗你的部分魔力。

messages.msgid: You can sense other nearby creatures from the Bright Lands.  Activate to enable your fae senses.
translations: 你可以感知到附近来自辉光之地的其他生物。激活以开启你的妖精感知。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Sylph gains the ability to create a cloud of damaging steam.
translations: 获得此能力后风妖精能够制造一团具有破坏力的蒸汽。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Undine gains the ability to create a cloud of damaging steam.
translations: 获得此技能后，水妖精可以制造破坏性蒸汽云。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Sylph gains the ability to create light.
translations: 获得此能力后风妖精能够创造光线。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Salamander gains the ability to create light.
translations: 获得这种能力后火妖精能够创造光。

messages.msgid: Your connection to this world is deep and rewards you with additional mana.
translations: 你与这个世界的联系很深，并能获得额外的魔力。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability, you gain the ability to enhance your dodge capabilities.
translations: 获得此能力后，你将获得增强闪避的能力。

messages.msgid: Like your fae ancestors, you can turn gossamer into clothing and armor.  Activate this trait to learn a gossamer recipe (once per week).
translations: 和你的异种祖先一样，你可以将月之纱变成衣服和盔甲。 激活此特性可学习一个月之纱配方（每周一次）。

messages.msgid: Your manipulation of gossamer has advanced to the point where you can make it yourself out of mundane cotton and moonlight.
translations: 你对薄纱的操控已经发展到可以用普通的棉和月光自己制作的地步。

messages.msgid: The Dollkin casts this spell to force a conversation with anyone, once.  If they've heard the Dollkin out and decided they wish not to speak again it will not work.
translations: 人偶裔施放此术以强行与任何人开启一次对话。如果对方已经听完人偶裔的话，并决定不再交谈，此法术便不会生效。

messages.msgid: This person won't speak with them again if this goes poorly.
Born from fire, it is easy for a Salamander to bring forth that fire and set something alight.
translations: 生于火焰，火妖精能轻易操纵火焰点燃某物。

messages.msgid: Wreathe your fist in flames and punch a single target, causing fire damage and knocking them backward.
translations: 用火焰包裹你的拳头击打单个目标，造成火焰伤害并将其击退。

messages.msgid: Summon a flaming whip to scourge your enemies.
translations: 召唤一条熊熊燃烧的鞭子来鞭笞你的敌人。

messages.msgid: Like fire leaping over a firebreak, you can vanish and reappear somewhere nearby, leaving a thick cloud of smoke in your former location.
translations: 就像火焰能跳过防火带一样，你可以消失然后重新出现在附近的某个地方，在原来的位置留下一团浓烟。

messages.msgid: As fire burns dead wood, you can burn away poison or sickness in your target.  However, just as fire is dangerous to touch, it damages the target as well.
translations: 如火一样烧过枯木，你可以烧掉目标身上的毒药或疾病。然而，如接触火一样危险，它也会伤害目标。

messages.msgid: Kindle a flame within the target, slowly burning them from the inside.  This spell does damage only slowly, but there is little defense against being burned from the inside out.
translations: 点燃目标内部的火焰，从内部慢慢燃烧。这个法术只会缓慢造成伤害，但由内到外的烧伤几乎无法被防御。

messages.msgid: You can infuse yourself or an ally with the blazing speed of fire.
translations: 你可以为自己或一名同伴注入炽热火焰般的速度。

messages.msgid: Like a bonfire, you can throw off large quantities of heat.
translations: 就像篝火一样，你可以散发出巨多热量。

messages.msgid: Calling the Children of the Inferno
A lesser fire spirit is summoned to support you.
translations: 召唤一个小火灵来支持你。

messages.msgid: Summon a delicate bird made of pure flame.  The bird will last only a few moments, but if it sees an enemy it will eagerly dive upon them and erupt into a fireball.
translations: 召唤一只由纯净火焰构成精致魔法鸟。这只鸟只能持续几分钟，但只要它发现敌人，就会急切地扑过去，爆炸为一团火球。

messages.msgid: You can breathe out a cloud of thick smoke, concealing your presence or causing humans to choke.
translations: 你可以呼出滚滚浓烟，借以隐藏身形，或令常人窒息。

messages.msgid: Like the legendary dragon, you can spray fire in a cone in front of you.
translations: 就像传说中的龙一样，你可以往面前的锥形区域喷射火焰。

messages.msgid: Hurl yourself forward in a burst of speed, causing an explosion at your arrive point.
translations: 把你自己以极快的速度向掷出，在目标点引发爆炸。

messages.msgid: Place a magical rune on a the ground that will explode when stepped on.
translations: 在地上放置一个魔法符文，当被踩踏时会引发爆炸。

messages.msgid: You may spin a bit of fae magick into the flames, bringing forth a goblin fruit.  Goblin fruit have a variety of effects, never predictable but always at least somewhat beneficial.  This spell may only be cast outdoors in natural surroundings.
translations: 你可以向火焰中注入一点精灵魔法，结出精怪果实。 果实的效果多种多样，虽然无法预测，但至少能带来一些益处。 此咒语只能在户外自然环境中施放。

messages.msgid: Like the rising heat of fire, you can ascend into the air and walk with the smoke for a short time before falling safely back to the earth.
translations: 就像火焰升腾的热量一样，你可以升到空中，与烟雾同行一小会儿，然后安全地落回地面。

messages.msgid: You draw on your own fiery nature and infuse a portion of it into an ally, rendering them immune to warm temperatures and fire.
translations: 你利用自己炽热如火的天性，将其中的一部分注入盟友，使他们对高温和火焰免疫。

messages.msgid: Like the rebirth of the legendary phoenix, you explode into flames, causing fire to engulf the entire nearby area.  You will heal faster for six hours after casting this spell.
translations: 你将如传说中的凤凰般浴火重生，身躯轰然爆裂为漫天烈焰，焚尽周遭一切。施放此术后六小时内，你的自愈速度将大幅提升。

messages.msgid: Your skin has turned the color of an autumnal bonfire.  Your skin is now an orange red with dark freckles.  This has no gameplay effects.
translations: 你的皮肤变成了秋天篝火的颜色。 你的皮肤现在是橙红色，并带有深色雀斑。这对游戏没有影响。

messages.msgid: Your skin has magickal flames flaring out of it on occasion.  You can operate in warmer climates than normal humans but begin to take damage from getting wet, and you always smell of smoke and ashes.
translations: 你的皮肤会适时迸发出魔法火焰。相比普通人你可以在比更温暖的气候下活动，但一旦被淋湿就会受到伤害，而且你身上总是有烟味和灰味。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Salamander gains the ability to set something nearby on fire.
translations: 获得此能力后火妖精能够能点燃附近物体。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Salamander gains the ability to rush forward and cause an explosion at the place they land.
translations: 获得此能力后火妖精能够向前冲刺并在他们着陆的地方引发爆炸。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Salamander gains the ability to lay a fiery trap which will burst into searing flames when stepped on.
translations: 火妖精在获取此能力后能够在地上设置火焰陷阱，当被踩踏时，陷阱会引爆成一团烈焰。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Salamander gains the ability to vanish in a burst of smoke and reappear somewhere nearby.
translations: 获得此能力后火妖精能够在一阵烟雾中消失然后重新出现在附近的某个地方。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Salamander gains the ability to punch a target with a fiery fist, causing damage and hurling them back.
translations: 获得此能力后火妖精能够用燃烧的拳头击打目标，造成伤害并将其击退。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Salamander gains the ability to summon a fire spirit.
translations: 获得此能力后火妖精能够召唤一只火之灵。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Salamander gains the ability to breathe out a cloud of thick smoke.
translations: 习得此技后，火妖精便可呼出滚滚浓烟。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Salamander gains the ability to breathe a cone of flames.
translations: 获得此能力后火妖精能够喷出锥形火焰。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Salamander gains the ability to summon a bird made of roaring flames to their aid.
translations: 习得此技后，火妖精便可召唤一只烈焰飞鸟前来助战。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Salamander gains the ability to increase their own or an ally's speed.
translations: 获得此能力后火妖精能够提高他们自己或一名同伴的速度。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Salamander gains the ability to summon a flaming whip to aid them in battle.
translations: 获得此能力后火妖精能够召唤燃烧的鞭子来协助他们战斗。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Salamander gains the ability to emit large quantities of heat.
translations: 获得此能力后火妖精能够散发巨多热量。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Salamander gains the ability to cure deleterious conditions at the cost of damage.
translations: 获得此能力后火妖精能够以伤害为代价治愈有害状态。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Salamander gains the ability to pluck a goblin fruit from the flames.
translations: 在获得这个技能后，火妖精就会获得从火焰中采摘妖精果实的能力。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Salamander learns how to convert water into very strong alcohol.
translations: 获得此能力后火妖精学会了如何将水转化为烈酒。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Salamander learn how to convert water directly into fuel.  This is an intensely draining activity.
translations: 获得此能力后火妖精学会了如何将水直接转化为燃料。这是一项消耗大量体力的活动。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Salamander's eyes begin reflecting their mood, with warm yellows and deep reds when happy and blazing oranges, blues, and whites when angry.  Glare no longer impacts them and they can always see exactly what temperature it is.
translations: 获得此能力后火妖精的眼睛开始反映他们的情绪，高兴时会呈现温暖的黄色和深红色，生气时会呈现耀眼的橙色、蓝色和白色。眩目不再能影响他们，他们还总能准确地看出温度。

messages.msgid: With their new eyes, the Salamander can see heat and pick out others in darkness.
translations: 通过它们崭新的眼睛，火妖精可以看见热量，并在黑暗中辨别出别人。

messages.msgid: The Salamander's ability to see heat has sharpened greatly, and they can pick out subtle change in a person's skin caused by blood flow.  This makes persuasion and lying easier.
translations: 火妖精看见热量的能力大幅增强，因此他们可以发现人体皮肤因血液流动发生的微小变化，使得说服和撒谎更加容易。

messages.msgid: The Salamander's ears narrow to a point, like tongues of leaping flame.  While distinctive, this has no gameplay effects.
translations: 火妖精的耳朵逐渐变窄缩小到一个点，就像跳跃的火舌。 虽然说这与众不同，但对游戏没有什么影响。

messages.msgid: The Salamander gains strength from heat and becomes faster in hot weather.  However, cold weather produces a corresponding slowing effect.
translations: 火妖精从热量中获得力量，在炎热天气里会变得更快。然而，相应地，寒冷会使其减速。

messages.msgid: The Salamander gains strength from heat and becomes faster and heals much quicker in hot weather.  However, cold weather produces a corresponding slowing effect.
translations: 火妖精从热量中获得力量，在炎热天气里会变得更快，也会大幅提升恢复速度。然而，相应地，寒冷会使其减速。

messages.msgid: As fae spirits of fire, Salamanders also partake of the heat of the forge and the glow of white-hot iron.  Your crafting speed will increase while standing in fire or hot air.
translations: 作为火之精灵，火妖精也会分享锻炉的热量和白热铁的光芒。站在火或热空气中时，你的制作速度会提高。

messages.msgid: The Salamander can enhance their inner fire to the point where they leave fiery footprints everywhere they travel.  Activate this trait to leave a trail of fire in your wake at the cost of mana for every footstep.
translations: 火妖精可以增强它们的内驱之火，以至于它们在旅行的任何地方都会留下炽热的足迹。激活此特性，以每一步消耗法力值为代价，在你身后留下一道火焰痕迹。

messages.msgid: As a distant fire reveals that which is nearby, the Salamander can see what surrounds their kin.  The Salamander may see through the eyes of any creatures they summon.
translations: 就像远处的火光会照亮其附近的环境一样，火妖精也能看到自己同类周围的事物。 火妖精可以通过它们召唤的任何生物的眼睛来观察。

messages.msgid: Fires require fuel, and so does the Salamander.  This trait allows them to eat twice as much at once.
translations: 火需要燃料，火妖精也是如此。 这一特性让它们一次能吃两倍的食物。

messages.msgid: Like a coal furnace, the Salamander devours food to keep functioning.  They may eat three times as much at once and eat food 50% faster.
translations: 火妖精就像一个煤炉，靠吞食食物来维持运转。 它们一次可以吃三倍的食物，吃东西的速度也快 50%。

messages.msgid: In times of extreme need, the Salamander can fuel their powers with their own body.  Activate this to restore mana at the cost of health.
translations: 危急时刻，火妖精可以自身血肉为薪，化为力量之源。激活此能力将以生命值为代价，换取魔力。

messages.msgid: The Salamander needs less sleep than a human.  However, they will also need to eat slightly more.
translations: 火妖精需要的睡眠比人类少。 不过，它们也需要稍微多吃一点。

messages.msgid: The Bonfire Blazes Until the Revelers Have Gone
translations: 篝火熊熊，直到狂欢者离去

messages.msgid: The Salamander needs much less sleep than a human.  However, they will also need to eat significantly more.
translations: 火妖精需要的睡眠比人类少得多。 不过，它们也需要吃得更多。

messages.msgid: The Watchfire Burns Throughout the Night

Like a blazing signal fire, a Salamander never stops shining.  They never need to sleep if they do not want to, and when they do, they need much less sleep than normal.  However, they require twice as much food as a human.
translations: 火妖精就像熊熊燃烧的烽火，永不停息地发光发热。 如果它们不想睡觉，就永远不需要睡觉，即使要睡觉，它们需要的睡眠时间也比常人少得多。 然而，它们需要的食物却是人类的两倍。

messages.msgid: The Inner Fire Cannot Be Quenched
Accursed water.  Its touch dampens your flames, and you will no longer have anything to do with it.  You do not need to drink.
translations: 该死的水。和它的接触会熄灭你的火焰。你将不会再与它有任何关系。你不再需要饮水。

messages.msgid: Smoke is the breath of fire and a Salamander is born of flames.  You suffer no negative effects from smoke inhalation.
translations: 烟是火之吐息，而火妖精为火焰所生。你将不会因吸入烟雾而受到任何负面影响。

messages.msgid: Like a fire fueled with fresh wood, you have increased strength.  +1 Strength.
translations: 就像用新鲜木柴点燃的火，你的力量得到了增强。+1力量。

messages.msgid: Like the bonfire that will burn through the night, you have greatly increased strength.  +3 Strength.
translations: 就像篝火将在黑夜中燃烧，你的力量也将大大增强。+3力量。

messages.msgid: Like a fire sparks kindling in flame, you have increased speed.  +2 Dexterity.
translations: 就像火种点燃火焰一样，你的速度也会增加。+2敏捷。

messages.msgid: Like a forest fire moving faster than a running horse, you have greatly increased speed.  +5 Dexterity.
translations: 就像比奔马跑得还快的森林大火一样，你的速度也会大大提高。+2敏捷。

messages.msgid: The Salamander can move even faster than a racing prairie fire.  -10% move and attack speed.
translations: 火妖精甚至可以比奔驰的燎原大火还要快。-10%移动和攻击耗时。

messages.msgid: Your thoughts are as fast as a forest fire.  +2 Intelligence.
translations: 你的思考如同森林大火一样迅速。+2智力。

messages.msgid: Like smoke rising to the sky, the Salamander cannot be kept down.  This trait may be activated to immediately clear the Stunned, Dazed, or Downed effects.
translations: 火妖精就像升上天空的烟雾，无法被压制。 激活该特质可立即清除眩晕、震晕或击倒效果。

messages.msgid: Instead of simply causing a burst of heat, the Salamander can emit heat from their hands at will, allowing them to use it to cook.
translations: 火妖精不再只是瞬间爆发出热量，而是能随心所欲地从掌心散发热量，借此烹煮食物。

messages.msgid: A creature born and bred of fire, the Salamander is utterly immune to heat and flame of any kind.  However, they will take additional damage from cold.
translations: 火妖精是一种生于火、长于火的生物，对任何热量和火焰都完全免疫。 不过，它们会受到额外的寒冷伤害。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Salamander gains the ability to hurl themselves skyward while standing in a fire.
translations: 获得此能力后火妖精获得了站在火中向天空投掷自己的能力。

messages.msgid: The Salamander is a font of mana, like a well-fueled bonfire.  25% extra mana.
translations: 火妖精是一种魔力形式，就像一堆燃料充足的篝火。25%额外法力。

messages.msgid: The Salamander's mana surges within them, ready to burst out at the slightly opportunity.  25% extra mana and -15% spell casting speed.
translations: 火妖精的法力在体内涌动，一有机会就会爆发出来。 额外 25% 的法力值和-15%的施法速度。

messages.msgid: With an act of will, you can extend wings of flame from your back.  These aetherial wings are not hindered by clothing or armor, but also do not have enough substance to allow you to fly.  However, they can break a fall or be used in combat.
translations: 只要你想，你就可以从背后展开火焰之翼。这些空气一般的翅膀不受衣服或盔甲的阻碍，但也没有足够的物质让你飞翔。然而，它们可以防止你摔落或用于战斗。

messages.msgid: Flaming wings extend from your back!
translations: 燃烧的翅膀从你的背上展开！

messages.msgid: You are extending wings of aetherial flame from your back.  You can attack enemies with them and will not take damage from falls.
translations: 你的背上展开火焰的翅膀。你可以用它们攻击敌人，并且不会受到坠落的伤害。

messages.msgid: You buffet %s with your fiery wings!
The wings on your back gutter and die.
translations: 你背后的火焰之翼听话地熄灭掉了。

messages.msgid: In Flames, Reborn Like the Phoenix

Like the bird of legend, the Salamander can recreate themselves from the heat and smoke of a fire.  If their body takes fatal damage while standing in a fire, their fae spirit will use those flames to renew themselves.  This can generally occur no more often than once every 14 days, though there is a small chance it can occur more often.
translations: 如同传说中的神鸟，火妖精可借烈焰与青烟重塑己身。若其身处火海之时遭受致命创伤，其妖精之魂便会御使这些火焰，令其浴火重生。此效果通常每14天至多触发一次，但亦有微小几率更频繁地触发。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Salamander gains the ability to make an ally immune to heat and flame.
translations: 获得这种能力后，火妖精获得了使盟友对热和火焰免疫的能力。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Salamander gains the ability create a massive explosion of flames around themselves and draw on its energy to increase their healing rate.
translations: 习得此技后，火妖精便可在周身引爆熊熊烈焰，并从中汲取能量以提升自愈速度。

messages.msgid: The Salamander may transform into smoke.  They will have only a dim awareness of their surroundings, but can freely move including through the air and will be nearly immune to attack.  They will be unable to attack anyone else themselves, however.
translations: 火妖精可以变成烟雾。 它们只能模糊地感知周围的环境，但可以在空气中自由移动，而且几乎不受攻击。 不过，它们自己无法攻击其他人。

messages.msgid: This mutation carries the sprite override info for Form of Billowing Smoke.  You shouldn't be able to see it in game.
While in hot air or a fire, you may ascend upwards
translations: 在热空气或火中，你可以向上上升

messages.msgid: In No Other Fire Shall I Burn
The Salamander is completely immune to radiation.
translations: 火妖精对辐射完全免疫。

messages.msgid: As a banked fire can suddenly spring up with a gust of wind, the Salamander can surge into raging activity.  Activating this trait will make the Salamander immune to pain and add +3 Strength and Dexterity for as long as it is active.  However, when it ends, all the previously put-off pain and more returns.
translations: 就像蓄势待发的火苗会在一阵风中突然窜起一样，火妖精会突然爆发出狂暴的活动。激活这一特性将使火妖精对疼痛免疫，只要它处于活动状态，就会获得+3的力量和敏捷性。然而，当它结束时，所有先前被推迟的痛苦就会更强烈地卷土重来。

messages.msgid: The goto ability for many Sylphs, this does just what you expect: you shoot lightning from your fingertips.  However, this lightning is more directed than most lightning, and travels in a line through most non-solid targets.
translations: 这是许多风妖精的必杀技，它的作用正如你所期望的那样：从你的指尖射出闪电。不过，这种闪电比大多数闪电更有方向性，会以一条直线穿过大多数非固体目标。

messages.msgid: The crash of lightning strikes your foes with a blast of electricity and a physical force that knocks them prone.
translations: 闪电的轰击会产生强烈的电流和物理力量，将敌人击倒在地。

messages.msgid: A thunder clap at a distance.
Like a Bird on the Wing
Concentrating for a moment, you can hurl your senses into the air, seeing the landscape spread out before you.  This spell only works outdoors.
translations: 凝神片刻，你便可将感官投向高空，俯瞰脚下延展的风景。此法术仅在室外生效。

messages.msgid: Charge forward like a sudden gust of wind.
translations: 化作一阵疾风，向前突进。

messages.msgid: With a burst of fae magick, you infuse the speed of the west wind into one of your allies, allowing them to move much more quickly for a time.
translations: 你使用妖精法术，将西风之速注入一名盟友体内，使其在短时间内身法迅捷无比。

messages.msgid: The Sylph strikes through the air so precisely that the air itself is cut and carries their force outward.  While the spell is in effect, the Sylph can make melee strikes and affect distant targets.
translations: 风妖精的挥砍精准无比，甚至能斩裂空气，借其将力道遥遥传出。法术生效期间，风妖精的近身攻击亦可伤及远处的敌人。

messages.msgid: You may spin a bit of fae magic into the winds, bringing forth a goblin fruit.  Goblin fruit have a variety of effects, never predictable but always at least somewhat beneficial.  This spell may only be cast outdoors in natural surroundings.
translations: 你可以在风中施展一点精灵魔法，结出妖精果实。 果实的效果多种多样，虽然无法预测，但至少总能带来一些益处。 此咒语只能在户外自然环境中施放。

messages.msgid: Call the Children of the Winds
A lesser air elemental is summoned to support you.
translations: 召唤一个低等空气元素来支援你。

messages.msgid: A whistling wind gusts past your shoulder in the direction you've pointed.  It creates a fearful effect in your foes.
translations: 一阵呼啸的风从你的肩膀吹过，吹向你所指的方向。 这让你的敌人感到恐惧。

messages.msgid: Shove something away with a burst of elemental air.
translations: 用一阵元素之气推开某样东西。
你用念力推开你的目标。

messages.msgid: Reassert the purity of the air around yourself, removing contaminants such as smoke or pollen.
translations: 令周遭空气重归纯净，清除烟尘或花粉等污秽之物。

messages.msgid: The air begins to smell sweet.
translations: 空气中开始弥漫起一缕清香。

messages.msgid: Surround a target with a blanket of buffeting winds, slowing them and hindering their freedom of movement.
translations: 用猛烈的旋风包围目标，使其减速，阻碍其行动自由。

messages.msgid: Call down a thundering lightning bolt to blast your enemies with the fury of the heavens.
translations: 召唤雷霆霹雳从天而降，以无上天威轰击你的敌人。

messages.msgid: Lightning crashes down from the heavens!
Going Wither the Wind May Lead

The wind blows where it will, through fences and open windows, across fields and over rivers  The Sylph can blow with it, traveling high above the earth and alighting on a location they have previously been.
translations: 风会随意吹拂，穿过栅栏和敞开的窗，越过田野和奔流的河。风妖精也能随风飘荡，飞至高空，降落在他们曾经到过的地方。

messages.msgid: Going Wither the Wind May Lead Attunement
Attune to a location for later traveling.  You must attune high above the earth and outdoors.
translations: 与一处地点建立调谐，以备日后传送。此过程必须在户外高空进行。

messages.msgid: Your skin has turned the rolling grey of the clouds.  Your skin is now an ever-shifting color of clouds shifting from stormy to rainy to barely there.  This has no gameplay effects.
translations: 你的皮肤已经变成了白云翻滚的灰色。你的皮肤现在是一种不断变化的云的颜色，从暴风雨到下雨，再到勉强存在。这没有游戏效果。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Sylph gains the ability to breathe without oxygen.  This will prevent damage from a lack of oxygen.
translations: 获得此能力后风妖精能够无氧呼吸。这将阻止缺氧伤害。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Sylph's eyes begin reflecting their mood with lightning and storms when angry and clear skies when happy.  Glare no longer impacts them.
translations: 获得此能力后风妖精的眼睛开始反映他们的情绪，愤怒时会出现闪电暴风，高兴时会出现晴空万里。眩目不再能影响他们。

messages.msgid: The Sylph's ears are longer and pointed, like a wisp of cloud trailing across the sky.  They can hear better and no matter how loud the thunder, their ears will not ring from it.
translations: 风妖精的耳朵长又尖，就像天空中飘过的一缕云彩。他们的听觉更灵敏，无论雷声多么响亮，他们的耳朵都不会因此而嗡嗡作响。

messages.msgid: The Sylph can make their voice boom like a peal of thunder, shouting so loudly that they can be heard from hundreds of yards away.
translations: 风妖精可以发出雷鸣般的怒吼，吼声在数百码外都能清晰听见。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Sylph gains the ability to create a loud clap of thunder noise at a distance.
translations: 获得此能力后风妖精能够在远处发出巨大的霹雳声。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Sylph gains the ability to summon and ominous wind that damages sapient creatures morale.
translations: 获得此能力后风妖精能够召唤不祥之风，不祥之风会损害有生命的生物的心情。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Sylph gains the ability to rush forward in a burst of wind.
translations: 获得此能力后风妖精能够乘风向前冲刺。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Sylph gains the ability increase the speed of one of their allies.
translations: 获得此能力后风妖精能够增加他们一名同伴的速度。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Sylph gains the ability to see surrounding terrain as though standing on high.
translations: 获得此能力后风妖精能够像站在高处一样看见周围的地形。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Sylph gains the ability to strike so precisely that the air will carry their melee attacks a short distance.
translations: 习得此能力后，风妖精的攻击将精准无比，其近战之势可破空而出，触及一小段距离外的敌人。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Sylph ceases to fall at speeds that would damage themselves, no matter how high the fall is.
translations: 无论从多高的地方坠落，风妖精都不会再以伤害自己的速度坠落。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Sylph can direct their falls, moving horizontally in a gust of wind if they step off a ledge and landing safely on the ground.
translations: 获得此能力后风妖精能够控制自己的坠落方向，如果它们从边缘走下就会在一阵风托着水平移动，然后安全地降落到地面上。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Sylph can leap straight into the air, riding the wind currents for a few seconds before descending to the earth.
translations: 获得此能力后风妖精能够直接跳到空中，，在降落到地面前乘风飞行几秒。

messages.msgid: The Sylph gains a resistance to cold and cold based damage.
translations: 风妖精获得对寒冷和基于寒冷的伤害的抗性。

messages.msgid: The sylph is nearly immune to mundane cold and heavily resistant to cold-based damage.
translations: 风妖精几乎对世俗的寒冷免疫，并对基于寒冷的伤害有很强的抵抗力。

messages.msgid: The winds surge around the Sylph as they attack, guiding their projectiles to the target.  The range of the Sylph's weapons is increased.
translations: 风妖精攻击时，狂风会环绕其身，引导其投射物飞向目标。风妖精的武器射程将得到提升。

messages.msgid: When outdoors, the Sylph moves 10% faster.
translations: 在户外时，风妖精的移动速度提高10%。

messages.msgid: When outdoors, the Sylph moves 10% faster and has +10% increased speed.
translations: 室外时，风妖精移动速度提高10%，速度增加10%。

messages.msgid: The Sylph slips away from attacks as easily as the wind finds its way through cracks in a wall.  They gain +1 bonus dodge attempt per turn (+2 if they have the Sylph trait).
translations: 风妖精闪避攻击时，身法灵动，一如风之穿隙。每回合获得额外+1闪避次数（若拥有风妖精特质则为+2）。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Sylph gains the ability to grow a goblin fruit when outdoors and the wind is blowing strongly.
translations: 获得此能力后风妖精能够在风力强劲的户外召唤妖精果实。

messages.msgid: The Sylph learns how to use the wind to push their opponents.
translations: 风妖精学会了如何利用风力推动对手。

messages.msgid: The Sylph learns how to surround a single target with buffeting winds, slowing their movements and knocking them off-balance.
translations: 风妖精可召唤狂风将单个目标团团围住，减缓其行动，并使其步履蹒跚。

messages.msgid: The Sylph can remove contaminants from the air such as smoke or pollen and leave only pure air behind.
translations: 风妖精可以清除空气中的烟尘、花粉等杂质，令其恢复纯净。

messages.msgid: Sylphs often develop electrical emissions that can culminate in lightning bolts.
translations: 风妖精经常会发出电光，最终形成闪电。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Sylph gains the ability to summon electrical fields.
translations: 获得此能力后风妖精能够召唤电场。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Sylph gains the ability to call down the thunderstorm's judgement on a location while outdoors.
translations: 习得此能力后，风妖精便可在户外召唤雷暴，对指定地点降下天裁。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Sylph gains the ability to summon an air sprite.
translations: 获得此能力后风妖精能够召唤一只气之灵。

messages.msgid: At will, the Sylph may cause their attacks to carry a charge, whose power grows with their mastery of lightning.  Each attack costs mana while this trait is active.
translations: 风妖精可意念一动，令攻击附带电荷，其威力会随着对闪电的掌控力而增强。此特质激活期间，每次攻击都会消耗魔力。

messages.msgid: The Sylph's moves like the wind.  +2 Dexterity.
translations: 风妖精的行动迅捷如风。+2敏捷。

messages.msgid: The Sylph's moves like a sudden burst of wind.  +5 Dexterity.
translations: 风妖精的身法迅如疾风。敏捷+5。

messages.msgid: The Sylph's mind has the clarity of pure frozen water.  +2 Intelligence.
translations: 风妖精的思绪澄澈，一如净水凝冰。智力+2。

messages.msgid: The Sylph's thoughts move as quickly as a bolt of lightning.  +4 Intelligence.
translations: 风妖精的思绪敏锐，一如电光石火。智力+4。

messages.msgid: Like a bird soaring on the wind, the Sylph's keen eyes take in their surroundings.  +3 Perception.
translations: 风妖精的目光锐利，一如乘风翱翔的飞鸟，将周遭尽收眼底。感知+3。

messages.msgid: Like the blowing winds, the Sylph's mana races from of their body at their command.  -20% spell casting speed when outdoors.
translations: 风妖精的魔力响应其号令，如风驰电掣般自其体内涌出。在户外时，施法速度-20%。

messages.msgid: The wind finds it way through any crack, and so does the Sylph's mana come to their call regardless of what movements they make.  -20% spell casting speed when outdoors and the Sylph no longer needs to gesture to use their magick.
translations: 风能穿堂过隙，风妖精的魔力亦然，无论其动作如何，魔力皆会应召而来。在户外时，施法速度-20%，且风妖精施展魔法时不再需要手势。

messages.msgid: Born of the winds, the Sylph can walk on them as easily as the ground.  While this trait is active, the Sylph will not fall and may walk on the air as they like.  It requires 3 mana per turn to fuel their steps.
translations: 风妖精生于风，踏风而行如履平地。此特质激活期间，风妖精将不会坠落，并可随意在空中行走。其步伐每回合需消耗3点魔力来维系。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Sylph gains the ability to travel along the blowing winds to another location they have previously been to.
translations: 习得此能力后，风妖精便可御风而行，前往先前曾到访过的地点。

messages.msgid: The Sylph may transform into misty cloud.  They will be insubstantial and unable to interact with the environment, but also able to move incredibly quickly and attacks will simply pass through them.  Each second in the cloud form will cost 10 mana.
translations: 风妖精可化身为一团迷雾。此形态下，其身形虚幻，无法与环境互动，但能以极快的速度移动，且所有攻击都将径直穿过其身躯。维持云雾形态每秒将消耗10点魔力。

messages.msgid: This mutation carries the sprite override info for Body of Cloud.  You shouldn't be able to see it in game.
Like the wind, the Sylph goes where they will with no one to stop them.  They are immune to anything that would restrict their movement, such as grabs, terrain costs, or slippery terrain.
translations: 风妖精来去如风，无人可挡。其将免疫任何限制移动的效果，如擒抱、地形移动消耗或湿滑地形。

messages.msgid: The winds surround the Sylph and carry them along regardless of their physical condition.  They suffer no penalties to dexterity or speed due to pain.
translations: 狂风环绕着风妖精，承托其身，使其不受身体状况的影响。其敏捷与速度将不再因疼痛而受损。

messages.msgid: This spell summons a pocket made of churning water that contains an air bubble inside and prevents any items in it from being damaged by water.
translations: 这个咒语会召唤一个由搅动的水组成的口袋，里面有一个气泡，可以防止任何物品被水损坏。

messages.msgid: Weave a cloak of fae magicks around a target, surrounding them with a thin shell of acidic mist.  This protects them somewhat from acid damage and will sometimes damage an attacker as well.
translations: 为目标编织一件妖精魔法斗篷，用一层薄薄的酸雾将其环绕。这能为其提供一定的酸蚀伤害防护，并偶尔会对攻击者造成伤害。

messages.msgid: You may spin a bit of fae magic into the waters, bringing forth a goblin fruit.  Goblin fruit have a variety of effects, never predictable but always at least somewhat beneficial.  This spell may only be cast when standing or water or a near a large body of water.
translations: 你可以将些许妖精魔法织入水中，催生出一枚妖精果实。妖精果实效果多样，无法预测，但至少总有些益处。此法术只有在站在水中或大型水体附近时才能施展。

messages.msgid: You may bring the force of the ocean's depths onto your enemy, crushing them and slowing them briefly.
translations: 你可以将深海的力量施加给你的敌人，将其粉碎并短暂地降低其速度。

messages.msgid: Create a whirling field of magickal waters, dragging everything within it toward a central point and slowing them with the force of the current.
translations: 创造一片旋转的魔力水域，将其中万物卷向中心，并以强劲的水流减缓其行动。

messages.msgid: You summon a water based vehicle to propel you across the waves.
translations: 您可以召唤一辆水上交通工具，带您穿越波涛汹涌的大海。

messages.msgid: A fish arrives from somewhere.  It may not be that useful on land.
translations: 一条鱼从某处驶来。 它在陆地上可能没那么有用。

messages.msgid: A friendly fish arrives from somewhere.  It may not be that useful on land.
translations: 一条友好的鱼不知从哪里来了。 它在陆地上可能没那么有用。

messages.msgid: A friendly kraken arrives from somewhere.  It may not be that useful on land.
translations: 一只友好的海怪不知从哪里来了。 它在陆地上可能用处不大。

messages.msgid: Calling the Children of the Waves
A lesser water elemental is summoned to support you.
translations: 召唤一个较低级的水元素来支援你。

messages.msgid: Create a magickal wall of water and bring it crashing down on your enemies, buffeting and carrying them away.
translations: 创造一道魔力水墙，令其倾覆在敌人身上，冲击并将其席卷而去。

messages.msgid: Your skin has turned the color of the Mediterranean Sea.  Your skin is now a brilliant turquoise color.  This has no gameplay effects.
translations: 你的皮肤变成了地中海的颜色。 你的皮肤现在是亮丽的绿松石色。 这对游戏没有任何影响。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Undine gains the ability to create a cloud of fog.
translations: 获得此能力后水妖精能够制造云雾。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Undine gains the ability to grant one person the ability to float and swim.
translations: 获得此能力后水妖精能够赋予一个人漂浮和游泳的能力。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Undine gains the ability to create an acidic mist that damages any creatures inside it.
translations: 获得此能力后水妖精能够制造酸雾，酸雾会伤害其中的任何生物。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Undine gains the ability to weave an enchantment on an ally which will protect them from acid and causes anything who attacks that ally to be splashed with acid themselves.
translations: 在获得此技能后，水妖精获得了在盟友身上使用魔法的能力，可以保护他们免受酸液伤害，并使任何攻击该盟友的人受到酸液上海。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Undine gains the ability to grow a goblin fruit from a natural water source.
translations: 获得此能力后水妖精能够从水源中培育妖精果实。

messages.msgid: One Foot in the River and One in the Sea
Upon gaining this ability the Undine learns how to convert salt water into freshwater and vice versa.
The Undine has gained the ability to breathe underwater.
translations: 水精灵获得了在水下呼吸的能力。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Undine learns how to foul water, making it murky and possibly infested.  Conversely, the Undine can also cleanse water that is not already clean.
translations: 习得此能力后，水妖精便能污化水源，使其浑浊不堪，甚至滋生秽物。反之，水妖精亦可涤净污水。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Undine learns how to convert various liquids into freshwater.
translations: 习得此能力后，水妖精便能将各类液体悉数化为淡水。

messages.msgid: You've gained a resistance to fire.
You've gained a resistance to acid.
The waves themselves answer your call and support you, allowing you to walk on the surface of the water.  Activate to walk on water.
translations: 浪潮将亲应你的呼唤，承托你的身体，使你得以行走于水面之上。启动后即可踏水而行。

messages.msgid: Let the Waves Wash Over Me
As the Undine is one with the waters, so too is anything they carry.  Their gear is immune to being dissolved or broken by water.
translations: 水妖既与水同体，其所携带的万物亦然。其装备将免疫水体的溶解与侵蚀。

messages.msgid: Allows the Undine to change the weather to rain.  (Currently not working)
translations: 允许 水妖精 将天气变为雨天。 （目前无法使用）

messages.msgid: Allows the Undine to summon fish and eventually charm them.  Practice this enough and you will be able to befriend sea monsters.
translations: 可以让水妖精召唤鱼类，并最终迷住它们。 只要多加练习，你就能与海怪成为朋友。

messages.msgid: Allows the Undine to slow and damage a single target, as though they were caught in the depths of the ocean.
translations: 可以让水妖精使单个目标减速并受到伤害，如同目标被困在海洋深处。

messages.msgid: Allows the Undine to force an entire group inward toward a central point, as though caught in a whirlpool.
translations: 可以使水妖精迫使整个群体陷入一个中心点，如同陷入漩涡。

messages.msgid: Upon gaining this ability the Undine's eyes begin reflecting their mood with colors of the deep waters, pitch black when angry or sad and green-blue when pleased.  Glare no longer impacts them, and neither do light levels when trying to sleep.  They can also see without problem underwater.
translations: 获得此能力后水妖精的眼睛开始用深水的颜色反映他们的情绪，愤怒或悲伤时是漆黑，高兴时是绿蓝。眩目不再能影响他们，光照也不能影响他们入睡。在水下，水妖精也能清晰视物。

messages.msgid: The Undine's ears are longer and pointed, like a stream of water poured into a glass from on high.  This is purely cosmetic.
translations: 水妖精的耳朵又长又尖，就像从高处倒进玻璃杯里的水流。当然这纯粹是为了好看。

messages.msgid: Allows the Undine to summon a minor water elemental to support them in the world for a short time.
translations: 允许水妖精召唤一只小型水元素，以支持他们现身一小段时间。

messages.msgid: Surrounded by the waters, Undines find it easy to rest.  Falling asleep underwater is easy for you, and you spend less time asleep when you rest there.  You can also eat underwater, though you can't drink.
translations: 被水包围时，水妖精更容易休息。在水下睡觉对你来说很容易，当你在水下休息时，你需要花在睡觉上的时间减少。你也可以在水下吃东西，但不能喝水。

messages.msgid: Undines are born of the flowing waters and the waters provide for their children.  While submerged in fresh water, any thirst you have will be slaked.
translations: 水妖精由流水所生，为流水所养。在淡水中潜水时，你的口渴会得到缓解。

messages.msgid: With the Undine's more fluid skin has come more fluid motion.  Activate this trait to immediately escape a grab and suffer less damage from falls for a few seconds.
translations: 水妖精更柔软的皮肤使运动更加灵活。获得此特性，水妖精可以立即逃离敌方的擒拿，并在几秒钟内减少跌落造成的伤害。

messages.msgid: Like a Fish in the River
The Undines are born of the waters and water is their home.  This trait allows them to move much faster when in water.
translations: 水妖精为水所生，以水为家。这一特性增加水妖精在水中移动的速度。

messages.msgid: The waters come to the Undine's defense.  When attacked, there is a chance that a burst of water will surge out and push their attackers back.
translations: 水妖精被水护佑。当受到攻击时，水中有概率涌出一股水柱，击退攻击者。

messages.msgid: Like the relentless pounding of the waves against the shore, the Undine's strikes hammer into their enemies.  While this trait is active, the Undine does 25% more melee damage.
translations: 如同海浪无情地拍打着海岸。获得此特性后，水妖精的近战伤害增加25%。

messages.msgid: All Rivers Flow to the Sea

Water falls as rain, flows into streams, and then into rivers to the sea, and rises as clouds to fall as rain once again.  While submerged in a river, lake, or the ocean, the Undine can exploit this connection to locate other sources of water.
translations: 水化雨落，落入小溪，流入江河，汇入大海，复变为水又化雨。潜入河流、湖泊和海洋时，水妖精可以利用这种方式寻找其他水域。

messages.msgid: Even the weakest waves will erode the strongest rock, given enough time.  +1 Strength.
translations: 假以时日，即便是最微弱的波浪，也能侵蚀最坚固的岩石。力量+1。

messages.msgid: Year by year, meter by meter, the waves gradually erode the beaches.  +3 Strength.
translations: 年复一年，寸寸蚕食，波浪将海滩逐渐吞噬。力量+3。

messages.msgid: The Undine's flexibility has increased, allowing them to move in increasingly more fluid ways.  +2 Dexterity.
translations: 水妖精的柔软度得以增加，它们的运动越发灵活。+2点敏捷。

messages.msgid: Like the babbling brook, the Undine flows over everything in their way.  +4 Dexterity.  However, they must also drink 15% more water.
translations: 如同小溪潺潺，水妖精流过他们所经之途。加4点敏捷。然而，他们必须多摄入15%的水。

messages.msgid: Like the flowing river, the Undine can twist back on themselves and pass through any obstacle.  +6 Dexterity.  However, they must also drink 25% more water.
translations: 水妖之身形亦如奔流江河，可曲折回环，穿行无碍。敏捷+6。然则，其饮水量亦将增加25%。

messages.msgid: The Undine's senses take in their environment like a fisher gazing to the bottom of a clear pond.  +2 Perception.
translations: 水妖精的感官就像渔夫凝视清澈的池底一样，将周围环境尽收眼底。+2 感知。

messages.msgid: The Pond's Depths Do Not Freeze
Though the ice over the top grows thick, the water below remains liquid.  The Undine is completely immune to cold temperatures when underwater.
translations: 虽然上层的冰越来越厚，但下面的水仍然保持液态。在水下时，水妖精完全不受低温的影响。

messages.msgid: Even the Undine's internal organs are becoming more liquid.  Bashing and cutting damage is reduced even further, and ballistic damage is halved.  However, the Undine needs to drink more water.
translations: 水妖精的内部器官也变得更加像液体。钝击和斩击伤害进一步降低，子弹伤害减半。然而，水妖精需要摄入更多水。

messages.msgid: Like the fountain continuously flowing with water, the Undine's mana regenerates 50% faster while standing in or under water.
translations: 如同喷泉流水，当水妖精站在水中或水下时，其魔力恢复速度增强50%。

messages.msgid: Like the fountain continuously flowing to the brim with water, the Undine's mana regenerates 50% faster and they have 50% more mana while standing in or under water.
translations: 如同喷泉流至水边，水妖精的魔力恢复速度增强50%，当他们站在水中或水下时，其魔力量增加50%。

messages.msgid: Like the fountain overflowing with water, the Undine's mana regenerates 50% faster, they have 50% more mana, and their stamina regenerates 100% faster while standing in or under water.
translations: 如同喷泉满溢，水妖精的魔力恢复速度增强50%，魔力量增加50%，当他们站在水中或水下时，其耐力恢复速度增加100%。

messages.msgid: You may transform your body into pure water, becoming much more difficult to hurt (except by fire), able to flow easily over all terrain, and capable of moving much faster and more stealthily when in water.  However, you will be unable to attack, cold will do triple damage to you, and cold weather will affect you more.
translations: 你可以把你的身体变成纯水，变得难以受伤（除了火），能够轻松地在所有地形上流动，并且能够在水中更快更隐蔽地移动。然而，你将无法攻击，寒冷会对你造成三倍的伤害，寒冷的天气也会对你产生更大的影响。

messages.msgid: You are a mass of pure water.  It is much harder to damage you, and you can move over any terrain without penalty, but you cannot attack.
translations: 你化身为一汪纯水，这使你极难被伤及，且能于任何地形上行动自如，但你也无法发动攻击。

messages.msgid: Being made entirely of water, it is easy for you to disguise yourself when underwater.
translations: 由于完全由水构成，你在水中很容易伪装自己。

messages.msgid: The Sea Is Always With Me
The Undine can draw a bit of extra water into their watery skin, fortifying them for journeys away from a water source.
translations: 水妖精可以在起水般的皮肤中吸纳额外的水，增加其在远离水源时探索的距离。

messages.msgid: You're not supposed to see this.  Tracks that you are killing your best friend ever
This person considers you their absolute best friend, the best person in the entire world.
translations: 此人视你为他的至交好友，是这片世界中最美好的人。

messages.msgid: Shouldn't be visible.  Tracks that you are killing someone that considers you the best person in the world.
translations: 不应可见。用于追踪你正在杀死某个视你为全世界最美好的人的状态。

messages.msgid: You are a creature of Faerie.
This person won't accept to let you drink more of their blood for a while.
translations: 此人暂时不会再同意让你饮用他们的血液了。

messages.msgid: Your roots sink into the ground and you are nearly immobile.
translations: 你的根沉入地下，你几乎一动不动。

messages.msgid: Make a gun that uses energy from almost any type of battery to shoot hot lasers.
translations: 制造一把能够利用几乎任何类型的电池来发射热激光的枪。

messages.msgid: Make a gun that uses energy from batteries to shoot superhot rays of energy.
translations: 制作一把利用电池内能量发射热能射线的枪。

messages.msgid: Make a gun using aether drawn from the void between all things, that shoots beams able to melt anything in its path.
translations: 用来自万物之间的虚空中抽取之以太打造一把枪械，放出的光束能融化所经之处一切。

messages.msgid: You know how to make a really dreadful hammer.  It's a two-handed basher, but it can also work as a boomerang.
translations: 你知道如何打造一把真正可怕的战锤。双手握住捶打，但也可以像回旋镖一样使用。

messages.msgid: You know how to make a tool to explode the biosignature of nearly all living creatures.  It's really powerful, but can't separate enemies from allies, or enemies from the user, so it's better to not use it in point-blank range.
translations: 你知道如何制造一种能够爆破几乎所有生物的生物特征的工具。它非常强大，但无法区分敌人和盟友，或者敌人和使用者，所以最好不要在近距离使用它。

messages.msgid: You know how to make a warhead for your humming mortar to fire.
translations: 你知道如何制造一个战斗头，用于发射你的鸣蜂迫击炮。

messages.msgid: Somehow if you write some symbols on paper and cover it with mana, you can make a tool that allows you to tear a small part of reality.  You found paper dollar bills perfectly fit the required shape.  You find it hilarious that reality accepts US currency.
translations: 如果你在纸上写下一些符号并用魔力覆盖，你就能制作出一种工具，让你撕裂现实的一小部分。 你发现一元纸币完全符合所需的形状。 你发现现实竟然接受美钞，这太搞笑了。

messages.msgid: You know how to make a helmet that will increase your creative abilities.  Even with this improvement you don't really know how it works, it just came to you in a flash of brilliance.
translations: 你知道如何制作这个头盔，这能提高你的创造能力。 即使有了这种改进，你也不知道它是如何工作的，只是你的灵光一闪。

messages.msgid: Craft a small weapon that does… things, that allow you to… kill… things… whatever, you have no idea how it works.
translations: 制造一个可以干……某些事的小型武器，可以让你……杀死……某些东西……无论如何，你不知道它是怎样工作的。

messages.msgid: Enters a manic creation episode in the appropriate workshop space and creates… something.
translations: 进入适当的工作坊空间，开始狂热创作，并创造出……某物。

messages.msgid: You spend some time, trying to understand what the dreamdross is capable of, and how you can utilize it's power.
translations: 你花了一些时间，试图了解浮梦残渣能够做什么以及如何利用它的力量。

messages.msgid: This ritual pulls a small amount of dreamdross into our world and makes it permanent.  These scraps of dreaming can then be used to make permanent objects.
translations: 这个仪式法术会将少量的浮梦残渣带入我们的世界，并使其永久存在。这些梦境的碎片可以用来制造永恒存在的物体。

messages.msgid: This spell allows you to speak to the trees and discern the layout of the forest.
translations: 这个法术可以让你对树木说话，并辨别森林的布局。

messages.msgid: From Root to Root the Forest Is Joined Real
The actual spell that transports you for From Root to Root the Forest Is Joined.  It's a bug if you have it.
translations: 这是“根须相连，合森为一”法术的实际传送效果。如果你能看到这个条目，说明游戏出了BUG。

messages.msgid: You consume human blood to keep the thirst at bay.
translations: 你吞噬人类的血液来解渴。

messages.msgid: Your eyes glow red for a moment.  Now your sight can pierce the darkest shadows.
translations: 你的眼睛闪着红色的光芒。现在你的目光可以穿透最深沉的阴影。

messages.msgid: You focus on sending the blood in your veins to where it can do the most good for your immediate stamina.
translations: 你专注于将静脉中的血液输送到对你的耐力最有好处的地方。

messages.msgid: Turning your blood mastery inwards, magically enhancing your flesh.  Rather than strength of healing, it staves off blood loss and purges wounds before they can turn septic, at the cost of increased hunger and thirst.
translations: 将你控制你的血液向内脏流去，魔法般地强化你的肌肉。它不是纯粹的治疗，而是以增加饥饿和口渴为代价，在伤口感染化脓之前止血和净化伤口。

messages.msgid: Stolen blood allows you to move as quick as lightning, scything through your enemies or outrunning a car.
translations: 盗取之血能让你动如掣电，无论是斩杀仇雠还是超越飞驰的汽车，皆不在话下。

messages.msgid: Like the flitting wind or the flexible willow, the spell allows you to avoid attacks much more easily.  It has <color_yellow>reduced effects</color> away from your natural environment (indoors for Sylph, non-natural terrain for Arvore).
translations: 身法如掠风，体态似摆柳，此法术能让你更轻易地避开攻击。当离开你的自然环境（风精在室内，木族在非自然地貌）时，其效果会<color_yellow>减弱</color>。

messages.msgid: Working with materials from other dimensions is never easy.  But this definitely improves your ability to work on fabrics and furs from the lands under the hill.
translations: 处理其他维度的材料从来都不容易。但这绝对能提高你处理山脚下的织物和毛皮的能力。

messages.msgid: The art of turning the tears of the moon into weapons and armor, light and impossibly sharp.
translations: 一种能将“月之泪”锻造成武器与护甲的技艺，其成品轻若无物，锋锐无匹。

messages.msgid: You know how you use your mind to transform dreamdross into basic shapes.
translations: 你知道如何用你的头脑把幻想具现成基本的形态。

messages.msgid: Your knowledge has grown, and you know how to shape dreamdross into a weapon of terrible power.
translations: 你的知识增长了，你知道如何把幻想具现成可怕的力量武器。

messages.msgid: Your knowledge has grown, and you know how to shape dreamdross into an indestructible armor.
translations: 你的知识增长了，你知道如何把幻想具现成坚不可摧的盔甲。

messages.msgid: Your mind and feeling are the one.  Your items are impossible.  Your dreamdross could be everything.
translations: 你的思想和感觉是一体的。你的道具并不存在。你的幻想泡沫可以成为一切。

messages.msgid: A fairly disturbing bionic module created by vampires for their servants.  Installed by planting the seed next to the heart inside of the chest, then sealed back up, the remainder of the surgery the seed spreads its root structures across the body and limbs.  The roots large enough to help obstruct damage to the body don't extend into the feet and hands but they do wrap around the skull in places.  They take up very little space for a body plus limbs CBM running mostly along the top layers of the skin.  Rumored to grow denser and thicker as they age over decades and centuries.
translations: 吸血鬼为他们的仆人创造的一个相当令人不安的仿生模块。 通过将种子种植在胸部内的心脏旁边，然后密封起来安装，手术的其余部分种子将其根部结构散布在身体和四肢上。 大到足以帮助阻碍身体损伤的根不会延伸到脚和手，但它们确实在某些地方缠绕在头骨周围。 它们占用的身体和四肢CBM占用的空间很小，主要沿着皮肤的顶层运行。 有传言说，随着几十年和几个世纪的老化，它们会变得越来越密集和厚实。

messages.msgid: Embedded into your back and connected to your bionic power supply is a device to convert the blood of vampires to produce a facsimile of bionic power.  It can store up to 100 mL of blood.  For unknown reasons if installed into an active vampire it will not function when filled with its bearers blood.  No one who talks about it knows why.
translations: 你的背部装有一个转化设备，并连接至你的生化能量系统，能够消耗吸血鬼的血液以产生生化能量。可以存放最多 100 毫升血液。出于未知的原因，如果安装在一只吸血鬼身上，当充入自身血液时装置无法运作，没人知道为什么会这样。

messages.msgid: Internal tank for vampire blood power generator bionic.
translations: 用于吸血鬼血液燃料电池CBM的内置储罐。

messages.msgid: Your vocal cords have been enhanced, able to resonate like a bat to draw in a swarm to protect you.
translations: 你的声带得到了增强，能够像蝙蝠一样产生共鸣，吸引一群人来保护你。

messages.msgid: Your vocal cords have been reinforced and enlarged.  You can make a strange noise with it, but you don't know what it's supposed to communicate.
translations: 你的声带得到了加强和扩大。 你可以用它发出奇怪的声音，但你不知道它应该传达什么。

messages.msgid: There are fungi that grow in the corpse dirt that vampires rest in.  In unexposed humans these fungal spores can cause crippling coughing fits and even death.  But when treated with a solution made of vampire blood or harvested straight from the still-warm lungs of a previous recipient they can be migrated into a living host body where they will speed up reactions and increase strength slightly.
translations: 有一些真菌生长在吸血鬼休息的尸体泥土中。在基准人类中，这些真菌孢子会导致令人残废的咳嗽，甚至死亡。但是当用吸血鬼血液制成的溶液处理时，或者直接从以前的接受者仍然温暖的肺部收获时，它们可以迁移到活着的宿主身体中，在那里它们会加速反应并略微增加力量。

messages.msgid: The earth around you rumble, and in an instant everything happen to be upside down.
translations: 你周围的大地隆隆作响，一瞬间，世间万物都横七竖八地颠倒了。

messages.msgid: It's not like you teleport somewhere else, rather the whole world has been shifted, and you are left in the same place.
translations: 并不是你传送了，而是整个世界都被传送了，而你只是被留在了原地。

messages.msgid: Something living nearby just exploded with fountain of gore.
translations: 附近有什么东西爆炸了，地上血流成河。

messages.msgid: Your flesh quickly rots and regenerates like in timelapse.
translations: 你的肉很快腐烂并再生，宛如时间正在飞速流逝。

messages.msgid: All your feelings numb for a second, and all pain is gone now.
translations: 你所有的感觉都麻木了一秒钟，所有的疼痛现在都消失了。

messages.msgid: The energy stream into your muscle, and you feel you can run a marathon right now.
translations: 能量流入你的肌肉，你觉得你现在可以跑一次马拉松了。

messages.msgid: You feel your body become energized, and you are ready to change the world.
translations: 你感觉到你的身体变得充满活力，你已经准备好改变世界了。

messages.msgid: You feel like you know this place.
translations: 你感觉这地方似曾相识。

messages.msgid: You know for sure - right now you are the smartest human on this side of the planet.
translations: 你确信且肯定——现在你是这个星球上最聪明的人。

messages.msgid: With some effort you can outsmart reality.
translations: 由于某些效果，你的智力达到了现实之外的境界。

messages.msgid: You feel yourself much less smarter than before.
translations: 你感觉自己没之前那么聪明了。

messages.msgid: You feel sparks dancing in your eyes.
translations: 你感到火花在眼前舞动。

messages.msgid: Tiny electrical joints jump in your cornea.
translations: 微小的电弧在你的角膜中跳跃。

messages.msgid: The sparks in your eyes are finally gone.
translations: 你眼睛你的火花消失了。

messages.msgid: Silently, a part of the world nearby just disappears.
translations: 悄无声息间，周围空间的一部分就这样消失了。

messages.msgid: It is you.  And this is you.  And that is you.  You are everywhere.
translations: 是你。这个是你。那个也是你。你无处不在。

messages.msgid: Your body emit enough energy to power some small city.
translations: 你的身体释放出的能量足以为一些小城市供电。

messages.msgid: The world around you silently stops.
translations: 你周围的世界无声地停止了。

messages.msgid: Somehow you can feel any motion around with your spine.
translations: 不知怎么的，你可以感觉到脊椎周围的任何运动。

messages.msgid: You feel unusual sensation in your spine.
translations: 你的脊椎有一种不寻常的感觉。

messages.msgid: The sensation in your spine gone.
translations: 你脊椎的奇怪感觉消失了。

messages.msgid: Like the fading of plantlife in the end of the year, afflict your target with the ravages of age, reducing their physical abilities for a brief period.  The duration is <color_green>greatly increased</color> in autumn.
translations: 如同岁末凋零的草木一般，此法术能使你的目标遭受岁月的摧残，在短时间内削弱其身体机能。在秋季，持续时间会<color_green>大幅提升</color>。

messages.msgid: Gaze at a nearby animal with the eyes of a stalking predator, sending them fleeing.  Repeated gazes in a short period of time have no additional effect.  The glamour has <color_yellow>reduced effect</color> in spring.
translations: 用潜行捕食者的目光凝视附近的动物，使其惊慌而逃。短时间内重复凝视不会产生额外效果。在春季，此妖术的效果会<color_yellow>减弱</color>。

messages.msgid: Weaving this glamour will allow you to sense the presence of nearby sorcerers.  The glamour has <color_yellow>reduced duration</color> in spring.
translations: 编织此妖术能让你感知到附近术士的存在。在春季，此妖术的持续时间会<color_yellow>缩短</color>。

messages.msgid: You mutter a charm under your breath and open your senses up to nearby enchanters.
translations: 你低声念诵咒语，将感官向附近的附魔师们敞开。

messages.msgid: With a forceful gaze projecting the energies of the dying of the year, you can wither plantlife in moments.  This also applies to mobile or even sapient plants.  The glamour <color_yellow>does less damage</color> in spring.
translations: 通过一道投射出岁末凋零能量的有力凝视，你可以在瞬间令植物枯萎。这也同样适用于可移动甚至有知觉的植物。在春季，此妖术造成的伤害会<color_yellow>降低</color>。

messages.msgid: You can draw on the mystery of misty autumn mornings and condense a thick fog out of the air, reducing the vision of everyone and hiding your movements.  Reweave the glamour to dispel it. The glamour is <color_yellow>quicker to expire</color> in spring.
translations: 你可以汲取秋日晨雾的神秘力量，从空气中凝结出浓雾，从而削弱所有人的视野并掩藏你的行踪。再次编织此妖术即可将其驱散。在春季，此妖术会<color_yellow>更快失效</color>。

messages.msgid: Spin an illusion around yourself, making those who look on you see their greatest fear, increase your ability to intimidate them, though with a corresponding loss of persuasive ability.  The glamour is <color_yellow>less effective</color> in spring.
translations: 在你周身编织一道幻象，让注视你的人看到他们内心最深的恐惧，从而提升你威吓他们的能力，但说服能力会相应地下降。在春季，此妖术的效果会<color_yellow>减弱</color>。

messages.msgid: Whip up a wind and a swirl of autumn leaves around yourself, giving ranged attacks a chance to go awry.  The glamour also makes you <color_green>harder to spot</color> if used in autumn.
translations: 在你周身掀起一阵狂风与纷飞的秋叶，使远程攻击有几率偏离目标。若在秋季使用，此妖术还会使你<color_green>更难被发现</color>。

messages.msgid: A spray of colored leaves whirl around you.
translations: 一阵纷飞的落叶在你周身盘旋。

messages.msgid: You can bring a growing plant to full ripeness, allowing you to harvest it immediately.  The glamour <color_red>cannot be used</color> in the spring.
translations: 你能催熟生长中的植物，并立即进行收获。在春季，此妖术<color_red>无法使用</color>。

messages.msgid: It is said that Balor could kill with a glance.  While this glamour is not quite so powerful, you can freeze your target in place, as long as you also take no action but to fix them with your stare.
translations: 据说，巴洛尔一瞥便可杀人。此妖术虽无那般威力，但你也能将目标定在原地，前提是你也必须一动不动地用目光锁定他们。

messages.msgid: Call up an obscuring mist, rendering anything inside insensate and incapable of navigating or determining their location.  Those inside the fog will wander, blind and deaf, until the glamour fades or they somehow find their way outside of its area.  The affected area is <color_yellow>reduced</color> in the spring.
translations: 召来一片遮蔽视线的迷雾，使范围内的任何生物五感尽失，无法辨别方向。身处雾中的人会像聋盲一般四处游荡，直到妖术消散，或他们设法走出迷雾范围。在春季，其影响范围会<color_yellow>缩小</color>。

messages.msgid: With a gesture, a mist begins to rise.
translations: 随着一个手势，迷雾开始升起。

messages.msgid: Your command over plants allows you to cause grass to grow in profusion from the soil, making the terrain very difficult for enemies to traverse.  The glamour is much more difficult to use in the winter.
translations: 你对植物的掌控力能使土地上的草木疯长，让敌人极难穿越。此妖术在冬季会更加难以施展。

messages.msgid: Cover your own scent with the scent of fresh-blooming flowers, marking it harder for animals (or the dead) to track you.  The glamour's is <color_yellow>less effective</color> in the autumn.
translations: 用初绽花朵的芬芳掩盖你自身的气味，让动物（或亡灵）更难追踪到你。在秋季，此妖术的效果会<color_yellow>减弱</color>。

messages.msgid: A pleasant scent fills the air
translations: 空气中弥漫着一股怡人的芬芳。

messages.msgid: You can draw some of the energy inherent in nearby plants into yourself, restoring a bit of your stamina and easing your pain.  However, the energy is drawn from nearby foliage and cannot be accessed if you are not standing on verdant ground.
translations: 你可以从附近的植物中汲取其固有的能量，为自己恢复些许耐力并缓解痛苦。然而，这股能量来自于附近的草木，因此你必须站在植被茂盛的地面上才能汲取。

messages.msgid: You can greatly speed plant growth.  Grass can grow from seed in moments, crops can shoot towards the sky, and even young trees can put forth mighty limbs.  You cannot, however, bring a plant to ripeness or fruiting.  The glamour <color_red>cannot be used</color> in the winter.
translations: 你能极大地加速植物生长。草籽片刻间即可萌发，庄稼能向天空疯长，甚至幼树也能生出粗壮的枝干。然而，你无法使植物成熟或结果。此妖术在冬季<color_red>无法使用</color>。

messages.msgid: Like a house after a long winter, this glamour removes impurities in the target's body, curing them of poison or disease and preventing them from reoccurring while it lasts.  The glamour's duration is <color_yellow>greatly reduced</color> in the autumn.
translations: 如同为度过漫长冬日的房屋拂去尘埃，此妖术能清除目标体内的杂质，治愈其中毒或疾病，并在持续期间防止复发。在秋季，此妖术的持续时间会<color_yellow>大幅缩短</color>。

messages.msgid: Endless fields of daffodil warriors fight and die at the pleasure of their overlords in the battles constantly waging in the Bright Lands.  While this is a simpler glamour that that which creates those armies, you can still spin up a small group of daffodil warriors from some nearby foliage.

Grow a set of enchanted living armor around yourself or an ally, providing protection and resistance to chill temperatures.  The glamour offers <color_yellow>no protection from cold</color> in autumn.
translations: 在你或一位盟友的周身生长出一套附魔活体护甲，提供防护并抵御低温。在秋季，此妖术<color_yellow>无法提供寒冷防护</color>。

messages.msgid: Like a hibernating animal shaking off the last remnants of sleep when the snow melts, you can shed sleepiness and fatigue.  The glamour requires that you be <color_yellow>outdoors in sunlight</color> if used in autumn.
translations: 如同冬眠的动物在冰雪消融时抖落最后的困意一般，你也可以摆脱自身的困倦与疲劳。若在秋季使用，此妖术要求你必须身处<color_yellow>户外阳光下</color>。

messages.msgid: Cause the sky to cloud over and a soft spring rain to fall.  Reweave the glamour to dispel it.  You cannot summon the rains if the weather is below freezing.
translations: 使天空乌云密布，降下柔和的春雨。再次编织此妖术即可将其驱散。如果气温在冰点以下，则无法召唤降雨。

messages.msgid: Summon the wrath of nature upon a single target, causing thorny vines to grow from the ground and attack them mercilessly.  The target must be outside and on natural ground for the glamour to take effect.  The glamour has <color_yellow>reduced duration</color> if used in autumn.
translations: 对单个目标召唤大自然的愤怒，使带刺的藤蔓从地面破土而出，无情地攻击他们。目标必须身处户外且站在天然地面上，此妖术才能生效。若在秋季使用，此妖术的持续时间会<color_yellow>缩短</color>。

messages.msgid: Draw on the power of growth and new sprouts to speed the healing of yourself or one of your allies, as long as you are outside.  The healing rate is <color_yellow>reduced</color> in autumn.
translations: 只要身处户外，你便能汲取生长与新芽萌发的力量，加速你自己或一位盟友的痊愈过程。在秋季，治疗速度会<color_yellow>降低</color>。

messages.msgid: By spinning the energy of desire into a group of human or fae targets, you can fill them with so overpowering a love for you that they will furiously defend you against all threats.  This glamour is <color_yellow>less likely to succeed</color> in the autumn.
translations: 通过将欲望的能量织入一群人类或妖精目标体内，你能让他们心中充满对你不可抗拒的爱意，以至于他们会奋不顾身地为你抵御一切威胁。在秋季，此妖术的成功率会<color_yellow>降低</color>。

messages.msgid: With a whispered hymn, you weave a glamour over your targets.
translations: 伴随着低语的颂歌，你将妖术织入目标体内。

messages.msgid: Conjure up a flickering ball of orange and red light that hovers nearby and sheds a dim glow on your surroundings.  The glamour is <color_yellow>quicker to expire</color> in winter.
translations: 召唤一个悬浮在附近的橙红色闪烁光球，为周围洒下黯淡的光芒。在冬季，此妖术会<color_yellow>更快失效</color>。

messages.msgid: With a quick gesture, summon up a burst of heat sufficient to ignite flammable material.  The glamour <color_red>cannot be used</color> in winter.
translations: 凭一个迅速的手势，召唤出一股足以点燃易燃物的热量。此妖术在冬季<color_red>无法使用</color>。

messages.msgid: The true initiate of summer can gaze directly at the sun without flinching.  The glamour protects your eyes from the light of the noonday sun, as well as other sources of bright light such as flashbangs or welding torches.
translations: 真正的夏日之道入门者，能够直视太阳而毫不畏缩。此妖术能保护你的眼睛免受正午烈日，以及闪光弹或焊枪等其他强光源的伤害。

messages.msgid: A quick chant infuses the power of summer into your or your ally's blood, providing resistance against hot weather.  The glamour also provides some <color_green>protection against fire</color> in summer.
translations: 一段快速的吟唱能将夏日之力注入你或盟友的血液中，提供对炎热天气的抗性。在夏季，此妖术还会提供一定的<color_green>火焰防护</color>。

messages.msgid: A refreshing breeze picks up as you chant.
translations: 随着你的吟唱，一阵清爽的微风吹起。

messages.msgid: Like a salmon leaping over obstacles in a river, you can make prodigious jumps.
translations: 如同鲑鱼跃过河中障碍一般，你可以做出惊人的跳跃。

messages.msgid: Surround your hands in ethereal flames, doing additional fire damage to targets you strike in melee.  This damage is greater when unarmed, but still transfers to any weapons you wield.  The glamour is <color_yellow>quicker to expire</color> in winter.
translations: 让虚幻的火焰环绕你的双手，对你近战攻击的目标造成额外的火焰伤害。此伤害在赤手空拳时更高，但也会传导至你所持的任何武器上。在冬季，此妖术会<color_yellow>更快失效</color>。

messages.msgid: Concentrate the heat of the sun on a small area, inflicting all within with a mystical tiredness that will slow their movements.  In the winter the glamour <color_red>does not work</color> indoors or at night.
translations: 将太阳的热量集中在一小片区域，使范围内的所有生物都感受到一种神秘的疲惫感，从而减缓他们的动作。在冬季，此妖术于室内或夜间<color_red>无效</color>。

messages.msgid: The sunlight shines a little brighter.
translations: 阳光似乎变得更耀眼了一些。

messages.msgid: After using this glamour, begin running.  As long as you continue running, you will not run out of stamina.  Weaving another glamour or attacking breaks the effect.  In the winter the glamour <color_red>does not work</color> if you are indoors.
translations: 使用此妖术后，开始奔跑。只要你持续奔跑，你的耐力就不会耗尽。编织其他妖术或进行攻击会中断此效果。在冬季，若你身处室内，此妖术<color_red>无效</color>。

messages.msgid: Summon a massive lightning bolt onto a target location.  This glamour may only be used outside during a storm.
translations: 在目标位置召唤一道巨大的闪电。此妖术只能在风暴天的户外使用。

messages.msgid: You call down a bolt of thunder!

Infuse the energy of the summer sun into your yourself, preparing for battle.  Your stamina will regenerate faster in proportion to the number of adjacent enemies, and you will have an easier time dodging enemy attacks.  In the winter the glamour <color_yellow>is less effective</color>.
translations: 汲取夏日骄阳之力注入己身，为战斗做好准备。你周围的敌人越多，你的耐力恢复速度就越快，你也越容易闪避敌人的攻击。此妖术在冬季的威力会<color_yellow>有所削弱</color>。

messages.msgid: Conjure up a thunderstorm, causing the sky to cloud over, rain to fall, and eventually lightning to flash.  You have no control over the storm once you set it in motion.  This glamour <color_red>will not work</color> if you are indoors or if the temperature is below freezing.
translations: 召唤一场雷暴，使天空乌云密布，降下大雨，最终电闪雷鸣。一旦发动，你便无法控制这场风暴。此妖术在室内或气温低于冰点时<color_red>无效</color>。

messages.msgid: Summon up a circle of flames around yourself and a nearby enemy, allowing you to fight undisturbed.  You will be immune to the heat of the flames while they last, though stepping into them will end this protection.  The death of the chosen enemy will end the glamour.  You must be <color_yellow>outdoors</color> for this glamour to have any effect.  In the summer, the flames are <color_green>even hotter</color>.  Reweave the glamour to dispel it.
translations: 在你和一名近敌周围召唤一圈烈焰，让你能不受干扰地战斗。在烈焰持续期间，你将免疫其灼热，但踏入其中会终止此项庇护。选中的敌人死亡后，此妖术便会终结。你必须身处<color_yellow>室外</color>，此术方能生效。在夏季，火焰会更加<color_green>炽热</color>。重塑此术即可将其驱散。

messages.msgid: Blaze with the blinding light of the sun, blinding anyone nearby capable of seeing you.  This is real sunlight and affects creatures harmed by it accordingly.
translations: 你的身体迸发出炫目的太阳光辉，使周围能看见你的生物目眩。这是真正的日光，会对惧光生物造成相应伤害。
