messages.msgid: You and your nearby allies' footsteps make almost no sound when you move, like the footsteps of an animal traveling across new-fallen snow.  If used in winter, your footsteps are <color_green>totally silent</color>.  The glamour is <color_yellow>quicker to expire</color> in summer.
translations: 你和附近盟友移动时的脚步声几近于无，如同野兽行于新雪之上。若在冬季使用，你的脚步将<color_green>完全无声</color>。此妖术在</color>夏季会<color_yellow>更快失效。

messages.msgid: Summon up thick ice around the target's lower limbs, freezing them in place.  Larger targets require more sorcerous might to affect.  If used in winter, the ice covers all of the target's limbs and they also <color_green>cannot attack</color> for the glamour's duration.  The glamour is <color_yellow>quicker to expire</color> in summer.
translations: 在目标的下肢周围召唤厚冰，将其原地冻结。体型更大的目标需要更强的法力才能奏效。若在冬季使用，寒冰将覆盖目标的所有肢体，且在妖术</color>持续期间，目标也<color_green>无法攻击。此妖术在夏季会<color_yellow>更快失效</color>。

messages.msgid: You can create ice under your feet, allowing you to walk across water or other liquids without sinking into them.  The glamour is <color_yellow>quicker to expire</color> in summer.
translations: 你可以在脚下凝结成冰，从而在水面或其他液体上行走而不会下沉。此妖术在夏季会<color_yellow>更快失效</color>。

messages.msgid: Instill ice into a single target's tongue, rendering it heavy and unwieldy in their mouth, and silence their voice with it.  The affected target will not be able to speak or make any noise at all.  The glamour <color_green>lasts much longer</color> in winter.
translations: 将寒冰注入单个目标的舌头，使其在口中变得沉重而笨拙，并以此禁绝其声。受术目标将完全无法说话或发出任何声音。此妖术在冬季的持续时间会<color_green>更长</color>。

messages.msgid: Snow forms around your hand as you gesture at your target.
translations: 你向目标打了个手势，雪花在你手中凝结。

messages.msgid: Call up the essence of an endless snow field, shining a moment of brilliant light into your target's eyes and blinding them.  The glamour only works outdoors during the day.  The glamour's duration <color_yellow>is reduced</color> in summer.
translations: 唤起无垠雪原的精萃，将一瞬的强光照入目标眼中，使其目盲。此妖术仅在白天的室外生效。此妖术在夏季的持续时间会<color_yellow>缩短</color>。

messages.msgid: You gesture and your target blinks.
translations: 你打了个手势，你的目标眨了眨眼。

messages.msgid: Draw in the chill air of winter and breathe out a cone of freezing air and ice, damaging and slowing your opponents.
translations: 吸入凛冬的寒气，再呼出一口夹杂着冰霜的锥形寒流，对敌人造成伤害并使其减速。

messages.msgid: You breathe out a cone of freezing air.

Freeze out all emotion in your heart, rendering you perfectly calm.  This will cancel extremes of both positive and negative emotion and prevent you from feeling anything for the glamour's duration.  This latter effect <color_red>does not occur</color> in summer.
translations: 冰封你心中的所有情感，使你臻于绝对的冷静。这将消除所有极端正面和负面的情绪，并在妖术持续期间让你心如止水。后一种效果在夏季<color_red>不会出现</color>。

messages.msgid: Become at home in darkness, allowing you to read and perform normal crafting actions as long as there is even a bit of light available.  This glamour <color_yellow>only works outdoors</color> in summer.
translations: 让你与黑暗为伴，只要有哪怕一丝微光，便能进行阅读和常规的制作活动。此妖术在夏季时，<color_yellow>仅在室外生效</color>。

messages.msgid: You open your eyes to the dark and the cold.
translations: 你在黑暗与寒冷中睁开了双眼。

messages.msgid: Cause a short but furious winter storm in a target location, dropping fist-sized hailstones and ice on your enemies.  The glamour leaves behind a field of ice that makes movement very treacherous.  This ice <color_red>melts immediately</color> in the summer.
translations: 在目标位置引发一场短暂而猛烈的冬季风暴，向你的敌人降下拳头大小的冰雹和冰块。此妖术会留下一片冰面，使移动变得异常凶险。在夏季，这些</color>冰会<color_red>立即融化。

messages.msgid: Infuse yourself with the cold and the stasis of iron, cutting off your fey powers.  You will no longer to be able to use any glamours, but can touch iron and steel without penalty.  This glamour's duration is <color_green>extended</color> in winter.
translations: 将钢铁的冰冷与静滞注入你的身体，切断你的妖精之力。你将无法再使用任何妖术，但可以触摸铁和钢而免受惩罚。此妖术在冬季的持续时间会<color_green>延长</color>。

messages.msgid: You feel an dull cold fill your entire body.
translations: 一股阴冷的寒意传遍你的全身。

messages.msgid: Draw on the power of winter to recreate the polar night, blotting out the sun and plunging the nearby area into darkness.  This glamour's duration is <color_yellow>greatly reduced</color> in summer.
translations: 汲取寒冬之力，重现极夜之景，遮蔽太阳，使附近区域陷入黑暗。此妖术在夏季的持续时间会<color_yellow>大幅缩短</color>。

messages.msgid: Using the power of human dreams, unlock the secrets of new seasonal magicks.  It requires a large amount of dreamdross and time to perform this research.
translations: 运用人类梦境的力量，解开新的季节魔法的秘密。这项研究需要大量的浮梦残渣和时间来完成。

messages.msgid: Pull the power of creativity and enchantment from dreamdross and condense it into dreamsparks, so you can use them to power fae magicks.
translations: 从浮梦残渣中汲取创造与附魔之力，并将其凝炼成梦之火花，以便用其驱动妖精魔法。

messages.msgid: Disguise yourself within nature, as a rock or tree or part of a babbling brook.  You must be outdoors and on natural terrain for the glamour to take hold, and the glamour <color_red>ends instantly</color> if you move or attack.
translations: 将自己伪装成自然的一部分，比如一块岩石、一棵树，或是潺潺溪流的一部分。你必须身处室外的自然地形，此妖术才能生效，且一旦移动或攻击，此术便会<color_red>立即终结</color>。

messages.msgid: Lord, what fools these mortals be, especially when they cannot see what's right in front of them.  You will be invisible for a time, as long as you do not take hostile action.
translations: 主啊，凡人何其愚哉，尤其是当他们对眼前之物视而不见时。只要你不采取敌对行动，你就能在一段时间内保持隐形。

messages.msgid: With a laugh and a wink, you disappear.
translations: 伴随着一声轻笑和一次眨眼，你的身影消失了。

messages.msgid: Summon the ignes fatui to lead your enemies astray.
translations: 召唤鬼火，引诱你的敌人误入歧途。

messages.msgid: At your command, distant lights appear.
translations: 随着你的指令，远方出现了几点光亮。

messages.msgid: Purify yourself or an ally, removing a wide variety of debilitating conditions such as disease or poison.  However, doing so will fatigue the target; too many problems will lead to a long period of recovery afterwards.
translations: 净化你自己或一名盟友，移除各种减益状态，如疾病或中毒。然而，这么做会使目标疲劳；需要解决的问题太多会导致之后需要很长一段时间来恢复。

messages.msgid: You wave your hand at your target.
translations: 你向你的目标挥了挥手。

messages.msgid: Set a weapon to burn with the purifying light of Bealtaine's bonfires, illuminating your surroundings and causing the weapon to burn anything it strikes.  It does additional damage to creatures of the Nether.  The glamour will not work without a weapon to affect.
translations: 让一件武器燃起圣炎的净化之光，照亮你的周围，并使其灼烧击中的任何目标。它对来自幽冥的生物造成额外伤害。若没有可供附魔的武器，此妖术将无法生效。

messages.msgid: Enhance yourself or an ally with the athleticism and prowess of the dancers, runners, and hurlers of Lughnasadh.  This increases movement and attack speed, dodging ability, and allows the target to leap to a rooftop from a standing start.
translations: 将丰收节庆典中舞者、奔跑者与投掷手的矫健与神勇赋予自身或盟友。此举将提升目标的移动与攻击速度、闪避能力，并使其能够原地跃上屋顶。

messages.msgid: Summon the hosts of Samhain, the spirits of the victorious dead, to defeat your enemies.  The hosts of Samhain are mighty in battle but cannot abide the light of the sun.
translations: 召唤幽冥行伍——那些凯旋的亡者英灵，前来为你击溃敌军。幽冥行伍战力卓绝，但畏惧天光。

messages.msgid: As you gesture, shadowy figures appear around your target.
translations: 随着你的手势，一团团黑影出现在你的目标周围。

messages.msgid: With a stern word of command, you can glamour one of the common fae, the redcaps or brownies or pooka or bannermen, into defending you from your enemies.
translations: 你可以用一句严厉的命令，将一个常见的妖精——无论是红帽子、棕仙、普卡精还是旗卫——迷惑过来，为你抵御敌人。

messages.msgid: You snap out an order to your target.
translations: 你对你的目标厉声下令。

messages.msgid: With a stern word of command or a whispered entreaty, you can glamour a human into defending you from your enemies.
translations: 用一句严厉的命令或一声低语的恳求，你可以迷惑一个人类，令其为你抵御敌人。

messages.msgid: You cast your glamour over your target.
When in danger of being discovered, brownies can slip away in moments.  This glamour allows you to vanish and reappear elsewhere in the house.  It cannot be used outdoors.
translations: 当有被发现的危险时，棕仙可以在片刻间溜走。此妖术能让你原地消失，并出现在屋内的其他地方。此术无法在室外使用。

messages.msgid: You always know your home and can return to it at need.  When standing in a doorway, you can use this glamour to return to the last place you slept, as long as you spent at least a day at that place previously and as long as you are unobserved.
translations: 你永远认得自己的家，并能在需要时返回。当你站在门口时，只要未被他人察觉，便可使用此妖术返回你上一个睡过觉的地方——前提是你曾在那个地方待过至少一天。

messages.msgid: You have learned to speak the secret tongues of birds and beasts and may use it to ask them for aid.  Casting this spell on a mammal or a bird will ally them with you, causing them to defend you against your enemies.
translations: 你已学会鸟兽秘语，可以借此向它们求援。对哺乳动物或鸟类施放此法术，可使它们与你结盟，保护你免受敌人侵害。

messages.msgid: You whisper a few words in the language of beasts.
translations: 你用兽语低声说了几句。

messages.msgid: With a wink and a bit of fae glamour, you can enchant a target to defend you for a brief time.  This glamour only <color_yellow>only works</color> on humans.
translations: 只需眨眼示意，再施加些许妖精的魅惑，你便能使一个<color_yellow>目标在短时间内为你而战。此魅惑仅对</color>人类奏效。

messages.msgid: Call a thick fog from the surrounding air, breaking line of sight with your enemies and obscuring your presence.  Weave the glamour again to dispel it.
translations: 从周遭空气中唤出浓雾，阻断敌人的视线，掩盖你的行踪。再次编织幻术即可将其驱散。

messages.msgid: Thick fog billows up around you.
translations: 浓雾在你周围翻涌而起。

messages.msgid: Manipulate the weather, pulling the water from the air and cause a thick fog to form and blanket the countryside.  Weave the glamour again to dispel it.
translations: 操控天气，从空气中凝结水汽，形成笼罩郊野的浓雾。再次编织幻术即可将其驱散。

messages.msgid: Manipulate the weather, causing the sky to cloud over and rain to fall.  Weave the glamour again to dispel it.  You cannot control the weather if the temperature is too cold.
translations: 操控天气，使天空乌云密布，降下雨水。再次编织幻术即可将其驱散。气温过低时，你无法操控天气。

messages.msgid: Manipulate the weather, causing the sky to cloud over and heavy rains to fall.  Weave the glamour again to dispel it.  You cannot control the weather if the temperature is too cold.
translations: 操控天气，使天空乌云密布，降下暴雨。再次编织幻术即可将其驱散。气温过低时，你无法操控天气。

messages.msgid: Manipulate the weather, transforming a rainstorm into a violent lightning storm.  It must already be raining heavily to transform the weather into a lightning storm, and a lightning storm cannot be controlled after the glamour is woven.
translations: 操控天气，将暴风雨转变为狂暴的雷暴。必须已在下暴雨才能将天气转为雷暴，且幻术编织完成后，雷暴将无法控制。

messages.msgid: Make a distant knocking sound, leading others astray.
translations: 制造出远处的敲击声，将他人引向歧途。
一声沉闷的巨响回荡开来。

messages.msgid: You may spin a bit of fae magic into water, bringing forth a goblin fruit.  Goblin fruit have a variety of effects, never predictable but always at least somewhat beneficial.  This spell may only be cast near water or under the rain.
translations: 你可以将些许妖精魔法织入水中，催生出一枚妖精果实。妖精果实效果多样，无法预测，但至少总有些益处。此法术只能在水源附近或雨中施放。

messages.msgid: You may spin a bit of fae magic into the air, bringing forth a goblin fruit.  Goblin fruit have a variety of effects, never predictable but always at least somewhat beneficial.  This spell may only be cast indoors, when nobody is watching.
translations: 你可以将些许妖精魔法织入空气中，催生出一枚妖精果实。妖精果实效果多样，无法预测，但至少总有些益处。此法术只能在室内无人注视时施放。

messages.msgid: You may spin a bit of fae magic into the air, bringing forth a goblin fruit.  Goblin fruit have a variety of effects, never predictable but always at least somewhat beneficial.  This spell may only be cast near an animal.
translations: 你可以将些许妖精魔法织入空气中，催生出一枚妖精果实。妖精果实效果多样，无法预测，但至少总有些益处。此法术只能在动物附近施放。

messages.msgid: You may spin a bit of fae magic into the earth, bringing forth a goblin fruit.  Goblin fruit have a variety of effects, never predictable but always at least somewhat beneficial.  This spell may only be cast underground or at night.
translations: 你可以将些许妖精魔法织入大地，催生出一枚妖精果实。妖精果实效果多样，无法预测，但至少总有些益处。此法术只能在地下或夜晚施放。

messages.msgid: You may spin a bit of fae magic into the air, bringing forth a goblin fruit.  Goblin fruit have a variety of effects, never predictable but always at least somewhat beneficial.  This spell may only be cast near a human or a Fae.
translations: 你可以将些许妖精魔法织入空气中，催生出一枚妖精果实。妖精果实效果多样，无法预测，但至少总有些益处。此法术只能在人类或妖精附近施放。

messages.msgid: Freeze your target in time, preventing them from acting but also preventing them from suffering harm.
translations: 冻结所选目标的时间，使其无法行动的同时也不会受到伤害。

messages.msgid: You freeze your target in time!
Fix the target area's timestream, unfreezing frozen targets and ending any active timeloops.
translations: 修复目标区域的时间流动，解除目标的时间冻结并结束任何激活的时间循环。

messages.msgid: Remove a time loop.  Part of the main unfreeze spell.  Having this spell is a bug.
translations: 移除时间循环。解冻主法术的一部分。拥有这个法术是一个bug。

messages.msgid: Unfreeze terrain from frozen time.  Part of the main unfreeze spell.  Having this spell is a bug.
translations: 使目标地形从时间冻结中解冻。解冻主法术的一部分。拥有这个法术是一个bug。

messages.msgid: Dangerously destabilize local time in an area, flooding everything within with entropy.  This will destroy any areas of frozen time and steadily erode any creatures caught within.
translations: 破坏一块区域的时间的稳定性，使熵淹没其中的一切。这将摧毁任何时间冻结的区域，并不断侵蚀任何其中的生物。

messages.msgid: Remove fields of frozen time.  Part of the Entropic Burst spell.  Having this spell is a bug.
translations: 移除时间冻结的地域。时熵爆发法术的一部分。拥有这个法术是一个bug。

messages.msgid: Unfreeze target from frozen time.  Part of the main entropic burst spell.  Having this spell is a bug.
translations: 使目标从时间冻结中解冻。时熵爆发法术的一部分。拥有这个法术是一个bug。

messages.msgid: Create an impenetrable bubble of frozen time at your chosen location, freezing everything within.
translations: 在你所选的位置制造一个时间完全冻结的气泡，不可穿透，并使里面的一切事物停滞。

messages.msgid: You create a bubble of frozen time!
translations: 你制造了一个时间冻结的气泡！

messages.msgid: Rewind the last injury you have taken, erasing the effects it has had on your person.
translations: 将最后一次创伤倒回到发生之前，抹去它对你的影响。

messages.msgid: Loop time around your person for a short duration, repeatedly resetting any changes to your person every few seconds.
translations: 在接下来的短暂时间里使你的时间不断循环，每隔几秒钟就重置你身上发生的一切变化。

messages.msgid: Temporarily halt the progression of time for everything but yourself.  Lasts roughly 2 seconds per level.
translations: 暂停你以外一切时间的进程。每级大约持续2秒。

messages.msgid: Revert yourself to a location you have previously memorized.
translations: 将自己还原到曾经记忆过的位置。

messages.msgid: Spend time memorizing an area so you can revert your physical location to that spot.
translations: 花一点时间把这个位置记在脑中，这样你你就能将自己物质上的位置复原到此处。

messages.msgid: Stabilize a zone of disjointed time, preventing it from decaying.
translations: 固化一个不连贯的时间区域，使其不再会衰退。

messages.msgid: Stabilize target of frozen time.  Part of the main cement spell.  Having this spell is a bug.
translations: 固化时间冻结的目标。固化主法术的一部分。拥有这个法术是一个bug。

messages.msgid: Create a minute incision in your target's personal timestream, separating their present from their past and thus deleting them from reality in a temporal paradox.  This technique is harder to perform on more powerful foes, and may result in backlash if you are not prepared.  Luckily, this time anomaly is significant enough that merely observing it will give you significant temporal insights based on its strength.
translations: 在目标个人的时间流上制造一个微小的切口，将其现在与过去分离，从而以一个时间悖论将他们从现实中抹除。此技法对更强大的敌人施展时难度更高，若准备不足可能会遭到反噬。幸运的是，此时间异常现象十分显著，仅凭观察其强度便能让你获得重要的时空洞见。

messages.msgid: Create a long-lasting time loop around yourself which you can end at any time.  Ending the loop will return you to the state you were in at the start of it.
translations: 在自己身上创造一个可以随时结束的持久时间循环。结束循环会将您重置到循环开始时的状态。

messages.msgid: You speed up the flow of your personal timestream, allowing you to act quicker relative to everything else.  This power will remain active until toggled off.
translations: 你加快了时间在你身上的流动，让你比其他事物更快地行动。此能力将保持激活，直到切换为关闭。

messages.msgid: By maintaining a field of destabilized time around your body, you can effortlessly cause your attacks to erode your target over time.  This power will remain active until toggled off.
translations: 在你的身体周围保持一个失序时间场，使你可以通过正常的攻击来逐渐侵蚀目标。此能力将保持激活，直到切换为关闭。
失序打击（切换） - 攻击

messages.msgid: This causes the dot when attacking targets with the destabilizing strikes buff.  Having the spell is a bug.
translations: 当你具有失序打击状态时，对你攻击的目标造成持续伤害。拥有这个法术是一个bug。

messages.msgid: Stabilize your personal timeline, making yourself immune to adverse changes to time around you.  This power will remain active until toggled off.
translations: 维持你个人的时间线的稳定，使你免疫周围时间变化的负面影响。此能力将保持激活，直到切换为关闭。

messages.msgid: Reverse the entropy on your equipment, repairing any damage it has taken or energy it has spent over time.  This power will remain active until toggled off.
translations: 逆转你身上的物品上的熵，逐渐复原它所受到的损伤或所消耗的能量。此能力将保持激活，直到切换为关闭。

messages.msgid: Sink into a mediative trance where you steadily rewrite the causality of your current wounds, effectively healing yourself of injury.  This power will remain active until you run out of mana or your wounds are healed.
translations: 沉浸在一种冥想的状态中，你不断地改写你当前伤口的因果，有效地治愈你受到的伤害。此能力将保持激活，直到你的魔力耗尽或你的伤口被治愈。

messages.msgid: Sink into a mediative trance where you steadily rewrite the causality of your carried items, efficiently repairing any faults they may have.  This power will remain active until you run out of mana or your wounds are healed.
translations: 沉浸在一种冥想的状态中，你不断地改写你随身携带的物品的因果，高效地复原它们的破损，变形或是消耗的能量。此能力将保持激活，直到你的魔力耗尽。

messages.msgid: Your eyes glow lavender for a moment.  Now your sight can pierce the darkest shadows.
translations: 你的眼睛闪着淡紫色的光芒。现在你的目光可以穿透最深沉的阴影。

messages.msgid: Everything around you faces an existential crisis and moves slower as a result.  Including things that you wouldn't expect to suffer from existential crises, like the undead.  The air around the targets' extremities chills dramatically.  Higher levels allow a bigger AoE, and longer effect.
translations: 你周围的一切都面临着生存恐惧，因此行动缓慢。包括那些你通常不认为会有生存恐惧的东西，比如不死生物。目标四肢周围的空气急剧冷却。等级越高，范围越大，影响越久。

messages.msgid: The edges of your form seem to blur and distort, increasing the amount of attacks you might dodge in a given turn.
translations: 你身体的边缘看起来模糊扭曲，增加了你在一个回合中所能闪避攻击的次数。

messages.msgid: Allows you to move some damage from your body to someone else.  Usually people don't like it, but who cares now?
translations: 让你将一些伤害从自身转移到其他人身上。通常人们不喜欢这个法术，但现在谁在乎呢？

messages.msgid: Transports you from one place to another, creating a huge fire explosion in the end.
translations: 将你从一个地方传送到另一个地方，并在终点处造成巨大的火焰爆炸。

messages.msgid: A few daffodil warriors appear near you.  They will fight for you, but they will fade away after a day.
translations: 几名水仙战士出现在你身边。他们会为你而战，但一天后便会消散。

messages.msgid: Summons your critters back to you, if they got lost.
translations: 如果您的召唤兽走失了，把它们召唤回来。

messages.msgid: This ephemeral blade allows you to defend yourself with dreams brought out of your mind!
translations: 这把短暂存在的剑可以让你用脑海中的浮梦来保护自己！

messages.msgid: This ephemeral dagger is powered with your own inner reality connections, and is deadlier the larger your mana pool.
translations: 这把昙花一现的匕首由你的内在现实连接驱动，你的魔力池越大，它的杀伤力就越大。

messages.msgid: Armor that sits lightly on your body with little in the way of encumbrance and rests on top of whatever you are wearing.
translations: 召唤出一套轻轻盖在你身上的盔甲，几乎没有什么累赘，并且叠加在你所穿衣物的上方。

messages.msgid: Attempts to banish things clearly inimical to local physics back to their home dimension.
translations: 试图将那些明显违背此地物理法则的存在驱逐回它们原本的维度。

messages.msgid: Attempts to banish monsters crafted from the darkest of nights.
translations: 试图放逐那些由最深沉的夜晚所造的怪物。

messages.msgid: Make a fake copy of yourself to disrupt your enemies.
translations: 制作一个自己的假分身来扰乱你的敌人。

messages.msgid: Fill the reality with your own copies.
All walls are obliterated before your eyes.
translations: 你眼前所有的墙都被抹去了。

messages.msgid: Feel them.  See them.  Connect to them.
translations: 感受他们。看见他们。连接他们。

messages.msgid: Summon a portal creature to help in a dangerous situation.
translations: 召唤传送门生物来帮助应对危险情况。

messages.msgid: Summon a disturbed sapient entity of another reality with a hatred for living creatures.  It won't attack you.  At least for now.
translations: 召唤一个来自另一个现实的对生物怀有仇恨的受干扰的智慧实体。它不会攻击你。至少目前是这样。

messages.msgid: Using your energy you construct an oddly shaped hammer.  You can use it to smash your enemies, or breach different obstacles.
translations: 利用你的能量，你制造了一个形状奇特的锤子。你可以用它来粉碎你的敌人，或者粉碎各种障碍。

messages.msgid: Summon an impenetrable bubble of frozen time at your chosen location, freezing everything within.
translations: 在你所选的位置召唤一个时间完全冻结的气泡，不可穿透，并使里面的一切事物停滞。

messages.msgid: Toss a coin.  On which side are you?
Summon a creature that looks pretty similar to how angels are described in the Bible - a giant flying mess of wings, eyes and rings.
translations: 召唤一种生物，它的外形与《圣经》中描述的天使十分相似--一个长着翅膀、眼睛和圆环的巨大飞行物。

messages.msgid: Create a small token.  When used, it'll pull you back to the place you created it.
translations: 创建一个小标记。 使用时，它会把你拉回到你创建它的地方。

messages.msgid: Using your abilities, you compress the gap between your hands with pure energy, attempting to construct…  something.
translations: 利用你的能力，你用纯粹的能量压缩双手之间的间隙，试图构建……某种东西。

messages.msgid: Continuously generate short-lived bubbles of accelerated time around you, allowing you and anything else that enters to act far quicker than normal.
translations: 在你周围持续生成短暂的时间加速泡，让你及任何进入其中的事物都能以远超正常的速度行动。

messages.msgid: Two ethereal wings sprout out of your back indefinitely until toggled off.  They work as phantasmal pair of wings that can somehow lift your weight even without conscious effort.
translations: 两只虚灵之翼从你背后生出，并将一直存在，直到你主动关闭。它们就像一对幻象之翼，即便你无意识地发力，也能以某种方式托起你的体重。

messages.msgid: Four transparent arms emit out of your body indefinitely until toggled off.  They work as a desirable additional pair of arms, and who knows what power they contain?
translations: 四条透明手臂从你身体中伸出，并将一直存在，直到你主动关闭。它们是求之不得的额外手臂，天知道其中蕴含着何种力量？

messages.msgid: Your own eyes are replaced with the eyeballs of an unknown creature, indefinitely, until you toggle them off.  Compounded from billions of red crosses inside void-dark sclera, they can see much more clearly than any natural creature.
translations: 你的双眼被未知生物的眼球所取代，并将一直存在，直到你主动关闭。它们的巩膜漆黑如渊，其中由亿万个红色十字构成，视物远比任何自然生物都清晰。

messages.msgid: A stretchy tail appears from the base of your spine, instinctively aiding you in battle or moving to defend you, indefinitely, until toggled off.
translations: 一条伸缩自如的尾巴从你的脊椎末端长出，它会本能地在战斗中协助或保护你，并将一直存在，直到你主动关闭。

messages.msgid: The line between reality and your dreams shrinks enormously.  In this dream you are barely affected by reality, with most changes to your body reverting when you wake up.  While it may end your dream, not even death can touch you.
translations: 模糊现实与梦境的边界。在梦中你几乎不受现实的影响，梦中身体发生的大部分变化都会在你醒来时复原。在梦中“死亡”会导致你当场醒来，但死亡抓不到你。

messages.msgid: Creates a crystal blacksmith's hammer with which to build a new reality.  You need all your magic force to hold it, and you are unable to do any magic while using it.
translations: 创造出一柄晶体铁匠锤，用以构筑崭新的现实。你需要耗尽所有魔力才能握住它，且使用期间无法施展任何法术。

messages.msgid: You consume dreamdross to regain mana.  Pretty tasty.
translations: 你吃下浮梦残渣来获取魔力。

messages.msgid: You can consume more dreamdross to regain mana in one sitting.  Delicious.
translations: 你一次性吃下更多浮梦残渣。

messages.msgid: You can't really process so much dreamdross at once, and additionally to restoring your mana pool, it directly improves your body, making your stronger and healthier.  It is probably the most delicious thing in your life.
translations: 你一次吸收不了太多的浮梦残渣，在恢复魔力值之外它还直接改变着你的身体，使你更强壮更健康。这可能是你生命中吃过的最好吃的东西了。

messages.msgid: With a shouted ancient word, the target's blood temperature begins to increase dangerously.
translations: 随着一声古代咒语，目标的血液温度开始危险地升高。

messages.msgid: Absorbs some dross and heals damage to yourself.
translations: 消耗一些浮梦残渣并修复自身伤害。

messages.msgid: Absorbs some dross and heals fatigue to yourself.
translations: 吸收一些浮梦残渣并治愈自己的疲劳。

messages.msgid: Force pushes your feet off the ground and launches you several meters.
translations: 魔力把你的脚推离地面，把你跃起离地面几米。

messages.msgid: Enhance your eyes to see at night as clearly as in daylight.
translations: 增强你的视力，使你在夜间看得像白天一样清楚。

messages.msgid: Take the blows.  Don't let the world kill you.
translations: 承受住打击。别让这个世界杀了你。

messages.msgid: Your body is a tool of destruction.  Use it effectively.
translations: 你的身体是一台毁灭机器，请明智地使用它。

messages.msgid: Throw a long ethereal spear out of your hand.
translations: 从你的手中投出一根长长的空灵之矛。

messages.msgid: Run.  Run as fast as you can.  Don't stop.
translations: 跑。 尽可能快地跑。别停下。

messages.msgid: Make enemies around you more vulnerable.
translations: 使你周围的敌人更脆弱。

messages.msgid: Nothing can move you from your path.
translations: 任何东西都无法把你推开或拉走。

messages.msgid: Prevent hostile adjustments to your personal reality and timeline.
translations: 防止你的个人现实与时间线遭到恶意调整。

messages.msgid: Generate an unstable field of time close to your body that erodes creatures you attack in melee over time.
translations: 在身体附近生成一个不稳定的时间场，它会随着时间推移，不断侵蚀你近战攻击的生物。

messages.msgid: This causes the dot when attacking targets with the erosion buff.  Having the spell is a bug.
A straight hit with your arm.  Using additional energy you could probably break a wall with such a powerful strike.
translations: 用手臂发出的一记直击。若注入额外能量，这强力一击或许能击穿墙壁。

messages.msgid: To Keep Off the Rain and the Damp
Keep yourself from getting wet in the rain.  The charm will not keep you dry if you step into a water source.
translations: 保护你不被雨水淋湿。如果你在水里，这个符咒不能让你保持干燥。

messages.msgid: You crush the leaves and wrap them in the cloth, touching it to you forehead, the crown of your head, both shoulders, and the backs of both wrists as you recite the words of the charm.
translations: 你碾碎树叶，用布包好，一边用它触碰你的前额，头顶，双肩和两腕背侧，一边念出咒语。

messages.msgid: To Bring Light to Dark Places
Summon up a bobbing ball of light, just bright enough to read by.  You may activate the witchlight to dismiss it.
translations: 召唤一颗跳动的光球，亮度刚好适合阅读。激活女巫灯来驱散它。

messages.msgid: Takin a bit of oil on your fingertips, you trace a pattern in the air while reciting the words of the charm, and a glowing ball of light forms in the air.
translations: 你用指尖蘸取些许油脂，在空中绘出图案，同时念出咒语，一颗发光的球体在空中成形。

messages.msgid: To Bring Health to the Soil and Life to the Crops
While standing on soil or turned earth, perform a ritual to increase the bounty of the crops.  The casting of this charm must end within one hour of noon.
translations: 站在泥土或翻耕过的土地上，举行一个仪式来增加作物的收成。此咒法的施展必须在正午前后一小时内结束。

messages.msgid: You dance slowly over the living earth, letting the seeds fall at the appropriate time, and as the sun climbs to its zenith you recite the last words of the charm.
translations: 你在生机勃勃的大地上缓缓起舞，在恰当的时机撒下种子，当太阳升至天顶之时，你念出了咒语的最后几句。

messages.msgid: Call forth the remnants of a fire from some ash to light a new flame.
translations: 从灰烬中唤出余火，点燃新的火焰。

messages.msgid: You sprinkle the wood ash over the kindling as you recite the words of the charm.
translations: 你一边吟诵咒语，一边将草木灰撒在引火物上。

messages.msgid: Using wild herbs and hawthorn berries, create an amulet that will tell you if any of the Fair Folk are nearby.
translations: 使用野生草药和山楂浆果，制作一个护身符，用以探知附近是否有仙灵出没。

messages.msgid: You laboriously sew the square of leather into a pouch and place the herbs and hawthorn berries inside.  Chanting softly, you seal the bag and attach the string to it so it can be worn around your neck.
translations: 你费力地将一块方正的皮革缝成小袋，把草药和山楂浆果放入其中。伴随着轻声吟唱，你封住袋口，系上绳子，以便能将它戴在脖子上。

messages.msgid: Using blood and ashes and certain herbs, create a paste that when rubbed on the eyes, will allow you to perceive otherworldly beings even in darkness or through walls.  It will inhibit your mundane sight, however.
translations: 使用血液、灰烬和某些草药，制作一种膏泥。将其涂抹在眼上，便能让你在黑暗中或隔着墙壁感知到异界的存在。然而，它会抑制你的凡俗视力。

messages.msgid: You grind the bones to powder and mix in the blood and herbs while rhythmically chanting the words of the charm, and when you're done you have a dark, foul-smelling paste as the reward of your labors.
translations: 你将骨头磨成粉末，一边有节奏地吟唱着咒语，一边混入血液和草药。完成后，你得到了一种深色、散发着恶臭的膏泥，作为你劳作的报偿。

messages.msgid: A spell to create a snare for catching one of the little folk, a changeling.  Has no effect on the elder spirits of wood and water, fire and earth, nor plant or man.
translations: 此咒可造出一个陷阱，用以捕获小精灵--变身者。它对林木与川流、火焰与大地的古老精魂无效，对草木与凡人亦然。

messages.msgid: You skein a complicated cat's cradle with splinters of wood guiding the way in to blackberries at each of the focus points in your design.
translations: 你用木片织成一圈复杂的翻绳结，以其为引，并在阵法的各个节点上放好黑莓作为诱饵。

messages.msgid: While outdoors, recite a quick charm to produce a flash of light like unto a thunderbolt, bedazzling anyone around you.
translations: 身处户外时，你可速念一段祷言，唤出一道霹雳般的闪光，令周遭之人目眩神迷。

messages.msgid: You call out the words of the charm to the sky and there is a burst of light.
translations: 你向天空高声诵出祷言，随即便迸发出一阵强光。

messages.msgid: To Purge the Most Virulent Grippe
By adding particular herbs and a bit of iron to your tea while you recite the words of the charm over it, you can brew a tea that will prove a sovereign remedy to a cold or a flu.
translations: 在泡茶时加入特定草药和少许铁屑，并同时对茶水诵念祷言，即可煮出一壶对感冒流感有奇效的灵茶。

messages.msgid: You brew the tea, adding in a bit of scrap iron and herbs to mix in, while you recite a chant as you stir, and eventually the tea is ready.
translations: 你煮着茶，加入少许铁屑和草药混合，一边搅拌一边吟诵咒文，不一会儿，茶就煮好了。

messages.msgid: To Ward Off the Evil Eye
With a bit of salt and some muttered words, deflect the gaze of the evil eye.
translations: 借助少许盐和几句低语，便可避开邪眼的注视。

messages.msgid: You toss a bit of salt over your left shoulder with your right hand and spit three times into the folds of your clothing as you say, "Keneinahora".
translations: 你用右手抓起一把盐，从左肩上撒过，然后朝自己的衣褶里连唾三口，同时念道：“Keneinahora”（意为“邪眼退散”）。

messages.msgid: With some string and the words of the charm, lock a door firmly, even one that doesn't have a locking mechanism.
translations: 用一段细绳和相应的祷言，便可将一扇门牢牢锁住，即使那扇门本身没有锁具。

messages.msgid: You wind the cord several times around your fingers, muttering the words of the charm, and as the pattern ends you hear a soft thud.
translations: 你将绳子在指间缠绕数次，口中低声念诵着祷言，待结形完成之时，你听到了一声轻微的闷响。

messages.msgid: With a candle, a penny, and paper, this will create a short lived luck charm upon oneself.
translations: 借助一支蜡烛、一枚铜板和一张纸，便可为自己制作一个短效的幸运符。

messages.msgid: You write the words upon the paper, place the penny on the ground, place the paper upon the penny, light the candle then the paper and firmly place the candle in the ashes on top of the penny, let the candle burn down melting all over the penny.  You will find your steps slightly lucky for the several hours to potentially a full day.
translations: 你将祷文写在纸上，将铜板置于地面，再把纸盖在铜板上。然后点燃蜡烛，用它引燃纸张，再将蜡烛稳稳地插在铜板顶上的灰烬中，任其燃烧殆尽，使蜡油完全覆盖铜板。在接下来的数小时乃至一整天里，你的运气会稍有提升。

messages.msgid: Gain a brief vision of what lies beyond a wall or a doorway.
translations: 获得一次短暂的启示，看清墙壁或门扉后的景象。

messages.msgid: You close your eyes and place the shards of glass over them and press, just slightly.  As the pain blooms and the blood trickles, you see beyond.
translations: 你闭上双眼，将玻璃碎片覆于其上，然后轻轻按压。当痛楚蔓延、鲜血渗出之时，你便能洞悉彼端。

messages.msgid: To Sooth the Pains and Injuries of the Flesh
Mix a paste of herbs, water, and willow bark and rub it on the target's wounds.  The charm increases the speed at which wounds heal, as long as the target does not engage in any strenuous activity.
translations: 将草药、水和柳树皮混合制成药膏，并涂抹在目标的伤口上。只要目标不进行任何剧烈活动，此祷言便能加快其伤口愈合的速度。

messages.msgid: You grind the herbs and willowbark together with the water, making a thick, woody-smelling paste, and rub it on the target.
translations: 你将草药和柳树皮与水一同碾磨，制成一种散发着木香的浓稠药膏，然后将其涂抹在目标身上。

messages.msgid: With some whispered words and a mixture of iron, salt, and herbs, increase your ability to stop the flow of blood.  Best recited right before bandaging a wound.
translations: 凭借几句低语祷言与铁、盐、草药的混合物，可以提升你的止血能力。最好在包扎伤口前诵念。

messages.msgid: You face toward the east and recite the words of the charm as you rub the iron and salt and herbs on your hands.
translations: 你面向东方，一边将铁、盐和草药的混合物在手上搓揉，一边念诵祷言。

messages.msgid: While standing in a forest, conceal your presence.  For a brief time after using the charm, anything looking at you will only see another bit of foliage.  Movement or taking any hostile action will cancel the charm.
translations: 身处林中时，可隐藏你的行踪。施展此祷言后的短时间内，任何看向你的生物都只会将你视作寻常草木。移动或采取任何敌对行动都会解除此效果。

messages.msgid: You wrap the beans in the leaf and, with a slight grimace, recite the words of the charm before you put them in your mouth and hold them there.
translations: 你用叶子将豆子包好，略作苦相，念诵祷言，随后将其放入口中含住。

messages.msgid: To Sail on the River of Dreams

With lavender and thyme, weave a barrier around your sleeping space to keep bad dreams away.  You must perform the charm directly before trying to sleep; moving will breach the barrier and allow the nightmares to find a way in again.
translations: 借助薰衣草和百里香，在你的安寝之处周围编织一道屏障，以驱离噩梦。你必须在入睡前立刻施展此祷言；任何移动都会破坏屏障，让梦魇再次乘虚而入。

messages.msgid: You place the herbs under your pillow and, while chanting the words of the charm, paint some thyme oil on the four corners of your sleeping space.
translations: 你将草药置于枕下，同时吟诵祷言，并将百里香油涂抹在安寝之处的四角。

messages.msgid: To Walk the Forests with the Brown One

Over the freshly-slain and butchered corpse of a bear, recite a paean to its spirit while using its fur and sinew and skull to create a garment.  Putting the garment on will take the spirit of the bear into yourself, allowing you to assume its form until the garment is removed.
translations: 对着一头新宰杀的熊尸，吟诵一首献给其灵魂的赞歌，同时用它的毛皮、筋腱和头骨制作一件外衣。穿上这件外衣便可将熊的灵魂纳为己有，使你化为熊形，直到将外衣脱下。

messages.msgid: As you recite the words of the charm, you sew the bits of fur together into a rough mantle with the bear skull at the top.
translations: 你一边念诵着祷言，一边将熊的毛皮缝合成一件粗糙的披风，并将熊头骨置于其顶端。

messages.msgid: To Walk Across the Flowing Waters

While standing with your feet in the water, recite this charm to have the water bear you up.  You must keep moving at a steady pace, without running or stopping for more than a few moments, or the charm will fade.
translations: 双脚立于水中时，念诵此祷言可令水流将你托起。你必须保持匀速移动，不可奔跑，亦不可驻足片刻，否则祷言将会失效。

messages.msgid: Ensorcell an iron or steel weapon that you are holding so it does additional damage to unholy creatures when used in melee combat.  If the weapon is too damaged, the charm will cease to function.
translations: 对你手持的铁制或钢制武器施加魔法，使其在近战中对邪恶生物造成额外伤害。如果武器耐久损坏过度，此魔法将会失效。

messages.msgid: After a period of trance and meditation, send out your disembodied spirit to wander the world.  Use of this ritual is <color_yellow>very tiring</color> and you will become increasingly more weary the longer you remain out of your body.
translations: 通过一段时间的冥想和神游，你可以让灵魂出窍，云游四方。举行此仪式会<color_yellow>非常劳累，</color>你的灵魂离体时间越长，你就会感到愈发疲惫。

messages.msgid: You settle down and slip into a trance.
translations: 你静下心来，进入了神游状态。

messages.msgid: To Shield the Mind from Assault

The first principle of psychic self-defense is to make sure your mind is in proper order so there is no foothold an assault can take advantage of.  While in effect, your mind is protected against psychic attack.  <color_red>Too much pain</color> will disrupt your concentration.
translations: 心灵自卫的首要原则，是确保心智井然有序，不给任何攻击留下可乘之机。效果持续期间，你的心智将免受心灵攻击。<color_red>过于剧烈的痛苦</color>会扰乱你的精神集中。

messages.msgid: You settle down and begin ordering your mind.
translations: 你静下心来，开始梳理自己的心智。

messages.msgid: Create a magic square that can later be used in a short ritual to walk across the surface of the water.
translations: 创造一个魔法方阵，之后可用于举行一个简短的仪式，从而实现在水面上行走。

messages.msgid: Focusing your mind and muttering the charms and spells under your breath, you carefully write down the patterns of the magic square.
translations: 你集中精神，口中低声念诵着祷言与咒语，小心翼翼地画下魔法方阵的图案。

messages.msgid: Create a magic square that can later be used in a short ritual to breathe underwater.
translations: 创造一个魔法方阵，之后可用于举行一个简短的仪式，从而实现在水下呼吸。

messages.msgid: Create a magic square that can later be used in a short ritual to do massive damage to a nearby structure.
translations: 创造一个魔法方阵，之后可用于举行一个简短的仪式，从而对附近的建筑物造成巨大破坏。

messages.msgid: To Cause Armed Men to Appear
Create a magic square to summon an ethereal group of soldiers who will attack your enemies.
translations: 创造一个魔法方阵，用以召唤一队会攻击你敌人的虚灵士兵。

messages.msgid: To Cause the Spirits to Bring us Anything We May Wish to Eat or to Drink
Create a magic square to cause an ethereal spirit to bring wine, meat, cheese, or bread to you.
translations: 创造一个魔法方阵，用以驱使一个虚灵为你取来酒、肉、奶酪或面包。

messages.msgid: To Render Oneself Invisible Unto Every Person
Create a magic square to that will cause you to turn completely invisible.  Violent action will reveal your presence.
translations: 创造一个魔法方阵，它会使你完全隐形。激烈的行动会暴露你的行踪。

messages.msgid: Your Fire Elemental abilities grant you good resistance to temperature conditions and heat damage.  Also your body emits streams of heat into anyone who attack you.
translations: 你的火元素能力使你对环境温度和热量伤害有很强的抵抗力。此外，任何攻击你的人都会被你身体散发出的热流所伤。

messages.msgid: Flames and heat flash out from where you've been hit.
translations: 火焰和热量自你击中的地方涌出。

messages.msgid: Your cloud skin grant you good resistance to temperature conditions.  Also your hands emit a small amount of electricity, increasing your damage in melee.
translations: 你的云皮肤赋予你良好的抵抗温度条件的能力。而且你的手会发出少量的电流，增加你在近战中的伤害。

messages.msgid: Your storm skin grant you good resistance to temperature conditions.  Also your hands emit a moderate amount of electricity, increasing your damage in melee.
translations: 你的风暴皮肤赋予你良好的抵抗温度条件的能力。此外，你的双手会发出适量的电力，增加你在近战中的伤害。

messages.msgid: Push the target.  It's not really effective, but sometimes comes in handy.
translations: 推开敌人，它并不是很有效，但有时还是可以派上用场。

messages.msgid: A small whip attack that uses energized cables as a conductor.
translations: 利用充能缆线传导能量，发动一次小型鞭击。

messages.msgid: Time suddenly stops for everything but you.
translations: 除了你之外，周围万物的时间都突然停止了。

messages.msgid: The sandwich is a flavor beyond time and space, and as you lick your fingers clean you feel your youth return to you - Wait, no, Your wounds are just healing.
translations: 这三明治的风味超越时空，当你舔净手指时，你感觉自己重返青春——等等，不是，只是你的伤口愈合了。

messages.msgid: The location the grenade occupied is instantly overwhelmed with sounds and colors you've never felt before as space warps in impossible ways.  Whatever used to be there is now gone.
translations: 手榴弹所在之处，空间以不可思议的方式扭曲，一瞬间被你从未感受过的声音与色彩所淹没。那里的东西已荡然无存。

messages.msgid: The two halves of the smoother surge together, forcing the teleporters together with a massive clang!  Due to your precise engineering the teleporters activate at the exact moment of impact, temporarily shunting them into the nether and unleashing a massive cascade of netherium energy that ripples around you.
translations: 聚合器的两半猛然合拢，伴随着一声巨响，强行将两个传送器撞在一起！得益于你的精密工程，传送器在撞击的瞬间精准激活，暂时将它们分流至虚空，并释放出一股巨大的虚质能量洪流，在你周围激起层层涟漪。

messages.msgid: Used by a time piercer to fix frozen time areas.  Having this spell is a bug.
Used by a time piercer to fix time frozen creatures.  Having this spell is a bug.
Freezes the target in time.  Having this spell is a bug.
translations: 冻结目标的时间。拥有这个法术是一个bug。
时间冻结 - 生成陷阱

messages.msgid: Spawns the trap after it is used.  Having this spell is a bug.
translations: 在陷阱使用后回收。拥有这个法术是一个bug。

messages.msgid: Fiery needles emerge from your body and surge towards anything vaguely hostile.
translations: 灼热的尖针从你体内涌出，射向任何有些许敌意的目标。

messages.msgid: Touch your victim and drain away a part of their ruach to fuel you.  It only works on living creatures, and animals provide barely any ruach compared to humans.
translations: 触摸受害者，汲取他们一部分的灵息为你所用。此能力只对活物有效，且与人类相比，动物提供的灵息微乎其微。

messages.msgid: Drain the ruach from a target at range.  It only works on living creatures, and animals provide barely any ruach compared to humans.
translations: 远距离汲取目标的灵息。此能力只对活物有效，且与人类相比，动物提供的灵息微乎其微。

messages.msgid: Curse a single nearby target with misfortune.
translations: 对附近单个目标降下厄运诅咒。

messages.msgid: Let out a piercing cry, disorienting all nearby enemies and allies.  Of necessity, this is a very loud course of action.
translations: 发出刺耳的啼叫，使附近所有的敌我单位晕头转向。此举必然会造成巨大的声响。

messages.msgid: Cut a single target off from the light.  It works only at night, and only either indoors or outside away from the cities.
translations: 使单个目标与光明隔绝。此能力只在夜晚生效，且只能在室内或远离城市的室外使用。

messages.msgid: Beguile a single human, fey, or avian target, causing them to stand in a stupor or wander aimlessly.  Any damage taken will break the effect.
translations: 蛊惑单个人类、精类或禽类目标，使其陷入昏沉或漫无目的地游荡。受到任何伤害都会解除此效果。

messages.msgid: Summon a miasma filled with pestilence to infect your enemies.  This supernatural disease can even strike zombies or stranger creatures.
translations: 召唤充满瘟疫的瘴气来感染你的敌人。这种超自然疾病甚至能侵袭丧尸或更奇异的生物。

messages.msgid: Enhance the power of the miasma from Unleash the Night-Wind, doing serious damage and crippling your target.
translations: 强化“释放夜风”所产生的瘴气，对目标造成严重伤害并使其残废。

messages.msgid: Spend ruach to alleviate your sleepiness.
translations: 消耗灵息以缓解你的困意。

messages.msgid: Manipulate the weather, pulling the water from the air and cause a thick fog to form and blanket the countryside.  Activate again to release your hold on the weather.
translations: 操控天气，从空气中汲取水分，形成笼罩郊野的浓雾。再次启动可解除你对天气的控制。

messages.msgid: Spend some ruach to greatly enhance your speed for a short period of time.
translations: 消耗一些灵息，在短时间内大幅提升你的速度。

messages.msgid: At night under the moon, you can greatly speed your healing, knitting together grievous wounds in moments.  This requires direct moonlight; clouds, rain, or being indoors will prevent this power from working.
translations: 在夜晚的月光下，你可以大幅加快你的治疗速度，在片刻间弥合严重创伤。此能力需要月光直射；云层、雨水或身处室内都会阻止其生效。

messages.msgid:
You can smell even the faintest traces of living human, or nearly-human, blood.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 0 ml.
Your fangs allow you to drink blood from an incapacitated or sleeping target.
translations: 你的尖牙使你能够从失去行动能力或沉睡的目标身上饮血。

messages.msgid:
You focus on sending the blood in your veins to where it can do the most good for your immediate stamina.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 100 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current).

Speak to nearby night-creatures; rats, bats, wolves, and so on.  They will tell you the layout of your surrounding area.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 100 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current).

You consume some of the blood in your veins, turning it into magical power.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 200 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current).

Heal your wounds with the power of stolen blood.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 750 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current).

With a bit of stolen blood and a savage expression, you can send your enemies fleeing.  This power only works on enemies capable of feeling fear.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 150 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current).

Stare into the eyes of your victim and wills them to pause.  This power does not work on unliving targets.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 150 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current).

Exert command over a predatory wild animal like a wolf or a rat, making it your ally for a time.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 500 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current).

You can sleep within the earth itself, avoiding the hateful light of the sun.  This power must be used on diggable soil.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 0 ml.
Enter a deathlike slumber and recover from your wounds and fatigue.  Preferably while somewhere nobody could attack you while you sleep.
translations: 进入死眠以恢复你的伤势与疲劳。最好在睡觉时无人能够攻击你的安全地点使用此能力。

messages.msgid:
Take control of a mind.  Only works on targets that have weak minds.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 700 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current).
You look for a mind to control.
Seep through a door or a window.
Create a magical sphere that will contain any blood you will put in it until the spell ends.
You conjure a magical sphere to store blood.

Surround yourself in shadows, becoming invisible for a while.  This power will fail if you stand outside under the sun.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 300 ml (<u_val:blood_amount_for_graph> ml current).
You gather as many shadows as you can.
The thick part of the flower, floating on the water.
translations: 花朵的厚实部分，漂浮在水面上。

messages.msgid: The central part of the flower.
Magical solar power, to power a floral vessel.
translations: 神奇的太阳能，为花舟提供动力。

messages.msgid: Eradicated the spiders in their blood.
translations: 消灭了他们体内的蜘蛛。

messages.msgid: Contracted a bloodborne pathogen out of legend.
translations: 感染了一种出自传说的血源性病原体。

messages.msgid: Rid themselves of a horrific curse of the blood.
translations: 摆脱了自己血液中的恐怖诅咒。

messages.msgid: Terrorized the remnants of humanity til there were none left.
translations: 让残存的人类陷入恐惧，直至最后一个人死去。

messages.msgid: Found a miracle in a world full of the dead.
translations: 在充满死亡的世界找寻到奇迹。
染上了一种超自然疾病。

messages.msgid: Empty your heart of its mortal dream.
The dawn breaks, and the owl lays down for its final rest.
translations: 黎明破晓，猫头鹰亦迎来了它的最终安息。

messages.msgid: Eradicated the spiders in their blood.
translations: 消灭了他们体内的蜘蛛。

messages.msgid: Contracted a bloodborne pathogen out of legend.
translations: 感染了一种出自传说的血源性病原体。

messages.msgid: Rid themselves of a horrific curse of the blood.
translations: 摆脱了自己血液中的恐怖诅咒。

messages.msgid: Terrorized the remnants of humanity til there were none left.
translations: 让残存的人类陷入恐惧，直至最后一个人死去。

messages.msgid: Found a miracle in a world full of the dead.
translations: 在充满死亡的世界找寻到奇迹。
染上了一种超自然疾病。

messages.msgid: Empty your heart of its mortal dream.
The dawn breaks, and the owl lays down for its final rest.
translations: 黎明破晓，猫头鹰亦迎来了它的最终安息。

messages.msgid: Born with the gift of gab.
What does the stone dream of?
Xedra Offworld Team: Big Game Hunter
XEDRA Operative, Department of Extra-Normal Capabilities, SATOR Division
Some would say that there's nothing particularly notable about you, but you've survived, and that's more than most could say right now.
translations: 有些人会说，你身上并没有什么可圈可点之处。不过，"你活下来了"——这一句话胜过千言万语。

messages.msgid: You had no idea what was going on the first time it happened, when you woke up with mud on your bare feet and a sour taste in your mouth, but you were soon found.  The People of the Moon, they called themselves, and they said you were one of them.  A werewolf.  You lived out in the wilderness for a while but didn't entirely abandon human civilization, and when the Cataclysm hit you ignored the evacuation warnings and struck it out on your own.  Maybe some of the People are still out there.
translations: 第一次发生的时候，你根本不知道发生了什么，当你醒来时，光脚上沾满了泥，嘴里带着酸味，但很快你就被发现了。他们自称是月球人，他们说你是他们中的一员。一个狼人。你在荒野中生活了一段时间，但并没有完全放弃人类文明，当大灾变来袭时，你无视疏散警告，自己闯荡了。也许有些人还在外面。

messages.msgid: For most or all of your life, you've had a secret; you are a predator.  While you don't need to drink blood or eat flesh or anything so crude, you must absorb the spiritual essence, the "ruach", of living beings in order to maintain your health and vitality.  You had to hide your condition before the Cataclysm, especially as things became stranger in the years leading up to it, but now you don't have to hide anymore.  On the other hand, your potential ruach supply has taken a drastic decline.
translations: 在你一生的大部分，或全部时间里，你都有一个秘密；你是个掠食者。虽然你不需要喝血或吃肉或任何如此低劣简易之物，但你必须吸收生命的精神精萃，即灵息，以保持你的健康和生机。一些事情发生后，现在你独自一人在荒野中，没有任何财产。你最好快点找到别人，否则将难以避免生命迎来凋零。

messages.msgid: You are the spirit of a place that slowly gained sentience, a genius loci, born alone in the wilderness.  With no parents, no kin, and no guidance, it's up to you to make your own way in the world.
translations: 你是一地之魂，是某个地方逐渐获得感知的“地灵”，孤独地诞生于荒野之中。你无父无母，无亲无故，也无人指引，只能靠自己在这个世界上闯出一条路来。

messages.msgid: You grew up thinking you were human, just another person among billions, but you were born Under the Hill and swapped for a human baby shortly after birth.  Your parents were the nobility of the Fair Folk, the great lords and ladies who traveled in spider-silk carriages on roads built of moonbeams and danced the unending nights away before leading fantastic armies in battle the next morning.  When the Cataclysm hit, your parents' slumbering power asserted itself, giving you access to a portion of their fae magick.  Hopefully it will help you survive.
translations: 你自小以为自己是人类，是亿万凡人中的一员，殊不知你实则诞生于山丘之下，并在出生后不久便与一个人类婴孩做了交换。你的父母是仙灵中的贵族，那些伟大的领主与仕女，曾乘坐蛛丝华盖的车舆，行驶在月光铺就的道路上，彻夜狂舞，又在翌日清晨率领奇幻大军奔赴沙场。当大灾变降临时，你父母沉睡的力量自行显现，让你得以使用他们一部分的妖精魔法。希望这能助你求生。

messages.msgid: You grew up thinking you were human, just another person among billions, but you were born Under the Hill and swapped for a human baby shortly after birth.  Your parents come from the common masses of the Fair Folk, the pooka, redcaps, hobgoblins, trow, pixies, knockers, selkies, or any of the myriad of others.  When the Cataclysm hit, your parents' slumbering power asserted itself, revealing your heritage and giving you access to a portion of their fae magick.  Hopefully it will help you survive.
translations: 从小，你一直以为自己只是人类，是数十亿人中的普通一员。殊不知，你诞生于山丘之下，出生后不久便被掉包，替换了一个人类的婴孩。你的父母出身于仙灵中的凡民大众，譬如普卡精、红帽子、悍地精、石窟妖、皮克精、敲击精、海豹精，以及其他万千族类。当大灾变降临时，你父母体内沉眠的力量就此苏醒，揭示了你的血脉传承，亦让你得以运用一部分妖精魔法。但愿它能助你求得一线生机。

messages.msgid: Species XE843 is how the Xedra scientists identified your people before they learned your people could speak to them after enough time around them to develop a way to communicate.  They had little idea that communication is your people's survival trait, coming from a much harsher environment than the humans are…were blessed with, you can make allies with almost any thinking being.  You informed the Xedra people of your race's name 'Gracken' but you didn't tell them that most of your people they found were larval forms and lacking access to the shadow materials needed would never grow up into an adult form.  Now the humans' world is as deadly or moreso than your home and the way back is mostly closed.  Time to try and find a route home that wouldn't be a death sentence, or see what this world has to offer.
translations: 在与你们相处了足够长的时间，并最终找到一种沟通方式之前，泽德拉的科学家们一直用XE843这个代号来识别你们的种族。他们几乎不知道，沟通恰恰是你们种族的生存之道；你们来自一个环境远比人类有幸……或者说曾经有幸身处的世界要严酷得多的地方，因此你们几乎能与任何有思想的生物结盟。你告诉了泽德拉人，你们种族的名字是“格拉肯”，但你没有告诉他们，他们找到的大多数族人都还处于幼体形态，并且由于缺乏必要的暗影物质，永远也无法成长为成体。如今，人类的世界和你的家乡一样致命，甚至有过之而无不及，而回去的道路也大都断绝。是时候想办法找一条不至于是有去无回的归乡之路了，又或者，看看这个世界能提供些什么。

messages.msgid: Ever since the Cataclysm you've been able to clearly see elements of other realities that have intruded your own.  You also are able to consume a resource they seem to have brought with them to give you power far beyond a normal human.
translations: 自大灾变以来，你便能清晰地看见侵入此世的异度现实的种种元素。你还能消耗它们带来的一种资源，以获取远超凡人的力量。

messages.msgid: Ever since the Cataclysm you've become far more aware of the weakened gap between realities.  Specifically, of what is on the other side.  Surprisingly, it doesn't seem universally hostile, and you think you'd be able to bring some of these entities over if you desired.
translations: 自大灾变以来，你愈发能察觉到现实之间那道已然衰弱的裂隙，尤其是裂隙彼端的存在。出乎意料的是，它们似乎并非全然抱有敌意，而你觉得自己若是有意，便能将其中一些存在召唤至此。

messages.msgid: Ever since the Cataclysm you've begun having crazy ideas on how to create technological devices.  While conventional logic would label these designs as silly or even insane, something tells you that they'd work regardless.
translations: 自大灾变以来，你脑中便开始涌现出各种关于制造技术装置的疯狂点子。虽然以常理来看，这些设计不是愚不可及，就是痴人说梦，但冥冥之中你却深信它们确实可行。

messages.msgid: Ever since the Cataclysm you've gained an instinctive sense of how to work dreamdross into tools and armor.  It will still take some effort to put these vague ideas to proper use.
translations: 自大灾变以来，你获得了一种天赋本能，知晓如何将浮梦残渣塑造成工具与护甲。不过，要将这些模糊的构想付诸实践，仍需一番功夫。

messages.msgid: One of your parents was always a little odd.  They stayed out of the sun as much as they could, their eyes were a bit of an odd color, and they vanished without a trace before you grew old enough to ask them why they left the room every time you got a scrape that drew blood.  But now that you're older, you understand.  You are the child of a vampire, and have inherited a small portion of their power.
translations: 你的双亲中，有一位总是有些古怪。Ta总是尽可能地避开阳光，双眼也泛着奇异的色泽。在你长大到能开口询问之前，Ta就已销声匿迹——你只记得，每当你擦伤流血，Ta都会立刻离开房间。如今你已长大，也终于明白了。你是吸血鬼的后裔，并继承了其一小部分力量。

messages.msgid: By dint of your birth you already have some knowledge of how the universe really works.
translations: 你与生俱来便对宇宙的真实运作法则有所洞悉。

messages.msgid: You've never met another person but already you are ready for the conversations that will ensue.
translations: 你虽素未与人谋面，却早已准备好应对未来的一切交谈。

messages.msgid: Water takes on the shape of whatever opening is given to it.  You were born with this knowledge and way of moving.
translations: 水，随器赋形，遇隙而入。你生来便通晓此道，并以此为行止之法。

messages.msgid: Air expands to fill every space it encounters and by filling the space it becomes diffuse and impossible to grasp.  Would you slip through the fingers of those who grasp at you?
translations: 气，遇隙则入，无所不充；充盈其间，便弥散无形，不可盈握。你是否亦能如此，于紧握你的指间悄然流逝？

messages.msgid: A gift from your birth world?  A quirk of nature?  For reasons unknown to you, you can sprout seeds from this planet.  You can't control what seeds you get, however.
translations: 这是来自你诞生世界的赠礼？还是造化的偶然？出于某种未知的原因，你能催生这颗星球上的种籽。然而，你无法控制会得到何种籽粒。

messages.msgid: At your birth you already danced a flaming path, enthralled with your own capacity for destruction and change.
translations: 自诞生之初，你便踏着烈焰的舞步，为你自身那毁灭与变革的力量而沉醉。

messages.msgid: Before you were born, your thoughts and dreams were those of stone.  When this world sucks you into it's highs and lows, you can remember the eternity that is stone.
translations: 在你诞生之前，你的思绪与梦境，皆如磐石。当这个世界将你卷入其间的起落浮沉之时，你仍能忆起那属于磐石的、亘古不变的永恒。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm, you used to work for the Paranormal Investigation Department of the FBI.  You got used to jokes at your expense, as well as being constantly underfunded and disregarded by your superiors.  You were returning from yet another case with nothing but a bag of suspicious candies to show, when all hell broke loose.  Oh well, at least now you can be certain that everyone still alive will believe you that the truth is out there.
translations: 在大灾变来临前，你为FBI的超自然调查部门工作。你已经习惯了以你为由的笑话，以及永远得不到上级的资助和被忽视。当你处理完一起案子，除了一袋可疑的糖果以外，什么收获都没有时，一切突然乱了套。哦，至少你能保证，现在所有活人都会相信你了：真相就在某处。

messages.msgid: Before Xedra recruited you, you probably worked for the ATF or a PMC like Kroll.  It was your job to investigate any cross-pollination incidents where alternate physics regions crossed over the Nether and reached our world.  Part exterminator part investigator, you made sure that any new resources and contaminants were accounted for, including any intelligent life trying to sneak into our world.  Local law enforcement and civilians called you 'Zebras' since your identification and badges only had a barcode instead of any name/rank/number.  This job has shown you things you don't want to remember but luckily the Zebra docs seem to have an endless supply of pills.
translations: 在XEDRA招募你之前，你可能为ATF或是像克罗尔公司这样的私人承包商工作。你的工作是调查任何跨界传播事件，在这类事件中，另一个物理实体穿越异界虚空，到达我们的世界。部分是除害员，部分是调查员，你确保任何新的资源和污染都能得到恰当的应对，包括任何试图潜入我们世界的智能生命。当地执法部门和平民称你为"斑马"，因为你的ID和钥匙卡上只有条形码，而没有任何姓名/军衔/编号，这份工作让你看见了太多不敢去回想的东西，幸运的是"斑马"的药物看起来是无限制供应的。

messages.msgid: You came here from another country trying to gain access to secrets the United States had ripped from other worlds.  They probably had sent people to your homeland to do the same.  You were out performing recon when the Cataclysm struck and caught a ride with a stranger trying to find safety.  Sadly you lost your companion and vehicle, getting lost in the process and with now only a vague idea on how to get back to the safehouse, where you hope your hidden gear remains untouched.
translations: 你从另一个国家来到这里，试图获取美国从其他世界窃取的秘密。他们可能已经派人到你的祖国去做同样的事了。你正在执行侦察任务，大灾变突然发生，不得不与一个陌生人搭车试图寻求庇护。遗憾的是，你失去了同伴和车辆，同时还迷路了，现在对于如何返回安全屋只剩下一个模糊的想法，你只能祈祷先前藏起来的装备还完好无缺。

messages.msgid: Part of Xedra's Offworld Acquisitions group, you specialized in tracking, killing and retrieving useful components from the cyborg tribes that seem to exist on some of the worlds Xedra had access to.  Do you feel guilt about bringing back the cybernetic components that are now inside you or your teammates?  Or do you worry that now they might be on this world hunting you?  You've lost your sidearm and spent half of your heavy ordnance.  Worst of all, you're out of smokes.
translations: 作为 XEDRA 异世界猎获组的一员，你专门跟踪、猎杀改造人部落并从他们身上回收有用组件。这些部落似乎存在于 XEDRA 能够到访的部分世界上。你是否为带回这些生化插件并任其被安装至你和队友体内感到过一丝内疚？还是担心现在他们可能会来到这个世界追杀你？你失去了你的副武器，用光了一半的重型弹药。最糟糕的是，你没有烟了。

messages.msgid: You are what Xedra refers to as a non-local guide.  A mature Gracken hired on to join the Offworld Acquisitions Team, you trained in human long distance weaponry in order to take down big game and create new improvements to bring back to your people.  They gave you a big gun and a little training in how to use it and in return you help them know what things in other dimensions to hunt and what to run from.
translations: 你就是 XEDRA 所称的非本地向导。你是一个受雇加入异世界猎获小队的成年格拉肯，受过人类远程武器的训练以便击倒大型猎物和创造进步成果回馈给你的人民。他们给了你一把大枪和一些如何使用它的训练，作为回报，你帮助他们知道其他维度上哪些东西可以猎杀、哪些要躲避。

messages.msgid: Part of Xedra's Offworld Acquisitions team, you were sent to gather biological specimens, they often objected strenuously to being gathered.  You've got some CBMs in you but understand they probably came out of someone that might have friends.
translations: 作为 XEDRA 异世界猎获组的一员，你被派去获取生物标本，虽然他们经常极力抵抗。你体内安装了一些 CBM，但要知道它们都可能来自于某个可能有朋友的人。

messages.msgid: Part of Xedra's Offworld Acquisitions team, you were trained to infiltrate any human compatible cultures that were discovered.  You never found any with technology worth stealing and you aren't sure what that says about humanity.
translations: 作为 XEDRA 异世界猎获小队的一员，你受训并被派去渗透任何被发现能与人类相容的文化。你从来没有发现任何值得窃取的技术，你不确定这对人类意味着什么。

messages.msgid: Being part of Upsilon 4, you were always at the front of your unit, protecting other operatives from danger ahead using your eater's abilities.  This one was no different, but something went really wrong.
translations: 作为Upsilon 4的一员，你总是站在前线，以食梦者能力保护其他特工。这次任务没有不同，但某些事情搞砸了。

messages.msgid: Theta 1, also known as "kindergarten" between other task forces, is used when missions are expected to be too dangerous to send people or when reconnaissance can't obtain any important information about the target, which is why otherworldly creatures, summoned by dreamers, are sent.  It's not the best course of action, but the unit's nearly zero fatality rate makes it worth using.
translations: 西塔 1，在其他特遣部队之间也被称为“幼儿园”，当任务预计过于危险而无法派人执行时，或者当侦察无法获得有关目标的任何重要信息时，他们就会出动，这也是为什么由梦行者召唤的异世界生物会得到派遣。这不是最好的行动方案，但该单位几乎为零的死亡率使其值得使用。

messages.msgid: Despite the "Task Force" in their name, Nu 3 is rarely called into the actual mission; their main task is reconnaissance and developing tools to support another task force, even if these tools last only a few weeks.  But when they do accept a task, it's almost guaranteed to be successful.  It should've been your first day here, but something went really wrong.
translations: 尽管名称中有“特遣队”，但Nu 3很少被召入实际任务；他们的主要任务是侦察和开发工具，以支持另一支特遣队，即使这些工具只持续几周。但当他们真的接受了一项任务时，几乎可以保证任务会成功。这应该是你来这里的第一天，但出了点问题。

messages.msgid: Sharing the same problem with Nu 3, dreamsmiths from Tau 8 are not called on the operation very often, and their main work looks really medieval.  Despite this, they are really popular among other branches, as their tools and armor have everything a modern soldier can dream of.
translations: 与Nu 3有着相同的问题，来自Tau 8的造梦师并不经常被召唤参加行动，他们的主要作品看起来真的很中世纪。尽管如此，它们在其他分支中确实很受欢迎，因为它们的工具和盔甲拥有现代士兵梦寐以求的一切。

messages.msgid: You joined XEDRA during the years leading up to the Cataclysm, and they told you that you fit the profile of a SATOR agent.  At the time you had no idea what they meant, and they gave you a couple days to process when you learned that magic was real, the enemies of the United States possessed it, and they wanted you to learn it too.  When they sat you down and had you practice writing letters into patterns for days on end you wondered if you had made a mistake, but when one of those squares let you summon a loaf of bread out of thin air for lunch, you changed your tune pretty quickly.
translations: 你在大灾变发生前几年加入了 XEDRA，他们告诉你，你符合 SATOR 特工的条件。当时你不知道他们的意思，在你了解到魔法是真实存在的、美国的敌人拥有魔法、他们也希望你学习魔法后，他们给了你几天时间来消化这些信息。当他们让你坐下来，让你连续几天练习将字母写成图案时，你怀疑自己是否犯了错误，但是当其中一个方格让你凭空变出一条面包作为午餐时，你很快就改变了想法。

messages.msgid:
With the dimensional spillage that preceded the Cataclysm you are the spirit of a place that slowly gained sentience, a genius loci.  As the world reshapes itself you have decided to wander from your birthplace and determine where you will end up.

As a spirit of the earth, your powers are strengthened by contact with the soil and the rock and weakened by separation from the living earth.
translations:
在大灾变前夕的维度倾泄中，你从一方水土中逐渐萌生了自我意识。值此世界重塑之际，你决定离开诞生地，四处云游，以探寻自己的最终归宿。

作为大地的一方之灵，当你接触土壤与岩石时，你的力量会得到增强；而脱离富有生机的大地，则会使你衰弱。

messages.msgid:
With the dimensional spillage that preceded the Cataclysm you are the spirit of a place that slowly gained sentience, a genius loci.  As the world reshapes itself you have decided to wander from your birthplace and determine where you will end up.

As a spirit of the forest, your powers are strengthened by the wild places and weakened within the constructs of humanity.
translations:
在大灾变前夕的维度倾泄中，你从一方水土中逐渐萌生了自我意识。值此世界重塑之际，你决定离开诞生地，四处云游，以探寻自己的最终归宿。

作为森林的一方之灵，身处荒野能增强你的力量；而置身于人类的造物之中，则会使你衰弱。

messages.msgid:
With the dimensional spillage that preceded the Cataclysm you are the spirit of a place that slowly gained sentience, a genius loci.  As the world reshapes itself you have decided to wander from your birthplace and determine where you will end up.

As a spirit of the lakes and rivers, your powers are strengthened when you are surrounded by water and weakened when you spend too long away from the water.
translations:
在大灾变前夕的维度倾泄中，你从一方水土中逐渐萌生了自我意识。值此世界重塑之际，你决定离开诞生地，四处云游，以探寻自己的最终归宿。

作为江河湖泊的一方之灵，身处水中能增强你的力量；而离水太久，则会使你衰弱。

messages.msgid:
With the dimensional spillage that preceded the Cataclysm you are the spirit of a place that slowly gained sentience, a genius loci.  As the world reshapes itself you have decided to wander from your birthplace and determine where you will end up.

As a spirit of the flames, your powers are strengthened when among heat and fire and weakened by the cold.
translations:
在大灾变前夕的维度倾泄中，你从一方水土中逐渐萌生了自我意识。值此世界重塑之际，你决定离开诞生地，四处云游，以探寻自己的最终归宿。

作为烈焰的一方之灵，身处炙热与火焰之中能增强你的力量；而严寒则会使你衰弱。

messages.msgid:
With the dimensional spillage that preceded the Cataclysm you are the spirit of a place that slowly gained sentience, a genius loci.  As the world reshapes itself you have decided to wander from your birthplace and determine where you will end up.

As a spirit of humanity, your powers are strengthened when among humankind or in the remnants of civilization and weakened when in the wilderness.
translations:
在大灾变前夕的维度倾泄中，你从一方水土中逐渐萌生了自我意识。值此世界重塑之际，你决定离开诞生地，四处云游，以探寻自己的最终归宿。

作为人道的一方之灵，当你身处人群或文明遗迹中时，你的力量会得到增强；而置身于荒野，则会使你衰弱。

messages.msgid:
With the dimensional spillage that preceded the Cataclysm you are the spirit of a place that slowly gained sentience, a genius loci.  As the world reshapes itself you have decided to wander from your birthplace and determine where you will end up.

As a spirit of the winds, your powers are strengthened when under the open sky and weakened when indoors or underground.
translations:
在大灾变前夕的维度倾泄中，你从一方水土中逐渐萌生了自我意识。值此世界重塑之际，你决定离开诞生地，四处云游，以探寻自己的最终归宿。

作为长风的一方之灵，当你身处开阔天穹之下时，你的力量会得到增强；而置身于室内或地下，则会使你衰弱。

messages.msgid: In the years and decades leading up to the Cataclysm, things got weirder and weirder.  The government tried their best to cover it up but they couldn't entirely stop all knowledge from leaking out.  You were one of the people who responded to the weirdness by becoming weird yourself; you spent time combing through old books and found some of the charms and spells written in them actually worked.  When you had the right ingredients and were in the right place, you could make the impossible possible.  Maybe lighting a fire without a match won't help you kill a zombie, but it's kept you warm and safe when you're sure other survivors had to shiver as the night closed in.
translations: 在大灾变来临前的数年乃至数十年间，世事变得愈发诡谲。政府竭力掩盖，却无法完全阻止所有真相泄露出去。你是那些以变得“怪异”来回应这份“诡谲”的人之一；你花费大量时间翻阅古籍，发现其中记载的一些咒语和法术确有其效。只要备齐合适的材料、身处合适的地点，你便能化不可能为可能。或许，不用火柴就能生火这种事，于你斩杀丧尸并无裨益，但当夜幕降临，别的幸存者只能在寒冷中瑟瑟发抖时，它却能让你安然无恙，温暖如春。

messages.msgid: Perhaps you were the member of a cult, or a strange family legacy, or maybe you just stumbled on a book that probably shouldn't have been left where you could find it.  Regardless, you have the ability to turn into an animal when you kill it and make a talisman out of its bones and skin.  Every change requires a death, but with so much death already since the Cataclysm, what's a little bit more?
translations: 或许你曾是某个秘教的成员，又或者继承了怪异的家族遗产，也可能只是偶然拾得了一本不该被你发现的古书。无论如何，你都获得了一种能力：在杀死一只动物后，用它的骨骸与皮毛制成护符，便能化身为它的模样。每一次变形都需要一次杀戮，但自大灾变以来，死亡早已司空见惯，再多一条性命又算得了什么呢？

messages.msgid: You spent months trying to find one of these elusive creatures, searching all over the country in the hopes of proving beyond doubt that they exist.  You recently found enough trustworthy information to write down a map that will certainly lead you to a cryptid.  Now that the supernatural is undeniable you feel that you should find a cryptid anyway, if only to say that you didn't do all this work for nothing.
translations: 你曾花费数月时间，踏遍全国，只为寻找这些神出鬼没的生物，希望能找到它们存在的铁证。最近，你终于找到了足够可靠的情报，并绘制出了一张必定能带你找到一只神秘生物的地图。如今超自然现象已是无可否认的事实，你觉得无论如何都该去找到一只，只为证明自己过去的一切努力都没有白费。

messages.msgid: Born with the gift of gab.
What does the stone dream of?
Xedra Offworld Team: Big Game Hunter
XEDRA Operative, Department of Extra-Normal Capabilities, SATOR Division
Some would say that there's nothing particularly notable about you, but you've survived, and that's more than most could say right now.
translations: 有些人会说，你身上并没有什么可圈可点之处。不过，"你活下来了"——这一句话胜过千言万语。

messages.msgid: You had no idea what was going on the first time it happened, when you woke up with mud on your bare feet and a sour taste in your mouth, but you were soon found.  The People of the Moon, they called themselves, and they said you were one of them.  A werewolf.  You lived out in the wilderness for a while but didn't entirely abandon human civilization, and when the Cataclysm hit you ignored the evacuation warnings and struck it out on your own.  Maybe some of the People are still out there.
translations: 第一次发生的时候，你根本不知道发生了什么，当你醒来时，光脚上沾满了泥，嘴里带着酸味，但很快你就被发现了。他们自称是月球人，他们说你是他们中的一员。一个狼人。你在荒野中生活了一段时间，但并没有完全放弃人类文明，当大灾变来袭时，你无视疏散警告，自己闯荡了。也许有些人还在外面。

messages.msgid: For most or all of your life, you've had a secret; you are a predator.  While you don't need to drink blood or eat flesh or anything so crude, you must absorb the spiritual essence, the "ruach", of living beings in order to maintain your health and vitality.  You had to hide your condition before the Cataclysm, especially as things became stranger in the years leading up to it, but now you don't have to hide anymore.  On the other hand, your potential ruach supply has taken a drastic decline.
translations: 在你一生的大部分，或全部时间里，你都有一个秘密；你是个掠食者。虽然你不需要喝血或吃肉或任何如此低劣简易之物，但你必须吸收生命的精神精萃，即灵息，以保持你的健康和生机。一些事情发生后，现在你独自一人在荒野中，没有任何财产。你最好快点找到别人，否则将难以避免生命迎来凋零。

messages.msgid: You are the spirit of a place that slowly gained sentience, a genius loci, born alone in the wilderness.  With no parents, no kin, and no guidance, it's up to you to make your own way in the world.
translations: 你是一地之魂，是某个地方逐渐获得感知的“地灵”，孤独地诞生于荒野之中。你无父无母，无亲无故，也无人指引，只能靠自己在这个世界上闯出一条路来。

messages.msgid: You grew up thinking you were human, just another person among billions, but you were born Under the Hill and swapped for a human baby shortly after birth.  Your parents were the nobility of the Fair Folk, the great lords and ladies who traveled in spider-silk carriages on roads built of moonbeams and danced the unending nights away before leading fantastic armies in battle the next morning.  When the Cataclysm hit, your parents' slumbering power asserted itself, giving you access to a portion of their fae magick.  Hopefully it will help you survive.
translations: 你自小以为自己是人类，是亿万凡人中的一员，殊不知你实则诞生于山丘之下，并在出生后不久便与一个人类婴孩做了交换。你的父母是仙灵中的贵族，那些伟大的领主与仕女，曾乘坐蛛丝华盖的车舆，行驶在月光铺就的道路上，彻夜狂舞，又在翌日清晨率领奇幻大军奔赴沙场。当大灾变降临时，你父母沉睡的力量自行显现，让你得以使用他们一部分的妖精魔法。希望这能助你求生。

messages.msgid: You grew up thinking you were human, just another person among billions, but you were born Under the Hill and swapped for a human baby shortly after birth.  Your parents come from the common masses of the Fair Folk, the pooka, redcaps, hobgoblins, trow, pixies, knockers, selkies, or any of the myriad of others.  When the Cataclysm hit, your parents' slumbering power asserted itself, revealing your heritage and giving you access to a portion of their fae magick.  Hopefully it will help you survive.
translations: 从小，你一直以为自己只是人类，是数十亿人中的普通一员。殊不知，你诞生于山丘之下，出生后不久便被掉包，替换了一个人类的婴孩。你的父母出身于仙灵中的凡民大众，譬如普卡精、红帽子、悍地精、石窟妖、皮克精、敲击精、海豹精，以及其他万千族类。当大灾变降临时，你父母体内沉眠的力量就此苏醒，揭示了你的血脉传承，亦让你得以运用一部分妖精魔法。但愿它能助你求得一线生机。

messages.msgid: Species XE843 is how the Xedra scientists identified your people before they learned your people could speak to them after enough time around them to develop a way to communicate.  They had little idea that communication is your people's survival trait, coming from a much harsher environment than the humans are…were blessed with, you can make allies with almost any thinking being.  You informed the Xedra people of your race's name 'Gracken' but you didn't tell them that most of your people they found were larval forms and lacking access to the shadow materials needed would never grow up into an adult form.  Now the humans' world is as deadly or moreso than your home and the way back is mostly closed.  Time to try and find a route home that wouldn't be a death sentence, or see what this world has to offer.
translations: 在与你们相处了足够长的时间，并最终找到一种沟通方式之前，泽德拉的科学家们一直用XE843这个代号来识别你们的种族。他们几乎不知道，沟通恰恰是你们种族的生存之道；你们来自一个环境远比人类有幸……或者说曾经有幸身处的世界要严酷得多的地方，因此你们几乎能与任何有思想的生物结盟。你告诉了泽德拉人，你们种族的名字是“格拉肯”，但你没有告诉他们，他们找到的大多数族人都还处于幼体形态，并且由于缺乏必要的暗影物质，永远也无法成长为成体。如今，人类的世界和你的家乡一样致命，甚至有过之而无不及，而回去的道路也大都断绝。是时候想办法找一条不至于是有去无回的归乡之路了，又或者，看看这个世界能提供些什么。

messages.msgid: Ever since the Cataclysm you've been able to clearly see elements of other realities that have intruded your own.  You also are able to consume a resource they seem to have brought with them to give you power far beyond a normal human.
translations: 自大灾变以来，你便能清晰地看见侵入此世的异度现实的种种元素。你还能消耗它们带来的一种资源，以获取远超凡人的力量。

messages.msgid: Ever since the Cataclysm you've become far more aware of the weakened gap between realities.  Specifically, of what is on the other side.  Surprisingly, it doesn't seem universally hostile, and you think you'd be able to bring some of these entities over if you desired.
translations: 自大灾变以来，你愈发能察觉到现实之间那道已然衰弱的裂隙，尤其是裂隙彼端的存在。出乎意料的是，它们似乎并非全然抱有敌意，而你觉得自己若是有意，便能将其中一些存在召唤至此。

messages.msgid: Ever since the Cataclysm you've begun having crazy ideas on how to create technological devices.  While conventional logic would label these designs as silly or even insane, something tells you that they'd work regardless.
translations: 自大灾变以来，你脑中便开始涌现出各种关于制造技术装置的疯狂点子。虽然以常理来看，这些设计不是愚不可及，就是痴人说梦，但冥冥之中你却深信它们确实可行。

messages.msgid: Ever since the Cataclysm you've gained an instinctive sense of how to work dreamdross into tools and armor.  It will still take some effort to put these vague ideas to proper use.
translations: 自大灾变以来，你获得了一种天赋本能，知晓如何将浮梦残渣塑造成工具与护甲。不过，要将这些模糊的构想付诸实践，仍需一番功夫。

messages.msgid: One of your parents was always a little odd.  They stayed out of the sun as much as they could, their eyes were a bit of an odd color, and they vanished without a trace before you grew old enough to ask them why they left the room every time you got a scrape that drew blood.  But now that you're older, you understand.  You are the child of a vampire, and have inherited a small portion of their power.
translations: 你的双亲中，有一位总是有些古怪。Ta总是尽可能地避开阳光，双眼也泛着奇异的色泽。在你长大到能开口询问之前，Ta就已销声匿迹——你只记得，每当你擦伤流血，Ta都会立刻离开房间。如今你已长大，也终于明白了。你是吸血鬼的后裔，并继承了其一小部分力量。

messages.msgid: By dint of your birth you already have some knowledge of how the universe really works.
translations: 你与生俱来便对宇宙的真实运作法则有所洞悉。

messages.msgid: You've never met another person but already you are ready for the conversations that will ensue.
translations: 你虽素未与人谋面，却早已准备好应对未来的一切交谈。

messages.msgid: Water takes on the shape of whatever opening is given to it.  You were born with this knowledge and way of moving.
translations: 水，随器赋形，遇隙而入。你生来便通晓此道，并以此为行止之法。

messages.msgid: Air expands to fill every space it encounters and by filling the space it becomes diffuse and impossible to grasp.  Would you slip through the fingers of those who grasp at you?
translations: 气，遇隙则入，无所不充；充盈其间，便弥散无形，不可盈握。你是否亦能如此，于紧握你的指间悄然流逝？

messages.msgid: A gift from your birth world?  A quirk of nature?  For reasons unknown to you, you can sprout seeds from this planet.  You can't control what seeds you get, however.
translations: 这是来自你诞生世界的赠礼？还是造化的偶然？出于某种未知的原因，你能催生这颗星球上的种籽。然而，你无法控制会得到何种籽粒。

messages.msgid: At your birth you already danced a flaming path, enthralled with your own capacity for destruction and change.
translations: 自诞生之初，你便踏着烈焰的舞步，为你自身那毁灭与变革的力量而沉醉。

messages.msgid: Before you were born, your thoughts and dreams were those of stone.  When this world sucks you into it's highs and lows, you can remember the eternity that is stone.
translations: 在你诞生之前，你的思绪与梦境，皆如磐石。当这个世界将你卷入其间的起落浮沉之时，你仍能忆起那属于磐石的、亘古不变的永恒。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm, you used to work for the Paranormal Investigation Department of the FBI.  You got used to jokes at your expense, as well as being constantly underfunded and disregarded by your superiors.  You were returning from yet another case with nothing but a bag of suspicious candies to show, when all hell broke loose.  Oh well, at least now you can be certain that everyone still alive will believe you that the truth is out there.
translations: 在大灾变来临前，你为FBI的超自然调查部门工作。你已经习惯了以你为由的笑话，以及永远得不到上级的资助和被忽视。当你处理完一起案子，除了一袋可疑的糖果以外，什么收获都没有时，一切突然乱了套。哦，至少你能保证，现在所有活人都会相信你了：真相就在某处。

messages.msgid: Before Xedra recruited you, you probably worked for the ATF or a PMC like Kroll.  It was your job to investigate any cross-pollination incidents where alternate physics regions crossed over the Nether and reached our world.  Part exterminator part investigator, you made sure that any new resources and contaminants were accounted for, including any intelligent life trying to sneak into our world.  Local law enforcement and civilians called you 'Zebras' since your identification and badges only had a barcode instead of any name/rank/number.  This job has shown you things you don't want to remember but luckily the Zebra docs seem to have an endless supply of pills.
translations: 在XEDRA招募你之前，你可能为ATF或是像克罗尔公司这样的私人承包商工作。你的工作是调查任何跨界传播事件，在这类事件中，另一个物理实体穿越异界虚空，到达我们的世界。部分是除害员，部分是调查员，你确保任何新的资源和污染都能得到恰当的应对，包括任何试图潜入我们世界的智能生命。当地执法部门和平民称你为"斑马"，因为你的ID和钥匙卡上只有条形码，而没有任何姓名/军衔/编号，这份工作让你看见了太多不敢去回想的东西，幸运的是"斑马"的药物看起来是无限制供应的。

messages.msgid: You came here from another country trying to gain access to secrets the United States had ripped from other worlds.  They probably had sent people to your homeland to do the same.  You were out performing recon when the Cataclysm struck and caught a ride with a stranger trying to find safety.  Sadly you lost your companion and vehicle, getting lost in the process and with now only a vague idea on how to get back to the safehouse, where you hope your hidden gear remains untouched.
translations: 你从另一个国家来到这里，试图获取美国从其他世界窃取的秘密。他们可能已经派人到你的祖国去做同样的事了。你正在执行侦察任务，大灾变突然发生，不得不与一个陌生人搭车试图寻求庇护。遗憾的是，你失去了同伴和车辆，同时还迷路了，现在对于如何返回安全屋只剩下一个模糊的想法，你只能祈祷先前藏起来的装备还完好无缺。

messages.msgid: Part of Xedra's Offworld Acquisitions group, you specialized in tracking, killing and retrieving useful components from the cyborg tribes that seem to exist on some of the worlds Xedra had access to.  Do you feel guilt about bringing back the cybernetic components that are now inside you or your teammates?  Or do you worry that now they might be on this world hunting you?  You've lost your sidearm and spent half of your heavy ordnance.  Worst of all, you're out of smokes.
translations: 作为 XEDRA 异世界猎获组的一员，你专门跟踪、猎杀改造人部落并从他们身上回收有用组件。这些部落似乎存在于 XEDRA 能够到访的部分世界上。你是否为带回这些生化插件并任其被安装至你和队友体内感到过一丝内疚？还是担心现在他们可能会来到这个世界追杀你？你失去了你的副武器，用光了一半的重型弹药。最糟糕的是，你没有烟了。

messages.msgid: You are what Xedra refers to as a non-local guide.  A mature Gracken hired on to join the Offworld Acquisitions Team, you trained in human long distance weaponry in order to take down big game and create new improvements to bring back to your people.  They gave you a big gun and a little training in how to use it and in return you help them know what things in other dimensions to hunt and what to run from.
translations: 你就是 XEDRA 所称的非本地向导。你是一个受雇加入异世界猎获小队的成年格拉肯，受过人类远程武器的训练以便击倒大型猎物和创造进步成果回馈给你的人民。他们给了你一把大枪和一些如何使用它的训练，作为回报，你帮助他们知道其他维度上哪些东西可以猎杀、哪些要躲避。

messages.msgid: Part of Xedra's Offworld Acquisitions team, you were sent to gather biological specimens, they often objected strenuously to being gathered.  You've got some CBMs in you but understand they probably came out of someone that might have friends.
translations: 作为 XEDRA 异世界猎获组的一员，你被派去获取生物标本，虽然他们经常极力抵抗。你体内安装了一些 CBM，但要知道它们都可能来自于某个可能有朋友的人。

messages.msgid: Part of Xedra's Offworld Acquisitions team, you were trained to infiltrate any human compatible cultures that were discovered.  You never found any with technology worth stealing and you aren't sure what that says about humanity.
translations: 作为 XEDRA 异世界猎获小队的一员，你受训并被派去渗透任何被发现能与人类相容的文化。你从来没有发现任何值得窃取的技术，你不确定这对人类意味着什么。

messages.msgid: Being part of Upsilon 4, you were always at the front of your unit, protecting other operatives from danger ahead using your eater's abilities.  This one was no different, but something went really wrong.
translations: 作为Upsilon 4的一员，你总是站在前线，以食梦者能力保护其他特工。这次任务没有不同，但某些事情搞砸了。

messages.msgid: Theta 1, also known as "kindergarten" between other task forces, is used when missions are expected to be too dangerous to send people or when reconnaissance can't obtain any important information about the target, which is why otherworldly creatures, summoned by dreamers, are sent.  It's not the best course of action, but the unit's nearly zero fatality rate makes it worth using.
translations: 西塔 1，在其他特遣部队之间也被称为“幼儿园”，当任务预计过于危险而无法派人执行时，或者当侦察无法获得有关目标的任何重要信息时，他们就会出动，这也是为什么由梦行者召唤的异世界生物会得到派遣。这不是最好的行动方案，但该单位几乎为零的死亡率使其值得使用。

messages.msgid: Despite the "Task Force" in their name, Nu 3 is rarely called into the actual mission; their main task is reconnaissance and developing tools to support another task force, even if these tools last only a few weeks.  But when they do accept a task, it's almost guaranteed to be successful.  It should've been your first day here, but something went really wrong.
translations: 尽管名称中有“特遣队”，但Nu 3很少被召入实际任务；他们的主要任务是侦察和开发工具，以支持另一支特遣队，即使这些工具只持续几周。但当他们真的接受了一项任务时，几乎可以保证任务会成功。这应该是你来这里的第一天，但出了点问题。

messages.msgid: Sharing the same problem with Nu 3, dreamsmiths from Tau 8 are not called on the operation very often, and their main work looks really medieval.  Despite this, they are really popular among other branches, as their tools and armor have everything a modern soldier can dream of.
translations: 与Nu 3有着相同的问题，来自Tau 8的造梦师并不经常被召唤参加行动，他们的主要作品看起来真的很中世纪。尽管如此，它们在其他分支中确实很受欢迎，因为它们的工具和盔甲拥有现代士兵梦寐以求的一切。

messages.msgid: You joined XEDRA during the years leading up to the Cataclysm, and they told you that you fit the profile of a SATOR agent.  At the time you had no idea what they meant, and they gave you a couple days to process when you learned that magic was real, the enemies of the United States possessed it, and they wanted you to learn it too.  When they sat you down and had you practice writing letters into patterns for days on end you wondered if you had made a mistake, but when one of those squares let you summon a loaf of bread out of thin air for lunch, you changed your tune pretty quickly.
translations: 你在大灾变发生前几年加入了 XEDRA，他们告诉你，你符合 SATOR 特工的条件。当时你不知道他们的意思，在你了解到魔法是真实存在的、美国的敌人拥有魔法、他们也希望你学习魔法后，他们给了你几天时间来消化这些信息。当他们让你坐下来，让你连续几天练习将字母写成图案时，你怀疑自己是否犯了错误，但是当其中一个方格让你凭空变出一条面包作为午餐时，你很快就改变了想法。

messages.msgid:
With the dimensional spillage that preceded the Cataclysm you are the spirit of a place that slowly gained sentience, a genius loci.  As the world reshapes itself you have decided to wander from your birthplace and determine where you will end up.
