As a spirit of the earth, your powers are strengthened by contact with the soil and the rock and weakened by separation from the living earth.
translations:
在大灾变前夕的维度倾泄中，你从一方水土中逐渐萌生了自我意识。值此世界重塑之际，你决定离开诞生地，四处云游，以探寻自己的最终归宿。

作为大地的一方之灵，当你接触土壤与岩石时，你的力量会得到增强；而脱离富有生机的大地，则会使你衰弱。

messages.msgid:
With the dimensional spillage that preceded the Cataclysm you are the spirit of a place that slowly gained sentience, a genius loci.  As the world reshapes itself you have decided to wander from your birthplace and determine where you will end up.

As a spirit of the forest, your powers are strengthened by the wild places and weakened within the constructs of humanity.
translations:
在大灾变前夕的维度倾泄中，你从一方水土中逐渐萌生了自我意识。值此世界重塑之际，你决定离开诞生地，四处云游，以探寻自己的最终归宿。

作为森林的一方之灵，身处荒野能增强你的力量；而置身于人类的造物之中，则会使你衰弱。

messages.msgid:
With the dimensional spillage that preceded the Cataclysm you are the spirit of a place that slowly gained sentience, a genius loci.  As the world reshapes itself you have decided to wander from your birthplace and determine where you will end up.

As a spirit of the lakes and rivers, your powers are strengthened when you are surrounded by water and weakened when you spend too long away from the water.
translations:
在大灾变前夕的维度倾泄中，你从一方水土中逐渐萌生了自我意识。值此世界重塑之际，你决定离开诞生地，四处云游，以探寻自己的最终归宿。

作为江河湖泊的一方之灵，身处水中能增强你的力量；而离水太久，则会使你衰弱。

messages.msgid:
With the dimensional spillage that preceded the Cataclysm you are the spirit of a place that slowly gained sentience, a genius loci.  As the world reshapes itself you have decided to wander from your birthplace and determine where you will end up.

As a spirit of the flames, your powers are strengthened when among heat and fire and weakened by the cold.
translations:
在大灾变前夕的维度倾泄中，你从一方水土中逐渐萌生了自我意识。值此世界重塑之际，你决定离开诞生地，四处云游，以探寻自己的最终归宿。

作为烈焰的一方之灵，身处炙热与火焰之中能增强你的力量；而严寒则会使你衰弱。

messages.msgid:
With the dimensional spillage that preceded the Cataclysm you are the spirit of a place that slowly gained sentience, a genius loci.  As the world reshapes itself you have decided to wander from your birthplace and determine where you will end up.

As a spirit of humanity, your powers are strengthened when among humankind or in the remnants of civilization and weakened when in the wilderness.
translations:
在大灾变前夕的维度倾泄中，你从一方水土中逐渐萌生了自我意识。值此世界重塑之际，你决定离开诞生地，四处云游，以探寻自己的最终归宿。

作为人道的一方之灵，当你身处人群或文明遗迹中时，你的力量会得到增强；而置身于荒野，则会使你衰弱。

messages.msgid:
With the dimensional spillage that preceded the Cataclysm you are the spirit of a place that slowly gained sentience, a genius loci.  As the world reshapes itself you have decided to wander from your birthplace and determine where you will end up.

As a spirit of the winds, your powers are strengthened when under the open sky and weakened when indoors or underground.
translations:
在大灾变前夕的维度倾泄中，你从一方水土中逐渐萌生了自我意识。值此世界重塑之际，你决定离开诞生地，四处云游，以探寻自己的最终归宿。

作为长风的一方之灵，当你身处开阔天穹之下时，你的力量会得到增强；而置身于室内或地下，则会使你衰弱。

messages.msgid: In the years and decades leading up to the Cataclysm, things got weirder and weirder.  The government tried their best to cover it up but they couldn't entirely stop all knowledge from leaking out.  You were one of the people who responded to the weirdness by becoming weird yourself; you spent time combing through old books and found some of the charms and spells written in them actually worked.  When you had the right ingredients and were in the right place, you could make the impossible possible.  Maybe lighting a fire without a match won't help you kill a zombie, but it's kept you warm and safe when you're sure other survivors had to shiver as the night closed in.
translations: 在大灾变来临前的数年乃至数十年间，世事变得愈发诡谲。政府竭力掩盖，却无法完全阻止所有真相泄露出去。你是那些以变得“怪异”来回应这份“诡谲”的人之一；你花费大量时间翻阅古籍，发现其中记载的一些咒语和法术确有其效。只要备齐合适的材料、身处合适的地点，你便能化不可能为可能。或许，不用火柴就能生火这种事，于你斩杀丧尸并无裨益，但当夜幕降临，别的幸存者只能在寒冷中瑟瑟发抖时，它却能让你安然无恙，温暖如春。

messages.msgid: Perhaps you were the member of a cult, or a strange family legacy, or maybe you just stumbled on a book that probably shouldn't have been left where you could find it.  Regardless, you have the ability to turn into an animal when you kill it and make a talisman out of its bones and skin.  Every change requires a death, but with so much death already since the Cataclysm, what's a little bit more?
translations: 或许你曾是某个秘教的成员，又或者继承了怪异的家族遗产，也可能只是偶然拾得了一本不该被你发现的古书。无论如何，你都获得了一种能力：在杀死一只动物后，用它的骨骸与皮毛制成护符，便能化身为它的模样。每一次变形都需要一次杀戮，但自大灾变以来，死亡早已司空见惯，再多一条性命又算得了什么呢？

messages.msgid: You spent months trying to find one of these elusive creatures, searching all over the country in the hopes of proving beyond doubt that they exist.  You recently found enough trustworthy information to write down a map that will certainly lead you to a cryptid.  Now that the supernatural is undeniable you feel that you should find a cryptid anyway, if only to say that you didn't do all this work for nothing.
translations: 你曾花费数月时间，踏遍全国，只为寻找这些神出鬼没的生物，希望能找到它们存在的铁证。最近，你终于找到了足够可靠的情报，并绘制出了一张必定能带你找到一只神秘生物的地图。如今超自然现象已是无可否认的事实，你觉得无论如何都该去找到一只，只为证明自己过去的一切努力都没有白费。

messages.msgid: Your first moments of life.  An elemental fae birth on a dying world.  Now you have to figure out how to survive on your own.  (Select the location that matches your profession or you may have a short journey)  P.S. This scenario is still in development, PRs for additional content welcome.
translations: 你生命的最初时刻。一个元素精灵在一个垂死的世界诞生。现在你得想办法自己活下去。（请选择与你的职业相匹配的地点，不然你的旅途可能会很短暂）注：这个场景仍在开发中，欢迎 PR 提供额外的内容。

messages.msgid: You had no idea what was going on the first time it happened, when you woke up with mud on your bare feet and a sour taste in your mouth, but you were soon found.  The People of the Moon, they called themselves, and they said you were one of them.  A werewolf.  You lived out in the wilderness for a while but didn't entirely abandon human civilization, and when the Cataclysm hit you ignored the evacuation warnings and struck it out on your own.  Maybe some of the People are still out there.
translations: 第一次发生的时候，你根本不知道发生了什么，当你醒来时，光脚上沾满了泥，嘴里带着酸味，但很快你就被发现了。他们自称是月球人，他们说你是他们中的一员。一个狼人。你在荒野中生活了一段时间，但并没有完全放弃人类文明，当大灾变来袭时，你无视疏散警告，自己闯荡了。也许有些人还在外面。

messages.msgid: Whether you were visiting Salem's Lot, boating on the Demeter, vacationing to Transylvania, or just another lost boy or girl, you've been bitten by a stranger at twilight the night before.  As a new day breaks you might want to find someone to interview about how you are feeling.  Dark shadows feel more inviting than yesterday and you don't feel like you are long for the day shift.
translations: 无论你是在参观塞勒姆的停车场，在得墨忒耳河上划船，去特兰西瓦尼亚度假，还是只是另一个迷路的男孩或女孩，你都有在前一天晚上的黄昏被陌生人咬伤的经历。随着新的一天的到来，你可能想找个人采访一下你的感受。黑暗的阴影比昨天更吸引人，你也不会觉得自己渴望上白班。

messages.msgid: For most or all of your life, you've had a secret; you are a predator.  While you don't need to drink blood or eat flesh or anything so crude, you must absorb the spiritual essence, the "ruach", of living beings in order to maintain your health and vitality.  You had to hide your condition before the Cataclysm, especially as things became stranger in the years leading up to it, but now you don't have to hide anymore.  On the other hand, your potential ruach supply has taken a drastic decline.
translations: 在几乎你一生的时间里，你都隐藏着一个秘密：你是潜藏的掠食者。你不需要血或肉或其它如此粗劣之物，但你必须吸收其它生命的精神精萃，即灵息，以维持你的生命。直到大灾变发生，你都不得不隐瞒自己的情况，尤其是受到大灾变之前的几年里诡异情况的影响——但现在你再也不必隐瞒了。坏消息是，那些你赖以为生的潜在小灵息食也随着大灾变快速减少。

messages.msgid: During the Cataclysmic portal storms, you and several other people were lost trying to escape the monsters attacking you.  Eventually, something caught up, and as your fellows started turning into frozen statues you ran straight into what should have been open air.  The pain of that impact was nothing compared to the knife you suddenly found stabbed into your torso.  The most you saw of your attacker was a quick blur before everything suddenly changed.  Snow covers the ground, the sun has set, you are freezing cold, and the knife is still stuck in your torso.  However, you've gained a dramatic new sense of time, and what is definitely the beginning of the ability to manipulate it.  Even beyond the knife and the winter you never thought you'd have to prepare for, your new powers tell you that there is much more wrong with you than is immediately apparent.  Hopefully you can use your skills and powers to survive both your new condition and every other horror of the Cataclysm.
translations: 在大灾变的空间风暴期间，你和其他几个人在试图逃离怪物时迷路了。当你们最终被未知之物赶上时，你的同伴们被转变为一动不动的雕像时，你径直跑向一个本该是空无一物的地方，却撞到了什么，并突然伴随着远超撞击之痛的、贯穿躯干的痛苦——那是一把刺入你身体的匕首。在一切突然发生之前，你只看到了袭击者快速到模糊的身影。大雪覆盖地面，太阳已经落山，而你冷的瑟瑟发抖，并且匕首还插在你的躯干上。然而，你获得了一种全新的、奇异的对时间的感知，并且开始掌握了司辰的能力。 除了你从未曾准备的寒冬和刺入身体的匕首，你的新能力还告诉你，你身上的问题远不止这些。 希望你能利用自己的技能和能力，在新环境和大灾变的其他恐怖中生存下来。

messages.msgid: Your first moments of life, born of the elements, alone.  An elemental fae on a dying world, lost in the wilderness.
translations: 你从元素中诞生，生命的最初时刻，便是孤身一人。你是一个元素妖精，身处于一个垂死的世界，迷失在无垠的荒野里。

messages.msgid: You had no idea what was going on the first time it happened, when you woke up with mud on your bare feet and a sour taste in your mouth, but you were soon found.  The People of the Moon, they called themselves, and they said you were one of them.  A werewolf.  You lived out in the wilderness for a while with them.  Maybe some of the People are still out there.
translations: 当“那件事”第一次发生时，你完全不知道是怎么回事。你醒来时，双脚赤裸，沾满泥污，嘴里还泛着酸味，但你很快就被找到了。他们自称“月之民”，说你是他们的一员：一个狼人。你和他们在荒野中生活了一段时间，也许……有些族人至今仍在某处流浪。

messages.msgid: You have no idea what happened, but you're alone in the unspoiled wilderness.  You have mud on your feet, none of your clothes or possessions, and you don't know where you are.  But you have learned there's a beast inside you, and anyone who crosses you had best beware.
translations: 你不知道发生了什么，只发现自己孤身一人，身处一片原始荒野。你赤脚沾泥，身无寸缕，也没有任何个人物品，甚至不知自己身在何方。但你已经了解到，你的体内栖息着一头野兽，任何胆敢与你作对的人，最好当心点。

messages.msgid: For most or all of your life, you've had a secret; you are a predator.  While you don't need to drink blood or eat flesh or anything so crude, you must absorb the spiritual essence, the "ruach", of living beings in order to maintain your health and vitality.  Something happened, and now you're alone in the wilderness, without any of your possessions.  You'd best find others quick, or you'll wither away.
translations: 在你一生的大部分，或全部时间里，你都有一个秘密；你是个掠食者。虽然你不需要喝血或吃肉或任何如此低劣之物，但你必须吸收生命的精神本质，即灵息，以保持你的健康和活力。一些事情发生后，现在你独自一人在荒野中，没有任何财产。你最好快点找到别人，否则将难以避免生命迎来凋零。

messages.msgid: Whether you were visiting Salem's Lot, boating on the Demeter, vacationing to Transylvania, or just another lost boy or girl, you've been bitten by a stranger at twilight the night before.  And to make matters worse, when you woke up, you were alone in the wilderness with no sign of humanity anywhere.  You're going to have to survive somehow.
translations: 也许你曾到访撒冷镇，或是在德墨忒尔号上航行，又或是在特兰西瓦尼亚度假，再或者……你只是又一个迷途的男孩或女孩。但无论如何，就在前一晚的黄昏时分，你被一个陌生人咬了。更糟的是，当你醒来时，你已是孤身一人，身处荒野，不见丝毫人烟。你必须想方设法活下去。
